### [1] [Trimodal Context-Aware Micro-Expression Recognition in Real-World Conversations: A Dataset and a Hierarchical Fusion Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23930)
*Junbo Wang,Yan Zhao,Shigang Wang,Jian Wei,Qiming Zhang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出TriCoME三模态（视觉、音频、文本）真实对话微表情数据集，并设计Hierarchical Focusing Fusion Network（HFFNet）融合对话上下文来提升微表情识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微表情识别方法多为"去上下文"的孤立视频分析，忽略了周围对话中的语义与声学线索；心理学研究表明社会上下文从"如何解读表情"与"表情生成强度"两方面影响面部行为，如对方挑衅性话语可诱发被压抑的负向情绪反应，而孤立无声片段无法捕捉这些信息。

Method: 构建TriCoME数据集：每个微表情配有同时发生的话语及前文上下文，并按会话角色将上下文分为"来自对话者的外部刺激"与"来自被试自身的内部背景"两类。提出HFFNet：细粒度对齐声学与语义流、压缩长对话序列、通过上下文类型嵌入按会话角色调制注意力，并基于视觉置信度在纯视觉与多模态决策间路由样本，避免噪声上下文损害识别。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值；核心结果是提出了带角色标注上下文的三模态真实对话微表情数据集TriCoME及相应融合网络HFFNet。

Conclusion: 将对话上下文（声学、语义）及会话角色结构纳入微表情识别具有重要价值；通过细粒度对齐、序列压缩、角色感知注意力与置信度路由，可在抑制上下文噪声的同时利用上下文线索。

Abstract: Recognizing micro-expressions in real-world conversations is challenging, as these facial movements are brief and faint, and their interpretations are strongly dependent on the contextual circumstances of their occurrence. Most existing methods are de-contextualized, as they analyze isolated video clips while disregarding the semantic and acoustic cues in the surrounding dialogue that help explain the emergence of an expression. Decades of psychological studies have shown that social context exerts influences on facial behavior over two key dimensions: how an expression is interpreted and how strongly it is generated to begin with. However, existing micro-expression research rarely incorporates such contextual factors into its models. As an example, provocative utterances from an interlocutor may elicit suppressed negative affective reactions, which isolated silent clips are unable to account for. We propose TriCoME, a trimodal dataset consisting of visual, audio and text data sourced from real-world conversations. In this dataset, each micro-expression is paired with its concurrent utterance and preceding context. We further annotate the context based on conversational role to denote two categories: external stimuli from an interlocutor's utterance and internal background from the subject's own utterance. On this basis, we propose the Hierarchical Focusing Fusion Network (HFFNet), which aligns acoustic and semantic streams at fine granularity, compresses long dialogue sequences, modulates attention toward conversational roles via a context-type embedding, and routes each sample between visual-only and multimodal decisions based on visual confidence to prevent noisy context from degrading recognition performance.

</details>


### [2] [ProV-Mem: Proactive Memory for Streaming Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23998)
*Bingbing Wang,Jing Li,Han Gao,Yishi Lin,Ruifeng Xu,Peng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProV-Mem 是一个免训练、基于冻结 VLM 的主动式流式视频问答记忆框架，通过时间触发、指令和情节三层轻量记忆分别决定“何时问”“说什么”“是否输出”，并在 ProactiveVideoQA 四个场景上取得最优 CAUC 与多个最优 PAUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式流式视频问答要求模型持续监测视频流并自主决定何时说话、说什么、是否输出。现有系统难以兼顾：保留长视觉历史成本高，而丢弃历史又会导致漏检事件和重复回答。

Method: 提出 ProV-Mem，免训练、围绕冻结 VLM 主干。将主动决策分解为三层轻量记忆：1）时间触发记忆控制何时查询主干并从长时间静默中恢复；2）指令记忆通过固定提示先验引导简洁且视觉有据的生成；3）情节记忆通过过滤近似重复回答来决定是否输出。在理想化条件充分性假设下推导了匹配分解过程与全状态联合策略的分段近似界。同时提出 CAUC 指标，在 PAUC 基础上对冗余、过频和过长输出进行折扣。

Result: 在 ProactiveVideoQA 四个场景上，ProV-Mem 在所有场景取得最佳 CAUC，在 WEB、EGO、TV 上取得最佳 PAUC，并保持较低的每次响应推理延迟。

Conclusion: 分层轻量记忆加免训练设计可有效实现低成本的主动式流式视频问答，并通过 CAUC 更全面地衡量输出的冗余与效率。

Abstract: Proactive streaming video question answering requires a model to continuously monitor an incoming stream and autonomously decide when to speak, what to say, and whether to emit a response. Existing streaming systems face a fundamental difficulty: retaining long visual histories is costly, whereas discarding them can lead to missed events and repeated responses. We propose \textbf{ProV-Mem}, a training-free proactive memory framework built around a frozen VLM backbone. ProV-Mem decomposes the proactive decision into three lightweight memory tiers: a temporal-trigger memory controls when to query the backbone and recovers from prolonged silence, an instructional memory guides what to say through a fixed prompting prior for concise and visually grounded generation, and an episodic memory determines whether to emit by filtering near-duplicate responses. Under an idealized conditional-sufficiency assumption, we derive a stagewise approximation bound relating the decomposed process to a full-state joint policy. We further introduce Cost-Aware Area Under the Curve (\textbf{CAUC}), which extends PAUC by explicitly discounting redundant, overly frequent, and unnecessarily long emissions. Experiments on the four scenarios of ProactiveVideoQA show that ProV-Mem achieves the best CAUC across all scenarios and the best PAUC on WEB, EGO, and TV, while maintaining low per-response inference latency.

</details>


### [3] [UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24791)
*Kien T. Pham,Yuhao Liu,Chong Hou Choi,Zhenqi He,Yanghao Wang,Chenyang Lei,Rui Liu,Qifeng Chen,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniAVC，用一套权重统一实现文本条件音视频联合生成、双向跨模态生成与指令引导编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法受限于稀缺的配对数据，把能力浪费在单模态即可学到的单支路生成/编辑上，而非跨模态耦合；且共享噪声调度忽视音视频信息密度差异（视频需更长高噪声阶段，音频可更早收敛），并导致单向条件的不对称工作流缺乏训练。

Method: 先用充足单模态数据把各支路训练到完整的生成与编辑能力，再将配对数据专用于学习跨模态对应关系；引入模态解耦调度器，从共享时间步为各模态独立扭曲噪声曲线；用含单一干净模态的子任务直接监督不对称配置。

Result: 实现意图感知编辑（保持一模态不变、约束另一模态）与推理后自精炼（仅对不满意支路针对已接受支路重生成）；单套权重覆盖多种创作任务，无需任务专属适配器。

Conclusion: 数据分配策略与解耦噪声调度的结合，使统一音视频创作模型摆脱配对数据瓶颈与共享调度的限制。

Abstract: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.

</details>


### [4] [Local Evidence, Global Failure: Diagnosing Speech-Vision Temporal Composition in Audio-Visual Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25352)
*Jaehong Myung,Seunghun Oh,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的TED诊断框架，将音视频大模型的全视频语音-视觉决策拆解为局部视觉验证与相对语音区间的证据聚合，证明局部可恢复的证据在整段视频提问下常被遗漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AV-LLM在整段视频问答中常做出错误决策，尽管相关视觉证据在局部时间窗口内是可获取的。作者希望弄清"局部可行"与"全视频决策失败"之间的落差来源。

Method: TED为免训练诊断框架：先用ASR获得转录文本与话语时间段；再在无音频的时间窗口上，用转录文本进行时序对齐与时序预测（Temporal Alignment/Forecasting），或用答案候选做跨模态时序绑定；最后相对该话语区间聚合证据。并设计查询替换、时间区域可得性固定、物理隔离与计时捷径等对照实验排除替代解释。

Result: 在四个冻结AV-LLM与SVHalluc数据集上，Temporal Forecasting准确率从全视频提问的29.3-33.7%提升至TED的79.3-82.2%；查询替换会降低恢复效果；在固定时间区域可得性时锚点仍有收益；对照实验排除了物理隔离与计时捷径解释。

Conclusion: 局部可恢复的证据不等于成功的全视频决策，二者需区分；应显式分离叙述内容、话语时间与时序索引的视觉证据，为AV-LLM评测与改进提供方向。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) can fail at full-video speech-vision decisions even when useful visual evidence is locally recoverable. We introduce Temporal Evidence Decomposition (TED), a training-free diagnostic framework that separates local visual verification from speech-relative aggregation. Automatic speech recognition supplies a transcript and utterance interval. TED queries audio-free windows with the transcript for Temporal Alignment and Forecasting, or answer candidates for Cross-Modal Temporal Binding, then aggregates evidence relative to that interval. Across four frozen AV-LLMs on SVHalluc, Temporal Forecasting accuracy rises from 29.3-33.7% under full-video questioning to 79.3-82.2% with TED. Query replacement reduces recovery; the observed anchor remains beneficial when temporal-region availability is held fixed. Physical-isolation and timing-shortcut controls test alternative explanations. The findings distinguish locally recoverable evidence from successful full-video decisions, motivating explicit separation of narration content, utterance timing, and time-indexed visual evidence.

</details>


### [5] [Multi-View Structural Representations for Physically-Consistent TeX Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25695)
*Daoheng Li,Jianjun Qian*,Mengkai Yan,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MVR-MoE框架，利用红外与可见光多视图结构表示与层次路由MoE，实现物理一致的低光图像生成，减少对配对数据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外与可见光图像提供互补线索，物理方法能更好利用这种互补性，但现有物理方法严重依赖配对数据，限制其应用。

Method: 从红外与可见光图像挖掘内在结构线索，组织为多视图表示；提出多视图超连接扩展特征空间，保留共享证据与模态特有细节；层次路由机制在结构视图层与专家层调节特征利用；预测温度、发射率与纹理图，并用斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律约束以保证物理一致性。

Result: 在挑战性数据集上的大量实验表明，MVR-MoE具有更优的鲁棒性与判别力，同时保持轻量化。

Conclusion: MVR-MoE通过多视图路由混合专家与物理约束，有效缓解配对数据依赖，实现物理一致且轻量的低光图像生成。

Abstract: Infrared and visible images provide complementary cues for low-light image generation, and physics-based methods can better exploit this complementarity. However, existing physics-based methods still rely heavily on paired data. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-View Routing Mixture-of-Experts (MVR-MoE), a framework for physically consistent TeX generation that learns multi-view structural representations. MVR-MoE mines intrinsic structural cues from infrared and visible images to organize them into multi-view representations, while the proposed multi-view hyper connections expand the feature space and preserve both shared evidence and modality-specific details. A hierarchical routing mechanism further regulates feature utilization at both the structural-view level and the expert level, enabling adaptive exploitation of heterogeneous cues. The predicted temperature, emissivity, and texture maps are constrained by the Stefan-Boltzmann law to ensure physically consistent. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate that MVR-MoE achieves superior robustness and discriminability while remaining lightweight.

</details>


### [6] [I$^2$-Med: Interpretable Medical Inference through Visual-Guided Dynamic Logits Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23858)
*Md Sajid,Shreeyut Maheshwari,Akshat Mishra,Ritik Mishra,Mohammad Tanveer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的I²-Med推理框架，通过视觉引导模块在生成时校正输出分数，提升医学视觉语言模型的视觉忠实度并减少视觉幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言任务需要精确的视觉定位和临床连贯的解释，但复杂成像模式与专家标注稀缺导致传统推理方法效果差，模型易产生视觉幻觉（生成不基于图像输入的文本），限制临床应用。

Method: 提出无需额外训练的可解释医学推理框架I²-Med。在文本生成过程中引入视觉引导模块，逐个检查候选词是否被医学图像支持且与当前推理一致，据此调整模型的输出分数以偏好视觉有据的词，而不改变模型参数。

Result: 在OmniMedVQA基准（涵盖8种医学成像模态和5类临床问题类型）上，I²-Med能生成更具临床意义且视觉忠实的推理链，并在标准医学VQA指标下减少视觉幻觉。

Conclusion: I²-Med在不训练的情况下有效提升医学视觉语言模型推理与解释的忠实度，缓解视觉幻觉，提高临床应用可行性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Medical vision language models have demonstrated strong potential for medical image understanding and reasoning. However, their interpretability and reliability remain limited because medical vision language tasks require precise visual grounding and clinically coherent explanations. This is particularly challenging due to complex imaging patterns and scarce expert annotations. These challenges reduce the effectiveness of conventional reasoning methods and lead to visual hallucination, defined as the generation of text that is not grounded in the given visual input, which further limits their applicability in clinical practice. To mitigate these challenges, we propose an interpretable medical inference (I$^2$-Med) framework that enhances visual faithfulness during inference without additional training to improve reasoning and explanation faithfulness in medical vision language models. During text generation, I$^2$-Med uses a visual guidance module to check whether each candidate word is supported by the medical image and consistent with the current reasoning. Based on this guidance, the model's output scores are adjusted to favor visually grounded words, without changing the model parameters. Extensive experiments on the OmniMedVQA benchmark, covering eight medical imaging modalities and five clinical question types, demonstrate that our proposed I$^2$-Med framework generates more clinically meaningful and visually faithful reasoning chains and reduces visual hallucination under standard medical VQA evaluation metrics. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/mtanveer1/l2-med}.

</details>


### [7] [Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23890)
*Cai Ke,Xinghao Chen,Yuanchen Bei,Yuni Lai,Keyu Chen,Ruizhi Qiao,Siyu An,Junnan Dong,Ruifeng Xu,Xing Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LMMR神经符号框架，将长时多模态记忆组织到连续潜空间中，用稀疏自编码器概念空间构建turn级多模态记忆图，并注入生成骨干，在Mem-Gallery九项任务与MemEye十二项设置上显著超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期个性化智能体需跨模态、跨会话推理分布式的历史与演化对话状态；现有扁平跨模态方法过早压缩视觉证据、观测时间陈旧，且未统一多模态与跨会话证据；原始多模态记忆纠缠异构，细粒度视觉落地与跨模态推理代价过高。

Method: (i) 将文本隐状态与视觉patch特征映射到共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间，以稀疏激活作为公共语义地址，动态构建turn级多模态记忆图，避免图像转文本与静态检索；(ii) 用图编码器在任务相关潜子图上聚合跨模态与时间依赖，将图读出作为连续残差rollout注入生成骨干，同时保留原始视觉token以保留细粒度细节。

Result: 在九个Mem-Gallery任务和十二种MemEye设置上的大量实验表明，LMMR在捕获复杂多模态依赖方面显著优于SOTA基线，并能生成忠实且有据可依的响应。

Conclusion: 将长时多模态记忆组织于连续潜空间并结合神经符号图推理，是统一跨模态、跨会话证据的有效途径，可兼顾细粒度视觉保真与高效跨模态推理。

Abstract: Long-term personalized agents are required to reason over distributed history across modalities and evolving dialogue states. While existing flat cross-modal methods compress visual evidence prematurely and struggle with temporally stale observations, they neglect the necessity to unify multimodal and cross-session evidence. Crucially, raw multimodal memories are inherently entangled and heterogeneous, making fine-grained visual grounding and cross-modal reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present latent multimodal memory reasoning, i.e., LMMR, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term multimodal memory organization into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of converting images to text and relying on static retrieval, LMMR maps both textual hidden states and visual patch features into a shared Sparse Autoencoder concept space, establishing sparse activations as common semantic addresses to dynamically construct a turn-level multimodal memory graph. (ii) A graph encoder then aggregates cross-modal and temporal dependencies across the task-specific latent subgraph, injecting the graph readout as a continuous residual rollout into the generation backbone while retaining native visual tokens to preserve fine-grained details. Extensive experiments on nine Mem-Gallery tasks and twelve MemEye settings demonstrate that LMMR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing complex multimodal dependencies while enabling faithful and grounded responses.

</details>


### [8] [EMMA: Event-Driven Multimodal Memory System with Multi-Agent Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23892)
*Ruochen Zhao,Jiazheng Kang,Gezi Li,Dongying Lin,Ting Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EMMA 是一个事件驱动的多模态记忆系统，用多智能体检索实现长视频理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频时长远超 MLLM 上下文窗口，现有固定长度切分导致事件碎片化、无关内容被合并，检索噪声大。

Method: 三阶段：(1) 双流事件分割，融合视觉语义漂移与语音转折自适应定位事件边界；(2) 构建原始视频/片段级/事件级三层记忆层级；(3) 多智能体检索，含查询分解、分层搜索、证据校验与答案生成，由粗到细定位证据。

Result: 在三个挑战性基准上取得显著提升，验证了事件对齐记忆系统的有效性。

Conclusion: 以语义事件为单位组织记忆并结合多智能体分层检索，可有效缓解长视频检索噪声问题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Long video understanding requires reasoning over hours of content that far exceed the context window of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches compress video into fixed-length clips, yet events are fragmented and unrelated content is merged, yielding noisy retrieval. To overcome this challenge, we propose EMMA, an Event-driven Multimodal Memory system with Multi-Agent retrieval, which organizes memory around semantic events in three stages: (1) Event segmentation: a dual-stream detector adaptively locates event boundaries by fusing visual semantic drift with spoken transitions, rather than fixed windows. (2) Memory construction: built on the detected events, a three-level hierarchy of raw video, clip-level memory, and event-level memory stores content at progressively higher semantic abstraction. (3) Memory retrieval: a multi-agent framework collaboratively queries this hierarchy through query decomposition, tiered search, evidence validation, and answer generation, narrowing evidence from coarse events to precise clips. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements, showing the effectiveness of our event-aligned memory system. Code, prompt templates, and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/BAI-LAB/EMMA.

</details>


### [9] [Path-Conditioned Attention Mobility: From Depth to Execution Hubs in SegFormer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23893)
*Aleksandr Druzhinin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过实验研究分层视觉Transformer中注意力头的"深度局部可迁移性"，提出路径条件下的深度→宽度重排（FOLDED_VEC），将SegFormer-B5的120个Stage-3头从40个执行深度压缩到20个hub，mIoU无显著损失且L4延迟降低3–5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer压缩通常把"保留的注意力容量"与"执行该容量的串行深度数"混为一谈。作者想探究：层级式ViT中任务相关的注意力功能能否在深度上局部移动，以及能否借此把冗余的执行深度转化为宽度以减少串行开销。

Method: 以SegFormer-B5人体分割为对象，测试注意力头向邻近深度迁移的效果（头单独迁移 vs. 头与代表边界联合适配 vs. 替换供体特定的归一化和空间降采样预处理）。基于"路径条件可迁移性"，将同一120头预算从40个执行深度合并为20个执行hub（K20），并设计布局匹配的三随机种子恢复对照；部署上用FOLDED_VEC保留供体特定路径并向量化执行。

Result: K20在恢复控制下mIoU 0.960686±0.000059，对照State120为0.960400±0.000074，配对差+0.000285，但配对图像bootstrap置信区间含零，故判定为"无可测质量损失"而非统计优越。FOLDED_VEC相对同120头State120父模型，在NVIDIA L4上batch 1/4/8端到端延迟分别降低5.28%、3.15%、3.58%。

Conclusion: 注意力冗余不仅包含可移除的容量，还包含执行深度冗余；但迁移功能必须保留其计算路径（供体特定归一化与预处理），头与边界的联合适配是关键。该发现为深度→宽度的结构化压缩与部署加速提供了途径。

Abstract: Transformer compression often couples two distinct quantities: retained attention capacity and the number of sequential depths at which that capacity is executed. We study whether useful attention functions in a hierarchical vision transformer are locally mobile across depth. Using SegFormer-B5 for human segmentation, we find that some task-relevant attention heads can be relocated to nearby depths, but only when their computational context is respected. Head-only relocation is insufficient, while joint adaptation of the relocated head and surrounding representation boundary improves functional preservation; replacing donor-specific normalization and spatial-reduction preprocessing causes large degradation. We use this path-conditioned mobility to reorganize retained attention from depth into width. Starting from a fixed parent with 120 retained Stage-3 heads across 40 attention execution depths, we consolidate the same 120-head budget into 20 execution hubs. Under a layout-matched three-seed recovery control, K20 reaches 0.960686 +/- 0.000059 mIoU versus 0.960400 +/- 0.000074 for the corresponding State120 control. The paired point difference is +0.000285, while a paired image-bootstrap confidence interval includes zero; we therefore interpret the result as no measurable quality penalty rather than statistical superiority. For deployment, FOLDED_VEC preserves donor-specific paths while vectorizing their execution. Relative to the same 120-head State120 parent, it reduces end-to-end NVIDIA L4 latency by 5.28%, 3.15%, and 3.58% at batch sizes 1, 4, and 8. These results suggest that attention redundancy includes not only removable capacity but also execution-depth redundancy, provided that the computational path defining a relocated function is preserved.

</details>


### [10] [GeoForward: Geometry-Guided Cross-View Alignment for Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23895)
*Yiming Shu,Peng Sun,Lang Zhang,Mingyue Feng,Yaonong Wang,Pei Liu,Chen Sun,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何条件化前馈重建新范式并实现GeoForward，用标定相机与稀疏LiDAR显式建立跨视角对应，再用视觉特征精化，在nuScenes上取得最低跨相机深度一致性误差和Chamfer距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3D重建遵循外观驱动范式：从多视角图像编码视觉表示、隐式推断跨视角对应再预测3D基元。但标定相机与稀疏度量测量已提供同一物理点在各视角应出现位置的显式约束，这种显式几何信息未被充分利用。

Method: 提出Geometry-Conditioned Feedforward Reconstruction范式：在形成3D表示之前先用度量几何建立跨视角对应，视觉特征只做精化而非发现。具体地，稀疏LiDAR点反投影到3D并解析投影到各标定相机，得到度量对应锚点；用有界连续局部搜索结合视觉特征精化锚点；将几何条件化表示与VGGT的全局多视角上下文融合；共享表示分别驱动度量深度与高斯属性预测，打通显式几何到高斯中心及空间属性的直接路径；稀疏3D精化模块在保持几何决定中心的前提下改善局部属性兼容性；时序重建用车辆掩码和运动先验组合端点高斯。

Result: 在nuScenes上，相比对比方法取得最低的跨相机深度一致性误差与Chamfer距离，同时保持有竞争力的重建质量。

Conclusion: 显式以度量几何条件化对应关系的形成，是纯外观驱动前馈3D重建的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Feedforward 3D reconstruction has largely followed an {appearance-driven paradigm}: multi-view images are encoded into visual representations, cross-view correspondence is implicitly inferred from learned features, and 3D primitives are subsequently predicted from these representations. However, calibrated cameras and sparse metric measurements already provide explicit constraints on where the same physical point should appear across views. We propose a novel paradigm, \textbf{Geometry-Conditioned Feedforward Reconstruction}, in which metric geometry establishes cross-view correspondence before the 3D representation is formed, while learned visual features refine rather than discover this correspondence. Based on this paradigm, we introduce \textbf{GeoForward}. Sparse LiDAR points are unprojected into 3D and analytically projected across calibrated cameras to provide metric correspondence anchors. A bounded continuous local search then refines these anchors using visual features, and the resulting geometry-conditioned representation is fused with global multi-view context from VGGT. The shared representation drives separate metric-depth and Gaussian-attribute prediction, establishing a direct path from explicit geometry to both Gaussian centers and spatial attributes. A sparse 3D refinement module subsequently improves local attribute compatibility while preserving the geometrically determined centers. For temporal reconstruction, endpoint Gaussians are composed using vehicle masks and motion priors. On nuScenes, GeoForward achieves the lowest cross-camera depth-consistency error and Chamfer distance among the compared methods while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. These results demonstrate that explicitly conditioning correspondence formation on metric geometry provides an effective alternative to purely appearance-driven feedforward 3D reconstruction.

</details>


### [11] [RhinoNet: Unsupervised Learning for Phenoscaping and Generation of High Dimensional Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23898)
*Siddharth Viswanath,Hiren Madhu,Eddie Cavallin,Benjamin Jones,Alistair Wilkinson,Christopher Tape,Michael Perlmutter,Rex Ying,Ian Adelstein,Smita Krishnaswamy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RhinoNet 是一个基于单纯复形的点云神经网络，为高维点云（如单细胞数据队列）学习保几何的隐空间嵌入，并支持在群体层面进行生成建模（phenoscaping）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞等高维数据以点云（患者数据队列）形式存在，现有方法（如 static maps）无法在患者/群体层面产生结构化的表示，也缺少从该表示生成完整点云的能力。作者希望把表示学习与生成建模从单点层面提升到点云/群体层面。

Method: 将每个点云视为单纯复形：数据点为顶点，边由 Vietoris-Rips 过滤学习得到；用单纯形小波与 MLP 层结合自编码器得到每个数据集的隐向量；并优化隐空间使成对点云间的最优传输距离在隐表示间得以保持。生成方面给出两种方式：(1) 隐空间 flow matching，(2) 隐空间测地插值，再解码回点云空间。

Result: 在患者单细胞数据上，RhinoNet 生成有组织的 phenoscape，而 static maps 等方法无法做到；可通过采样并解码 phenoscape 生成完整点云；在单细胞与空间数据队列上相较所测基线取得 SOTA 性能。

Conclusion: RhinoNet 把表示学习与生成建模提升到点云/群体层面，并给出了用于 phenoscaping 的神经模型。

Abstract: We present RhinoNet, a simplicial complex-based point cloud neural network, that creates a geometry-preserving embedding of high-dimensional point clouds. RhinoNet takes collections of datasets, also called {\em data cohorts}, and processes each dataset (point cloud) within the cohort as a simplicial complex. These simplicial complexes have datapoints as vertices and edges learned by Vietoris-Rips filtration. Using simplicial wavelets and MLP layers, RhinoNet computes a vector representation of each dataset in a latent space produced by an autoencoder. The latent space is optimized such that an optimal transport distance between pairs of point clouds is preserved between the latent representations. We apply RhinoNet to single-cell datasets collected on patients---a common source of such high-dimensional data. RhinoNet creates a patient level representation, known in biological contexts as a phenoscape. We establish that RhinoNet generates organized phenoscapes, whereas other methods such as static maps do not. Next we show that we can generate entire point clouds by sampling and decoding this phenoscape. We show two modes of generation via 1) latent flow matching and 2) geodesic interpolation in latent space, followed by a decoding back into the point cloud space. RhinoNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on single-cell and spatial data cohorts relative to tested baselines. Overall, RhinoNet lifts the concepts of representation learning and generative modeling to the point cloud or population level and defines a neural model for phenoscaping.

</details>


### [12] [EAGLE: Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer for Partially Polygon-Supervised Object Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23900)
*Naveen Stewart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于信息论与统计形状分析的逐类几何复杂度度量框架，并据此设计轻量后处理模块 EAGLE，融合边缘细化与熵引导重打分，提升定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用边界框监督的检测器在高IoU阈值下几何精度不足；全多边形监督标注昂贵，部分多边形（partial polygon）监督在低形状复杂度类别上反而会干扰框定位、降低性能。缺少量化"每类几何复杂度"的手段来判断何时使用掩码信息。

Method: 结合信息论（熵）与统计形状分析构造数学框架，量化逐类几何复杂度；在此基础上提出 Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer (EAGLE)——轻量、可插拔的训练后模型头，学习几何信息，通过边缘细化（edge refinement）与基于熵的重打分（localization rescoring）改进定位。

Result: 在 MS COCO 与 Pascal SBD 上，熵框架能有效预测形状重建误差及掩码派生预测与标准框预测之间的精度差异；EAGLE 在已有 SOTA 检测框架上稳定提升，MS COCO 上 +0.9 mAP50-95，推理开销极小。

Conclusion: 几何复杂度可被理论量化且具有实用预测力，据此指导掩码信息的使用；EAGLE 以低开销、后训练方式为现有检测器提供一致的定位增益，缓解全/部分多边形监督的实际局限。

Abstract: Object detection is a critical application of computer vision, yet models trained uniformly on bounding boxes lack the geometric precision to be fully effective in inference settings, especially at high IoU thresholds. One common approach is the introduction of polygon-supervised localization, where a model is trained explicitly for localization but with access to polygon masks during training. Among such methods, partial polygon supervision is viable due to the higher annotation costs of developing fully supervised training datasets. However, this introduces a further challenge: in object classes of relatively low shape complexity, the addition of training masks and subsequent segmentation loss may obscure box localization, often worsening model performance despite access to deeper geometric information. To address the practical limitations of both full and partial polygon supervision, we introduce a mathematical framework for quantifying per-class geometric complexity by combining information theory and statistical shape analysis. With this framework, we develop Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer (EAGLE), a lightweight, post-training model head that learns geometric information for the localization model, improving accuracy via edge refinement and localization rescoring using entropy-informed updates. Empirical analysis across MS COCO and Pascal SBD demonstrates the entropy framework meaningfully predicts shape reconstruction error and accuracy differences among mask-derived and standard box predictions, while the implemented EAGLE framework achieves consistent improvement on already SOTA detection frameworks (+0.9 mAP50-95 points on MS COCO) at minimal observed inference overhead.

</details>


### [13] [Rethinking weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs: position nulls, protocol dependence, and PACE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23902)
*Shixin Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 弱监督胸部X线定位论文报告的单一重叠精度在不同论文间不可比。作者量化了"一个检测框包含多少信息"，发现两个位置零对照模型在多数发现上即可被超越、三个少被说明的选择（结果制度、提取阈值、掩膜转框规则）即可使结果产生超过多数方法效应的波动；据此提出PACE方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督胸部X线定位工作仅以单一重叠精度指标汇报，跨论文数字不可比，缺乏对评测协议依赖性与方法真实增益的严格度量。

Method: 引入"位置零对照"（保留读出自身框、只移动位置）作为基线；系统改变结果制度、阈值、掩膜转框规则等评估选择并测量影响；提出PACE方法，将标签训练头给出的发现身份与不接触病理标签的冻结X线骨干给出的空间证据相乘，并用匹配面积分析评估。

Result: CAM与Grad-CAM仅在ChestX-ray14的7个标注发现中2–4个、CheXlocalize的8个中2个超过零对照；三位放射科医生在4–7个发现上超越零对照。三个评估选择的影响超过多数方法效应，掩膜碎片化可预测转框损失；仅用预测框面积即可逆转配对比较。PACE在匹配面积分析中提升两数据集的严格重叠精度并优于标签派生第二图，但在三种读出中最不忠实于分类器因果图，优势依赖框规则，且所有设计选择均在评分框上做出，其单一迁移实验胜负各一。

Conclusion: 弱监督定位的报道数字高度依赖评测协议，零对照与协议消融应成为标准报告项；PACE展示了方法增益，但其收益有条件且存在诚实披露的局限。

Abstract: Weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs is reported as a single overlap accuracy, and those numbers are not comparable across papers. We measure what one contains. Against position-null controls that keep a readout's own box and move only its position, class activation mapping and its gradient-weighted variant beat the null on two to four of seven annotated findings on ChestX-ray14 and two of eight on CheXlocalize. The null is beatable: three board-certified radiologists clear it on four to seven. Three rarely stated choices each move a result by more than most reported method effects: the results regime, the extraction threshold, and the mask-to-box rule, whose cost is predicted by how fragmented the thresholded mask is. Predicted box area alone reverses a paired comparison. These measurements produced PACE, for \emph{population anomaly and class evidence}, which multiplies the finding identity from the label-trained head by the spatial evidence from a frozen radiograph backbone that never sees a pathology label. It is the case study that made the protocol dependence visible, and we report its costs beside its gain: in an exploratory matched-area analysis it improves strict-overlap accuracy on both corpora and beats a label-derived second map, but it is the least faithful of the three readouts to the classifier's causal map, its advantage depends on the box rule, and, this benchmark releasing no localization validation set, every design choice behind it was made on the boxes it is scored on. Its one clean transfer beats one baseline and loses to the other.

</details>


### [14] [AI-Experiment: an augmented reality art project co-created with artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23903)
*Bernhard Egger,Hans Furer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 艺术家、计算机科学家与生成式AI协作创作实体艺术品：用艺术家作品照片微调潜扩散模型生成同风格图，再由艺术家以丙烯重绘部分生成图，并叠加基于生成式视频模型的AR效果，公开部分训练数据、代码与AR体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索艺术家、计算机科学家与生成式AI之间协同创作的可能性，将AI生成内容落地为实体艺术品并增强其互动体验。

Method: 以特定艺术家作品照片微调潜扩散模型，生成同风格合成作品；从中筛选子集由原艺术家用丙烯在画布上重绘；再结合生成式视频模型添加增强现实组件，使作品"活起来"。

Result: 产出含实体画作与AR体验的混合艺术品，并随论文开源部分艺术品（训练数据）、生成代码及AR体验，供艺术、科研与教育使用。

Conclusion: 展示了人机协同的艺术创作流程可作为可复现范式，开源资源有利于推动AI艺术的研究与教学。

Abstract: We describe the creation of a physical artwork that was performed in synergy between an artist, a computer scientist and generative AI tools. A latent diffusion model was finetuned on photographs of the artwork of the specific artist and the generative model then generated synthetic artworks in a similar style. From the generated artworks a subset was selected to be painted again with acrylic on canvas by the original artist. In addition to the physical artifact an augmented reality component was added which brings the artwork to life with a set of generative video models. Together with this paper we release part of the artwork (training data), the code that was deployed to generate the artwork as well as the augmented reality experience for arts, research and education under https://github.com/BernhardEgger/ARTimate

</details>


### [15] [LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23904)
*Liwei Che,Benlin Liu,Dai Li,Xiangyan Li,Zijian Wu,Changjiang Li,Minghao Guo,Chengzhi Mao,Vladimir Pavlovic,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LVMH将长视频记忆策略开发转化为多目标代码搜索，自动发现SEEM策略，在准确率、token和延迟上同时大幅优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频智能体需在有限token与延迟预算内处理数小时至数天的多模态证据，记忆设计本质是上下文管理问题；现有记忆系统多依赖手工设计策略，如何在性能与效率间联合优化记忆尚不明确。

Method: 提出LVMH自动化多智能体框架，将记忆策略开发形式化为围绕固定答案模型的多目标代码搜索；通过实现与独立评审分离、设置受保护的观测边界防止自我认证与开发集过拟合；用持久化元记忆记录历史提案、轨迹、成本与失败以指导后续修订。借该框架发现"文本优先、视觉其次"的SEEM策略：基于紧凑结构化事件记忆与证据专家作答，并通过选择性视觉门控按需查询局部帧。

Result: 在EgoLifeQA上演化的策略可泛化至未见基准，在Ego-R1 Bench与Video-MME (L)（GPT-5 mini）上均超过Meta-Harness；三个基准上SEEM+GPT-5平均准确率65.7%，较此前SOTA高7.7个百分点，平均评估token用量约降32倍，平均响应时间约缩短91倍。

Conclusion: 自动化、元记忆驱动的多智能体搜索能有效发现兼顾性能与效率的长视频记忆策略，且学得策略具备跨基准泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-video agents must map hours or days of multimodal evidence into a bounded context while respecting token and latency budgets, making memory design a context-management challenge. Existing memory systems largely rely on hand-designed policies, leaving open how to jointly optimize memory design for performance and efficiency. We propose Long Video Meta-memory Harness (LVMH), an automated multi-agent framework that formulates memory-policy development as multi-objective code search around a fixed answer model. To guard against self-certification and development-set overfitting, LVMH separates implementation from independent review and enforces protected observation boundaries. Persistent meta-memory records past proposals, traces, costs, and failures to guide subsequent policy revisions. Through this harness, we discover Self-Evolving Evidence Memory (SEEM), a "text-first, vision-second" policy that answers from compact structured event memory and evidence specialists, consulting localized frames through a selective visual gate. The policy evolved on EgoLifeQA generalizes to unseen benchmarks, outperforming Meta-Harness on both Ego-R1 Bench and Video-MME (L) with GPT-5 mini. Across the three benchmarks, SEEM with GPT-5 achieves 65.7% average accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 7.7 percentage points with approximately 32x lower average evaluation token use and 91x shorter average response time.

</details>


### [16] [Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23905)
*Wajeeh Atrash,Tom Tirer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出用实例特定的CFG尺度替代固定CFG，并训练轻量网络预测编辑指标以实现快速选择，从而在LPIPS与CLIP-T权衡上优于现有编辑方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于文本到图像扩散/流模型的提示式图像编辑需要在保持原图（LPIPS）与实现目标提示变化（CLIP-T）之间权衡，该权衡通常由CFG尺度控制；但现有编辑方法多使用固定CFG尺度，忽略了不同编辑需要不同程度的修改。

Method: 首先通过在基准数据集上以广泛CFG尺度范围反复运行主流编辑方法，系统探究实例特定CFG的潜在收益；为避免重复执行编辑管线的低效，训练一个轻量神经网络，对给定编辑实例和CFG尺度预测底层编辑方法的指标；推理时用这些预测快速选择实例特定CFG尺度。

Result: 实例特定CFG设置能在不损害CLIP-T的情况下显著改善LPIPS；在多种编辑方法与基准设置上的实验表明，该方法相较基线方法具有性能优势。

Conclusion: 采用实例自适应CFG尺度可有效提升提示式图像编辑的权衡表现，轻量预测网络提供了快速可行的实现方式。

Abstract: In recent years, a variety of prompt-based image editing methods have been developed based on text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow models. Image editing introduces an inherent trade-off between adhering to the original source image and realizing the change specified by the target prompt, which are typically measured by the LPIPS and CLIP-T metrics, respectively. Intuitively, this trade-off can be controlled by the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Most existing editing methods, though, use a fixed CFG scale, ignoring that different edits require varying levels of modification. In this paper, we first explore the potential benefits of using an instance-specific CFG by exhaustively re-running prominent editing methods with a wide range of CFG scale values on benchmark datasets. We show that instance-specific setting can significantly improve LPIPS without compromising CLIP-T. Yet, tuning based on repeatedly executing an editing pipeline is inefficient. To prevent slow inference, we train a light-weight neural network that predicts the metrics of the underlying editing method for a given edit instance and CFG scale. At inference time, these predictions enable fast selection of an instance-specific CFG scale. Experiments across multiple editing methods and benchmark settings show the performance advantage of our approach over the baseline methods.

</details>


### [17] [Beyond Generator-Specific Shortcuts: Open-World AI-Generated Video Detection via Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23906)
*Qi Zhou,Yuanfan Li,Huiqi Deng,Hongbin Pei,Yazhe Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FORGE框架，通过梯度引导的嵌入扰动掩盖生成器特定线索，提升开放世界AIGV检测的跨生成器泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGV检测器在开放世界下对未见生成器泛化差；分析发现检测器表征强编码生成器特定线索，导致ID-OOD性能大幅下降，且简单扰动生成器敏感token反而降低OOD性能，说明生成器线索与检测证据仅部分可分离。

Method: FORGE：token级对抗训练框架。识别与生成器捷径强相关但对真假判别不太关键的token，训练时选择性扰动这些token；通过攻击者与检测器同步对抗训练，抑制生成器依赖模式、保留取证证据，学习可迁移的生成器不变表征。

Result: 在29个留出基准条目上平均F1达92.62，比8个强基线高5.31分；在四种常见后处理攻击下保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 通过针对性混淆生成器特定线索的对抗训练，可有效提升开放世界AIGV检测的泛化性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection is increasingly important for mitigating misinformation, impersonation, and other malicious uses of synthetic media, yet existing detectors often generalize poorly to unseen generators in open-world settings. To better understand this challenge, we analyze the failure modes of AIGV detectors under cross-generator out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and observe that detector representations strongly encode generator-specific cues, which are associated with substantial ID-OOD performance drops. Further analysis shows that naively perturbing generator-sensitive tokens can even reduce OOD performance, indicating that generator-related cues and detection-relevant evidence are only partially separable. Motivated by these findings, we propose Forensic Obfuscation of geneRator-specific cues via Gradient-guided Embedding perturbation (FORGE), a token-aware adversarial training framework for open-world AIGV detection. FORGE identifies tokens that are strongly associated with generator-specific shortcuts yet less critical to real/fake discrimination, and selectively perturbs them during training to suppress generator-dependent patterns while preserving useful forensic evidence. Through synchronized adversarial training between an attacker and a detector, FORGE encourages the detector to learn more transferable generator-invariant forensic representations. Experiments on 29 held-out benchmark entries show that FORGE achieves an average F1 of 92.62, outperforming eight strong baselines by 5.31 points, while also remaining robust under four common post-processing attacks. We will release our code and datasets upon acceptance.

</details>


### [18] [EgoVine: Post-Training with Branching Experience Compiled from Real-World Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23907)
*Qinchuan Cheng,Bowen Lyu,Zhantao Gong,Angela Yao,Cheston Tan,Shijie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoVine是一个后训练框架，将固定的第一人称演示视频转化为可交互的经验，用符号化可执行环境让紧凑规划器探索替代动作并从错误中恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实第一人称视频记录的是单一的成功轨迹，学习器无法从中探索替代动作，也无法学习如何从自身错误中恢复，不利于长时程规划能力的培养。

Method: 把真实视频标注编译成可执行的符号化环境，智能体需在部分可观测下协调物体操作并考虑延迟后果；通过恢复决策状态来探索替代动作并比较最终结果；提出Union，用同一模型联合训练动作生成与后果预测；用经验证的修复为失败尝试补充恢复目标，并通过采样后续轨迹间的比较指导策略更新，形成迭代循环。

Result: 在共享基准上，EgoVine-1.5B在Main规划任务上达到81.8%成功率，在更长任务组合上达到66.7%，两项均优于所有评估的Flash LLM基线。

Conclusion: EgoVine把真实演示与迭代学习过程连接起来，使紧凑规划器能在录制轨迹之外学习选择与未来后果。

Abstract: Real-world egocentric videos capture multi-step household procedures, but their recorded trajectories leave alternative actions and recovery from the learner's own mistakes largely unexplored. We introduce EgoVine, a post-training framework that turns a fixed demonstration set into interactive experience for long-horizon planning. EgoVine operates in executable symbolic environments compiled from real-world video annotations, where an agent must coordinate object manipulations under partial observation and account for delayed consequences. Restoring a decision state allows the learner to explore alternative actions and compare their eventual outcomes. Union jointly trains action generation and consequence prediction in one model, using the same executions to supervise candidate comparison and recovery. Verified repairs add recovery targets from failed attempts, while comparisons among sampled continuations guide policy updates. The updated planner then returns to the environments, with its own decisions and mistakes shaping the next round of experience. On a shared benchmark, EgoVine-1.5B achieves 81.8% success on Main planning tasks and 66.7% on longer task compositions, outperforming all evaluated Flash LLM baselines on both. EgoVine connects real demonstrations to an iterative learning process that trains compact planners on choices and futures beyond the recorded trajectories.

</details>


### [19] [ContraSafe-VL: A Contrastive Safety Preference Dataset for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23908)
*Di Wu,Yanyan Zhao,Xin Lu,Hao Yang,Taotao Zhang,Yunzhen Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ContraSafe-VL对比安全偏好数据集，通过配对视觉上下文直接监督视觉信息如何影响多模态安全判断，兼顾安全性与过度拒答的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM作为通用多模态助手部署增多，多模态安全对齐重要。安全依赖图文交互，视觉上下文关键。但VLM常不能恰当使用视觉信息：或忽视安全相关视觉内容，或过度解读敏感视觉内容，导致不安全响应或过度拒答。现有数据集多为响应偏好范式，只教模型如何回答，对"视觉上下文应如何影响安全判断"监督不足，难以平衡安全与过度拒答。

Method: 构建ContraSafe-VL对比安全偏好数据集。对每个固定文本查询，构造成对视觉上下文，使多模态查询得到不同的安全标签，从而直接监督视觉上下文如何影响安全判断；并基于无害性与有用性提供响应偏好对，鼓励生成既安全又有帮助的响应。

Result: 在三种VLM架构和多个基准上实验表明，用ContraSafe-VL训练可提升跨模态安全识别能力，实现更好的安全—过度拒答权衡，同时保持通用多模态能力。数据集将公开。

Conclusion: 该工作通过对比式视觉上下文监督弥补现有响应偏好范式的不足，为多模态安全对齐提供更细粒度的监督信号，兼顾安全与有用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as general-purpose multimodal assistants, making multimodal safety alignment an important challenge. Safety depends on the interplay between textual and visual content, with visual context often playing a critical role. However, VLMs may fail to use visual information appropriately, either overlooking safety-relevant visual content or over-interpreting sensitive visual content, leading to unsafe responses or over-refusal. Existing multimodal safety alignment datasets largely follow the response-preference paradigm, which teaches models how to respond but provides limited supervision on how visual context should inform the safety judgment, making it difficult to balance safety and over-refusal. To address this limitation, we introduce ContraSafe-VL, a Contrastive Safety preference dataset for Vision-Language Models. For each fixed textual query, ContraSafe-VL constructs paired visual contexts that result in multimodal queries with different safety labels, providing direct supervision for how visual context should inform multimodal safety judgments. It further provides response preference pairs based on harmlessness and helpfulness to encourage models to generate responses that are both safe and helpful. Experiments across three VLM architectures and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that training with ContraSafe-VL improves cross-modal safety recognition and achieves a better safety--over-refusal trade-off while preserving general multimodal capabilities. The dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [20] [When the Editing Intent Is Split: A Cross-Modal Jailbreak Attack for Large Image Editing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23909)
*Xianmin Ye,Zhiyuan Fan,Tianju Liu,Yuhang Wang,Zhenxing Niu,Haichang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"分割意图"越狱攻击SIJA：把有害编辑意图拆分到文本(指明编辑对象)与图形化视觉语义(隐含有害动作与规格)中，使图像编辑模型重组出有害变换却逃过安全检查；作者构建SI2ESBench基准，在GPT Image 2和Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro上ASR分别达68.28%与91.38%，并提出"编辑意图重建"防御原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代图像编辑模型会同时从文本和视觉输入推断编辑意图，当有害意图被分散到不同模态时，形成尚未被充分探索的安全风险；现有多模态编辑安全评估与防护机制缺乏对拆分输入的统一判定。

Method: 形式化split-intent漏洞；提出SIJA攻击，将编辑指称放在文本中，用辅助线索的图形化视觉语义隐藏安全关键动作与规格；构建SI2ESBench基准以系统评测分割意图输入下的编辑模型；提出防御原则"编辑意图重建"，即显式评估多模态联合上下文所隐含的完整变换。

Result: 在代表性商用与开源模型上实验，SIJA对GPT Image 2的ASR达68.28%，对Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro达91.38%；分布意图可被模型恢复并执行，但现有安全防护往往无法识别其有害性；意图重建防御显著提升对分割意图攻击的拒答率。

Conclusion: 揭示了现代图像编辑系统存在跨模态安全缺口：应评估多模态输入联合推断出的变换，而非孤立评估单一输入；需将分割意图纳入安全建模与基准评测。

Abstract: Large image editing models increasingly infer editing intent from both textual and visual inputs, creating an underexplored safety risk when harmful intent is distributed across modalities. In this work, we formalize this split-intent vulnerability and propose the Split-Intent Jailbreak Attack (SIJA), which asymmetrically distributes an unsafe editing intent by specifying the editing referent in text while concealing the safety-critical action and specification through graphical visual semantics in an auxiliary cue. To systematically study this threat, we introduce the Split-Intent Image Editing Safety Benchmark (SI2ESBench) for evaluating image editing models under split-intent inputs. Extensive experiments on representative commercial and open-source models demonstrate that SIJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art image editing systems, achieving ASRs of 68.28% on GPT Image 2 and 91.38% on Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro. Our results expose a mismatch between multimodal editing and safety assessment: the distributed intent can be recovered to execute the requested transformation, yet its harmfulness often remains undetected by existing safeguards. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose editing-intent reconstruction, a defense principle that explicitly evaluates the complete transformation implied by the joint multimodal context and substantially improves rejection of split-intent attacks. Our findings expose a cross-modal safety gap in modern image editing systems and highlight the need to assess the jointly inferred transformation rather than individual inputs in isolation. https://github.com/yexianmin/SIJA

</details>


### [21] [Grounding Confusable Movie Moments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23910)
*Dong-Hee Kim,Seonwoo Choi,Changbeen Kim,Juyeon Ko,Youngju Choi,Il Hyeon Mun,Hyunwoo J. Kim,Donghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出CoM$^2$-Bench基准（由易混淆查询对组成），揭示检索环节是电影时刻定位的主要瓶颈，并提出免训练的Agentic Window Search (AWS)方法将mIoU从18.5提升到26.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影中人物、地点、动作反复出现，许多时刻仅在细粒度细节上不同。现有时间定位基准很少测试模型能否区分这种“细节差异”，而不是仅匹配共享属性。作者希望定位现有方法究竟在哪一步失败。

Method: 1) 构建CoM$^2$-Bench：成对查询共享大部分属性，仅在一个细节上不同；2) 采用“先检索后定位”流水线，把失败归因于检索或定位两阶段；3) 提出AWS：MLLM智能体先将查询分解为属性级子查询，再检查每个候选窗口与子查询是否匹配，当证据在窗口边缘被截断时扩展窗口，无需训练。

Result: 实验发现检索是主要瓶颈，SOTA检索器常选中混淆对应时刻，因为其选择依据是共享内容而非区分性细节。AWS可即插即用于现有检索器与定位器，将mIoU从18.5提升至26.8。

Conclusion: 细粒度区分是电影时间定位的关键挑战，且瓶颈主要在检索而非定位；免训练、基于MLLM智能体分解-检查-扩展的推理时方法能有效缓解该问题。

Abstract: Characters, locations, and actions recur throughout a movie, so many of its moments differ only in fine-grained details. Grounding such a moment in a full-length movie requires resolving that detail rather than matching the attributes it shares with other moments, yet existing temporal movie grounding benchmarks rarely test this. We introduce CoM$^2$-Bench, a benchmark of confusable query pairs, where the two queries in each pair share most attributes but differ in a single distinguishing detail within a full movie, posing a challenge for recent temporal grounding approaches. To locate where grounding breaks down, we analyze a retrieve-then-localize pipeline, in which a retriever first selects a short candidate chunk and a localizer then performs temporal grounding within it. Separating the two stages lets us attribute each failure to either retrieval or localization. We find that retrieval is the major bottleneck: state-of-the-art retrievers often select a moment's confusable counterpart, because their choices follow the content the two moments share rather than the detail that tells them apart. To address these failures, we propose a simple, training-free remedy, Agentic Window Search (AWS): an MLLM agent $\textit{Decomposes}$ the query into attribute-level sub-queries, then $\textit{Inspects}$ each candidate window against them and $\textit{Expands}$ the window when evidence is cut off at its edge. AWS works with existing retrievers and localizers without additional training, raising mIoU from 18.5 to 26.8.

</details>


### [22] [Pseudo-Label Foreground Quality Weighting for Domain-Generalized Fundus Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23911)
*Lucas Gabriel Telesco,José Ignacio Orlando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在Noisy Student半监督框架中引入基于掩膜的可信度估计，对OD/OC伪标签监督进行分任务加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视盘/视杯分割是自动化青光眼评估的核心，但在有限标注眼底数据上训练的模型在域偏移下性能退化；标准Noisy Student将所有伪标签视为同等可靠。

Method: 用多任务Dice预测器从Teacher生成的掩膜估计OD与OC各自的伪标签质量，并据此在Student训练中对伪标签损失进行加权；保留低分前景伪标签的基础贡献，同时相对提升高可信伪标签的权重。

Result: 在已知域与未见域上均优于Noisy Student基线，视杯分割提升尤为明显，同时保持有竞争力的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 以掩膜导出的可信度对伪标签监督进行任务特定调制，是提升半监督分割跨域泛化的有效且轻量方向。

Abstract: Optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC) segmentation is central to automated glaucoma assessment, but models trained on limited labeled fundus datasets often degrade under domain shift. Semi-supervised Teacher-Student learning can improve generalization by leveraging unlabeled data, yet standard Noisy Student training treats all pseudo-labels as equally reliable. In this paper we investigate a targeted extension of Noisy Student training in which OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label supervision is modulated using a mask-derived reliability estimate. A multitask Dice predictor estimates OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label quality from Teacher-generated masks, and these estimates are used to weight the pseudo-label loss during Student training. This preserves the baseline contribution of low-scoring foreground pseudo-labels while assigning greater relative emphasis to pseudo-labels predicted to be more reliable. Experiments across known and unseen domains show improvements over the Noisy Student baseline, particularly for OC segmentation, while maintaining competitive generalization performance.

</details>


### [23] [Junction Geometry Survives an Unidentifiable Blur](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23912)
*Sohail,Sarkar,Shakuntala Baichoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文证明：在未知中心高斯混合模糊且可能存在不可识别模糊的情况下，从交叉/分支结构中仍可恢复各直臂的数目、方向、相对权重与支撑线；建立与网格单元概率欧氏差成比例的均匀距离界，并给出n^{-1/2}的极小极大误差率，实践中用约束局部似然联合拟合射线与模糊，在显微与Chandra谱数据上显著优于固定尺度Hessian脊检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微图像中细丝交叉、X射线探测器上色散谱交叉，交叉/分支处有多少直臂、朝向如何常被未知模糊掩盖；在平衡交叉处，不同高斯模糊甚至可产生完全相同的观测分布（不可识别），因此需要回答：在这种病态情形下各臂是否仍可被唯一且稳定地恢复。

Method: 将结构建模为非零权重的分离直射线叠加未知中心高斯混合模糊；构造一个综合臂数、方向、相对权重与支撑线的距离，证明其在足够细的固定网格上被常数倍于单元概率欧氏差所上界，且该界在有界模型类（含不可识别模糊）上一致成立；据此证明n个位置/光子计数下全局估计的极小极大误差率为n^{-1/2}；实践中用约束局部似然同时拟合射线与模糊。

Result: 在360个由实测单分子定位构建的交叉/分支上（协议预先固定、25–400个定位），正确臂数且所有方向误差在10°内的成功率比调参的固定尺度Hessian脊检测器高24–37个百分点；锐角且计数正确时平均绝对误差3.5°–4.3°，对照10.4°–15.5°；两探测器一致时BIC臂数更小。Chandra谱800光子下90次拟合中38次找到全部四臂（10°内），其中位误差0.023°。

Conclusion: 即使模糊不可识别，交叉/分支的几何结构仍可从数据中被稳定恢复，统计率与估计方法均得到理论保证；约束局部似然拟合在真实显微与光谱数据上明显优于经典固定尺度脊检测，为交叉结构分析提供了可靠且可验证的框架。

Abstract: Thin filaments cross in microscopy, and dispersed spectra cross on X-ray detectors. At a junction, where these structures cross or branch, how many straight arms meet, and which way do they go? Unknown blur obscures the answer. At a balanced crossing, distinct Gaussian blurs can even produce the same observation law. We show that the arms can still be recovered. For separated rays of nonvanishing weight and an unknown centered Gaussian-mixture blur, a distance combining arm count, directions, relative weights and supporting lines is bounded by a constant times the Euclidean difference in cell probabilities on a sufficiently fine fixed grid. The bound is uniform over a bounded model class, including unidentifiable blurs. From $n$ positions or photon counts, the minimax error is of order $n^{-1/2}$. This rate is proved for a global estimator. In practice we fit rays and blur by constrained local likelihood, reducing the BIC count when two detectors agree on fewer arms in the microscopy studies. Across three studies with protocols fixed before evaluation, on 360 crossings and branches assembled from measured single-molecule localizations, the fit gets the arm count and every direction within $10^\circ$ 24 to 37 percentage points more often than a tuned fixed-scale Hessian ridge detector, averaged over 25 to 400 localizations. On acute angles with correct counts, mean absolute error is $3.5^\circ$ to $4.3^\circ$, versus $10.4^\circ$ to $15.5^\circ$. On Chandra spectra, 38 of 90 fits at 800 photons find all four arms within $10^\circ$; among these, median error is $0.023^\circ$.

</details>


### [24] [SPIRIT: Sparse Physics-Informed Inverse Rendering for SAR Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23914)
*Yimeng Liu,Maolin Gan,Jingkai Lin,Jialuo Du,Mi Zhang,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPIRIT 是一个面向稀疏孔径 SAR 的物理信息逆渲染框架，通过直接重建显式三维表面而非增强图像，在减少 90% 以上数据采集的情况下实现低几何与信号误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RF 与波成像系统在恶劣条件下感知能力强，但受限于采集速度与空间分辨率的权衡。减少测量以获得快速采集会导致高度非单射的逆问题，使传统图像域重建和超分辨方法不稳定。稀疏孔径采样下的 SAR 正是这一挑战的典型代表。

Method: 提出 SPIRIT 物理信息逆渲染框架。它不做图像增强，而是重建显式三维表面；采用优化策略，并显式建模可见性、相位相干性与波传播，将稀疏孔径各视角的分布式几何特征聚合为一致重建。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据上的大量实验表明，SPIRIT 在极端稀疏条件下能恢复准确几何与信号，采集数据减少超过 90%，几何与信号误差均较低，并持续优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将稀疏孔径 SAR 重建转化为物理约束下的显式三维表面逆渲染问题，SPIRIT 有效缓解了稀疏采样带来的非单射难题，为快速、高保真的波成像提供了新范式。

Abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) and wave-based imaging systems play a critical role in sensing under adverse conditions, but are fundamentally constrained by a trade-off between collection speed and spatial resolution. Reducing measurements to enable rapid collection of fragment geometric information across sensing dimensions, leading to highly non-injective inverse problems that destabilize conventional image-domain reconstruction and super-resolution methods. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) exemplifies this challenge in sparse-aperture sampling. We introduce SPIRIT, a physics-informed inverse rendering framework for sparse-aperture SAR. Rather than enhancing formed images, SPIRIT reconstructs an explicit three-dimensional surface. By adopting an optimization strategy and explicitly modeling visibility, phase coherence, and wave propagation, SPIRIT aggregates distributed geometric features across sparse aperture views into a coherent reconstruction. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that SPIRIT recovers accurate geometry and signal under extreme sparsity, reducing data collection by over 90% while achieving low geometric and signal error and consistently outperforming baselines.

</details>


### [25] [Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23915)
*Arthur Aubret,Jochen Triesch,Céline Teulière*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 自监督学习（SSL）的预训练任务隐式建模了物体共现统计，视觉骨干编码类别信息、投影头专门编码类别间共现关系；控制共现可加速类别级表征的形成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSL在语义视觉表征上表现优异，但其成功背后的底层机制尚未被充分理解，作者希望探究常见pretext任务究竟隐式学习了什么。

Method: 假设SSL pretext任务隐式建模物体共现统计。用SOTA分割模型从已有视觉基准构建三个分割物体数据集，在多种SSL模型上进行探测实验；并进一步在预训练中人为控制共现模式来做因果验证。

Result: 发现语义信息的层级编码：视觉骨干捕获物体类别，投影头专门编码类别间的共现；投影头在与人判断的类别间相似度对齐上优于骨干；控制共现模式可显著加速类别级表征的出现。

Conclusion: 揭示了SSL中此前隐藏的学习原理，并指出通过显式利用物体共现结构来设计更有效pretext任务的路径。

Abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of semantic information: while the visual backbone captures object categories, the projection head specializes in encoding co-occurrences between object categories. As a result, the projection head outperforms the backbone in aligning with human judgments of inter-category similarity. Furthermore, by controlling co-occurrence patterns during pre-training, we demonstrate that encoding object co-occurrences can significantly accelerate the emergence of category-level representations. Our findings uncover a previously hidden learning principle in SSL and suggest a path toward designing more effective pretext tasks by explicitly leveraging object co-occurrence structure.

</details>


### [26] [Cross-Modal Forgetting and Transfer in Unified Multimodal Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23918)
*Francesco Colasurdo,Ivan Slobozhan,Joaquin Vanschoren,Anna Vettoruzzo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 测量 Janus-Pro-7B 的 LoRA 后训练中的跨模态遗忘：单次运行看似安全，但连续三次微调会摧毁先前学到的能力并使通用文本困惑度恶化1–2个数量级；根源在于目标函数只约束被训练模态，锚定另一模态头部可消除损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（共享权重同时做图像问答与图像生成）存在单用途模型没有的后训练风险：微调一种能力可能损害另一模态的能力。作者希望以真实干预检验"未训练能力的保持性"。

Method: 对 Janus-Pro-7B 做 LoRA 后训练，每个目标均选自基座模型本已表现很差的任务（如诗歌语体、几乎不会的语言），以检验真实干预下的保持性；先做单次运行、再链式三次运行，用四个公开基准与自由英文评估未训练能力；并做消融（学习率降至1/5、锚定另一头部）。

Result: 单次运行看似完全安全：未训练能力在四个基准与自由英文上均无退化，即使适配器将留出威尔士语困惑度降低76%（相对权重变化<2%）。但链式三次运行摧毁了一次前学到的能力，并使通用文本困惑度比从未适配模型高1–2个数量级；学习率降至1/5不能阻止崩溃；锚定另一头部可消除对未训练能力的损害且不损失所学内容。此外所学内容留在自身模态内：文本习得的威尔士语仅弥合图像生成中英–威差距的3%。

Conclusion: 单次微调的"安全性"属于该次运行而非配方本身；跨模态遗忘源于只约束被训练模态的目标函数，需在目标中锚定另一模态头部。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models answer questions about images and also generate images with one shared set of weights. This creates a post-training risk that single-purpose models do not have: fine-tuning one capability can damage another that works in a different modality. We measure this cross-modal forgetting for LoRA post-training of Janus-Pro-7B. Every target is chosen by how poorly the base model already handles it, from a poetic register to a language it barely speaks, so that retention is tested against a real intervention; we then evaluate the capabilities we never trained, first after a single run and then after chaining three. A single run looks entirely safe: nothing we did not train degrades on four public benchmarks or in free-form English, even when the adapter cuts held-out Welsh perplexity by 76% with a relative weight change under 2%. That safety belongs to the run, not to the recipe. Chaining three runs destroys the capability learned one run earlier and raises general-text perplexity by one to two orders of magnitude above the never-adapted model, on the very measures that stayed flat before. The cause is in the objective, which constrains only the modality being trained and leaves the other head unconstrained: cutting the learning rate to one fifth does not prevent the collapse, while anchoring the other head removes the damage to the capabilities we never trained, at no cost to what is learned. What is learned also stays inside its own modality, with Welsh acquired from text closing only 3% of the English-Welsh gap in image generation.

</details>


### [27] [Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23919)
*Si Qin,Jiawei Tang,Yaxin Hou,Yan Chen,Yutong Xie,Chen Li,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 VI-UVA 任务（词汇不完整的无监督视觉语言模型适配），并提出 Label Space Reconstruction (LSR)，通过从无标签数据重建潜在标签空间来缓解适配偏差，扩展适配范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督 VLM 适配方法假设适配词表包含所有类别名，但真实场景中词表往往不完整（存在被忽略或超出任务范围的类），导致适配偏向已提供类别、削弱被省略类别的识别。

Method: 提出 Label Space Reconstruction (LSR)：从无标签数据重建潜在标签空间，并将其融入 prompt tuning，使适配超越不完整词表；同时推导被省略类别的语义差异上界，并分析影响该上界的关键因素。

Result: 在八个基准上的大量实验表明 LSR 优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: LSR 能有效缓解词汇不完整带来的适配偏差，在有限词表条件下实现更强的适配性能，为无监督 VLM 适配提供了新任务设定与解决方案。

Abstract: In certain real-world scenarios, obtaining labeled data is excessively expensive, motivating increasing interest in adapting models without annotations. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide pseudo-labels for unlabeled images through image-text similarity, enabling adaptation without manual labeling. The previous unsupervised vision-language model adaption methods assume access to an adaptation vocabulary containing all class names. However, a complete vocabulary is difficult to construct in real-world scenarios, as unlabeled data may contain classes that are overlooked or fall outside the current task scope. Thus, we propose Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-language model Adaptation (VI-UVA), where only a subset of class names are available during adaptation. The vocabulary incompleteness induces an adaptation bias toward provided classes, which degrades omitted-class recognition. To address this issue, we propose Label Space Reconstruction (LSR), which reconstructs a latent label space from the unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning, thereby extending adaptation beyond the incomplete vocabulary and mitigating the adaptation bias. Furthermore, we derive an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound for LSR and identify the key factors affecting the bound. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that LSR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [28] [SpinDoctor: Finding Innocuous Prompts for Biased Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23925)
*Anna Gerchanovsky,Omer Akgul,Lujo Bauer,Michael K. Reiter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpinDoctor，用黑盒方式为文生图模型寻找看似无害、实则产生目标偏见的提示词，304次实验中仅2次失败，平均偏见提升约34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 看似中性的提示词可能暗藏诱导，使用户在不知情下得到带特定偏见的图像，构成操纵风险；需要研究此类"无害提示词"的生成以揭示隐患。

Method: 仅以黑盒方式访问文生图模型，根据可选定的目标偏见搜索提示词，在保持图像与提示词质量的同时使输出图像朝目标偏见方向偏移。

Result: 304次实验中除2次外均找到有效提示词；在两个开源模型上偏见平均提升34.8%与33.5%；跨模型迁移场景中78.6%出现相同偏见；部分结果经人工评估验证。

Conclusion: 该方法灵活、易迁移目标偏见并具备跨模型迁移性，揭示了文生图模型的提示词操纵风险。

Abstract: We introduce SpinDoctor, a method for discovering innocuous prompts for text-to-image models that result in images with a chosen target bias, while retaining the quality of the images and prompts. These prompts present a risk for user manipulation, in that a user who is given these seemingly unbiased prompts might be willing to use them and would receive biased images in return. Our method is flexible: it uses models in a black-box way only and the target image bias can easily be changed, and so our method can be applied with various motivations and in various scenarios. Our method shows some transferability between models-we saw the same bias emerge in 78.6% of cases-such that a victim who uses a prompt generated via our method using one model still likely receives a biased image from another model. In our experiments, a subset of which we corroborated with human evaluation, we were able to find an innocuous prompt that moved generated images in the direction of the desired bias in all but two of 304 experiments, with an average improvement of 34.8% and 33.5% on two open-source text-to-image models.

</details>


### [29] [Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23929)
*Hoyeon Shin,Jeongyeon Kim,Yeong Jun Koh,Yeoneung Kim,Hanul Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将视觉文档检索中的视觉token压缩建模为非平衡最优传输(UOT)问题，统一平衡token重要性、语义冗余与覆盖能力，并理论证明可上界MaxSim检索误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs实现无OCR的多向量视觉文档检索，但为保留稠密视觉细节生成过多token，严重限制检索可扩展性；现有压缩方法依赖孤立启发式，无法平衡token重要性、语义冗余和覆盖容量。

Method: 将视觉token压缩建模为Unbalanced Optimal Transport问题，通过单一交替优化过程统一三个目标；理论上证明最小化传输代价可上界MaxSim检索误差，保证排序稳定性。

Result: 在ViDoRe V1和V3基准上的大量实验表明，方法保留细粒度文档语义，并在效率-效果权衡上优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: UOT框架为视觉token压缩提供统一优化视角，兼顾语义保真与检索效率，并提供排序稳定性理论保障。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models(VLMs)have advanced Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) by enabling OCR-free, multi-vector representations. However, these models generate excessive tokens to preserve dense visual details, which severely limits retrieval scalability. Existing compression methods mitigate this overhead but rely on isolated heuristics that fail to balance token importance, semantic redundancy, and coverage capacity. We propose a visual token compression framework formulated as an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) problem. Our approach unifies these three objectives into a single alternating optimization process. Furthermore, we theoretically show that minimizing the transport cost upper-bounds the MaxSim retrieval error, ensuring ranking stability. Extensive experiments on the ViDoRe V1 and V3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method preserves fine-grained document semantics and improves the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off over state-of-the-art base-lines. Code is available at https://github.com/shhhhhyy/Unbalanced-Optimal-Transport-for-EVDR.

</details>


### [30] [STLQ: Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23931)
*Kuizhi Liu,Junying Zhang,Xindi Ma,Xiangyu Wang,Qi Jiang,Sheng Gao,Chen Gong,Jianfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STLQ是一种拓扑浅层多码本量化方法，将每个IVF簇组织为带紧凑码与缩放系数的有向森林，通过链接编码复用局部重建信息以获得更精细表示，在相同比特预算下取得更高召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浅层MCQ在每个IVF簇内独立编码向量，未利用簇内局部参考信息，导致编码效率受限。

Method: 提出时空拓扑链接量化STLQ：将每个IVF簇组织为有向森林结构；基础编码阶段独立量化向量，链接编码阶段以选定重建父节点为参考重编码相对残差；设计链接ADC保持线性扫描复杂度；并进一步压缩缩放系数与有向森林结构以控制拓扑额外开销。

Result: 在可比比特预算下，STLQ召回率高于所评估的浅层MCQ；与深层MCQ相比具有竞争性的召回-QPS权衡；但离线构建成本较高。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 利用簇内拓扑链接复用局部重建信息可有效提升浅层MCQ的检索精度，代价是更高的离线构建开销，为ANNS中浅层量化提供了一种可行新范式。

Abstract: Vector quantization is widely used for large-scale data compression and approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). Multi-codebook quantization (MCQ) is a practical paradigm that represents database vectors with compact codes and supports efficient retrieval through asymmetric distance computation (ADC). However, existing shallow MCQs encode vectors independently within each inverted file (IVF) cluster, without exploiting local references. Therefore, we propose Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization (STLQ), a topological shallow MCQ method that organizes each IVF cluster as a directed-forest with compact codes and scaling coefficients. Its basic encoding phase first quantizes vectors independently, while the linked encoding phase re-encodes relative residuals with respect to selected reconstructed parents, reusing local reconstruction information to obtain finer representations. The corresponding linked-ADC preserves linear scanning complexity. STLQ further compresses the scaling coefficients and directed-forest structure to control the additional topology overhead. Extensive experiments show that STLQ achieves higher recall than the evaluated shallow MCQs at comparable bit budgets, although at a higher offline construction cost. Meanwhile, it has a competitive recall-QPS tradeoff against deep MCQs. The code is available at https://github.com/ighxiy/STLQ.

</details>


### [31] [Toward AI-Driven Phytoplankton Event Detection from Image Classification: Temporal Aggregation Under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23932)
*Ali Rohan,Hassan Shayan,Han-Gue Jo,Colin Moffat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究验证了AI浮游植物图像分类在真实采样与跨域条件下能否复现具有生态意义的时间出现模式。基于MedPlanktonSet开发监测导向框架，在SMHI独立IFCB数据集上评估8个类群，结果AI导出的目标出现率与专家信号高度一致（MAE=0.0432，Pearson r=0.9696），并成功恢复"升高/强/持续"出现代理指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IFCB系统产生的浮游植物图像量远超人工分析能力；机器学习虽在图像级分类表现优异，但其预测能否为监测提供生态有意义的时间信息（在真实采样与独立域迁移条件下）尚不明确。

Method: 构建监测导向框架（MedPlanktonSet开发，SMHI独立IFCB数据集验证）；选取8个生物学可比目标类群，其余保留为背景以维持完整图像流分母；采用会话感知划分防止时间泄漏；比较不同预处理策略与CNN架构；跨域实验筛选模型（EfficientNet-B0最优）后进行时间分析。

Result: 预处理显著影响泛化；EfficientNet-B0在目标-背景判别上最强；尽管存在残余图像级错误，聚合后AI目标出现率高度复现专家信号（MAE=0.0432，Pearson r=0.9696，Spearman ρ=0.9568）；多会话窗口一致性仍强；在留出测试中恢复了升高、强、持续出现三类代理指标。

Conclusion: AI浮游植物分类不仅能做图像级识别，还能支持监测相关的时间指标，为未来业务化早期预警系统的开发奠定基础。

Abstract: Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) systems generate large volumes of phytoplankton imagery that exceed the capacity of manual expert analysis. Although machine-learning approaches achieve high image-level classification performance, it remains unclear whether their predictions can provide ecologically meaningful temporal information for monitoring. This study investigates whether AI-derived phytoplankton classifications can reproduce temporal occurrence patterns and elevated-occurrence signals under realistic sampling and independent-domain transfer. A monitoring-oriented framework was developed using MedPlanktonSet and evaluated on an independent IFCB dataset from the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI). Eight biologically comparable taxa were selected as targets, while all remaining observations were retained as background to preserve the full image-stream denominator. Session-aware partitioning prevented temporal leakage, and alternative preprocessing strategies and convolutional neural network architectures were evaluated. Cross-domain experiments showed that preprocessing strongly affected generalisation. EfficientNet-B0 provided the strongest target-versus-background discrimination and was selected for temporal analysis. Despite residual image-level errors, AI-derived target-occurrence rates closely reproduced expert-derived signals after aggregation (mean absolute error = 0.0432, Pearson $r$ = 0.9696, Spearman $ρ$ = 0.9568). Agreement remained strong across multi-session windows, and elevated, strong, and persistent occurrence proxies were recovered in held-out testing. These results show that AI-based phytoplankton classification can support monitoring-relevant temporal indicators beyond image-level identification and support future operational early-warning development.

</details>


### [32] [VERDICT: Visual Extraction-Result Decoder with Integrated Confidence and Traceable Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23933)
*Harikrishnan P M,Goutham Vignesh,Siva Prasad,Zishan Ahmad,Mahesh Basveshwar Deshmukhe,Varun V,Rohit Agrawal,Vishal Vaddina*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VERDICT 是一个可插拔框架，在不改动现有抽取器的前提下，用小 VLM 为每个抽取值定位证据并提供经校准的值置信度与证据置信度，微调显著扩展选择性预测的可用区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业用前沿多模态模型做schema引导的结构化字段抽取，准确率不断提升，但两件事没跟上：每个抽取值对应的证据位置（来自文档何处），以及对该值和证据应信任到什么程度。多数现有抽取系统不含这两个组件。

Method: 构建为外挂式插件框架，保持原抽取器不动；用小规模视觉语言模型（VLM）在固定外部抽取器输出上对每篇文档做一次证据定位（grounding/localization），再校准值置信度与证据置信度。用开权重VLM以便校准器访问其内部状态；并对VLM做证据定位微调。

Result: 微调显著提升证据质量并扩大可选择性预测区间：在0.80严格阈值下，分布内和分布外数据集上均获得可用的精度-覆盖率权衡，冻结设置常退化为几乎零覆盖。内部状态优于输出log-prob：分布内AUROC值置信0.730→0.914，证据置信0.681→0.906；该优势在分布偏移下不保持。信号是位移而非消失，用目标数据集约120个字段标注即可将证据置信度从0.641升至0.905（另一数据集0.675→0.829）。

Conclusion: 证据定位与置信度校准可作为独立插件补足抽取系统缺失的能力；VLM微调与内部状态利用是关键，少量目标域标注即可在分布偏移下恢复校准效果。

Abstract: Enterprises run schema-guided structured field extraction on documents with frontier multimodal models, and accuracy keeps improving as new models and systems arrive. Two things have not kept pace: the evidence for each extracted value, meaning the location of the document it was read from, and how far to trust the value and that evidence. Neither is a component of most extraction systems today, so we build them as a framework that attaches to an existing extractor and leaves it untouched. We present VERDICT, a plug-in framework that uses a small Vision--Language Model (VLM) to ground/localize the evidence once per document over a fixed external extractor's output, then calibrates value and evidence confidence. Fine-tuning the VLM for evidence localization substantially improves visual evidence quality and, more importantly, expands VERDICT's selective-prediction operating range. At a strict confidence threshold $0.80$, VERDICT with the fine-tuned VLM gives usable precision--coverage trade-offs for both value and evidence confidence across the in-distribution and out of distribution datasets, whereas the frozen setting often collapses to little or no coverage. Running an open-weight VLM for localization rather than a closed API makes its internal states available to the calibrator, and they are worth more than output log-probabilities: in-distribution AUROC rises from $0.730$ to $0.914$ for value confidence and from $0.681$ to $0.906$ for evidence confidence. This advantage does not survive a distribution shift. We show that the signal is displaced rather than destroyed, and that labeling roughly $120$ fields from the target dataset takes evidence confidence from $0.641$ to $0.905$ on one dataset and from $0.675$ to $0.829$ on the other.

</details>


### [33] [CrowdH-Edit: Reference-Guided Instruction-Based Synthetic Hajj Crowd Image Generation for Crowd Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23945)
*Amirah F. Alshammari,Bander A. Alzahrani,Nahed A. Alowidi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 CrowdH-Edit，一种基于参考图与指令的合成朝觐（Hajj）人群图像生成框架，用真实图像作结构参考、文本指令改变人群与光照条件，最终构建 6,122 张合成图像池及 387 张标注集，并验证其可提升部分人群计数模型的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 朝觐场景的领域专用标注图像稀缺，现有公开人群计数数据集与通用生成模型都无法反映朝觐特有的视觉条件（圣地几何结构、白衣朝圣人群、室内外光照变化），因此限制了该场景计算机视觉系统的开发。

Method: 采用参考引导+指令编辑的生成范式：以真实朝觐图像提供结构参考，用文本指令控制人群密度与光照并保持场景布局。对比评估了 Stable Diffusion 2.1 与 SDXL 1.0（配 LoRA 微调），以及不做额外训练、在 ComfyUI 工作流中直接使用的 Qwen Image Edit，最终选用 Qwen Image Edit 构建数据集。

Abstract: AI-based 3D generation models such as Hunyuan 3D and Meshy can produce visually appealing 3D shapes from an image or text prompt.However, they typically focus on an object's external appearance, often producing incomplete or implausible interior geometry. Consequently, the generated shapes are not guaranteed to be functionally valid, limiting their direct use in downstream applications such as simulation and fabrication. In this paper, we present a computational approach to functionalize AI-generated 3D shapes through interior geometry construction. Our key observations are that a part's functional role defines its interior geometry, and such geometry is often smooth, relatively simple, and closely related to the part's external shape. Guided by the graph, we model the interior geometry of each part as a generalized cylinder and infer its parameters from the part's external geometry through an optimization. The resulting 3D shapes are functionally valid while preserving their AI-generated external appearance. We demonstrate our approach on a variety of AI-generated 3D shapes, including vessels, containers, and storage furniture, and fabricate selected examples for functional validation.

Abstract: Spatial intelligence, the capacity to represent and reason about physical space, underlies embodied perception and real-world visual understanding. Existing benchmarks probe it through spatial relations, perspective-taking, and mental modeling. What remains underexamined is whether a model can maintain a coherent scene representation across views, since pairwise comparison alone cannot reveal which view departs from the truth. We thus introduce Same Space or Not (SSoN), a benchmark of cross-view contradiction resolution comprising 1,000 questions from seven indoor scene sources and six categories of controlled 3D edits. Each question presents three views of an unchanged scene and one view of an edited variant. Models must identify the inconsistent view and explain the contradiction without a designated trusted reference or a marked target. Humans achieve 83.3% accuracy, compared with 39.7% for the strongest vision-language models (VLMs), falling to 34.9% when a valid visual explanation is also required. On a 100-question intervention set with a 24% baseline, prompting and 3D reconstruction remain below 50% answer accuracy, except when ground-truth camera information is supplied, which reaches 61% answer accuracy but only 48% True solve accuracy. On a held-out 201-question test set, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 21.89% accuracy, 33.33% after answer-only fine-tuning, and 41.79% after fine-tuning on both rationales and answers. Abstract: Reliable fetal brain biometry on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosing congenital brain anomalies, but artificial intelligence models often lose accuracy under domain shifts. This retrospective multicohort study included 394 reconstructed 3D fetal brain MRI volumes at 20-39 gestational weeks, with 11 biometric measurements annotated by radiologists. A web-based reporting platform mapped measurements onto normative growth trajectories and was evaluated against radiologists in four multicenter disease cohorts covering germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage, ventriculomegaly, and cerebellar abnormality. Across all three target datasets, BioTTA outperformed auto-SVRTK, source-only models, and FetalSynthGen, while matching models finetuned with target labels. Abstract: Geo-vision classifies vehicle-part damage using a fixed representation combining appearance, multiscale geometry, orientation, and sampled digital topology.   <summary>Details</summary>

On fresh objects, the Fourier head roughly triples the gain of a perfect memory over plain pose tokens (2.8-3.2x). Abstract: Sparse-frame video-language models can change their answers when only the sampling timestamps shift. Raw agreement exposes this problem, but it need not rank errors better than token confidence or identify which additional observation will repair an answer. We argue that answer risk and action value must be estimated separately. PhaseGuard+ probes a frozen VLM at controlled temporal offsets, predicts the reliability of the phase-vote answer, and predicts the example-wise correctness gain of a specific rescue action. The second score routes only examples expected to benefit from denser frames or a stronger VLM. Both predictors use lightweight models trained on public data; the VLMs remain frozen. Abstract: The global transition toward carbon-neutral energy systems is heavily dependent on the rapid deployment of solar photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure, yet the speed of this expansion has outpaced the ability of administrative registries to maintain accurate records. The application enables users to retrieve up-to-date satellite observations and assess the presence of PV systems on industrial building rooftops. The tool incorporates quality metrics that inform users whether a prediction is supported by sufficient training data density or requires manual verification. This end-to-end framework demonstrates that open-source medium-resolution data can effectively bridge this monitoring gap.

Abstract: Learned satellite super-resolution is commonly assessed by pixel fidelity and potential downlink savings, but these criteria do not establish whether the reconstructed field preserves spatial structure or supports reliable downstream analysis. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出QA-MBG（QA mini-batch greedy）方法，通过离线搜索为每张图像构造一个共享的视觉token子集，在固定预算下最大化对广泛问题的支持能力，从而揭示视觉token剪枝的真实性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝研究多聚焦于方法特定的选择器和在特定预算下的增量改进，却不清楚性能瓶颈究竟来自剪枝本身的固有限制，还是来自当前token选择算法的局限。
