</details>


### [150] [CASE: Complementary Articulation-Aware Speech Encoder to Enhance Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25342)
*Jaehong Myung,Seungho Eum,Taegon Kim,Hyunjung Chung,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CASE编码器，通过对比学习将语音片段与3D唇部网格VQ-VAE潜变量对齐，再以残差交叉注意力融合到基线SSL语音表征中，在VOCASET四种基线上降低唇部顶点误差2.8–6.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用自监督语音编码器的预训练目标并未显式对齐语音驱动的3D面部动画所需的可见发音器官动态，因此其声学表征对唇形重建并非最优。

Method: 用短语音片段与连续3D唇部网格的VQ-VAE潜变量做对比对齐，微调得到CASE编码器；适配后移除几何分支，仅保留音频侧CASE表征，并通过残差交叉注意力与基线SSL语音表征融合，同时保留原有运动解码器结构与训练目标。

Result: 在VOCASET的四种基线上，平均唇部顶点误差（LVE）降低2.8–6.0%，平均全脸顶点误差在所有系统中均下降；相同融合协议下，CASE在全部四个生成器上LVE均低于未适配的AV-SE流（幅度因模型而异）。适配用韩语语音-几何数据、评估用英语VOCASET，结果与共享英语预训练音视频先验下的跨语言下游迁移一致。

Conclusion: 显式的发音感知对比适配可为现有语音驱动面部动画系统提供互补增益，且具备跨语言迁移潜力；但增益幅度依赖生成器，跨语言结论目前仍属初步印证。

Abstract: General-purpose self-supervised speech encoders provide strong acoustic representations, but their pretraining objectives are not explicitly aligned with the visible articulatory dynamics required by speech-driven 3D facial animation. We propose CASE (Complementary Articulation-aware Speech Encoder), a complementary speech encoder adapted by contrastively aligning short speech clips with continuous 3D lip-mesh VQ-VAE latents. After adaptation, the geometry branch is removed, and the audio-only CASE representation is fused with the baseline SSL speech representation through residual cross-attention, while retaining the motion-decoder architecture and objective. Across four VOCASET baselines, CASE reduces mean lip vertex error by 2.8-6.0%, and mean full-face vertex error decreases in every system. Under the same fusion protocol, CASE yields lower mean LVE than the unadapted AV-SE stream on all four generators, with model-dependent margins. Because adaptation uses Korean speech-geometry pairs and evaluation uses English VOCASET, the result is consistent with cross-language downstream transfer under a shared English-pretrained audio-visual prior.

</details>


### [151] [MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25345)
*Yifei Wang,Wei Tian,Wenhua Bao,Jia Zhou,Hanshi Wang,Fudong Ge,Jianhua Wu,Shuai Yuan,Zhipeng Zhang,Xingliang Liu,Xianming Zeng,Jianyun Xu,Bingzhao Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MCSplat：面向驾驶场景的多视角一致前馈高斯泼溅框架，解决跨相机光度不一致污染几何与深度不连续处法向监督不可靠两大难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏多视角图像的前馈高斯泼溅驾驶场景重建受两方面困扰：(1) 曝光、ISP、光照差异导致跨相机光度不一致，误差被错误吸收进高斯几何；(2) 深度不连续附近基于法向的局部几何监督不可靠。

Method: 1) 由深度引导的多相机对应关系构建规范外观空间，将几何学习与相机特定外观解耦；2) 多尺度双边网格Transformer从规范渲染恢复原始相机外观，实现不污染几何的光度监督；3) 由光度敏感度估计Fisher信息不确定性，自适应加权表面朝向自监督。

Result: 大量实验显示重建质量与跨驾驶数据集泛化性提升；几何评测表明跨视角深度一致性与局部表面法向一致性增强；定性结果显示重叠视角间几何伪影更少、结构更连贯。

Conclusion: 通过外观-几何解耦与不确定性加权的几何监督，MCSplat有效提升驾驶场景稀疏视角前馈重建的保真度与几何一致性。

Abstract: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.

</details>


### [152] [LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25358)
*Mohammad Omama,Aeyan Ashraf,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可缓存图像匹配范式LateMatch，将跨图像交互推迟到末层，并用E-SToRE进一步降算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备部署深度特征匹配器受巨大算力限制。现有匹配器每层都紧密交织图像内上下文构建与图像间匹配，形成严重交互瓶颈；单次查询对K张库图像需完整跑网络K次且无法缓存。

Method: LateMatch重构现有匹配器，把图像内处理隔离为可离线缓存的Context Blocks，仅少量Interaction Blocks在线执行，将跨图像交互延后至末层；并引入E-SToRE，依据后段Interaction Block的香农熵下降，在跨图像交互前动态缩减token数量（空间Token约减与扩展）。

Result: 在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D、Aachen上评估：LateMatch相比标准深度匹配器降低超2倍有效计算成本，E-SToRE再额外节省10%~14%，精度下降可忽略。

Conclusion: 通过延迟跨图像交互实现可缓存的图像匹配，显著降低边缘部署算力需求，且精度几乎不受影响。

Abstract: Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.

</details>


### [153] [Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25369)
*Markus Pobitzer,Chang Liu,Niccolò Biondi,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Painting Change Map：一种时空控制机制，用1000步归一化结构变化图（编码到RGB空间）显式控制绘画/反绘画视频生成中"何处"与"何时"作画，性能优于现有控制基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有绘画过程视频生成把创作过程当黑箱，条件机制要么过刚（Canny边缘、深度图等静态几何线索），要么过粗（标量进度变量），缺乏局部时空控制，用户无法引导画面如何随时间演变。

Method: 主张控制需联合理解"艺术家在何处动作"与"动作何时发生"两个维度。提出 Painting Change Map：在1000步时间连续统上跟踪归一化结构变化，将局部视觉差异映射到编码RGB空间，为正向绘画与反向"反绘画"过程提供细粒度引导。

Result: 大量基准测试显示优于现有控制基线，与最先进绘画方法相比达到相当或更优结果；在oracle条件下显著超越所有基线。

Conclusion: 时空局部控制是艺术品视频生成的有效方向，Painting Change Map可作为通用细粒度控制表示，代码已开源。

Abstract: Digital art generation has undergone a massive paradigm shift, moving from static image synthesis to dynamic video generation that can mimic the human painting process. While existing models can synthesize visually stunning time-lapses of paintings being created or "unpainted," they largely treat the creative process as a black box. Current conditioning mechanisms are either too rigid, relying on static geometric cues like Canny edges or depth maps, or too holistic, utilizing simple scalar progress variables that offer no localized control. Consequently, users lack the agency to steer how a painting evolves over time. In this work, we argue that true control over the video generation of artwork requires a joint understanding of two fundamental dimensions: where an artist acts, and when those actions take place. To achieve this, we introduce the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that explicitly tracks normalized structural changes across a 1,000-timestep continuum, a resolution sufficient to capture fine-grained stroke-level changes while remaining computationally tractable. By mapping localized visual differences into an encoded RGB space, our representation enables fine-grained guidance for both the forward painting and reverse unpainting processes. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. We outperform existing control baselines and achieve competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art painting methods. Furthermore, under oracle conditions, our method surpasses all baselines by a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map.

</details>


### [154] [Only Means Only: what a harmonization benchmark score averages over](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25387)
*Imad Buljić,Delaida Muminović*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 图像协调（image harmonization）基准的官方测试集中存在显著的训练-测试来源照片泄漏：1,399 张照片同时出现在训练与测试划分中，由其生成的合成图占测试集四分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该基准以"无照片跨训练/测试划分"作为数据划分承诺，并据单一平均误差排名方法。作者怀疑这一承诺未被兑现，且泄漏会污染排行榜结论，因此需要核查并给出可用的修正测试集。

Method: 通过"构造身份"（底层原始照片）而非文件名或字节做去重，追溯每张测试合成图的源照片是否出现在训练集；对三种方法做端到端评测，并在泄漏子集与其余子集、以及单一来源集合内部对比误差，分解"构成效应"与"共享效应"。

Result: 发现 1,399 张照片跨划分共享，其合成图占测试集 25%；在该子集上三种方法的误差比其余部分低 2–5 倍，但差距主要来自来源集合构成（泄漏样本几乎全部来自四个源集合之一），在该集合内部差距降至约 1.5 倍。发布 5,581 张构造身份未入训练的测试清单，并披露 4 对近重复样本而非删除，无需重训、每个检查点重打分一次即可采用。

Conclusion: 官方分数实为两个分布按未报告比例混合的平均，排行榜可比性受损；修正测试切分可在不重训的前提下采用。共享本身是否改变模型学到的内容仍为开放问题。

Abstract: Image harmonization methods adjust the colour and lighting of an object pasted into a photograph so that it looks native to its new scene, and they are ranked by average error on one benchmark whose test images are real photographs with one object recoloured. One photograph can yield several such test images, and the benchmark promises that no photograph appears in both the training and the test split. We find that 1,399 photographs do, and the composites built on them are a quarter of the test set. Duplicate checks over file names or bytes miss this, because every composite is a different file. On that quarter the three methods we score end to end read two to five times lower error than on the rest, but most of the gap is composition rather than the sharing: the shared composites come almost entirely from one of the benchmark's four source collections, and inside that collection the gap falls to about one and a half times. An official score is therefore an average over two populations, mixed in a proportion the benchmark does not report. We release a test list of 5,581 composites whose construction identities do not appear in training, with four confirmed near-duplicate pairs disclosed rather than removed, adoptable without retraining at the price of one rescore per checkpoint. We leave open whether the sharing itself changes what a model learns.

</details>


### [155] [ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25390)
*Hossein Shahabadi,Raya Namazi,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ATLAS 提出一种免训练框架，利用冻结视觉自回归生成器内部注意力信号在图像生成前引导搜索，实现低成本、可扩展的组合性文本到图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉自回归模型生成的图像存在属性错配和空间关系错误等组合性问题；多路径搜索虽能改善，但完整生成每个候选代价高昂。

Method: 利用冻结生成器的内部注意力作为即时信号：通过提示内诊断识别能预测最终组合偏好的注意力评分（在 Infinity 上验证，对 Switti 呈类别相关迁移）；据此动态将计算集中于有前景的轨迹——保留多个粗粒度备选，在中间尺度不解码即剪枝，仅在部分轨迹间做最终选择时才进行图像空间评估。整个流程无需参数更新或梯度优化。

Result: 在两个骨干上均随计算量增加而提升 T2I-CompBench 与 GenEval 相关类别得分；最大预算下 T2I-CompBench 目标均值较各骨干提升超 10%；在相同初始候选数下生成时间减少 50% 以上，且峰值 GPU 显存更低；候选数越多相对省时越明显。

Conclusion: 结果支持可扩展的组合性搜索：增加采样扩展探索，而注意力引导的选择限制延续成本，无需训练即可实现高效组合生成。

Abstract: Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

</details>


### [156] [A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25395)
*Michael Wakeham,Mrinmoy Kumar Das,Wenqi Wang,Ayush Tewari,Boqing Gong,Deepti Ghadiyaram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模块化3D驱动框架，将透视视频转360°视频的三项职责分配给专门组件并通过共享场景表示连接，无需全景视频训练即达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将移动相机的透视视频转为360°视频，需要同时保留时序观测、补全未观测区域、并在相机变化下保持场景一致。现有方法让单一条件视频模型同时学习这些要求，依赖全景视频数据联合训练，负担过重且难以兼顾。

Method: 模块化、3D驱动的分解框架：显式重建3D输入观测；用预训练全景图像模型基于选定的全景渲染补全未见内容；将生成内容提升到共享3D场景中，从而在相机视角变化时保持空间锚定。

Result: 在Argus评测集静态场景子集上，无需额外全景视频训练，即在输入视角保真度、感知质量和几何一致性上取得SOTA。

Conclusion: 该分解式、3D驱动的建模方式是该设定下直接视频生成的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

</details>


### [157] [PolarVis: A Dataset and Diffusion Framework for RGB-to-Polarization Perception in Adverse Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25396)
*Ruilin Huang,Jue Wang,Zhen Tian,Xia Hua,F. Richard Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RGB-P Wild数据集（10,000组RGB与四角度线偏振配对图像）及基于扩散模型的PolarVis框架，从单张RGB图像重建0°/45°/90°/135°偏振强度图，取得PSNR 27.83 dB、SSIM 0.8597，AoLP误差25.66°、DoLP MAE 0.0404，显著优于PolarAnything。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆相关场景中的反射、眩光、透明结构与材质差异会给基于RGB的视觉感知带来歧义，偏振信息可提供反射与材质敏感的互补线索，但其获取依赖专用传感器硬件，成本高且难以普及。作者希望用单张RGB图像"虚拟"恢复偏振信息，规避硬件限制。

Method: 1) 构建RGB-P Wild真实世界数据集，含10,000组RGB与四角度线偏振图像对；2) 提出PolarVis扩散式框架，包含分层RGB特征提取、扩散式特征精炼、四个角度专属解码器以及多尺度注意力重校准，重建四个角度的偏振强度图像；3) 在车辆载具图像上开展跨数据集评估以检验域外迁移；4) 用冻结的PCDNet做下游感知评测。

Result: RGB-P Wild上归一化域MSE 0.0465、PSNR 27.83 dB、SSIM 0.8597；相比PolarAnything，AoLP误差从46.03°降至25.66°，DoLP MAE从0.1084降至0.0404；下游任务中，用PolarVis生成偏振输入时冻结PCDNet在990张RGBP-Car测试图上取得AP50/AP50:95为86.3%/59.1%，接近真实测量偏振的87.0%/59.8%。

Conclusion: RGB推导的偏振保留了对应感知任务有用的偏振信息，能有效提升下游性能并接近真实偏振水平；但其与标定后的物理偏振测量仍有本质区别，不能等同替代真实偏振传感器。数据集与框架为无偏振硬件条件下的偏振感知提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Reflections, glare, transparent structures, and material-dependent appearance variations can introduce ambiguity into RGB-based visual perception in vehicle-relevant environments. Polarization provides complementary reflection- and material-sensitive information, but its acquisition requires dedicated sensing hardware. This paper presents RGB-P Wild, a real-world dataset containing 10,000 paired RGB and four-angle linear-polarization image sets, together with PolarVis, a diffusion-based framework for recovering polarization representations from a single RGB image. PolarVis combines hierarchical RGB feature extraction, diffusion-based feature refinement, four angle-specific decoders, and multi-scale attention recalibration to reconstruct polarization intensity images at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$. On RGB-P Wild, PolarVis achieves a normalized-domain MSE of 0.0465, a PSNR of 27.83 dB, and an SSIM of 0.8597. Compared with the released PolarAnything model under the adopted evaluation protocol, PolarVis obtains an AoLP error of $25.66^\circ$ and a DoLP MAE of 0.0404, compared with $46.03^\circ$ and 0.1084, respectively. Cross-dataset evaluation on vehicle-mounted imagery further examines transfer beyond the training domain. In downstream evaluation, a frozen PCDNet achieves AP50/AP50:95 of 86.3%/59.1% on 990 RGBP-Car test images using PolarVis-generated polarization, compared with 87.0%/59.8% using measured polarization. These results indicate that RGB-derived polarization retains useful polarimetric information for the evaluated perception tasks, while remaining distinct from calibrated physical polarization measurements.

</details>


### [158] [RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25400)
*R. D. Lin,Pengcheng Weng,Ge Wang,Han Ding,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAHF-Net，将圆柱体素LiDAR特征投影到图像平面并按距离可靠性分区融合，提升RGB语义分割精度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D融合方法将点云投影为浅层深度/距离图并做空间均匀融合，丢失丰富3D结构，且忽略了室外LiDAR的可靠性随距离变化的问题。

Method: 包含两个模块：C2P（Cylindrical-to-Perspective）将预训练圆柱体素特征投影至图像平面以保留结构化3D语义先验；RAHF（Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion）用由深度导出的软距离掩码，在近场可靠区域做LiDAR引导的几何增强，在远场稀疏区域做视觉上下文增强。

Result: KITTI-360上达到65.76 mIoU，优于代表性RGB-only与RGB-LiDAR基线，较CMX高1.45点；在DELIVER上展示出对恶劣天气、光照退化和传感器损坏的更强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 按距离自适应地异构融合LiDAR与RGB特征，可同时提升室外语义分割的精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

</details>


### [159] [MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25404)
*Houyuan Chen,Fanzhou Wang,Xiangyu Fan,Zesong Qiu,Yukun Wei,Songlin Yang,Zhitao Yang,Lvmin Zhang,Pei Yang,Hao Zhao,Lei Yang,Anyi Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，通过单轮分布匹配蒸馏与教师强制引导，缓解统一多模态模型在多轮图像编辑中的视觉质量漂移与内容不一致问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮图像编辑方法在少数几轮编辑后即出现明显漂移：1）视觉质量不稳定，伪影累积、细节退化；2）图像内容不一致，非编辑区域与先前编辑结果被意外改变。

Method: 面向基于自回归扩散的统一多模态模型（UMMs）提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，包含：(1) Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation，用一次性对源图施加累积编辑的教师在单轮内监督学生自回滚轨迹，避免递归误差累积地提供视觉质量指导；(2) Teacher-Forcing Guidance，在预热阶段于参考轨迹上监督历史依赖的转移，并在蒸馏阶段作为正则项，增强跨轮内容一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了 UMMs 的多轮图像编辑能力，视觉质量更稳定、跨轮一致性更强。

Conclusion: MT Forcing 为多轮图像编辑中抑制漂移提供有效训练范式，兼顾视觉质量稳定与内容一致性。

Abstract: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

</details>


### [160] [UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25414)
*Jaeseok Jeong,Kyungmook Choi,Sohyun Chung,Youngsik Yun,Youngjung Uh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniState 框架，基于统一世界状态表示实现可控世界模拟，分离物体运动干预与相机视角选择，并保持模型对干预后果的自主合成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型环境丰富，但在自由选择视角下观察干预后果仍很困难；现有控制方式中物体运动与视角变化相互混淆，存在控制歧义。

Method: 构建统一世界状态表示，将空间记忆与用户干预统一；用户在空间记忆中直接指定物体运动，并独立选择相机轨迹；辅以配套训练与采样策略，使生成视频遵循指定运动与轨迹，同时保留生成超出指定变换的反应能力。

Result: 实验显示物体与相机联合控制精度优于现有方法，并定性证明干预引发的场景变化能在多次 rollout 中持续存在。

Conclusion: 统一世界状态表示可有效消除控制歧义，实现解耦且一致的可控世界模拟，并支持干预后果的持续演化。

Abstract: World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

</details>


### [161] [From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25418)
*Shuochen Chang,Bingjie Gao,Qingyang Liu,Qianli Ma,Yibo Miao,Haonan Zhao,Zhaohe Liao,Xiaofeng Zhang,Jiangtong Li,Li Niu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出将长视频理解中的关键帧选择重新表述为潜变量推断问题，先用监督学习初始化选择策略，再用冻结MLLM的答案似然作为密集任务证据，通过贝叶斯GRPO微调策略，从而弥合静态标注先验与下游推理需求之间的错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM处理长视频受二次注意力复杂度和上下文窗口限制。现有基于检索的方法依赖静态关键帧标注的监督学习，但这些标签先验与下游MLLM实际推理所需信息不一致，导致训练目标与推理需求之间产生错位。

Method: 提出概率框架，将帧选择建模为潜变量推断。先用监督学习初始化轻量策略以捕捉通用视觉显著性；然后将冻结MLLM视为任务环境，以其答案似然作为密集任务证据，通过贝叶斯GRPO精炼策略。其中真值答案token上的负对数似然（NLL）提供有原则的密集奖励，先验匹配KL项保持与标注先验的语义一致性。该过程使选择原则从静态标签先验转向任务证据。

Result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上实验表明，该选择器在保持轻量方法推理效率的同时，达到了与基于MLLM的评分器相当的准确率。选择器只需在冻结MLLM环境中训练一次，即可直接迁移到多个下游MLLM而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 通过将帧选择转化为潜变量推断并用任务证据替代静态先验，该方法有效缓解了标注先验与推理需求间的错位，兼具高准确率与轻量推理效率，并具备跨模型迁移能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO}.

</details>


### [162] [Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25429)
*Eli A. Underwood,I. Taylor McKechnie,Leslie M. Collins*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Frozen Expert框架，冻结CROMA SAR编码器与CLIP文本编码器，仅用轻量约束残差桥接实现SAR-文本对齐，避免模态不匹配与"物理遗忘"，在零样本SAR场景分类上以更少训练数据显著超越微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR与自然语言跨模态对齐面临两大失败：(1)模态不匹配——在光学影像上预训练的文本编码器（如CLIP）难以有效微调到SAR，因为主动微波后向散射与被动光学反射物理上不兼容，且现有SAR caption数据量过小；(2)物理遗忘——在大规模自监督目标上预训练的SAR编码器包含的雷达物理特性，在有限caption数据上微调时会被逐渐抹除。

Method: 核心设计原则是保持两个编码器均冻结，只学习一个受约束、保结构的桥接。具体地，通过轻量级约束残差桥（constrained residual bridge）将冻结的CROMA SAR编码器与冻结的CLIP文本编码器对齐；并用Procrustes disparity形式化定义"物理遗忘"，以约束桥接保持SAR几何结构。还验证了在多种SAR骨干与文本编码器上的泛化性。

Result: 桥接相比微调更好地保持SAR几何结构（Procrustes disparity：0.210 vs. 0.351）。零样本SAR场景分类上，用最多8倍更少训练数据即超越微调基线：DFC2020（R@1 +10.3%，mAP +15.5%）、EuroSAT-SAR（R@1 +15.7%，mAP +12.2%）、BigEarthNet-MM（R@1 +14.7%）。

Conclusion: 结果确立了"冻结流形对齐"（frozen manifold alignment）作为高差异跨模态场景下微调的一种有原则、数据高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Cross-modal alignment of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery to natural language is constrained by two distinct failures. The first is modality mismatch: text encoders pre-trained on optical imagery, such as CLIP, cannot be efficiently fine-tuned on SAR, because active microwave backscatter is physically incompatible with passive optical reflectance and the available SAR caption datasets are orders of magnitude too small to bridge this gap without substantially degrading the learned semantic manifold. The second is physical forgetting: SAR encoders pre-trained on large-scale self-supervised objectives encode radar physics that are progressively erased when the encoder is fine-tuned for text alignment on limited caption data. A single design principle addresses both failures: keep both encoders frozen and learn only a constrained, structure-preserving bridge. Our Frozen Expert framework aligns a frozen CROMA SAR encoder with a frozen CLIP text encoder via a lightweight constrained residual bridge. We formally define physical forgetting via Procrustes disparity and show our bridge preserves SAR geometry significantly better than fine-tuning (disparity: 0.210 vs. 0.351). We validate generality across multiple SAR backbones and text encoders. On zero-shot SAR scene classification, our approach outperforms fine-tuned baselines using up to 8x less training data: DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP), EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP), BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1). These results establish frozen manifold alignment as a principled, data-efficient alternative to fine-tuning in high-disparity cross-modal settings.

</details>


### [163] [DragonMoCap: Monocular Video-based Motion Capture for Diverse Dragon Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25437)
*Zhongfei Qing,Xiaoxiang Zhao,Ling-Hao Chen,Zhongang Cai,Wenjia Wang,Yifan Wu,Qianying Liu,Wei Zeng,Bo Hu,Songnan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DragonMoCap，将目标骨架作为动态输入而非固定先验，用语言驱动的关节查询token实现跨拓扑的单目龙形角色动作捕捉，并支持零样本适配新骨架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 龙形角色的单目动作捕捉目前依赖手工关键帧，原因是缺乏高质量数据集与参数化模型；更核心的障碍是龙骨架拓扑极其多样（关节数量、命名规范各异），使传统固定模板回归器无法适用。

Method: 将目标rig作为动态输入处理，并有意将框架限定在生产中最常见的拓扑范围内以保证保真度。核心是设计语言接地的关节查询token，建立“双重属性”表示：既保证同一rig内关节的可区分性，又保持跨rig的相似性；另提出非参数化的查询token检索机制，实现无需重训练的零样本新骨架适配。

Result: 在多种龙骨架拓扑上，DragonMoCap 一致优于 HMR 类基线方法；框架已集成到专业动画工作流中，体现出实时工业应用潜力。

Conclusion: 以“骨架为动态输入+语言接地token”的思路可有效解决异构骨架的单目动作捕捉问题，并在生产环境中具备实用性与实时性价值。

Abstract: This work explores monocular motion capture for dragon-type characters, which currently relies on manual keyframing due to the lack of high-quality datasets and parametric models. The primary obstacle lies in the extreme topological diversity across dragon rigs, where varying joint counts and naming conventions render traditional fixed-template regressors inapplicable. To address this, we introduce DragonMoCap, a novel framework that treats the target rig as a dynamic input rather than a fixed prior. By deliberately scoping the framework to the most prevalent production topologies, we ensure high-fidelity results across diverse morphologies. The core of our approach is the design of language-grounded joint query tokens, which establish a dual-property representation: ensuring intra-rig discriminability while maintaining cross-rig similarity. We further propose a non-parametric query-token retrieval mechanism to enable zero-shot adaptation to unseen rigs without retraining. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DragonMoCap consistently outperforms HMR-style baselines across diverse dragon topologies. The practical utility of our framework is further evidenced by its integration into professional animation workflows, highlighting its potential for real-time industrial applications.

</details>


### [164] [A New Hope for PRNU on Modern Smartphones? Evidence That Device-Specific Fingerprints Survive Computational Photography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25438)
*Benjamin Loison,Quentin Bammey,Thibaud Ehret,Rafael Grompone von Gioi,Pablo Musé,Marina Gardella*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对现代智能手机间PRNU指纹相关性过高的问题，验证了问题根源在于比较方式而非指纹本身，并提出ΔsPCE评分归一化方法提升归属准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究发现现代智能手机图像与指纹之间PRNU相关性很高，令人质疑PRNU在这些设备上的判别力。作者希望厘清：是指纹本身失效，还是比较方式不当。

Method: 在受控采集条件下（如无数字变焦）使用30部近期智能手机，分析发现同一型号所有指纹共有的成分会抬高标准sPCE。据此提出ΔsPCE：查询图像与候选相机指纹的sPCE，减去该图像与其余候选指纹的平均sPCE，思路类似T-norm分数归一化。

Result: ΔsPCE提升了归属准确率，表明设备特异性的PRNU信号仍然存在。

Conclusion: 数据集规模有限且ΔsPCE依赖候选相机集合，目前限制其实际适用性；但结果表明，在恰当比较指纹时，现代智能手机的PRNU归属仍可行。

Abstract: Photo Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is widely regarded as the most reliable marker for source camera identification. Recent studies, however, report high correlations between images and fingerprints from different modern smartphones, which calls into question the discriminative power of PRNU on these devices. Using 30 recent smartphones under controlled acquisition conditions (e.g., no digital zoom), we investigate whether the fingerprint itself is at fault or the way it is compared. We find that a component shared by all fingerprints of the same model inflates the standard signed peak-to-correlation energy (sPCE). To counter this, we propose $Δ$sPCE: the sPCE between a query image and a candidate camera's fingerprint, minus the mean sPCE between that image and the fingerprints of the remaining candidates, in the spirit of T-norm score normalization. $Δ$sPCE improves attribution accuracy, suggesting that the device-specific PRNU signal is still present. Although the limited dataset size and the dependence of $Δ$sPCE on the candidate camera set currently restrict operational applicability, these results suggest that PRNU-based attribution of modern smartphones remains feasible when fingerprints are compared appropriately.

</details>


### [165] [UBD-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Unimodal Branch Degradation in Multimodal Perception for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25448)
*Ang Liu,Xiang Gu,Ruikai Li,Qiyue Wang,Yizhe Fan,Hao Shan,Ziyang Yan,Han Jiang,Zhenning Li,Xiaoshuai Hao,Yilong Ren,Zhiyong Cui,Haiyang Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 UBD-Bench，系统研究多模态自动驾驶感知中单模态分支的表征退化（UBD）。用配对冻结分支探针发现 Camera 分支在联合训练后持续退化，且退化最严重处位于融合前的 Camera BEV 表征；据此在退化表征处做单模态到多模态蒸馏，可同时提升分支与整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合能提升自动驾驶感知输出性能，但更强输出不等于各模态分支的表征更强，分支级弱点在常规输出级评测中被掩盖。

Method: 构建 UBD-Bench：用 Paired Frozen-Branch Probe，在匹配解码条件下比较同一模态在独立单模态训练与多模态联合训练后的任务相关表征质量；覆盖 4 个自动驾驶感知任务、10 个模型，并做分层探针定位退化来源。基于诊断提出在退化表征处进行单模态到多模态蒸馏。

Result: Camera 分支在多模态联合训练后一致退化，LiDAR 分支变化较弱且依赖模型，呈现明显模态不对称；Camera 退化贯穿视觉骨干到 Camera-to-BEV 通路，在融合前 Camera BEV 表征处最严重。所提蒸馏干预在全部 4 个任务上同时提升 Camera 分支探针性能与全模型性能。

Conclusion: 多模态收益可与单模态表征退化并存；分支级表征质量应作为评估与改进多模态感知的重要维度。

Abstract: Multimodal perception improves autonomous-driving performance by combining complementary sensor information. However, stronger multimodal predictions do not necessarily imply stronger representations in each modality-specific branch. Such branch-level weaknesses can remain hidden in conventional output-level evaluation. We introduce UBD-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying unimodal branch degradation (UBD) in multimodal perception. UBD-Bench uses a Paired Frozen-Branch Probe to compare the task-relevant representation quality of the same modality after independent unimodal training and multimodal joint training under matched decoding conditions. Across four autonomous-driving perception tasks and 10 models, we find that Camera branches consistently degrade after multimodal joint training, whereas LiDAR branches exhibit weaker and more model-dependent changes, revealing a pronounced modality asymmetry. Hierarchical probing further shows that Camera-branch degradation extends from the visual backbone through the Camera-to-BEV pathway and is most severe at the pre-fusion Camera BEV representation. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce unimodal-to-multimodal distillation at the degraded representation. This intervention consistently improves both Camera-branch Probe performance and full-model performance across all four tasks. These results show that multimodal gains can coexist with degraded unimodal representations, highlighting branch-level representation quality as an important dimension for evaluating and improving multimodal perception.

</details>


### [166] [Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25479)
*Wenyi Lian,Zheng Zhao,Thomas B. Sch{ö}n*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出noise-rejuvenated SMC，一种面向文本到图像流匹配模型的推理时缩放方法，通过在重采样后将粒子映射到新的源噪声对应的中间状态实现粒子探索，无需转成SDE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMC用于奖励引导采样时依赖随机提议，而流匹配模型推理是确定性ODE，标准SMC无法直接适用。

Method: 对每个重采样粒子，改变其源噪声，并用当前端点估计构造新的中间状态，使其仍处于流匹配插值可表示的状态空间；另引入look-ahead机制在加权前精炼重采样粒子。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 3、FLUX.1-dev、Z-Image上奖励引导生成均有稳定提升，消融验证了噪声复新与look-ahead精炼的贡献。

Conclusion: 无需将采样器改为SDE即可在流匹配模型上实现有效的推理时SMC缩放，代码已开源。

Abstract: Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

</details>


### [167] [Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Models for Spatiotemporal Brain MRI Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25481)
*Antonio Scardace,Silvia Ingala,Sebastiano Battiato,Daniele Ravì*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MC-LDM，一种多模态条件潜扩散模型，用于患者个体化脑 MRI 的时空预测，训练时利用 MRI、tau-PET、CDR、APOE4 多模态生物标志物，推理时仅需基线 MRI、APOE4 与患者元数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病进展的 3D 解剖变化时空预测是重要的生成式视觉任务，但现有工作多依赖单一模态 MRI，tau-PET、临床评分等互补多模态标志物利用不足；同时临床部署中这些昂贵检查往往不可得，存在"丰富监督"与"实际可用性"之间的鸿沟。

Method: 构建潜扩散模型（LDM），用 LoRA 微调实现数据高效学习；设计多模态条件机制，融合分子（tau-PET）与临床（CDR、APOE4）信号以刻画异质病程；并引入辅助预测器，从 MRI 特征与患者协变量估计推理时不可观测的生物标志物以完成条件化。数据为 ADNI 的 852 名受试者、1,355 次随访。

Result: 在独立测试集（664 次随访）上，平均区域体积 MAE 相比次优基线降低 18%。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个利用多模态先验进行 MRI 预测的扩散框架，可生成捕捉结构解剖之外 AD 异质性的个体化轨迹，弥合多模态监督与常规临床部署约束之间的差距；代码已开源。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting of 3D anatomical changes is a critical generative vision challenge for modeling Alzheimer's Disease (AD) progression. While brain MRI forecasting from single-modality data has advanced, other key complementary multimodal biomarkers remain underutilized. In this work, we propose the Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (MC-LDM), a novel framework for patient-specific brain MRI synthesis. MC-LDM leverages multimodal biomarkers---MRI, tau-PET, Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR), and APOE4---during training, but relies only on baseline MRI, APOE4, and patient metadata at inference, reflecting realistic clinical availability. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for data-efficient learning; (2) a multimodal conditioning that integrates molecular and clinical signals to model heterogeneous disease trajectories; and (3) auxiliary predictors estimating unobserved multimodal biomarkers from MRI features and patient covariates to condition the diffusion model, removing the need for these assessments at inference. Trained on 1,355 visits from 852 subjects in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), MC-LDM reduces average regional volumetric MAE by 18% over the second-best baseline on an independent test set of 664 visits. To our knowledge, MC-LDM represents the first diffusion-based framework to leverage multimodal priors for MRI forecasting. This conceptual advancement enables patient-specific trajectory generation that captures aspects of AD heterogeneity not observable from structural anatomy alone, bridging the gap between rich multimodal supervision and the strict constraints of routine clinical deployment. Code is available at: https://github.com/antonioscardace/MC-LDM.

</details>


### [168] [PRIMA: Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter for Zero Shot Social Bodily Behavior Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25482)
*Mingcong Ding,Babette Bühler,Tim Fütterer,Ulrich Trautwein,Enkelejda Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PRIMA，一个轻量适配器，利用人体姿态作为训练时监督信号，将身体结构先验注入冻结的视觉语言模型，推理时只需RGB输入即可零样本识别细粒度身体行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度身体行为（自我理毛、姿势转换、附和动作等）识别对社会信号分析有用，但行为类别随社交语境变化，逐一定义重训成本高；VLM虽可通过文本提示适配新类别，却对身体结构不敏感，常混淆细微姿势差异。

Method: PRIMA将模型专属投影头与共享核心解耦，核心编码可迁移的身体构型知识；在微动作数据集上以姿态为训练监督训练，新VLM只需重训投影头，推理阶段不使用姿态输入，全部以零样本提示评估。

Result: 在训练域上识别提升；核心冻结即可迁移到不同规模的其他VLM骨干；泛化到社会心理学与日常活动识别的两个未见数据集；下游研究中改进的行为预测与人类对协作场景中融洽度和支配性的评分相关性更高。

Conclusion: 在受测模型与室内数据集范围内，姿态引导训练可获得跨未见行为词表泛化的身体结构先验，并可在VLM骨干间部分复用，同时保持仅RGB推理。

Abstract: Recognizing fine-grained bodily behaviors, such as self-grooming, postural shifts, and backchanneling, is a useful intermediate step for computational social signal analysis. But the behaviors that matter vary across social contexts, and retraining a model for each new taxonomy is expensive. Vision-language models (VLMs) can adapt to new categories through text prompts, yet they lack sensitivity to body structure and often confuse subtle postural distinctions. We propose PRIMA (Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter), a lightweight module that injects a body-structure prior into frozen VLMs using human pose as a training-time supervisory signal, requiring no pose input at inference. PRIMA separates a model-specific projection head from a shared core that encodes transferable body-configuration knowledge; adapting to a new VLM requires retraining only the head. We train PRIMA on a micro-action dataset and evaluate entirely through zero-shot prompting. The adapter improves recognition on its training domain, transfers to additional VLM backbones at different scales with the core frozen, and generalizes to two unseen target datasets from social psychology and daily activity recognition. In a supporting downstream study, the improved behavior predictions also yield higher correlations with human ratings of rapport and dominance in a collaboration context. Within the scope of the tested models and indoor datasets, the results indicate that pose-guided training can produce body-structure priors that generalize across unseen behavior vocabularies and can be partially reused across VLM backbones while preserving RGB-only inference.

</details>


### [169] [PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25486)
*Xueyang Li,Alec Girten,Peng Zeng,Mingze Jiang,Shaoyang Huang,Gelei Xu,Danny Z. Chen,Yiyu Shi,John N. Kheir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PediaDeviceSeg-1K——首个公开的儿科CICU胸片数据集（1000张，含临床落地的器械精细标注），并基于此构建PCXR-Copilot设备感知流水线，输出肺/器械掩膜、器械抑制视图及水肿相关可视化与标量指标，已在波士顿儿童医院TWIST平台实时部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科ICU/心脏ICU患者需频繁胸片监测支持设备、肺外水及体壁水肿，但重叠的解剖与医源性结构干扰读片；深度学习辅助受限于器械负担高、儿科数据集稀缺且缺乏临床可靠的器械标注。

Method: 构建PediaDeviceSeg-1K数据集（1000张儿科CICU前后位胸片，含临床落地的常见ICU器械细粒度标注）；基于该数据集开发PCXR-Copilot，一个设备感知流水线，生成肺与器械掩膜、可选器械抑制视图，以及水肿相关可视化图和标量指数。

Result: 提供了首个公开的儿科CICU胸片器械标注基准资源；PCXR-Copilot完整流水线已集成至波士顿儿童医院TWIST平台并实时运行，验证了真实临床部署可行性。

Conclusion: 通过数据集与设备感知流水线的结合，本文填补了儿科CICU胸片器械标注与设备感知分析的空白，并展示了临床实时部署的可行性。

Abstract: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.

</details>


### [170] [SlimFormer++: Token Mixing Where It Matters for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25488)
*Yang Hong,Lei Zhang,Zhihong Liu,Jianqing Mo,Xujiong Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过块级冗余与阶段级token-mixer贡献分析，提出阶段感知的稀疏混合分割网络SlimFormer++，在八个数据集上以最少参数取得最高Dice与最低HD95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体积分割网络中计算应分配在何处尚不清楚，需明确哪些模块真正必要，以改善精度-效率权衡。

Method: 用Centered Kernel Alignment分析块内输入输出表征相似性；提出Anatomical Relation Distortion量化跳过token mixer对解剖位置间特征关系的扭曲；基于发现设计SlimFormer++：首编码阶段用windowed Mamba的Selective Mixing块，深层仅用残差通道MLP，瓶颈处用Augmented Mixing将相似度加权稀疏长程上下文注入深度卷积轴向taps，代价关于体素数线性。

Result: 相似度引导剪枝在Dice下降不足0.4个百分点下减少39-75%参数；中间编码器mixer冗余高、贡献小，瓶颈mixer贡献最大；对比12个基线、8个公开CT/MRI/超声数据集（1809例），平均Dice 87.84%、HD95 6.50 mm，参数仅5.98M，均为最优。

Conclusion: 阶段感知的token mixing是提升体积分割精度-效率权衡的有效设计策略；源码已开源。

Abstract: To determine where computation is needed in volumetric segmentation networks, we analyze block-level redundancy and stage-wise token-mixer contribution. Centered Kernel Alignment reveals high input-output representational similarity within blocks of representative convolutional, hybrid, and Transformer-style segmentation networks. Similarity-guided pruning reduces their parameter counts by 39-75% while decreasing mean Dice by less than 0.4 percentage points. To examine token mixers within blocks, we introduce Anatomical Relation Distortion, which quantifies how bypassing a mixer distorts feature relations between labeled anatomical positions. Applied to an unpruned candidate architecture, Centered Kernel Alignment indicates high representational redundancy in intermediate encoder mixers, whereas Anatomical Relation Distortion shows that they contribute little and the bottleneck mixer most. These findings motivate SlimFormer++, which uses Selective Mixing blocks with windowed Mamba mixing in the first encoder stage and only residual channel MLPs in deeper stages. At the bottleneck, Augmented Mixing injects similarity-weighted sparse long-range context into the axial taps of a depthwise convolution at cost linear in voxel count. Evaluated against 12 baselines across eight public CT, MRI, and ultrasound datasets (1,809 cases), SlimFormer++ achieves the highest mean Dice (87.84%) and lowest mean HD95 (6.50 mm) with the fewest parameters (5.98 million). These results support stage-aware token mixing as a design strategy for improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in volumetric segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/WHHHHHY822/SlimFormerPlusPlus

</details>


### [171] [GroundedVDR: Grounding Video-to-Web Evidence Dependencies in Video Deep Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25493)
*Xiyuan Liang,Yu Wang,Zuhao Yang,Ziting Wang,Duo Li,Sudong Wang,Zhongyu Yang,Xiaoqin Zhang,Ling Shao,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视频深度研究基准 \method{}，要求模型同时使用视频时序信息与检索到的网络证据，并分别评测视频定位、网络证据定位与最终答案正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VDR 基准只评测工具调用轨迹和最终回答，不验证模型是否真正利用了视频时序信息或检索到的网络证据，模型可能靠参数化知识或单一信息源作答。

Method: 三项设计：1）人工审核 + 多模型受限访问探测，剔除仅凭参数化知识或单一信息源即可回答的问题；2）为每题标注结构化"视频—网页"证据链接，将相关视频片段与其支撑网页证据对应；3）评测协议分别给视频定位、网络证据定位、答案正确性打分。

Result: 在八个多模态智能体系统上测试，最佳答案准确率达 76.0%，但没有任何系统能在超过 8% 的问题上召回完整的必需网络证据。

Conclusion: 该基准揭示出当前系统高答案准确率与真实证据利用能力之间的显著落差，数据集已公开。

Abstract: Video large multimodal models have improved at identifying cross-frame visual evidence and conducting open-web retrieval, as reflected in recent video deep research (VDR) benchmarks. However, existing VDR benchmarks primarily evaluate tool-use trajectories and final responses without verifying whether a model actually uses the temporal video information or the retrieved web evidence. To fill this gap, we introduce \method{}, an evidence-grounded benchmark with three features. First, it combines human review with restricted-access probing across multiple models to exclude questions answerable from parametric knowledge or a single information source. Second, each question carries structured video-to-web evidence annotations that link the relevant video segments to their supporting web evidence. Third, its evaluation protocol separately scores video grounding, web evidence grounding, and final-answer correctness. Across eight multimodal agent systems, the best reaches 76.0\% answer accuracy, yet none recovers the complete required web evidence for more than 8\% of questions. Our benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hh721/vdr_temp}.

</details>


### [172] [From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25503)
*Junzhe Shi,Yuan Gan,Shida Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"从看到到报告"(FSR)理论，将视觉报告建模为从响应到解码记录、构造集合、任务答案的链条，并据此设计推理阶段流程，显著降低冻结VLMs在密集计数与GUI定位上的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-language models被要求"报告所见"（计数、框选、解析界面、GUI grounding）。作者认为报告是视觉任务的一部分而非单纯格式化，因为模型逐条列出的记录与它自己给出的计数可能矛盾（173个形状却报188），说明报告环节存在系统性误差，需专门建模。

Method: FSR理论+推理时程序：(1) 将报告拆为响应→解码记录→构造集合→任务答案的链条，用任务兼容匹配连接；(2) 给出精确关系式，用于删除记录、坐标平均、切换读出方式；(3) 将多调用选一答案的误差分解为缺失候选、丢失代表、错误选择三类；(4) 用任务规范和随附配置引导计数、检测、文档版面、屏幕解析与GUI grounding流程，无需目标任务标签。

Result: 50个密集合成场景上，单次调用"报告-解码"协议使每类计数误差降低85.2%(GPT-6.1)与98.8%(Claude Sonnet 5.5)。600个ScreenSpot-Pro样本上，三模型组合的GUI grounding层将漏检率从GPT-6.1两级缩放的13.67%降至9.33%；同等成本下三缩放聚类投票为12.67%，简单投票为12.33%——候选由他模型提供，关键在于择优而非简单投票。

Conclusion: 报告应作为视觉任务的一部分被显式建模；FSR的关系式与流程能在冻结模型、无标签条件下大幅改善计数与定位精度，并揭示多模型协作的收益来自候选生成后的选择机制。协议、存储响应与分析代码全部公开。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are asked to report what they see: to count objects, box them, parse a screen or pick a click target (GUI grounding). We argue that reporting is part of the visual task, not merely its formatting. In a dense scene with 173 shapes, GPT-6.1 lists 173 records that match every shape, yet the counts it states in the same response sum to 188. From Seeing to Reporting (FSR) is a theory of visual reporting and a set of inference-time procedures that improve the reports of frozen VLMs. It models reporting as a chain from responses to decoded records, constructed sets and task answers, linked by task-compatible matching. The chain gives exact relations for deleting records, averaging their coordinates and switching readouts, and it splits the error of one answer chosen among several calls into missing candidates, lost representatives and wrong choices. These relations guide procedures for counting, detection, document layout, screen parsing and GUI grounding that use the task specification and a shipped configuration, without requiring labels from the target task. On 50 dense synthetic scenes, a one-call reporting-and-decoding protocol cuts per-type count error by 85.2% for GPT-6.1 and 98.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5. On 600 ScreenSpot-Pro items, a GUI-grounding tier that combines three models lowers the miss rate from 13.67% for GPT-6.1's two-stage zoom to 9.33%, against 12.67% for three such zooms combined by a cluster vote at about the same cost. A plain vote over the same three models misses 12.33%: the other models supply the candidates, and selecting among them turns those candidates into fewer misses. We release the protocols, the stored responses and the analysis code.

</details>


### [173] [ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25517)
*Abteen Arab,Guile Wu,Dongfeng Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReDT是一种前馈视觉几何Transformer，通过将每个视图映射为固定大小的基元token集合，在紧凑恒定空间计算对应关系，从而将多视图重建扩展到高清输入，显著降低成本并提升质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉几何Transformer在固定SD分辨率上训练，难以扩展到高分辨率；高效架构只优化帧间注意力，昂贵的帧内与编码器注意力仍未解决，使HD重建不可行。

Method: 分辨率感知架构：先将每个视图映射为固定数量的基元token，在此紧凑恒定空间做多视图对应计算，再将输出投影回原始分辨率进行稠密预测。注意力内部表征与输入分辨率解耦。

Result: 在SD到FHD(2K)多个数据集上，重建质量与计算效率均优于SOTA。ETH3D(2K)上相较VGGT-Ω实现16倍加速、峰值GPU显存降低34%、Chamfer距离降低33%。

Conclusion: 解耦注意力表征与输入分辨率是可行且高效的路径，ReDT同时改善各分辨率下的性能与计算缩放性，使HD多视图重建变得实用。

Abstract: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

</details>


### [174] [Modaliff: A Unified Token Diffusion Model for Any-to-Any Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25533)
*Duc Kieu,Kien Do,Minh Khoa Le,Tung Kieu,Dang Nguyen,Thin Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Modaliff 是一种基于 token 的扩散模型，可从双模态配对数据中学习，在保留各模态原生隐序列结构的前提下实现文本、图像、音频之间的任意到任意生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任意到任意方法要么依赖完全对齐的多模态元组，要么使用会压制模态特有结构的共享表示，限制了数据可得性和生成质量。

Method: 将条件与目标拼接为统一 token 序列，并用 per-token 属性区分 token 身份、用基于角色的位置编码在不同序列布局下保留各模态内部结构，使单一去噪器无需任务特定架构改动或共享跨模态隐空间即可支持多种任务；多条件生成可通过推理时组合单条件预测，或对联合描述多输入的 caption 做轻量微调实现。

Result: 在文本、图像、音频实验中，Modaliff 在多数生成任务上取得任意到任意模型中最优的保真度，且参数量和训练数据显著更少。

Conclusion: 统一 token 序列 + 角色感知位置的扩散框架可在无共享隐空间、无全对齐数据条件下高效实现任意到任意多模态生成。

Abstract: Any-to-any generation seeks a single model that translates flexibly among text, image, and audio, yet existing approaches either require fully aligned multimodal tuples or a shared representation that suppresses modality-specific structure. We introduce Modaliff, a novel token-based diffusion model that learns from widely available bimodal pairs while preserving each modality in its native latent sequence. Modaliff assembles conditions and targets into a unified token sequence, with per-token attributes to disambiguate token identities and role-based positional embedding to preserve each modality's internal structure across sequence layouts. This design enables a single denoiser to support diverse generation tasks without task-specific architectural changes or a shared cross-modal latent space. Beyond one-to-one generation, Modaliff supports multiple conditions either by combining single-condition predictions at inference or by lightweight finetuning on captions that jointly describe multiple inputs. Experiments across text, image, and audio show that Modaliff achieves the best fidelity among any-to-any models on most generation tasks while using substantially fewer parameters and training data.

</details>


### [175] [Residential Construction Image Dataset Using CSI Divisions for Deep Learning-based Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25535)
*Fahad Iqbal,Shayan Mirzabeigi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ResCD-CSI数据集，一个按CSI工程规范分部结构组织的住宅施工现场图像基准，含16,365个标注目标、覆盖14个CSI大分部，用于施工要素的目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在建筑行业应用受限，主要因缺乏结构化、公开且与行业标准对齐的数据集。

Method: 采集美国多个活跃住宅施工现场的高分辨率图像，依据CSI分部框架人工标注边界框，构建统一标准的图像数据集。

Result: 数据集共16,365个目标，覆盖14个CSI主要分部，涵盖多样构件、材料与设备，均在真实工况下精确标注。

Conclusion: ResCD-CSI以CSI分部框架连接施工实践与计算机视觉研究，为AI驱动的住宅施工监测提供标准化资源基础。

Abstract: Accurate recognition of construction site elements is essential for the application of deep learning (DL) in the construction industry. Despite rapid advances in computer vision, the adoption of DL in construction has been limited by the lack of structured, publicly available datasets aligned with established industry standards. To address this gap, we introduce the Residential Construction Dataset Using CSI Divisions (ResCD-CSI) image dataset, a manually labeled image benchmark organized according to the divisional structure defined by the Construction Specifications Institute (CSI). The dataset comprises high-resolution images collected from active residential construction sites across the United States, capturing diverse building components, materials, and equipment under real-world conditions. In total, 16,365 objects spanning 14 major CSI divisions were precisely annotated using bounding boxes, ensuring consistency and reliability for object detection tasks. By aligning with the CSI divisional framework, ResCD-CSI establishes a standardized resource that bridges construction practice with computer vision research and supports the development of Artificial Intelligence-driven solutions for residential construction monitoring.

</details>


### [176] [Tricking Synthetic Image Detectors with Amortized Generative Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25554)
*Mohamed Awad,Khaled Elhady,Yasser Rohaim,Samuele Poppi,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统评估合成图像检测器对可迁移攻击的鲁棒性，提出同时改变"替代检测器"与"输入生成器"的双轴评测协议，发现迁移性是检测器与生成器联合决定的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像合成技术进步使合成图像检测器需求上升，但其对可迁移攻击的鲁棒性研究不足。现有评测通常只考察攻击在检测器之间的迁移，很少单独分离"被攻击图像来自不同生成器"时攻击效果如何变化，忽略了输入分布这一维度。

Method: 对三类代表性攻击（迭代扰动类 MIG、MuMoDIG 与摊销式生成攻击 Tricker）进行系统评测，覆盖4个检测器和5个不同架构的生成器。提出双轴评测协议，独立变化构造/训练攻击所用的替代检测器与提供输入图像的生成器；评估攻击有效性、跨检测器迁移性、感知质量、运行时间及与常见后处理的交互。同时简化 Tricker 的数据与训练需求以降低评测成本。

Result: 迁移性并非仅由检测器决定：输入-生成器分布强烈影响逃逸有效性与被攻击图像质量。MIG 与 MuMoDIG 明显依赖"检测器–生成器"组合，而 Tricker 提供更均匀的白盒逃逸效果与图像质量。后处理操作保持了这种不对称的迁移性拓扑结构。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了攻击评测中被忽视的维度，主张采用同时考虑检测器与生成器变化的迁移感知评测协议；将公开代码、评测数据与训练好的攻击模型，并附负责任使用声明。

Abstract: Rapid advances in image synthesis have increased the need for reliable synthetic-image detectors, yet their robustness to transferable attacks remains incomplete and understudied. Existing evaluations generally examine whether an attack constructed against one detector transfers to another, but rarely isolate how its effectiveness changes when the attacked images originate from different generators. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three representative attacks: two iterative perturbation-based methods, MIG and MuMoDIG, and the amortized generative attack Tricker. Across four detectors and five generators spanning diverse architectures, we introduce a two-axis evaluation protocol that independently varies the surrogate detector used to construct or train the attack and the generator supplying its input images. We assess attack effectiveness, cross-detector transferability, perceptual quality, runtime, and interaction with common post-processing operations. We revisit Tricker and show that its data and training requirements can be substantially reduced, enabling broader and more efficient evaluation. Our results demonstrate that transferability is not a detector-only property: the input-generator distribution strongly influences both evasion effectiveness and attacked-image quality. MIG and MuMoDIG exhibit pronounced dependence on the detector--generator pair, whereas Tricker provides more uniform white-box evasion and image quality. We additionally observe that post-processing maintains the asymmetric transferability topology. These findings expose a neglected dimension of attack evaluation and motivate transfer-aware protocols that jointly account for detector and generator variation. We will release our code, evaluation data, and trained attack models with a responsible-use statement.

</details>


### [177] [DiffGround: Semantic Difference-Guided Zero-Shot Video Question Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25570)
*Cheng-Han Lee,Amir Salimi,Hsiang-Wei Huang,Che-Chun Su,Min Sun,Cheng-Hao Kuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffGround is a training-free, action-driven zero-shot framework for Video Question Grounding that uses frozen MLLMs to predict an action cue, select keyframes, and refine temporal segments via semantic diff of SigLIP2 embeddings, achieving SOTA on NExT-GQA and STAR.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Video Question Grounding needs both answering and temporal localization. Supervised methods need costly temporal annotations; existing zero-shot methods target VQA and are not optimized for temporal grounding.

Method: Built on frozen MLLMs: (1) predict an answer-relevant action cue turning the reasoning question into an action-centric retrieval query; (2) a VLM uses the cue to select informative keyframes; (3) Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement exploiting semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions.

Result: On NExT-GQA and STAR, DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, setting a new state of the art for VideoQG.

Conclusion: Action-cue-guided keyframe selection plus training-free semantic diff refinement enables effective zero-shot temporal grounding without temporal annotations.

Abstract: Video Question Grounding (VideoQG) requires both accurate question answering and precise temporal localization. Existing supervised methods rely on costly temporal annotations, while existing zero-shot approaches are primarily designed for Video Question Answering (VQA) and are not optimized for temporal grounding. We propose DiffGround, an action-driven zero-shot framework built upon frozen Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework first predicts an answer-relevant action cue that transforms the input question into an explicit semantic target for grounding. Action Cue converts a reasoningoriented question into an action-centric retrieval query. Guided by the action cue, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) efficiently selects informative keyframes for reasoning. Finally, we introduce Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement method that exploits semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA and STAR show that DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, establishing a new state of the art for Video Question Grounding.

</details>


### [178] [ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25595)
*Bishoy Galoaa,Sarah Ostadabbas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViMoLa 从语言预测运动先验（压缩轨迹的64个VQ token），并通过零门控交叉注意力适配器注入冻结的 Wan 2.2 图像到视频 DiT，提升文本指定运动的方向准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导的视频生成常能还原场景内容，却难以实现所请求的运动。作者希望显式地向冻结的视频生成骨干注入语言预测的运动先验，以改善运动控制。

Method: 空间向量量化自编码器将稠密轨迹压缩为来自512码本的64个token；28M参数transformer由文本预测这些token；零门控交叉注意力适配器经forward hook接入每个冻结的Wan 2.2 DiT块。训练数据为Something-Something v2与Kinetics-400共462K视频。另测低秩适配器版本及将分词器与语言模型迁移到新训练CogVideoX适配器。

Result: 方向准确率由0.287升至0.442（随机0.250），生成质量相近；跨提示打乱码为0.283，说明提示匹配的token内容重要。低秩适配器以1.45%额外前向FLOPs达0.428；迁移到CogVideoX由0.301升至0.398。局限：oracle码仅0.531，复合运动增益较小，适配器未显式保持token到patch的对应。

Conclusion: 语言预测的运动先验可有效注入冻结视频生成骨干，显著提升运动方向可控性且代价低、具一定可迁移性，但控制仍不完美。

Abstract: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.

</details>


### [179] [CheXFuse: Guided Differential Joint Attention Fusion for Robust Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classification in Data-Scarce Medical Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25617)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Priyanka Siddappa,Md Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma,Md Ripon Ahammed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CheXFuse多模态融合框架，基于引导差分联合注意力（GuDJA），在胸片正常/异常二分类上取得最优平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合中，当各模态预测能力差异较大时，无差别的跨模态交互会引入弱、冗余或不稳定信号，甚至劣于最强单模态表现，因此需要一种能抑制弱信号的融合策略。

Method: 提出CheXFuse框架，核心为GuDJA：将图像与文本token表示拼接成联合多模态序列，利用可学习的token引导突出有信息量的表示，并用差分注意力削弱作用较小的注意力响应。

Result: 在IU Chest X-ray数据集二分类任务上，原始报告设置下准确率95.73%、F1 95.79%、召回96.54%、Sens@95Spec 95.28%；掩码报告设置下分别为95.58%、95.60%、95.60%、94.34%，均为对比基线中最优平均表现。

Conclusion: GuDJA在模态信息量不对称或部分减弱时是一种有前景的融合策略，掩码报告实验验证了其在文本信息受损条件下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: A central challenge in multimodal learning is how to fuse modalities that differ substantially in predictive strength. When one modality provides a much stronger representation than another, indiscriminate cross-modal interaction can introduce weak, redundant, or unstable signals, limiting or even degrading performance relative to the strongest unimodal representation. To address this problem, we propose CheXFuse, a multimodal fusion framework based on Guided Differential Joint Attention (GuDJA). CheXFuse combines image and text token representations within a joint multimodal sequence, where learned token guidance emphasizes informative representations and differential attention reduces less useful attention responses. We evaluate CheXFuse on the Indiana University (IU) Chest X-ray dataset, using binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification as the downstream task. Experiments are conducted under both original-report and masked-report settings, with the latter serving as a controlled stress test under reduced textual informativeness. CheXFuse with GuDJA achieves the strongest mean overall performance across the evaluated baselines and ablations, reaching 95.73% accuracy, 95.79% F1-score, 96.54% recall, and 95.28% sensitivity at 95% specificity (Sens@95Spec) with original reports, and 95.58%, 95.60%, 95.60%, and 94.34%, respectively, under masked reports. These results suggest that GuDJA provides a promising fusion strategy under asymmetric or partially reduced modality informativeness.

</details>


### [180] [Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25622)
*Sofia McLeod,Mohsi Jawaid,Carl Seubert,Tat-Jun Chin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用循环视觉Transformer（RVT）解决慢速相对运动下事件相机航天器位姿估计（EBSPE）信噪比低的问题，利用循环记忆跨稀疏事件流捕获长期信息并学习时间注意力跨度，在真实慢速RPO轨迹数据上验证了精度和稳定性优于逐帧/固定时间窗方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机凭借超高动态范围可应对轨道恶劣光照，但在真实RPO中为安全常需极慢相对运动（低至1 mm/s）并伴随低照度，导致事件率骤降、数据信噪比很低，使EBSPE失效。因此解决慢速相对运动问题是提升EBSPE实用性的关键。

Method: 采用循环视觉Transformer（RVT）进行EBSPE：核心是用循环记忆跨稀疏事件流捕获更长期的信息，并从完整轨迹中学习时间注意力跨度而非固定时间窗；构建基于RVT的热力图回归器生成2D-3D对应关系以完成位姿估计。

Result: 在真实事件相机数据（对应RPO典型的慢速相对运动）上验证，RVT方法相比以往逐事件帧方法或固定时间窗方法，位姿估计精度更高、稳定性更好。

Conclusion: 循环记忆与可学习时间注意力可有效缓解慢速运动下事件稀疏、低信噪比的难题，显著提升事件相机航天器位姿估计的实用性。

Abstract: Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.

</details>


### [181] [Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25631)
*Jeagon Song,Jhonghyun An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅在训练期使用的前景吸引损失，将前景伪标签像素结合伪深度反投影为3D点并吸引附近高斯靠近，无需3D标签、不改变推理网络，从而提升稀疏高斯表示中前景物体的高斯密度与前景IoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机3D语义占据模型可借助渲染与2D伪标签免3D标注训练，但高斯位置仅靠逐像素渲染损失学习，作者假设这会给予小前景物体很小的权重；实测GaussianFlowOcc模型中前景体素上的高斯密度仅为背景的1.62倍，说明前景表示过于稀疏。

Method: 提出训练专用的前景吸引损失：用伪深度将前景伪标签像素反投影到3D空间，把附近高斯拉向这些3D点，并优先作用于已预测目标类别的高斯；推理网络保持不变。另外对比了将目标放在真值体素上的变体，以及仅作用于高斯位置的做法。

Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上，三个随机种子下前景/背景高斯密度比提升至2.40；前景IoU均值从6.29升至6.96且每个种子均提升，而mIoU变化（13.53→13.82）处于基线种子间波动范围内。单次运行消融显示伪标签目标优于真值体素目标，仅调整高斯位置并不充分；单种子测试显示推理时保留更少高斯时性能下降更小。

Conclusion: 通过训练期前景吸引损失，可在不增加标注、不改变推理的前提下改善稀疏高斯占据表示中对小前景物体的覆盖，前景IoU稳定提升；但整体mIoU改善尚不显著，消融与鲁棒性结论仍需多随机种子验证。

Abstract: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

</details>


### [182] [Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25633)
*Sundas Iqbal,Danish Ali,Qing Tian,Yuhui Zheng,Jianping Gou,Weihua Ou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CGPLR框架，通过置信度引导的伪标签精炼实现无监督域自适应行人重识别


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域偏移导致伪标签噪声在迭代适应中被强化；现有聚类方法依赖有限的可靠性线索或全局置信度准则，对模糊目标样本施加硬性身份监督

Method: 联合建模质心兼容性、局部邻域一致性、与最强竞争簇的分离度及时序分配稳定性估计样本级可靠性；据此生成簇自适应上下阈值进行三向选择性决策（保留可靠/重分配可恢复/延迟模糊样本）；学习目标相应采用置信加权监督、谨慎修正标签加权与无标签表征一致性

Result: Market-1501→MSMT17达76.4% Rank-1、47.6% mAP；MSMT17→Market-1501达95.1% Rank-1、87.7% mAP

Conclusion: 验证了可靠性感知的选择性自适应策略的有效性，代码已开源

Abstract: Unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification remains challenging because domain shifts generate noisy pseudo labels that are reinforced during iterative adaptation. Existing clustering-based methods often rely on limited reliability cues or global confidence criteria and may impose hard identity supervision on ambiguous target samples. To address these limitations, we propose CGPLR, a confidence-guided pseudo-label refinement framework for unsupervised domain-adaptive person re-identification. CGPLR estimates sample-level reliability by jointly modeling centroid compatibility, local neighborhood consistency, separation from the strongest competing cluster and temporal assignment stability. The resulting confidence distribution is used to derive cluster-adaptive upper and lower thresholds for a three-way selective decision. Reliable assignments are preserved, recoverable samples are reassigned only when an alternative cluster receives sufficient geometric and neighborhood support and highly ambiguous samples are deferred from hard identity supervision. The learning objective adapts to these decisions through confidence-weighted supervision for preserved samples, cautious corrected-label weighting for reassigned samples and label-free representation consistency for deferred samples. CGPLR achieves 76.4% Rank-1 accuracy and 47.6% mean average precision (mAP) on Market-1501 to MSMT17, and 95.1% Rank-1 accuracy and 87.7% mAP on MSMT17 to Market-1501, demonstrating effective reliability-aware selective adaptation. The code is available at https://github.com/Sundas058/CGPLR.

</details>


### [183] [Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25634)
*Wenqing Wang,Joonghyuk Shin,Jonathan Tremblay,Chan Hee Song,Yun Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Clean Forcing，通过对冻结基座训练 5.9M 参数 LoRA 修正器回归"反事实速度差"，缓解自回归视频扩散模型的曝光偏差与漂移，几乎零成本且数据效率极高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成，训练用干净上下文、推理却用自身不完美输出，导致曝光偏差累积、误差在数秒内崩溃（drift）。现有方法要么需集群级重训，要么免训练修正效果不稳，要么训练冻结基座修正器来处理采样与缓存误差。

Method: 发现漂移近似确定性、可学习：固定噪声状态、只变历史，会暴露反事实速度差，约95%跨噪声种子是系统性的。据此在冻结基座上训练 5.9M 参数 LoRA 修正器回归该差距；闭环阶段加入 DAgger 式聚合与漂移收缩目标，使修正器接触自身 rollout；干净历史可来自基座单次生成，无需真实视频，合并后无推理开销。

Result: 50 秒文生视频中，Δ-drift 从 +11.3 降至 +1.65（无真实视频），加入 40 个真实片段则降至 -0.16，优于已发表最佳 +3.57，且数据量少 150 倍以上。美学质量与数据效率均优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 漂移的可预测性使轻量修正器即可有效抑制长时序漂移，实现高数据效率、零推理开销的长视频生成方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ~95% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing, which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model's own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos, and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces Δ-drift from +11.3 to +1.65 without real video and to -0.16 with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of +3.57 with over 150x less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.

</details>


### [184] [TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25637)
*Jineon Kim,Jhonghyun An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出地形归一化垂直分布扫描上下文(TNVD-SC)，用与地形相对的垂直概率分布代替高度编码，在保留SC环-扇拓扑的同时解决森林LiDAR重定位的结构混叠，TreeLoc++协议下平均R@1达91.83%，并以无损计数编码+JS层次检索降低约3.86倍描述子体积与23.8%时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林长期LiDAR位置识别受重复植被与崎岖地形影响，产生严重结构混叠。作者将Scan Context(SC)拆分为候选检索与精细匹配诊断：TNVD支持键能在约99%查询中把真实位置放入top-25候选，但常规SC匹配仅61.84% R@1。进一步对照实验显示，在同一原始SC候选集上，地形归一化使最大高度单元仅提升1.21点，而垂直分布单元提升19.72点——说明瓶颈在垂直描述方式而非候选质量。

Method: 提出TNVD-SC：保留SC原有的环-扇(ring-sector)拓扑结构，将描述子改为编码相对于地形的垂直概率分布(terrain-relative vertical probability distribution)，取代绝对高度/最大高度编码。同时设计无损计数编码实现与精确层次Jensen-Shannon检索，在保持检索输出完全一致的前提下压缩描述子并加速计算。

Result: 在标准化TreeLoc++ Wild-Places协议上，TNVD-SC平均R@1达91.83%，在对比方法中取得最高R@1均值与R@1稳定性；TreeLoc++在平均MR、MF1、AUC上仍更强。未改动方法在四会话CVTNet风格NCLT评测中达85.14% R@1。无损计数编码与精确层次JS检索使描述子负载减少3.86倍、计算时延降低23.8%，且审计的检索输出不变。

Conclusion: 森林场景的SC失效主要源于对地形起伏敏感的垂直编码，而非候选召回；以地形相对垂直分布重编码即可显著提升R@1与稳定性。方法在跨数据集(NCLT)上保持较好泛化，并提供无损、可加速的工程化实现；局限在于最优综合精度指标(MR/MF1/AUC)仍不及TreeLoc++。

Abstract: Long-term LiDAR place recognition in forests is difficult because repetitive vegetation and uneven terrain create severe structural aliasing. We diagnose Scan Context (SC) by separating candidate retrieval from fine matching: on the standardized TreeLoc++ Wild-Places protocol, a TNVD support key places a valid location in the top-25 set for approximately 99% of queries, while conventional SC matching on those candidates reaches only 61.84% mean R@1. With an identical raw-SC candidate set, terrain normalization improves max-height cells by only 1.21 points but vertical-distribution cells by 19.72 points. These observations motivate Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC), which preserves the SC ring-sector topology while encoding terrain-relative vertical probability distributions. Under the standardized TreeLoc++ protocol, TNVD-SC reaches 91.83% mean R@1 and attains the highest R@1 mean and R@1 stability among the compared methods, while TreeLoc++ remains stronger in mean MR, MF1, and AUC. The unchanged method reaches 85.14% mean R@1 on the four-session CVTNet-style NCLT evaluation.
