ChatGPT follows the location an application declares, down to the city: it writes the place into its own searches, and its search backend localizes results even when the queries name no place. It ignores the network. Gemini ignores the declared location and follows the country of the network, changing most of its sources even for questions that do not depend on place. The businesses the answers recommend change with the sources. Thus, visibility in generative search is specific to the user's location, and audits must control both channels.

</details>


### [474] [Candidate-dependent residual routing trades top-of-list accuracy for recall in sequential recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24200)
*Han Chen,Yingrui Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在REES46数据集上给自注意力序列推荐加入小型候选依赖路由模块，NDCG@10基本不变，但召回上升、首位排序下降，二者相抵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验候选依赖路由（为每个待打分物品对用户历史赋予不同权重）这一灵活性是否真能提升序列推荐效果。

Method: 在自注意力基线上加入小型残差路由模块，两种版本仅以路由权重来源区分（用户历史表示 vs 候选物品嵌入）；REES46美妆店数据、5个配对种子、三个模型训练条件匹配。

Result: NDCG@10平均相对变化+0.003%（基本持平）；召回+1.81%但MRR −1.09%，新增命中多落在第6–10位；收益来自目标出现在最近50个事件内的查询，窗口外查询变差。

Conclusion: 该形式下候选依赖路由以列表顶部的准确率换取靠后位置的召回，整体净收益近零；其价值高度依赖目标在近期历史中的可得性。

Abstract: Candidate-dependent routing lets a sequential recommender weight a user's past behaviors differently for each item it scores. We test whether this flexibility helps by adding a small residual routing module to a self-attentive baseline, in two versions that differ only in what sets the routing weights: the user's history representation or the candidate item's embedding. Across five paired seeds on the REES46 cosmetics-shop dataset, with matched training for all three models, candidate-dependent routing leaves the primary metric, normalized discounted cumulative gain at cutoff ten (NDCG@10), essentially unchanged (mean relative change +0.003%). Secondary and exploratory analyses show that this flat average hides two effects that cancel. The candidate-dependent model places more relevant items in its top ten (recall +1.81%) but ranks the first one lower (mean reciprocal rank -1.09%), and most of its new hits land at positions six to ten. Its gains come from queries with at least one target among the user's last 50 events, while queries whose targets all lie outside that window get worse. In this form, candidate-dependent routing trades accuracy at the top of the list for recall further down.

</details>


### [475] [Optimal Fusion Weights Form Intervals, Not Points: A Latency-Aware Study of Query-Adaptive WRRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24341)
*Iris Ma,Zahra Shekarchi,Stuart Mcilroy,Mahtab Farrokh,Fattane Zarrinkalam,Joel Stremmel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对混合检索中的RRF融合进行实证研究，发现每查询最佳融合权重是区间而非单点，多数动态融合方法优于标准RRF，并提出分层决策框架帮助选择合适方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RRF在稀疏-稠密混合检索中广泛使用，但对每个检索器赋予固定均匀权重，与查询无关；已有查询感知方法假设每查询最佳权重为单点，该假设缺乏实证检验。

Method: 在4个数据集、4种稀疏-稠密检索器组合上，实证比较8种动态融合权重预测策略，与静态融合及每查询oracle性能上界进行对比，并做FDR校正的显著性检验。

Result: 每查询最佳融合权重通常是区间（甚至多个、形状多样）而非单点；128种动态融合方法中有74种经FDR校正后显著优于标准RRF；不同动态方法在质量与延迟上各有差异。

Conclusion: 提出分层决策框架，将实践者约束、数据属性、标签可得性、硬件及延迟预算映射到合适的方法类别；代码已开源。

Abstract: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is widely used to combine sparse and dense retrievers in hybrid information retrieval, but a critical limitation is that it assigns a fixed, uniform weight to each retriever regardless of the query. Query-aware methods treat the per-query optimal weight as a single point, an assumption whose empirical validity has not been examined. We present an empirical study of eight dynamic fusion weight prediction strategies across four datasets and four sparse--dense retriever pairs. When we compare these approaches to static fusion and a per-query oracle that bounds achievable performance, several findings emerge. First, the per-query optimal fusion weight is typically an interval rather than a point. Queries can have multiple optimal intervals, and these can take on a variety of shapes. Second, 74 of 128 dynamic fusion methods tested were significantly better than standard RRF after false discovery rate correction. Third, dynamic fusion methods exhibit differing quality and latency characteristics that should be considered when choosing an appropriate fusion method. To address this last finding, we present a tiered decision framework that maps practitioner constraints, dataset properties, label availability, hardware, and latency budget to an appropriate method class. We release the code for our experiments at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/query-based-rrf.

</details>


### [476] [DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24481)
*Jiang Wu,Yutong Song,Hongbo Wang,Guanghe Cao,Jeff Liang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DuoLM 用编码器 LLM 离线生成物品表示，再由个性化排序 LLM 结合用户历史/反馈打分，配合专用运行时优化，实现与教师模型相当的推荐质量，且吞吐约为 vLLM 教师的 60 倍（单 H100 约 26,400 分/秒）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用语言模型做个性化推荐时，若对大量候选用全文输入逐一评估，在线计算开销大、服务吞吐受限，难以实用。

Method: 框架由紧凑推荐模型与高效服务运行时构成：编码器 LLM 学习可离线复用的紧凑物品表示；个性化排序器 LLM 将表示与用户历史、反馈结合进行推荐；两模型以推荐监督信号和教师蒸馏端到端训练。运行时通过虚拟 token ID 访问嵌入、共享历史计算和 CUDA Graph 回放加速推理。

Result: 推荐质量与专家教师模型相当；单张 H100 上约 26,400 条候选评分/秒，约为使用 vLLM 与自动前缀缓存的教师模型的 60 倍吞吐。

Conclusion: 将离线物品编码、轻量排序与系统级推理优化结合，可在保持推荐质量的同时大幅提升基于 LLM 的个性化推荐服务效率。

Abstract: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.

</details>


### [477] [RAGit: Turning Document Preprocessing into an Experimental Variable for RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24659)
*Omar El Bachyr,Saad Ezzini,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Jacques Klein*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RAGit：开源实验工作台，可将文档预处理作为显式实验变量，在固定下游配置下系统、可复现地评估 RAG 检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档预处理（解析、分块等）对 RAG 检索影响很大，但通常靠经验启发式选择，且缺乏在一致条件下可比的评估手段。

Method: 将解析、分块、索引、检索、评估建模为可配置的实验阶段，固定其余下游设置以做受控对比；保留从检索块到源页面的溯源信息，并把异构检索单元映射到统一的页面级排序进行评估；支持多种解析器与分块策略、稠密与晚交互检索、中间产物复用及多配置基准测试。

Result: 在固定检索设置下进行受控实验，比较了不同预处理配置，展示预处理可作为显式实验变量；工具与文档已在 GitHub 公开，并提供演示视频。

Conclusion: RAGit 为 RAG 预处理选择提供了系统、可复现的实验框架，推动预处理从经验性选择转向可量化验证的变量。

Abstract: Document preprocessing choices can substantially affect retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, yet they are often selected heuristically and are difficult to compare under consistent conditions. We present RAGit, an open-source experimentation workbench for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of document preprocessing choices through downstream retrieval. RAGit represents parsing, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation as configurable experimental stages, enabling controlled comparisons while the remaining downstream settings are kept fixed. It preserves provenance from retrieved chunks to source pages and maps heterogeneous retrieval units to a common page-level ranking for evaluation. The current implementation supports multiple parsers and chunking strategies, dense and late-interaction retrieval, reusable intermediate artifacts, and multi-configuration benchmarking. We demonstrate RAGit through controlled experiments comparing alternative preprocessing configurations under a fixed retrieval setup, illustrating how preprocessing can be treated as an explicit experimental variable. RAGit and its documentation are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/OmarElbachyr/ragit). A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/tsst-Bhfz4I.

</details>


### [478] [MemRevise: A Self-Revising Memory for Conversational Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24672)
*Mohammed Ali,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CONVREVISE基准（六层级返回与修订，共4429题）与MEMREVISE方法（可修订记忆图+3B写入器+记忆引导检索），MRR@10达0.701，显著优于此前的ConvSearch-R1-FT（0.589）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式搜索中用户会纠正误解、修改请求并回到早前话题，导致部分历史不再代表当前意图。现有基准未单独隔离这类"被丢弃/修订"的轮次；现有方法要么重读全部历史、要么保留每轮记录，均无法标记早期内容为已丢弃。

Method: 构建CONVREVISE基准：基于TopiOCQA、CORAL、OR-QuAC，按"返回与修订"划分为六个难度层级。提出MEMREVISE：可修订记忆图 + 从教师记忆蒸馏的3B写入器 + 基于记忆的检索。写入器每轮只读一次，添加记录话题、事实与操作（新增/放弃/重新激活）的节点；话题状态由操作推导，被放弃话题保留事实且可恢复。

Result: 冻结检索器下平均MRR@10为0.701，优于最佳竞品ConvSearch-R1-FT的0.589；无记忆的同法蒸馏写入器为0.617，说明记忆及其派生步骤贡献+0.084。在TopiOCQA与OR-QuAC上显著更优，在CORAL上与提示式32B重写器统计持平，在任何层级均未显著落后于最强竞品。

Conclusion: 显式标注被丢弃/修订内容并维护可修订记忆，比反复重读历史或全量保留更有效，且小模型（3B）配合结构化记忆可媲美大模型重写器。

Abstract: In conversational search, users correct misun-derstandings, revise their requests and return to earlier topics, so part of the history no longer reflects what they want. Existing benchmarks do not isolate such turns. Current search methods either re-read the history or keep a record of every turn, and none of them marks earlier content as dropped. We introduce CONVREVISE, a benchmark of 4,429 test questions in six tiers of returns and revisions over TopiOCQA, CORAL and OR-QuAC. We also propose MEMREVISE, which combines a revisable memory graph, a 3B writer distilled from teacher memories, and a search guided by the memory. The writer reads each turn once and adds a node that records its topic, its facts and the operations it performs, such as adding, abandoning or reactivating a topic. Topic status follows from these operations, so a dropped topic keeps its facts and can be restored. With a frozen retriever, MEMREVISE reaches a mean MRR@10 of 0.701, against 0.589 for the best competitor, ConvSearch-R1-FT, and 0.617 for a writer distilled the same way without the memory, so the memory and the steps built on it add 0.084. MEMREVISE is significantly better on Topi- OCQA and OR-QuAC, statistically tied with prompted 32B rewriters on CORAL, and never significantly behind the strongest competitor of any tier.

</details>


### [479] [VisR-RAG-Fin: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG over Visually Rich Financial Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24822)
*Omar El Bachyr,Laura Maria Bernardy,Saad Ezzini,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Charles Mont'e,Anas Zilali,Ulrick Ble,Anne Goujon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文针对视觉信息丰富的企业财务文档，构建开源基准VisR-RAG-Fin，并对多模态RAG在检索与生成各环节的设计选择进行系统实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 财务报告等企业文档主要为人类阅读设计，融合密集文本、表格、图表与复杂版面，给RAG系统的检索与生成带来挑战；尽管多模态检索与视觉语言模型已有进展，但检索与生成组件设计选择如何影响端到端性能仍缺乏理解。

Method: 提出VisR-RAG-Fin基准，通过保留原始版面与视觉内容的通用流水线构建，用于页面级问答；在纯文本、多模态与混合配置下系统分析检索与生成行为。

Result: 提供了可对复杂企业文档集合上RAG系统进行严格评估的基础，并系统比较了不同配置下检索与生成的表现。

Conclusion: 为设计并评估面向复杂、视觉丰富企业文档的多模态RAG流水线的从业者提供了可操作的洞见。

Abstract: Enterprise documents such as financial reports are increasingly processed by automated systems, yet they are primarily designed for human reading and exhibit complex visual structure, combining dense text with tables, charts, diagrams, and rich layouts. These characteristics pose significant challenges for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which must retrieve relevant pages and leverage visual and structural information during answer generation. Despite recent advances in multimodal retrieval and vision-language models, there remains a limited understanding of how design choices across retrieval and generation components affect end-to-end RAG performance on visually rich documents. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of multimodal RAG for page-level Question Answering (QA) over financial documents. We introduce VisR-RAG-Fin (Visually Rich RAG for Finance), an open-source benchmark constructed through a general pipeline for visually rich documents that preserves original layout and visual content. Using this benchmark, we systematically analyze retrieval and generation behavior under text-only, multimodal, and hybrid configurations, providing a foundation for rigorous evaluation of RAG systems on complex enterprise document collections. Overall, this work provides actionable insights for practitioners designing and evaluating multimodal RAG pipelines over complex, visually rich enterprise documents.

</details>


### [480] [Structure-Aligned History Learning with Subspace-Structured Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25093)
*Kaiwen Wei,Kejun He,Jie Zhang,Xiaomian Kang,Yuming Yang,Aijia Zhou,Xie Zhou,Yining Wang,Nayu Liu,Li Jin,Zhenyang Li,Jiang Zhong,He Bai,Jingxuan Wei,Junnan Zhu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SAHL通过将量化阶段构建的语义结构直接用于历史重建，把生成式推荐的两个阶段重新连接，在四个Amazon类别上显著超越RPG与MHL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐存在两方面局限：量化器易产生码本分配不均衡，且缺乏介于单个token与完整item之间的连贯中间语义单元，限制了历史重建；同时推荐模型过度依赖下一物品预测，历史交互仅作条件上下文，对跨越远距离交互的持久偏好缺乏监督。

Method: 提出结构对齐历史学习（SAHL）：其语义残差均衡量化（SRBQ）构建均衡的token–子空间–物品层级结构，SAHL在相同粒度上重建历史；用预测熵优先关注不确定转移，并通过课程优化逐步转向与推理一致的下一物品预测。

Result: 在四个Amazon Review类别上，SAHL相较RPG提升NDCG@10达18.6%–30.0%，相较强基线MHL提升2.7%–6.0%；对照分析验证了码本均衡使用、按量化器定义分组进行重建的收益，以及对用户历史的依赖性。

Conclusion: 以量化生成的结构对齐历史重建，可同时改善语义ID质量与历史偏好监督，代码已开源。

Abstract: Generative recommendation constructs semantic IDs for catalog items and predicts the next ID from user interaction histories. However, existing methods face limitations in both stages. First, conventional quantizers may produce imbalanced code assignments and lack coherent intermediate semantic units between individual tokens and complete items, limiting history reconstruction. Second, recommendation models remain dominated by next-item prediction, treating historical interactions mainly as conditioning context and providing limited supervision for recovering persistent preferences across the historical path, particularly when relevant preference signals are distributed over distant interactions. To address these limitations, Structure-Aligned History Learning (SAHL) reconnects the two stages by using the structure created during quantization directly for history reconstruction. Its Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization (SRBQ) forms a balanced token-subspace-item hierarchy, and SAHL reconstructs history at these same granularities. Predictive entropy prioritizes uncertain transitions, while curriculum optimization progressively shifts training to inference-aligned next-item prediction. On four Amazon Review categories, SAHL improves NDCG@10 by 18.6%-30.0% over RPG and 2.7%-6.0% over strong method MHL. Controlled analyses verify balanced code use, the benefit of following quantizer-defined groups during reconstruction, and dependence on user history. The relevant code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/SAHL.

</details>


### [481] [When Semantics Fall Short: Persona-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25221)
*Jundong Chen,Honglei Zhang,Shuai An,Enneng Yang,Han Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出PerCDR框架，以LLM推断的用户画像（persona）引导跨域行为迁移，并用局部语义关系增强域内行为建模，替代全局语义桥接，提升跨域序列推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的跨域序列推荐（CDSR）依赖全局物品语义桥接域间信息，但存在两个固有问题：一是语义域隔离，物品语义仍局限于各自域，难以形成可迁移表示；二是语义-行为不一致，局部语义与行为转移一致，但该一致性在跨域全局层面常被破坏。

Method: PerCDR将重心从全局语义桥接转向画像引导的行为建模：利用LLM推断的用户画像在全局层面引导可迁移的跨域行为模式；利用局部语义关系增强域内行为建模；最后通过域偏好自适应进行推荐结果的精炼。

Result: 大量实验表明PerCDR优于对比方法，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 以画像引导的行为建模替代全局语义对齐，是缓解跨域序列推荐数据稀疏与语义不一致问题的有效途径。

Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation (CDSR) alleviates data sparsity by transferring user behaviors across domains. Recent advances increasingly leverage large language models (LLMs) to bridge domains through global item semantics. However, this paradigm is inherently limited by two issues: I. semantic domain isolation, where item semantics remain domain-specific and hinder transferable modeling, and II. semantic-behavior inconsistency, where local semantic relations are more consistent with behavioral transitions, whereas such consistency often breaks down globally across domains. To this end, we propose PerCDR, an LLM-enhanced CDSR framework that shifts the focus from global semantic bridging to persona-guided behavioral modeling. Specifically, PerCDR leverages LLM-inferred personas to globally guide transferable cross-domain behavioral patterns, while exploiting local semantic relations to enhance intra-domain behavioral modeling, followed by domain preference adaptation for recommendation refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PerCDR and validate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [482] [MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25282)
*Mohamed Mahmoud,Mostafa Farouk Senussi,Mahmoud Abdalla,Mahmoud SalahEldin Kasem,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Hyun Soo Kang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MEMORA 是一个记忆增强的多模态编排重排智能体，通过因子委员会重排、情节记忆模块和推理感知稠密检索器，在 MM-BRIGHT 29 个领域上显著超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理密集型检索面临两大挑战：查询需要深层语义推理，且常以多模态形式出现。现有系统将每个查询孤立处理、依赖单一整体式重排器、且缺乏为跨模态推理训练的检索器。

Method: 提出三项贡献：(1) 协作因子委员会重排，将查询分解为意图因子，抽取因子特定证据构成结构化矩阵，并通过记忆条件化的元裁决模型综合判断；(2) 情节记忆模块，跨查询跟踪因子结果并在推理时动态调整优先级；(3) 推理感知稠密检索器，用链式思维增强在 2 万+ 推理密集型查询对上微调。

Result: 在 MM-BRIGHT 的 29 个领域上，MEMORA 取得 nDCG@10 为 41.5（文-文）和 38.9（多模态查询-文），分别比最强纯文本智能体基线高 8.3 分、比最强多模态智能体基线高 7.9 分。

Conclusion: MEMORA 通过因子分解、情节记忆与推理感知检索的协同，有效应对多模态推理密集型检索，并在多领域基准上验证了显著优势，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval is fundamentally challenged when queries demand deep semantic inference and arrive in multimodal form. Existing systems treat each query in isolation, rely on monolithic rerankers, and lack retrievers trained for cross-modal reasoning. We introduce MEMORA, a Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Orchestrated Reranking Agent built around three contributions: (1) Collaborative Factor-Committee Reranking, which decomposes queries into intent factors, extracts factor-specific evidence into a structured matrix, and synthesizes judgments via a memory-conditioned meta-verdict model; (2) an Episodic Memory Module that tracks factor outcomes across queries and dynamically adjusts priorities at inference time; and (3) a Reasoning-Aware Dense Retriever fine-tuned with chain-of-thought augmentation on 20k+ reasoning-intensive pairs. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 domains, MEMORA achieves nDCG@10 of 41.5 (text-to-text) and 38.9 (multimodal query-to-text), outperforming the strongest agentic text-only baseline by +8.3 points and the strongest agentic multimodal baseline by +7.9 points. Code and data are available at https://github.com/HarnessLab/MEMORA.

</details>


### [483] [Selling in the Wild: Benchmark and Randomized Field Evidence for a Sales Agent Trained on Commercial Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25461)
*Benjamin Tannenbaum*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文验证Javo（基于460万条合规商业对话微调的销售智能体）是否优于前沿通用模型与人类销售员，四部分研究发现其显著提升收入与转化，且成本极低、安全性达标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对专用销售智能体与前沿通用模型及人类销售员在同一受控条件下的系统比较，尤其在真实商业环境中的因果证据不足。

Method: 四项研究：(1) 在SalesLLM和SmartSalesBench两个公开基准上与10个前沿/开源模型对比；(2) 在14个行业100个真实网站开展RCT，1480万访客随机分配至无智能体、Javo、同一接口的前沿模型智能体三组（2026年5–9月）；(3) 单独对比两种智能体以隔离模型效应；(4) 在20个有人工在线客服的站点将Javo与人类销售员对比。

Result: 相较无智能体，Javo使每访客收入+10.0%（95%CI +5.1~+14.9）；互动访客中相较前沿模型转化+21.6%（95%CI +16.9~+26.3）；相较人类销售员互动转化11.26% vs 11.20%（非劣，margin -7%，单侧p=0.004，无显著优势），单次对话成本仅1.8%。退货率、无依据产品宣称与投诉率均满足预设安全护栏。

Conclusion: 领域微调的专用销售智能体在真实商业环境中显著优于通用前沿模型，转化效果不劣于人类销售员而成本远低，且安全性达标，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: We test whether Javo, a sales agent fine-tuned on 4.6 million consented, de-identified commercial conversations, sells better than a frontier general-purpose model and better than human sales associates. The evaluation has four parts. Study 1 scores the agent on two public sales benchmarks, SalesLLM and SmartSalesBench, against 10 frontier and open-weight models. Study 2 is a randomized controlled trial on 100 live websites in 14 industries (e-commerce, travel and hospitality, and high-consideration services), run from 1 May to 30 September 2026, in which 14.8 million visitors were randomized to no agent, Javo, or a frontier-model agent with an identical interface, catalog tools and guardrails. Study 3 isolates the effect of the model by comparing those two agent arms. Study 4 compares Javo with each site's own human associates on 20 sites with staffed live chat. Relative to no agent, Javo changed revenue per visitor by +10.0% (95% CI +5.1 to +14.9). Among engaged visitors, it changed conversion by +21.6% relative to the frontier-model agent (95% CI +16.9 to +26.3). Against human associates, its engaged conversion was 11.26% versus 11.20% (non-inferior, margin -7%, one-sided p = 0.004; no significant superiority), at 1.8% of the cost per conversation. Return rates, unsupported product claims and complaint rates met the prespecified safety guardrails.

</details>


### [484] [Knowledge Manifold Optimization for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25662)
*Shigeru Obayashi,Yoshiaki Kawagoe,Kazuhiko Komatsu,Tomonaga Okabe*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出知识流形优化(KMO)，将科学发现建模为文献知识空间上的多目标搜索，识别Pareto最优“有支撑的知识空白”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学文献快速膨胀与专业化，使研究者难以判断哪些知识已被确立、哪些新的可支撑知识可能涌现。

Method: 在连续文献导出的知识空间上做多目标搜索，用四个互补目标评估候选位置：持续知识体制边界强度、带通式空白新颖度、语义梯度幅值、证据支撑度；不合并为单一加权分数，而求Pareto前沿，得到“相对语料未占据但周围文献充分支撑”的空白；在空气动力学99篇文献、21×21网格上验证，并与距离最大化基线比较；代表点转为可审计证据包，再由受限LLM语言化为假设。

Result: 精确Pareto分析得19个非支配点，剔除空白度为零后为16点前沿；呈现方法论桥接、气动-结构拓扑/FSI集成、功能型气动装置集成、尾流/整车流动控制集成等发现模式；距离最大化基线偏向低支撑低可靠的外推区域。

Conclusion: 科学发现可表述为显式知识空间中的结构化多目标搜索；新颖性保持相对于语料，并将数值发现与下游语言生成分离。

Abstract: The rapid expansion and specialization of scientific literature make it increasingly difficult to identify not only what is known, but where new and still supportable knowledge may emerge. We introduce Knowledge Manifold Optimization (KMO), a discovery-oriented extension of the Knowledge Manifold framework that treats scientific discovery as a multiobjective search over a continuous, literature-derived knowledge space. Candidate locations are evaluated using four complementary objectives: persistent knowledge-regime boundary strength, band-pass white-space novelty, semanticgradient magnitude, and evidential support. Rather than collapsing these criteria into a single weighted score, KMO identifies Pareto-optimal Supported Knowledge Gaps, defined as corpus-relative unoccupied regions that remain sufficiently supported by surrounding literature. The method is demonstrated on a 99-paper corpus in aerodynamics and aerodynamic design. On a 21 x 21 grid, exact Pareto analysis produced 19 non-dominated points, of which 16 formed the practical front after excluding points with zero white-space score. These solutions exhibited distinct discovery modes, including methodology bridges, aero-structural topology/FSI integration, functional aerodynamic-device integration, and rear-wake/vehicle flow-control integration. A distance-maximization baseline preferentially selected extrapolative regions with substantially lower support and reliability, demonstrating why emptiness alone is insufficient. Representative Pareto locations were converted into auditable evidence packages and then verbalized by a constrained large language model into candidate research hypotheses. The results show that scientific discovery can be formulated as structured multi-objective search in an explicit knowledge space, while keeping novelty corpus-relative and separating numerical discovery from downstream language generation.

</details>


### [485] [Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25678)
*Seokwon Jung,Yerang Kim,Yejin Kim,Alexander Rubinstein,Arnas Uselis,Sangwoo Park,Seong Joon Oh,Sangdoo Yun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出跨领域"交叉授粉检索"任务，构建CPR-Dataset（1,300查询/26领域评估集，10,573训练对），现有检索器Recall@10仅0.26，LLM重排可达0.81，用CPR-train对比微调可提至0.70，并泛化到类比与推理型检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多科学进展源于跨领域的思想迁移，但跨领域论文检索研究不足，现有基准领域覆盖狭窄，缺乏专门问题定义与数据。

Method: 定义cross-pollination retrieval任务；通过挖掘跨主题引用构建大规模CPR-Dataset，划分CPR-eval（1,300查询、26领域）与CPR-train（10,573对）；在CPR-train上做标准对比学习微调，并与11种现有检索器及LLM重排对比。

Result: CPR-eval上最佳现有检索器Recall@10仅0.26，LLM重排0.81，对比微调最高0.70；AnaloBench上nDCG@10提升至33%（而用三个现有数据集训练反而下降）；BRIGHT上提升至70%，超现有数据集增益两倍；且可迁移到留出领域。

Conclusion: 跨领域检索是现有模型明显短板，但用少量高质量跨领域数据微调即可显著改进并泛化到类比与推理密集任务，数据集与代码已开源。

Abstract: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.

</details>


### [486] [MAPS: A Multi-Agent Personalized Script-Driven Video Advertising System Enhanced by Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25748)
*Zhongyu Wang,Chen Zuo,Qingxuan Sun,Jiayang Qiao,Qiuhao Qian,Songyan Cui,Guocheng Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出多智能体个性化脚本驱动视频广告系统MAPS，通过用户画像、脚本生成、视频合成与反馈迭代四个协作智能体的闭环流程，实现更细粒度的个性化广告生成，并在快手线上系统取得显著收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频广告系统多采用基于检索的范式，在特征空间中匹配广告内容与用户偏好并推荐最相似候选。但由于候选创意是预先制作的，这种范式限制了个性化粒度，并导致不同用户群体间效果差异明显。

Method: 设计四个协作智能体构成闭环流水线：用户画像建模、脚本生成、视频合成及反馈驱动的迭代优化。针对Scripter Agent，构建强化学习框架，并设计多维奖励函数，引导其生成同时符合用户内容偏好与目标产品信息的脚本。

Result: 在代表性数据集上的离线实验显示，方法在个性化创意的生成与整合方面取得令人鼓舞的效果。快手广告系统特定场景的线上A/B实验表明，相比生成式基线，MAPS将CTR提升2.87%，CVR提升2.74%，ARPU提升9.85%。

Conclusion: MAPS以生成式多智能体闭环替代检索式范式，突破了预制创意的个性化粒度限制，并通过强化学习实现偏好与产品信息的平衡，在实际工业系统中验证了显著的业务收益。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become a dominant component of digital advertising. Most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, which matches ad content with user preferences in a feature space and recommends the most similar candidates. However, since the candidate creatives are pre-produced, this paradigm limits the granularity of personalization and leads to performance disparities across diverse user groups. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent personalized script-driven video advertising system (MAPS). We design four collaborative agents that form a closed-loop pipeline of user profile modeling, script generation, video synthesis, and feedback-driven iterative refinement. To train the Scripter Agent, we develop a reinforcement learning framework equipped with a multi-dimensional reward function, which steers the agent toward producing scripts that simultaneously align with user content preferences and target product information. Extensive offline experiments on representative datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves encouraging performance in generating and integrating personalized creatives. Online A/B experiments in a specific scenario in the Kuaishou advertising system show that MAPS improves CTR by 2.87%, CVR by 2.74%, and ARPU by 9.85% over the generative baseline.

</details>


### [487] [Learning Complementary Agent Groups via Task Hypergraphs for Next-POI Recommendation with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25801)
*Jinze Wang,Yuze Liu,Liang Yuan,Gaoyuan Du,Xiaohang Xu,Yong Xiang,Jiong Jin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CATH框架，用任务超图学习选择LLM智能体组合来完成下一POI推荐中的各类子任务，在内容缺失场景下NDCG@20相对提升8.4–9.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一POI推荐依赖访问历史与POI内容，但文本和图像常常缺失；已有LLM智能体方法需要针对每个请求联合分析可用证据，关键难点在于如何为不同任务动态选择合适且互补的智能体组合。

Method: 将具有不同处理角色的智能体作为任务超图节点，超边连接被选中的组合并记录分析目标与目标POI；策略以请求、任务及已选成员为条件逐步选择成员；执行时成员共享候选相关结果以指导后续操作，完成任务更新候选状态与智能体记忆；共享排序头把候选状态转为对固定基排名的修正；先用监督式排序训练执行器，再进行考虑计算开销的策略优化。

Result: 在Gowalla-CA、Foursquare-NYC、Foursquare-TKY的自然缺失设定下，相比最强基线HyperAgent4POI，NDCG@20获得8.4–9.1%的相对提升；额外分析对比了组选择与执行设计、测试了更多掩码下的排序表现并刻画了质量–成本权衡。

Conclusion: 通过任务超图驱动的智能体组选择与协同执行，CATH能在内容缺失条件下有效提升POI推荐质量，并在计算成本可控的前提下实现质量与成本的折中。

Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation uses visit histories and POI content, but text and images are often missing. Large language model agents have been applied to recommender systems for preference modeling and evidence acquisition. The challenge is to select agents that can jointly analyze the available evidence for each request. We propose \textsc{CATH} (\emph{Complementary Agents via Task Hypergraphs}), which learns to select agent groups for tasks such as comparing candidates or analyzing a POI with missing content. Agents with distinct processing roles are the task hypergraph nodes; each hyperedge connects the selected group and records its analysis goal and target POIs. The policy selects members conditioned on the request, task, and agents already selected. During execution, members share candidate-linked results that guide their subsequent operations. Completed tasks update candidate states and agent memories within the request. A shared ranking head converts candidate states into corrections to a fixed base ranking. Supervised ranking trains the executor, followed by policy optimization that accounts for computation cost. Experiments under natural missingness on Gowalla-CA, Foursquare-NYC, and Foursquare-TKY show 8.4--9.1\% relative NDCG@20 gains over HyperAgent4POI, the strongest prior baseline evaluated. Additional analyses compare group-selection and execution designs, test ranking under additional masking, and characterize quality--cost tradeoffs.

</details>


### [488] [OneChord: Distill What You Rank, Recommend in One Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25805)
*Zesheng Li,Chengchang Pan,Honggang Qi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 OneChord，以"distill what you rank"为原则，让训练、精炼蒸馏与推理共用同一个目录归一化的融合排序，在六个 Amazon 数据集上取得最优 Recall@5/NDCG@5 并有 1.04–1.18× 生成加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义ID推荐在部署时会融合码本概率与物品相似度，最终排序依赖二者的归一化与相对权重；而传统训练目标与实际服务排序不一致，导致训练—推理落差。

Method: 共享并行解码器同时输出联合 SID 证据与物品匹配分；训练中冻结的降噪器提供合法部分 SID，学生模型评估这些状态构造精炼融合目标；在共享困难候选上对齐直接预测与精炼预测，把精炼能力迁移到单次推理。并对候选条件诱导的融合权重进行刻画，给出保持全目录 Top-K 选择一致的充分条件。

Result: 六个 Amazon 数据集上 Recall@5 与 NDCG@5 全部最优，较最强基线平均相对提升 6.30% 与 7.12%；相对最快基线有 1.04–1.18× 全测试集生成加速。

Conclusion: 使"被服务的排序分布"成为推荐学习与蒸馏的共同对象，可有效消除训练—推理不一致，兼顾效果与推理效率。

Abstract: Accurate product discovery on the Web requires recommendation models that rank catalog candidates within tight inference budgets. In semantic-ID recommendation, deployment can fuse code probabilities with item similarities, making the final ranking depend on their normalization and relative weights. This motivates a direct training principle: \emph{distill what you rank}. We present OneChord, which uses one learned, catalog-normalized fusion for next-item supervision, refinement distillation, and inference. A shared parallel decoder produces joint SID evidence and item-matching scores. During training, a frozen denoiser supplies legal partial SIDs; the student evaluates these states to construct refined fused targets. Matching direct and refined predictions on shared hard candidates transfers refinement into one-pass recommendation. We characterize the fusion weights induced by candidate conditioning and establish sufficient conditions for preserving the refined predictor's full-catalog Top-$K$ selection. Across six Amazon datasets, OneChord achieves the highest Recall@5 and NDCG@5 among the compared methods on every dataset, with average relative gains of 6.30\% and 7.12\% over the strongest baseline. It also achieves a 1.04--1.18$\times$ full-test generation speedup over the fastest baseline. OneChord makes the served ranking distribution the common object of recommendation learning and distillation.

</details>


### [489] [Multimodal Decoupling for Diversified Recommendation through Semantic and Structural Shaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26024)
*Changran He,Jiaming Wei,Jianghong Ma,Tianjun Wei,Haijun Zhang,Xiaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MOSS是一个多模态推荐统一框架，通过语义解耦特征提取、类别感知嵌入选择、交替双图传播和熵基多样性正则化，同时从语义与结构两个层面缓解精度—多样性权衡，实验显示其权衡效果优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统为追求精度易导致结果过度集中、多样性不足。现有多样性方法存在两方面根本局限：一是多模态语义信号常被当作ID嵌入的辅助，语义利用不足；二是训练中精度—多样性权衡持续存在，精度提升常以多样性为代价，且该现象受表示结构与优化动态共同支配。

Method: 提出MOSS统一框架，包含四个模块：(1) 基于MLLM的解耦特征提取模块，将多模态内容分解为信息性表示；(2) 类别感知嵌入选择模块，提取紧凑的类别感知语义特征以增强语义利用；(3) 交替双图传播，融合协同传播与多模态传播以缓解表示坍缩；(4) 熵基多样性正则化，通过促进类别曝光均衡缓解优化偏差。

Result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MOSS在精度—多样性权衡上稳定优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 从语义与结构双重视角对多模态表示进行解耦与塑形，可有效改善精度—多样性权衡，为多模态多样性推荐提供统一解决方案。

Abstract: Recommender systems often suffer from over-concentrated results when optimized for accuracy, limiting recommendation diversity. While diversity has become an important objective, existing methods still face fundamental limitations from both semantic and structural perspectives. On the one hand, multimodal recommender systems provide rich semantic signals, yet are often treated as auxiliary to ID embeddings, leading to ineffective semantic utilization for diversity. On the other hand, the accuracy--diversity trade-off persists during training, where accuracy gains often come at the cost of diversity. We show that this phenomenon is fundamentally governed by both the structural properties of learned representations and the dynamics of optimization. To address these challenges, we propose MOSS, a unified framework for multimodal decoupling through semantic and structural shaping. Specifically, we first introduce an MLLM-based Decoupled Feature Extraction module to disentangle multimodal content into informative representations. To enhance semantic utilization, we design a Category-aware Embedding Selection module that extracts compact, category-aware semantic features. To address structural limitations, we propose two complementary modules: Alternating Dual-Graph Propagation, which alleviates representation collapse by integrating collaborative and multimodal propagation, and Entropy-based Diversity Regularization, which mitigates optimization bias by promoting balanced category exposure. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MOSS consistently achieves a superior accuracy--diversity trade-off over strong baselines.

</details>


### [490] [Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26105)
*Jianbo Zhu,Xing Fang,Xiaopeng Chu,Mingmin Jin,Jing Wang,Bokang Wang,Jiaqi Ye,Xiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文通过67天大规模电商搜索日志的受控实验，系统刻画了生成式检索中SID语义漂移与检索质量的关系，提出"新增冻结旧SID+热启动"的拓扑保持原则，并在天猫APP三周在线A/B中取得UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商等动态环境中新品持续到达，需周期性更新SID到Item的映射并重训模型以保持检索时效性；但每次更新会破坏检索器已学到的搜索路径，而映射变化与检索质量之间的定量关系尚未被系统刻画。

Method: 基于67天大规模电商搜索日志开展大量受控实验，量化SID语义漂移、SID变更比例对HitRate的影响（分不同beam size），并比较全量重映射与冻结旧SID+插入新项+热启动策略的效果；随后进行三周天猫APP在线A/B测试验证。

Result: (1) SID漂移造成显著退化但被大beam size掩盖：beam=1时HitRate降41.78–62.05%，beam=1000时仅降8.33–10.85%；(2) SID变更比例与检索质量严格单调相关，变更比例从0%升至72.75%时HitRate单调下降，beam=1最大降42.66%，且全量重映射仍明显劣于保持策略；(3) 拓扑保持原则使最简热启动策略极有效：固定旧SID、插入新项并热启动，旧Item HitRate提升10%、新Item提升109%，在两个不重叠更新周期上均验证。

Conclusion: 提炼出简洁的部署原则："插入新项、冻结旧项；能热启动则热启动，否则冻结；绝不更改模型已学过的SID"。三周天猫APP在线A/B显示UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。

Abstract: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.

</details>


### [491] [FLMNet: Self-Ensemble Distillation from Masks to Seeds for Single-Tower CTR Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26143)
*Yifan Wang,Yifei Du*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文从理论上解释了CTR模型中"自蒸馏"（学习自身平均预测）为何有效，并据此提出无需随机采样的FLMNet及集成蒸馏方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FinalNet、QNN等CTR模型通过在不同dropout模式下运行网络并朝其平均预测训练而获得更高精度，但这一自蒸馏为何有效、随机采样是否必要尚不清楚。

Method: 证明当dropout模式数量趋于无穷时，目标精确退化为logit平均预测的标签损失加上一项惩罚——衡量各dropout副本网络间的不一致程度；当dropout不影响特征门控时，该惩罚可闭式近似，据此设计无需采样的FLMNet；并将不同随机种子的网络以相同形式蒸馏到单一网络。

Result: 在五个基准、十七个基线上，所得模型在推理时仅用单网络即取得准确率前两名；惩罚项与蒸馏带来的增益在可测范围内基本可叠加。

Conclusion: 自蒸馏的收益可归结为一致性惩罚，无需随机采样即可实现，且种子集成蒸馏与惩罚增益可相互累积。

Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction underpins recommender systems and online advertising, where high-dimensional categorical features interact in combinatorially many ways. Several recent CTR models, such as FinalNet and QNN, report higher accuracy when a network also learns from its own averaged predictions, for example by running the same network under different dropout patterns and training each run toward the average. Why this self-distillation helps, and whether its random sampling is needed, remains unclear. This work shows that as the number of dropout patterns grows without bound, the objective reduces exactly to the label loss of the logit-averaged prediction plus a penalty on how much the dropout copies of the network disagree. When dropout does not affect how a network gates its features, this penalty can be approximated in closed form, and FLMNet is designed on this principle and trains without sampling. Networks trained from different seeds disagree in the same form, and distilling several of them into one network recovers part of their ensemble gain. On five benchmarks against seventeen baselines, the resulting models take the top two places in accuracy with a single network at inference, and the gains of the penalty and of distillation, where measurable, largely add up.

</details>


### [492] [Babbar26 main x genre](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26220)
*Bournonville Aur{é}lien,Clotilde Levy,Thomas Largillier,Guillaume Pitel,Fran{\c c}ois Rioult,Fabrice Maurel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Babbar26是一个多语言网页数据集，共1111个网页（来自1006个域名，涵盖英法德西意五种语言），同时标注了网页体裁（五类）和主内容/噪声区域（锚定DOM）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有体裁基准（如KI-04）网页较简单，现代网页DOM元素和可读文本量显著更大，需要更贴合当代网页的多语言、双重标注资源。

Method: 构建1111页多语言网页集，制定标注指南；按紧凑五类体系标注体裁，并在DOM上标注主内容与模板噪声；采用双人标注计算一致性。

Result: 体裁双标注一致率97.1%；主内容内容级Cohen's k=0.766；与KI-04相比，中位网页DOM元素多2.3倍、可读文本多1.9倍。

Conclusion: Babbar26提供兼具体裁与内容抽取标注的多语言基准，反映现代网页复杂度，可支撑相关研究。

Abstract: We introduce Babbar26, a multilingual dataset of 1111 web pages from 1006 domains in five languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian), jointly annotated for genre, following a compact five-class taxonomy, and for main content and boilerplate, as main/noise regions anchored to the DOM. We describe the annotation guidelines and report double-annotation agreement on both tasks (97.1% on genre; content-level Cohen's k = 0.766 for main content). Compared with the classic KI-04 genre benchmark, a median page has 2.3x more DOM elements and 1.9x more readable text.

</details>


### [493] [Preference Is Not Position: Evaluating Reranking on NevIR in Fixed Hybrid Candidate Pools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26260)
*Yuning Bian,Lele Xu,Yifan Yuan,Xinyu Yin,Chengyan Zhan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究近同段落（如仅差否定）在排序中的表现，指出成对排序器可能判对偏好但把偏好段落排得很靠后，主张联合评估成对偏好、指定段落位置与计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近同段落可能只因否定等决定性条件不同，现有评估只看到成对正确率，可能掩盖排序器把偏好段落排到很后的位置问题。

Method: 使用NevIR官方成对样本，构造dense、learned sparse与BM25固定候选池并取交集；比较成对训练排序器与固定融合；探索背景采样与修订监督的变体；对融合top20做有界pointwise重排；并测试Qwen3-14B-AWQ与BGE交叉编码器。

Result: 2,736条测试查询方向上，成对排序器严格偏好56.62%（融合52.30%），但MRR从0.5764降至0.3055；变体回放MRR 0.5859、严格偏好54.53%。融合top20有界重排两项均改善。Qwen3-14B-AWQ配融合打破平局达77.45%严格偏好、58.99% NevIR成对准确率、MRR 0.7509；BGE交叉编码器69.77%与MRR 0.7404。

Conclusion: 成对偏好与位置指标可能背离，应联合评估；后验分析显示Qwen对两段评分相同时由融合打破平局的分支占27%方向且集中了多数严格偏好失败，需区分模型判断与整体排序流程。

Abstract: Near-identical passages can differ in a decisive condition, such as negation. A ranker may order such a pair correctly while placing the preferred passage far down the retrieved list. We examine this distinction using official NevIR pairs jointly covered by fixed candidate pools from dense, learned sparse, and BM25 retrieval. On 2,736 Test query directions, a pairwise-trained ranker improves strict per-query preference over fixed fusion (56.62% versus 52.30%) while reducing preferred-passage mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.5764 to 0.3055. An exploratory fixed-model replay of a variant with background sampling and revised supervision yields MRR of 0.5859 and strict preference of 54.53%. Bounded pointwise reranking of the fusion top 20 improves both outcomes. Qwen3-14B-AWQ with fusion tie-breaking reaches 77.45% strict preference, 58.99% NevIR-style paired accuracy across 1,363 complete pairs, and preferred-passage MRR of 0.7509. A BGE cross-encoder reaches 69.77% strict preference and MRR of 0.7404. A post-hoc analysis finds that the branch where equal Qwen grades for the two designated passages trigger fusion tie-breaking accounts for 27% of evaluated directions and contains most remaining strict-preference failures. These findings support joint evaluation of pairwise preference, designated-passage position, and computational cost, while distinguishing model judgments from the combined ranking procedure.

</details>


### [494] [AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26831)
*Ming Yang,Yaqi Yin,Zhibo Wang,Xiaoze Jiang,Jingwei Zhuo,Chao Zhang,Quanzhi Zhu,Weiguo Zheng,Liang Zeng,Yunfeng Zhao,Jiaqiang Liu,Kefeng Wang,Yupeng Huang,Kaiqiao Zhan,Xuanping Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR)，将语义ID生成与按需特征获取交错进行，由模型自主决定何时调用工具、选哪个特征、在何处注入影响，并以特征适用性与信息增益构造轨迹进行监督训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模检索推荐系统依赖丰富异构特征，而现有生成式检索（GR）方法难以高效利用特征生态：静态特征注入要么编码全部信号，要么按预定方案放置，增加服务成本并引入无关或冲突证据；更根本的是，现有方法无法自适应判断何时需要特征、选择哪个特征、以及在分层SID生成的何处施加影响。

Method: 提出工具增强的AGR范式：以请求和已解码SID前缀为条件，逐步决策是否调用工具、获取哪个特征、观测结果应在后续解码何处生效，从而引导生成走向特征一致的SID分支；基于SID层级上的特征适用性与信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，采用SID预训练+工具增强微调的两阶段训练。

Result: 在工业数据集与三个公开基准上的实验以及在线A/B测试均一致验证了AGR的有效性。

Conclusion: AGR通过将特征获取与SID生成解耦并实现按需、自适应的特征调用，克服了静态特征注入的成本与冲突问题，验证了工具增强式生成检索在工业检索推荐场景中的实际价值。

Abstract: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [495] [Agentic Interpretation: Harness-Governed Evidence Construction for Software Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23996)
*Yifeng He,Yanjun Wang,Siwei Cui,Aritra Sengupta,Murali Krishna Ramanathan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgInt 是一个由确定性 harness 治理的"证据构造"框架：模型提出带类型的记录，harness 负责接纳、评分、持久化并授权作答，从而构建可审计的证书状态来回答代码行为问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件代理需基于仓库级证据回答代码行为问题（补丁是否通过测试、哪几行导致失败），但现有框架把中间结论留在自由文本轨迹中，难以复用且易与最终答案脱节。

Method: 提出 Agentic Interpretation (AgInt)：模型提出 typed records，确定性 harness 对其接纳、评分、持久化，报告未满足的需求，并按任务规则许可作答，形成持久外部状态与可审计决策记录。形式上，仅追加的证书状态构成按记录包含排序的 grounding lattice，每条被接纳记录通过并集扩展状态。在 SWE-bench-Live、DeepSWE（补丁接受）与 Defects4J、GitBug-Java（故障定位）上用四个模型评测，并设 matched-template 对照。

Result: 在所有报告的补丁接受指标上优于 plain agent 与 Agentic Code Reasoning；故障定位中负责行排名更高且检查的无关行更少。GLM-5 上 SWE-bench-Live 的 reject-class F1 从 0.256 升至 0.543，Defects4J 的 All@1 从 0.140 升至 0.400，GitBug-Java 浪费行数从 31.5 降至 11.7。对照实验显示：持久化脚手架驱动大部分故障定位增益，而证书主体与 gate 主导补丁接受校准。执行授权下，空指针候选复现 293/475（shell agent 253），资源泄漏 62/117（对比 58）；执行次数减少 35%，每候选成本降低 59%。

Conclusion: 将中间证据结构化、由确定性 harness 治理并持久化，可显著提升代码行为问答的准确性与效率，并留下可审计的决策记录；不同组件（脚手架 vs 证书/gate）分别主导不同任务的收益。

Abstract: Software agents answer behavioral questions about code, such as whether a patch passes tests or which lines caused a failure. These tasks require repository-wide evidence, yet most scaffolds leave intermediate findings in free-form trajectories, making them hard to reuse and easy to disconnect from final answers. We present Agentic Interpretation (AgInt), a framework for harness-governed evidence construction. The model proposes typed records, while a deterministic harness admits, grades, and persists them, reports unresolved requirements, and licenses answers under task-specific rules. The resulting certificate gives the model persistent external state and leaves an auditable decision record. Formally, append-only certificate states form a grounding lattice ordered by record inclusion, where each admitted record extends the state by union.
  We evaluate AgInt with four models on SWE-bench-Live and DeepSWE for patch acceptance and Defects4J and GitBug-Java for fault localization. AgInt outperforms the plain agent and Agentic Code Reasoning on all reported patch-acceptance metrics and ranks responsible lines higher while inspecting fewer irrelevant lines in fault localization. For GLM-5, reject-class F1 rises from 0.256 to 0.543 on SWE-bench-Live, All@1 rises from 0.140 to 0.400 on Defects4J, and wasted inspected lines fall from 31.5 to 11.7 on GitBug-Java. A matched-template control separates the mechanism: the persistent scaffold drives most fault-localization gains, while the certificate body and gate govern patch-acceptance calibration. With execution licensed, AgInt produces harness-reproduced witnesses for 293 of 475 null-dereference candidates versus 253 for a matched shell agent, and 62 of 117 resource-leak candidates versus 58. Across reported efficiency measurements, it uses 35% fewer executions and reduces cost per candidate by 59%.

</details>


### [496] [Does AI-Assisted Development Homogenize Software? An Empirical Study of Code Similarity, Quality, and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24093)
*Luciano Marchezan,Romain Lefeuvre,Kevin Delcourt,Benoit Combemale,Houari Sahraoui*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对50个长期维护的Java/Python开源项目在pre-LLM、LLM辅助、智能体开发三个时期的实证研究：代码相似度未上升（Java反而显著下降），质量总体稳定甚至气味密度更低，结构增长放缓、开发活动略有上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发正从交互式LLM助手转向可自主执行软件工程任务的智能体系统，但这种转变的实际影响尚缺乏充分理解。

Method: 基于Software Heritage快照，对50个长期存活的Java和Python开源项目划分三个时期（pre-LLM、潜在LLM辅助、检测到的智能体开发）。相似度用嵌入余弦相似度（语义）与CodeBLEU*（语法）衡量；质量用SonarQube指标（可维护性、复杂度、可靠性、安全性）；演化用LOC、函数、类、文件、语句的年化增长率及快照前三个月的提交活动刻画。

Result: 未发现相似度上升的一致证据：Java在LLM期与智能体期的语义与语法相似度均显著低于pre-LLM期，Python无显著差异。质量基本稳定，智能体期代码异味与SQALE指数密度显著更低。结构增长总体偏低（尤其文件数），而Java开发活动中度上升，提交数与新增行数尤明显。

Conclusion: 结果挑战了"LLM与智能体辅助开发必然导致代码同质化、质量下降或增长加速"的假设。

Abstract: AI-assisted software development is evolving from interactive LLM assistance toward agentic systems that autonomously perform software engineering tasks, yet the effects of this shift remain insufficiently understood. We present an empirical study of 50 long-lived Java and Python open-source projects across three eras: pre-LLM, potentially LLM-assisted, and detected agentic development. Using snapshots from Software Heritage, we examine code similarity, software quality, and software evolution. Similarity is measured semantically through embedding-based cosine similarity and syntactically through CodeBLEU*. Quality is assessed with SonarQube metrics covering maintainability, complexity, reliability, and security. Evolution is characterized by annualized growth rates of LOC, functions, classes, files, and statements, and by commit activity in the three months preceding each snapshot. Results show no consistent evidence of increased similarity as semantic and syntactic similarity decreased significantly in Java for both the LLM and agentic eras relative to the pre-LLM era, while Python showed no significant differences. Software quality remained largely stable, although the agentic era showed significantly lower code-smell and SQALE index densities. Structural growth was generally lower in the agentic era, particularly for files, whereas development activity increased moderately in Java, especially in commits and added lines. These findings challenge the assumption that LLM- and agent-assisted development necessarily homogenizes code, degrades quality, or accelerates growth.

</details>


### [497] [Towards an Intelligent Decision Engine for Smart Contract Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24198)
*Oana-Otilia Captarencu,Emanuel Onica,Andrei Arusoaie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一套基于多指标与用户自定义画像的系统化方法，帮助选择部署智能合约的L2方案；在Arbitrum、Optimism、Base上对六个月的交易数据评测，揭示不同L2对不同应用类型与用户偏好的明显适配偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: L2方案虽可作为以太坊（L1）扩容手段，但为区块链应用选择部署智能合约的L2需权衡成本、效率、流行度与稳定性等多因素，缺乏系统化的决策支持。

Method: 定义一组相关指标并引入体现不同优先级权重的用户自定义画像；从社区维护的数据源获取主要智能合约类别，采集Arbitrum、Optimism、Base三大L2六个月内的交易数据，按合约类别与链计算指标及面向各画像的评分。

Result: 方法应用后显示分类存在明显偏向性，能指出哪些L2方案更适合特定应用类型与用户画像。

Conclusion: 所提方法可为L2选型提供可复现、可定制的量化依据，帮助应用开发者依需求匹配最优L2。

Abstract: Layer 2 (L2) blockchain solutions emerged in recent years, predominantly in the Ethereum ecosystem, as a viable option for scaling a main blockchain network (L1). However, the selection of a L2 solution for deploying smart contracts backing blockchain applications is a decision that depends on many factors, such as costs, efficiency, popularity, and stability. We propose here a systematic methodology to help with this decision making process by using a set of relevant metrics and introducing user-defined profiles that capture different priorities among these metrics. We collect the major categories of smart contracts from a community-maintained data source, and we gather transactions for a six months period from three major L2 solutions: Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base. For each contract category and each blockchain, we compute a set of metrics and scores tailored to each user profile. By applying our methodology, we identify a clear bias in the classification, showing which L2 solutions are better suited for particular application types and user profiles.

</details>


### [498] [Pattern-Based Precondition Inference from Method Implementations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24204)
*Shanyue Zhou,Martin P. Robillard*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Prex：基于模式的静态分析工具，从Java源码中的显式检查推断方法前置条件，并报告所需条件与违反时抛出的异常；引入"变更边界"区分前置检查与状态改变后的异常。评估46个开源项目、人工审查150条报告，149条正确，125条可被客户端代码执行，精度优于路径展开方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方法前置条件（调用前必须满足的条件）常未被文档记录，需要被自动推断出来；现有文档往往缺失这些信息。

Method: 提出Prex，一种基于模式的静态分析，从Java源码显式检查中推断前置条件：(1) 对每个前置条件报告有效调用所需条件及违反时抛出的异常；(2) 通过代码变换将方法内部的检查条件转换为客户端可求值的表达式；(3) 利用"变更边界"概念，将前置检查与改变程序状态之后可能出现的异常区分开。

Result: 在46个开源Java项目上评估，人工审查150条独立抽样报告：149条正确，其中125条可被客户端代码执行。与基于路径展开的替代方法系统比较，Prex结果更精确。149条正确报告中122条无相关方法文档，41条需非平凡的源码分析才能人工恢复。

Conclusion: 源码显式检查可提供方法文档中缺失的前置条件信息，Prex能有效恢复这些信息，帮助开发者正确调用方法。

Abstract: Method preconditions define the conditions that must be satisfied before a method is called. Often, such conditions are not documented and must be inferred. We present Prex, a pattern-based static analysis approach that infers preconditions from explicit checks in Java source code. For each precondition, Prex reports the condition required for a valid call and the reported exception in the case of a violation. Prex also attempts code transformations to convert the condition detected within a method's implementation into an expression that can be evaluated by client code. It leverages the concept of a mutation boundary to separate precondition checks from exceptions that may occur after the method changes the program state. We evaluated Prex from 46 open source Java projects and manually reviewed independent samples of 150 reports. Among the 150 Prex reports, 149 were correct and 125 of the correct reports were executable by client code. In a systematic comparison with an alternative approach based on path expansion, Prex provided more precise results. In total, 122 of the 149 correct reports had no relevant method documentation, and 41 required nontrivial source code analysis to recover manually. Overall, explicit source-code checks provide precondition information that can be absent from method documentation, and Prex can help recover it.

</details>


### [499] [SWE-Bench Pro V2: A Cleaner, Harder-to-Game Coding Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24206)
*Soham Dan,Jeff Da,Sanyam Bhutani,Miguel Romero Calvo,Ivan Guevara,Fernando Carabedo,Jose Bernal,Julio Reyna,Luis Leandro Monsalve Mendez,Ying Liu,Daniel Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWE-Bench Pro V2 通过代理审计、专家裁定、盲复现修复或淘汰 480/731 个任务，并以硬化协议限制网络、干净容器重评分，修复基准泄漏与评分漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着编码代理能力提升，代理会触达原基准未曾预料的任务与评测环境交互方式，导致 SWE-Bench Pro 的准确性与有效性下降，因此需要修订维护。

Method: 由 23 名签约工程师（各用其专业语言）投入 404 小时进行代理审计与专家裁定；每条修订指令由第二名工程师仅凭文本独立解题验证；盲复现重写任务。采用硬化协议：网络访问仅限模型端点，并在干净容器中重新评分每个补丁，防止代理获取上游修复或在补丁外变更上得分。

Result: 在 642 个 V2 任务上，前沿代理最高解决率达 99.4%，其他系统仍明显区分；51 任务 Hard 子集上系统得分分布于 52.9% 至 98.0%。

Conclusion: V2 修复并维护了基准的准确性，公开发布基准，并总结了长期维护代理基准的经验教训。

Abstract: SWE-Bench Pro is a widely used benchmark of long-horizon software engineering tasks for coding agents. As agents improve, they reach task issues earlier agents never touched and interact with the evaluation environment in ways the original harness did not anticipate. We present SWE-Bench Pro V2, a revised public split built to keep the benchmark accurate as capabilities advance. Agentic audits, expert adjudication and blind re-implementation repaired or retired 480 of the 731 tasks: 23 contracted engineers spent 404 hours, each working in a language they write professionally, and every revised instruction was verified by a second engineer solving the task from the text alone. A hardened protocol restricts network access to the model endpoint and re-grades every patch in a clean container, so agents cannot retrieve upstream fixes or get credit for changes outside their patch. On the 642 V2 tasks frontier agents resolve up to 99.4% while other systems stay clearly separated, and a 51-task Hard split spreads systems from 52.9% to 98.0%. We release the benchmark and distill lessons for maintaining agent benchmarks over time.

</details>


### [500] [VERAS: Verification-Guided Adaptive Search for Reliable Operations Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24329)
*Minbo Ma,Honglin Zhang,Bangtao Zhou,Chunguang Yu,Dasheng Ju,Yichen Shen,Fengli Xu,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出VERAS，一个验证引导的自适应搜索框架，用独立验证智能体生成的验证证据来驱动可行性修复、约束覆盖检查和目标优化，提升LLM在运筹优化任务中的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体虽能通过迭代建模、编程与自验证求解运筹学（OR）问题，但自写验证通过并不代表真正满足任务约束与优化质量。原因是存在相关规格错误（生成程序与其检查共享遗漏或误解）、验证覆盖不完整、优化策略低效。

Method: VERAS将任务专用解答检查器与独立的验证智能体结合，对候选解按任务要求进行审查；利用验证反馈引导可行性修复、额外约束检查与目标改进；并通过候选接受准则筛除在输出有效性或约束满足上退化的修订版本。

Result: 在ORAgentBench上通过率达42.99%，超过同LLM下Codex的35.51%；两个工业级OR问题上，相较原生Codex将跨数据中心峰值带宽降低10.34%，相较专家方案将年化配电网规划成本降低6.28%。

Conclusion: 引入独立于生成过程的验证证据并据此自适应搜索，可有效缓解自验证失效问题，在基准与真实工业OR场景中同时提升可行性与优化质量。

Abstract: Advances in reasoning, coding, and tool use enable LLM agents to solve operations research (OR) problems through iterative problem modeling, program construction, and verification. Yet passing self-authored verification does not ensure that the solutions satisfy task constraints and meet optimization quality. This gap can arise from correlated specification errors, where the generated program and its checks share omissions or misinterpretations of task requirements, alongside incomplete verification coverage and ineffective optimization strategies. We propose VERAS, a verification-guided adaptive search harness for reliable OR that uses verification evidence to prioritize feasibility repair, constraint-coverage review, and solution-quality improvement. VERAS combines task-specific solution checkers with a separate verification agent to examine candidate solutions against the task requirements. It uses verification feedback to guide feasibility repair, additional constraint checking, and objective improvement, while candidate acceptance criteria screen revisions for deterioration in output validity or constraint satisfaction. On ORAgentBench, VERAS achieves a 42.99% pass rate, exceeding the reported 35.51% of Codex using the same LLM. Across two industrial-scale OR problems, VERAS reduces inter-datacenter peak bandwidth by 10.34% relative to native Codex and lowers annualized distribution network planning costs by 6.28% compared with expert-designed solutions. Code and evidence are available at https://github.com/holimario/VERAS.

</details>


### [501] [Safety Analysis of CPSs Over-the-air Updates: Test Case Prioritization and Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24475)
*Andrea Bombarda,Luca Carminati,Nunzio Marco Bisceglia,Mehrnoosh Askarpour,Sahar Kokaly,Ramesh S,Marsha Chechik,Claudio Menghi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CRISP：面向OTA更新场景、基于测试用例鲁棒性（临界度）的测试用例优先级排序与选择框架，减少组合爆炸下的测试成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汽车CPS的OTA更新会产生大量可能的软件配置（如用户自行选择安装更新），配置组合爆炸使软件测试难以进行，需要高效地针对每次更新的测试选择与排序方法。

Method: 提出CRISP框架，利用测试用例鲁棒性（距离违反系统需求的程度）作为临界度度量，据此对测试执行从最危险到最不危险排序，并仅选择与特定OTA更新相关的关键测试用例；在含7款车、22个驾驶场景、2个软件组件、224个测试（59小时执行时间）的产物线上，针对5次OTA更新进行评估，与随机方法及最新实证研究中的SOTA方案AP-DISC对比。

Result: CRISP在发现暴露失败的测试用例方面优于随机基线与AP-DISC；其选择流程可配置，在准确性（识别的失败暴露用例比例）与计算时间之间取得合理且实用的权衡。

Conclusion: 基于临界度的排序与选择能有效应对OTA更新带来的测试组合爆炸，兼具检测效果与计算效率，具备工程实用性。

Abstract: Over-the-air (OTA) updates for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) allow engineers to modify their software wirelessly. In the automotive domain, they enable manufacturers to update software without physical access to the vehicle. However, OTA updates can generate a large number of possible software configurations. For example, end users may decide whether or not to install any given OTA updates. The combinatorial explosion of these configurations hampers SW testing, a standard practice for detecting errors in CPS. To overcome this limitation, we propose CRISP (CRIticality-based Selection and Prioritization), a novel framework supporting test case prioritization and selection in the context of OTA updates. Our framework leverages test case robustness, i.e., how far they are from violating the system requirements, to drive test case prioritization and selection. It enables engineers to rank test case executions from most to least critical, and to select only the critical test cases relevant to a given OTA update. We evaluated our approach using a representative SW product line consisting of seven different vehicles, 22 driving scenarios, and two software components. We considered 224 tests, requiring 59 hours of execution time. We assessed the effectiveness of CRISP across five OTA updates. We compared our solution with (a) a random test case prioritization and selection algorithm, and (b) AP-DISC, identified as the state-of-the-art solution in a recent empirical study on the subject. Our results show that CRISP outperforms our baselines in finding failure-revealing test cases, and that our selection procedure can be configured to find reasonable and practical tradeoffs among accuracy (percentage of failure-revealing test cases identified) and computational time (time required to find them).

</details>


### [502] [Effective Construction of Feature Database of Fingerprinting Functions for Code-Clone SCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24479)
*Zhiling Zhu,Tieming Chen,Chengwei Liu,Jiahui Wu,Qijie Song,Zhengzi Xu,Yueming Wu,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出OSScope，用贪心算法从GitHub 255万个C仓库中挑选最优开源仓库来构建代码克隆检测特征数据集，得到190K仓库、6100万指纹函数的数据集，召回率较SOTA提升22.65%，并进一步提出轻量分类器RClassifier辅助迁移到其他语言生态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C/C++等缺乏成熟包管理器的生态中，第三方库复用普遍，代码克隆检测（CCD）对识别代码复用、规避安全与法律风险至关重要。然而学术CCD工具依赖的实验数据集仅来自少量索引仓库，与真实场景所需的广泛代码来源存在明显差距，导致学术工具与实际应用脱节。

Method: 提出OSScope：基于贪心算法分析GitHub上255万个C仓库中指纹函数的多样性，在最大化唯一指纹函数的同时最小化所需仓库数量，从而选出最优仓库集合构建特征数据集；并基于所选仓库训练轻量分类模型RClassifier，判断某仓库是否应被纳入，以降低迁移到其他语言生态的构建成本。

Result: OSScope构建的数据集包含来自190K仓库的6100万指纹函数，相比SOTA工具召回率提升22.65%，并覆盖其他来源95%以上的特征。在Golang生态中评估RClassifier，其召回率与OSScope生成的数据集相当，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过系统化的开源仓库选择，可显著提升CCD特征数据集的质量与覆盖面，缩小学术工具与真实应用的差距；RClassifier进一步提供了可迁移、低成本的跨语言生态数据集构建方案。

Abstract: In contemporary software development, the extensive adoption of third-party libraries has become standard practice to avoid reinventing the wheel. This trend is particularly evident in programming ecosystems that lack mature package managers, such as C/C++. Within this context, Code Clone Detection (CCD) techniques have emerged as essential tools for identifying instances of code reuse, thereby mitigating security and legal concerns. Despite significant advances in CCD algorithms, a notable gap persists between academic tools and real-world applications. This disparity primarily arises because academic tools rely on experimental datasets composed of a limited number of indexed repositories, whereas real-world applications require a much broader scope of code sources.
  To address this challenge, we propose a novel, systematic approach for selecting appropriate open-source repositories to construct a more effective CCD feature dataset. Our method, OSSScope, employs a greedy algorithm to analyze the diversity of fingerprinting functions across 2.55 million C repositories on GitHub, maximizing unique fingerprinting functions while minimizing the number of repositories required. OSSScope compiles an optimal feature dataset containing 61 million fingerprinting functions from 190K repositories, resulting in a 22.65% improvement in recall over SOTA tools, and covers over 95% of the features from other sources. Leveraging the selected repositories, we introduce RClassifier, a lightweight classification model that determines whether a repository should be included, streamlining construction for migration to other language ecosystems. Our evaluation of RClassifier in the Golang ecosystem validates its effectiveness, achieving recall comparable to the dataset produced by OSSScope.

</details>


### [503] [When Code Becomes an LLM Call: An Empirical Study of Call-Site Contracts in Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24545)
*Shihao Weng,Longtian Wang,Yang Feng,Mingfei Cheng,Jia Liu,Chao Shen,He Ye,Federica Sarro,Xiaofei Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对40个开源智能体系统496个LLM调用点的契约实证研究：48%的模型输出进入控制流或执行，63%的期望约束未被满足，仅5.3%的调用点满足完整契约，10种模式解释99%的差距，38种机制可在运行时触发且均可通过小改动修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体系统把选择工具、判断动作合法性、生成代码等逻辑交给LLM，模型行为不由代码固定、跨运行可变、可被输入引导，使传统"规格—测试—验证"的质量保障基础失效。因此保证必须来自每个LLM调用点周围的程序契约（前置条件、提示约束、后置条件），而此类契约的实际状况此前缺乏系统性的实证刻画。

Method: 构建多智能体分析流水线，并经17,428条人工判断验证；对40个流行开源智能体系统（13.4 MLOC，四种语言）共496个LLM调用点，追踪每个模型输出的流向，在无法访问源码的条件下推导每个调用点的期望契约，再与代码实际实现的契约逐一比对。

Result: 48%的LLM输出到达控制流或执行路径，其中73%从不经过人工；程序中78%的约束以代码强制，而提示中67%的约束只是"请求"模型遵守；82%的调用点在调用前后有检查，但63%的期望约束未被满足，仅5.3%的调用点满足完整契约；10种重复模式解释99%的差距，其背后38种机制会在运行时触发。

Conclusion: 存在检查并不等于检查充分；对38种失效机制施加小的代码修复即可全部拦截，说明差距多可低成本弥补。作者据此为智能体开发者、框架维护者和研究者提出相应启示：契约应作为调用点处的一等设计对象。

Abstract: Software quality has long rested on specifications that state what code must do, and on testing and verification that check that the code does it. Agentic systems change this foundation: they replace parts of their logic, such as choosing the next tool, judging whether an action is allowed, or writing code to run, with calls to a large language model (LLM). The program still relies on what this logic must guarantee, but the model's behavior is not fixed by code, varies across runs, and can be steered by its input. The guarantee must therefore come from the program around each LLM call site, as a contract of pre-conditions, prompt constraints, and post-conditions. We present an empirical study of these contracts in 496 LLM call sites of 40 popular open-source agentic systems (13.4 MLOC, four languages). Using a multi-agent pipeline validated by 17,428 human judgments, we trace where every model output flows, derive an expected contract for each call site without access to its code, and compare it with the contract that the code implements. We find that 48% of LLM outputs reach control flow or execution, and 73% of these never reach a person. Programs enforce 78% of their constraints in code, but in the prompt, 67% of the constraints are only requested from the model. Although 82% of call sites are checked before and after the call, 63% of the expected constraints are unmet and only 5.3% of call sites satisfy their whole contract; ten recurring patterns explain 99% of the gaps. 38 mechanisms behind these gaps trigger at runtime, and a small code fix that enforces the expected constraint stops all 38. Our results show that the presence of checks says little about their adequacy, and we derive implications for agent developers, framework maintainers, and researchers.

</details>


### [504] [From Candidate Admission to Task-Level Return: Auditing LLM-Generated Code under Execution Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24609)
*Hiroyasu Usami,Keisuke Hara,Ayato Tsuboi,Naohiko Matsuda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在两个人不重叠的HumanEvalPlus冻结队列中审计"准入规则(保留生成程序)"与"选择策略(每任务返回一个候选)"的交互，报告非通过被准入、套件通过被排除的量化结果，并强调这些在近全通过池中属于不同维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准入规则和选择策略在既有工作中常被混为一谈，作者希望厘清二者与执行契约的交互，量化准入判定误纳/误排的程度，并区分"候选保留"与"任务级返回"两种评估口径。

Method: 在两个独立冻结且互不重叠的HumanEvalPlus队列(各32任务、每任务每profile四个样本、两个served profile)上做审计；内联执行契约下用"结构+自测"筛选；增设受限的模块供应条件；对固定首准入结果与弃权结果做对照；并做选中子集诊断，处理注册敏感完成与相对参考的断言分歧(考虑输入域与比较器容差)。

Result: 内联契约下，筛选每80–107个准入中仍放进4–9个扩展套件非通过，同时把128次计划尝试中14–43个套件通过者排除；受限模块供应条件为某profile在两队列分别新增20与14个通过准入(另有1个后续非通过)，排除的套件通过降至14–23。所有固定首准入结果与弃权不变。原始池中新增通过进入已全通过的准入池；后续中24个公共样本顺序里有4个丢失一个通过任务。

Conclusion: 候选保留与任务级返回在高通过池中产生分歧，须分别报告；准入筛选存在双向误差(误纳非通过与误排通过)，模块供应条件可缓解但引入少量新非通过；结论受限于保存池、契约与固定套件，训练端下游效应未测量。

Abstract: Admission rules retain generated programs, whereas selection policies return one candidate per task. We audit how these decisions interact with execution contracts in two separately frozen, disjoint HumanEvalPlus cohorts, each comprising 32 tasks, four samples per task per profile and two served profiles. Under the inline execution contract, a structural-and-self-test screen admits 4-9 expanded-suite nonpasses per 80-107 admissions and excludes 14-43 suite passes per 128 planned attempts. A restricted module-supply condition adds 20 and 14 passing admissions for one profile in the respective cohorts, plus one follow-up nonpass, and reduces the excluded suite passes to 14-23. All fixed first-admitted outcomes and abstentions remain unchanged. In the original pool, the added passes enter already all-passing admitted pools; in the follow-up, four of 24 common sample orders lose one passed task. Selected-subset diagnostics separately address registration-sensitive completion and reference-relative assertion disagreement, accounting for input domains and comparator tolerances. In these high-pass pools, candidate retention and task-level return diverge and are reported separately. Results are conditional on the saved pools, contracts and pinned suites; downstream training effects are unmeasured.

</details>


### [505] [Vibenix: Agentic Software Packaging and Maintenance with Nix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24712)
*Martim Monis,Martin Schwaighofer,Nuno Saavedra,Alexandra Mendes,Rene Mayrhofer,João F. Ferreira*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Vibenix 是一个基于 LLM 的开源 AI 智能体，通过规则引导的构建-修复反馈循环自动生成 Nix 打包表达式；在 NixBench 的 466 个任务上可构建率达 95.3%（对比单次生成工具的 5.6%），人工验证显示初始功能正确率 47%，经 evaluator-optimizer 后处理提升 35 个百分点，维护修复任务成功率达 87.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件构建中存在隐式依赖、不受控网络访问等"构建环境杂质"，导致供应链不透明、依赖难以穷尽识别。函数式包管理（如 Nix）通过可复现打包与声明式、密封隔离的输入来解决该问题，但编写打包配方复杂耗时，成为开发者与维护者采用此类方案的主要门槛。

Method: 提出开源 AI 智能体 Vibenix，利用大语言模型自动生成 Nix 打包表达式，并通过规则引导的构建-修复反馈循环迭代精化配方；同时构建 NixBench（466 个打包任务）与 NixBench-Repair（维护任务）两个数据集，并在构建后引入基于 evaluator-optimizer 模式的功能性精化流程，辅以人工验证。

Result: 在 NixBench 上，Vibenix（Claude Haiku 4.5）生成可构建包的比例为 95.3%，而当前最优的 LLM 单次打包工具仅 5.6%；100 个包的人工验证显示 47% 初始功能正确，构建后精化使功能正确率提升 35 个百分点；在 NixBench-Repair 上成功率达 87.6%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，不可靠的 LLM 在规则约束与反馈循环下能够生成严谨定义、完整且可审计的依赖树，服务于真实软件；该方法可减轻维护者负担，并为安全软件分发提供可信基础。

Abstract: Implicit dependencies, uncontrolled network access, and other build-environment impurities create intransparent software supply chains. Identifying every dependency affecting a build is a difficult task. Functional package management addresses this through reproducible packaging, ensuring software relies exclusively on declared, hermetically isolated inputs. However, creating build recipes remains complex and time-consuming, posing a significant barrier to adoption for developers and maintainers. We present Vibenix, an open-source AI-powered agent that bridges this gap by automatically generating Nix packaging expressions. Vibenix uses a large language model (LLM) to iteratively refine recipes through a rule-guided build-repair feedback loop. On 466 packaging tasks from our new NixBench dataset, Vibenix produced buildable packages in 95.3% of cases using Claude Haiku 4.5, compared with 5.6% for a state-of-the-art LLM-based single-shot packaging tool. Manual validation of 100 packages revealed that 47% of the buildable packages were initially functionally correct; a post-build refinement process based on the evaluator-optimizer pattern increased functional correctness by 35 percentage points. On our new NixBench-Repair dataset of package maintenance tasks, Vibenix achieved an 87.6% success rate. These results demonstrate how unreliable LLMs can generate rigorously defined, complete, auditable dependency trees for real-world software, reducing maintainer burden while providing a trustworthy foundation for secure software distribution.

</details>


### [506] [When LLM-Generated Refactorings Ripple: An Empirical Study of Repository Adoption Readiness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24790)
*Muhammad Waseem,Aakash Ahmad,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究对15个开源Java仓库150个生产文件进行1,500次LLM重构生成，从仓库级视角评估契约/依赖风险，发现93.8%候选属高风险，仅8个低风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM重构评估多局限于文件本地，无法揭示对契约、依赖及调用方假设的改变，进而影响代码在真实仓库中的采纳。

Method: 150个生产Java文件×5种LLM配置×2种依赖感知生成条件（单提示重构、基于LangGraph的多智能体重构），共1,500次生成（1,455个完整候选）；用本地变更、仓库面向的结构指标、调用方影响检测、行为等价指标及测试证据进行四类风险分级（低风险、需审查、高契约/依赖风险、不确定），并做705对配对分析。

Result: 1,365个（93.8%）为高契约/依赖风险；106个（7.3%）至少破坏一个下游调用方；290个（19.9%）行为等价指标为假阳性；仅8个满足低风险标准。保守依赖增量阈值下高风险率下降；65个有明确定向测试结果的候选中60个通过（含50个高风险者）。配对分析显示两种生成条件在主风险指标上无显著差异，但模型配置在特定风险通道上有差异。

Conclusion: 应将LLM生成的重构视为需分阶段仓库级验证的候选；未来研究需验证筛选与抽取精度，并加强编译、行为及多文件协同验证。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to refactor source files, but file-local evaluations do not reveal changes to contracts, dependencies, or caller assumptions affecting repository adoption. To address this gap, we conduct 1,500 generation attempts across 150 production files from 15 open-source Java repositories, five LLM configurations, and two dependency-aware generation conditions: single-prompt refactoring and LangGraph-based multi-agent refactoring. Of these attempts, 1,455 yield complete candidates eligible for analysis. We evaluate these candidates using local changes, repository-facing structural indicators, detected caller impact, the behavioural-equivalence indicator, and available test evidence, and categorize them as Low-risk, Review-needed, High Contract/Dependency Risk, or Inconclusive. The results show that 1,365 candidates (93.8%) are classified as High Contract/Dependency Risk, whereas 106 (7.3%) have at least one detected broken downstream caller and 290 (19.9%) have a false behavioural-equivalence indicator; only eight satisfy the Low-risk criteria. Within the reason-covered subset, the High-risk rate decreases under more conservative dependency-delta thresholds, while 60 of the 65 candidates with conclusive targeted-test outcomes pass, including 50 classified as High risk. Paired analyses of 705 complete pairs identify no statistically significant generation-condition difference in the principal risk indicators, although model configurations differ in specific detected risk channels. These findings suggest that practitioners should treat LLM-generated refactorings as candidates requiring staged repository-level verification, while future research should validate screening and extraction precision and strengthen compilation, behavioural, and coordinated multi-file verification.

</details>


### [507] [When Does UML Software Modeling Pay Off? A Contingency Model of Industrial Modeling Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24884)
*Kleinner Silva Farias de Oliveira*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 基于405份从业者问卷的实证研究，发现软件建模的价值是情境依赖的：当建模的预期情境价值超过创建与维护模型所需的社会技术成本时才值得投入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着规格驱动开发（SDD）兴起，软件建模重新获得战略地位，被视为将人的意图、需求和设计决策转化为可指导开发者与AI辅助工具之精确规格的手段。但在工业实践中，建模的收益何时能超过其创建、沟通、同步与维护所需的社会技术成本，尚缺乏实证证据。

Method: 分析405份软件从业者的问卷；问卷将关于UML使用、收益、障碍与改进机制的封闭题项，与关于当前使用情况、困难及适用情境的开放题项相结合。

Result: 多数受访者将建模与集成讨论（90%）和共享理解（82%）相联系，但也报告了时间压力（85%）及创建和维护模型的成本（80%）。选择性建模、模型与代码同步、协作支持被视为提升可行性的条件；仅24%的人每天使用UML。

Conclusion: 当建模的预期情境价值超过创建与维持它所需要的社会技术摩擦时，软件建模才有回报；其价值是情境性的，而非普适的。

Abstract: With the emergence of specification-driven development (SDD), software modeling has regained strategic importance as a way to translate human intentions, requirements, and design decisions into precise specifications that can guide both developers and AI-assisted development tools. Despite the renewed relevance of modeling in SDD, empirical evidence remains limited on when its benefits outweigh the socio-technical effort required to create, communicate, synchronize, and maintain software models in industrial practice. This study investigates when software modeling generates value in industrial practice. We analyzed 405 survey responses collected from software practitioners. The questionnaire combined closed items concerning UML use, benefits, barriers, and improvement mechanisms with open-ended questions about current use, difficulties, and worthwhile contexts. Most respondents associated modeling with integration discussions (90 percent) and shared understanding (82 percent), but also reported time pressure (85 percent) and the effort required to create and maintain models (80 percent). Selective modeling, model-code synchronization, and collaborative support emerged as conditions that improve its viability, whereas only 24 percent reported daily UML use. Software modeling pays off when its expected contextual value exceeds the socio-technical friction required to create and sustain it. Its value is therefore contingent, not universal.

</details>


### [508] [RXSynth: A Seed-Grounded Corpus for Studying Java Runtime-Exception Bugs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24902)
*Parnian Eslamloo,Banani Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出RXSynth合成语料库（4,275对Java方法），用真实bug/fix样本生成并经两阶段锚定校验，揭示现有修复检测评测受表面方向线索（token增长）干扰、高准确率并不代表真正理解缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Java bug基准（Defects4J、Bugs.jar、Bears、BugSwarm）过滤后仅剩170个真实方法级bug/fix对、覆盖7类未检查异常，方法级数据严重不足，难以研究运行时异常检测。

Method: 从真实bug/fix样本生成合成方法对构建RXSynth（4,275对），用结构对齐选择生成器，并用两阶段patch锚定流程校验（定位标注异常风险、检验修复是否消除），500对分层样本经独立JVM执行验证；保留provenance记录以防生成样本与测试bug重叠，并做结构分析与多种检测范式对比。

Result: 84.2%的抽样对通过JVM验证；provenance控制下，监督式孤立方法ROC-AUC约0.55-0.64，强零样本模型准确率约69%但仅正确识别41.2%的已修复方法；双版本微调编码器达70.4-74.8%；而简单token增长规则达84.7%，在36对无token增长样本上编码器接近随机，GPT-5.5与Gemini 3.1 Pro超94%。

Conclusion: RXSynth支持对比式、patch导向与上下文感知研究；成对评测须控制provenance与方向性表面线索，避免将高准确率误读为对缺陷的理解。

Abstract: Existing Java bug benchmarks offer limited method-level data for studying runtime-exception detection. Filtering Defects4J, Bugs.jar, Bears, and BugSwarm yields only 170 real buggy/fixed method pairs across seven unchecked exception types. We introduce RXSynth, a corpus of 4,275 synthetic Java method pairs generated from real bug/fix exemplars. We select the generator using structural alignment with real seeds and validate pairs using a two-stage patch-anchored procedure that identifies the labelled exception risk and checks whether the repair removes it. Independent JVM execution confirms patch-local validity for 84.2% of a stratified sample of 500 pairs. Provenance records enable evaluation without overlap between generation exemplars and test bugs. Structural analyses show good alignment within the represented size range, but compression of larger methods.
  We use RXSynth to compare isolated-method detection with pair discrimination when the repair is visible.
