Under provenance-controlled evaluation, supervised isolated-method ROC-AUC is about 0.55-0.64. Stronger zero-shot models reach about 69% accuracy but identify only 41.2% of repaired methods correctly. In contrast, fine-tuned encoders achieve 70.4-74.8% accuracy with both versions available. However, a simple token-growth rule achieves 84.7% expected accuracy, highlighting repair-direction cues. On 36 pairs without token growth, encoder accuracy falls to approximately chance, while GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro exceed 94%. RXSynth thus supports contrastive, patch-oriented, and context-aware studies; pairwise evaluations should control for provenance and directional surface cues before interpreting high accuracy as defect understanding.

</details>


### [509] [Theory of Developer Momentum: The Developer's Experience of Progress and the Craft of Maintaining Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24935)
*Arty Starr,Keith Mann,Margaret-Anne Storey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"开发者动能理论"(Theory of Developer Momentum)，将开发软件视为一种有方向的运动与技艺过程，区分并整合心流、动能与动机三个相关构念，基于扎根理论访谈12名专业开发者并做8次反馈访谈，用于理解AI智能体工作流下开发者认知体验的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究缺少一个能刻画"开发活动处于运动之中"的体验性视角，且心流、动能、动机等构念常被混用，难以看清它们如何交织推动进展；同时在AI工作流兴起的背景下，需要新的理论透镜来观察开发者认知体验的转变。

Method: 采用建构主义扎根理论(constructivist grounded theory)方法，在既有扎根理论工作基础上，对理论抽样的12名专业开发者进行深度访谈，并开展8次反馈访谈以评估理论共鸣度并探讨其在智能体AI工作流中的适用性。

Result: 提出"开发者动能"定义——开发者对任务目标进展与前进运动的体验；厘清了心流、动能与动机之间的关系与交织方式；识别出支撑进展的机制：在记忆中构建工作上下文、沉浸于认知谜题、在不确定地形中通过运动获得清晰感。

Conclusion: 该理论提供了一个新的范式，可在多个尺度与分辨率上观察软件开发之运动、观察支撑该运动的"活的"能力，并扩展了可被改进、技能判断与技艺所触及的范围，为研究AI时代开发者认知体验提供丰富透镜。

Abstract: This paper introduces a Theory of Developer Momentum that helps us see the activity of developing software in motion and the skilled craft through which progress unfolds. We define Developer Momentum as the developer's experience of progress and forward motion toward the goal of a task. Our theory disentangles the related constructs of flow state, momentum, and motivation, so we can more clearly see the relationships between them and how they interweave to support progress. In order to make progress, developers build up working context in memory, become immersed in a cognitive puzzle, and gain clarity through motion in uncertain terrain. The theory provides researchers with a rich experiential lens to investigate how developers' cognitive experiences are shifting in emerging AI workflows. Building on prior grounded theory work, we conducted in-depth interviews with a theoretically sampled subset of 12 professional developers, and eight feedback interviews to evaluate resonance and investigate how the theory translates to agentic AI workflows. We followed a Constructivist Grounded Theory approach to construct a theory grounded in empirical data. Our theory contributes a novel paradigm for seeing the motion of developing software at multiple scales and resolutions, seeing the living capacities that support this motion, and expanding what becomes available for improvement, skilled judgment, and craft.

</details>


### [510] [Noise-Awareness in Quantum Software Testing: An Empirical Landscape Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25233)
*Mir Mohammad Yousuf,Shabir Ahmad Sofi,Bisma Majid*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对2018–2025年61篇量子软件测试(QST)论文进行系统性实证分析，发现77%的论文忽视噪声，仅23%显式处理噪声，18%在真实硬件或噪声模拟器上评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NISQ硬件带来噪声、退相干和概率执行等根本挑战，量子软件测试研究快速发展，但现有测试方法是否真正应对噪声与硬件约束尚不清晰，需要系统性刻画该领域的现状。

Method: 构建确定性、分类学引导的分析框架，覆盖八种测试范式，应用于61篇2018–2025年的论文；对比"贡献表述"与"评估方式"，并用人编码盲审参考样本验证分类框架的信度。

Result: 47篇(77.0%)为噪声无感，仅14篇(23.0%)显式涉及噪声；11篇(18.0%)在物理硬件或噪声模拟器上评估。测试生成(最大范式)噪声感知率仅14.3%，调试与修复18.2%，基于覆盖率、蜕变和差分测试均无噪声感知工作。噪声感知方法出现较晚且各年数量均处劣势。表述与评估强相关(OR=40.5, p<0.001)，但14篇噪声感知论文中5篇仅在理想模拟器上评估。仅16.4%论文报告推断性统计检验。

Conclusion: QST领域对噪声与硬件约束的显式关注严重不足，方法表述与实际评估存在脱节。所提框架具有较高评分者一致性，可作为硬件感知测试实践纵向分析的可复用实证基础。

Abstract: Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware has transformed quantum computing into a practical experimental platform while introducing fundamental challenges associated with hardware noise, decoherence, and probabilistic execution. Although quantum software testing (QST) has rapidly emerged as an active research area, it remains unclear to what extent existing testing methodologies explicitly engage with noisy and hardware-constrained execution environments. This paper presents a systematic empirical landscape analysis of noise-awareness in QST research through a deterministic, taxonomy-guided analytical framework applied to 61 papers published between 2018 and 2025 across eight testing paradigms, contrasting how contributions are framed with how they are evaluated. Among the analyzed papers, 47 (77.0%) are noise-oblivious and only 14 (23.0%) explicitly engage with noise-related execution concerns, while only 11 (18.0%) report evaluation on physical hardware or a noisy simulator. Test generation, the largest paradigm, exhibits a noise-awareness rate of only 14.3%, and debugging and repair 18.2%; coverage-based, metamorphic, and differential testing contain no noise-aware contributions. Noise-aware methodologies emerged late and remain outnumbered in all analyzed years. Framing and evaluation are strongly associated (odds ratio 40.5, p < 0.001) yet diverge for individual papers: 5 of the 14 noise-aware papers evaluate only on ideal simulators. Inferential statistical tests are reported in only 16.4% of papers. The classification framework was validated against a blinded, human-coded reference sample, achieving almost perfect inter-rater agreement on testing-technique classification and substantial agreement on noise-awareness. The framework provides a reusable empirical basis for longitudinal analysis of hardware-conscious testing practice.

</details>


### [511] [Beyond Similarity-Based Generation: Guiding Commit Message Generation with Issue-Commit Traceability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25303)
*Chunying Zhou,Gong Chen,Xiaoyuan Xie,Yi Song,Yuxuan Yang,Peng He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TraceMsg：用issue-commit可追溯性指导提交消息生成，采用协作式多智能体框架（生成、追溯推理、反馈精炼），在6个开源项目上Hit@1达0.893、MRR达0.911。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CMG方法将任务孤立处理，仅优化与开发者参考消息的相似度，未必反映消息的实际可用性；在AI辅助开发流程中，提交消息需作为共享信息服务多种软件工程活动，故此目标存在局限。

Method: 提出TraceMsg，以issue-commit可追溯性作为代表性SE活动来引导生成。它是由消息生成、追溯推理和反馈引导精炼组成的协作多智能体框架，使生成消息服务于追溯，并利用推理反馈进行issue条件的精炼。

Result: 在6个开源项目上评估，平均Hit@1为0.893、MRR为0.911，相较最优基线分别提升13.16%和38.75%。

Conclusion: 将下游SE任务（可追溯性）纳入优化目标可有效提升提交消息的实用价值，多智能体协作与反馈精炼是有前景的方向。

Abstract: Commit messages provide records of code changes and help developers understand and maintain software. To reduce the manual effort involved in writing them, commit message generation (CMG) approaches automatically generate commit messages that describe code changes in natural language. Existing CMG approaches generally treat CMG as a standalone task and optimize generated messages primarily for similarity to developer-written references. However, this objective may not properly reflect the practical usefulness of generated commit messages. This limitation matters in current AI-assisted software engineering workflows, where commit messages are used as shared information to serve different software engineering activities. To fill this gap, we propose TraceMsg, which uses issue-commit traceability, a representative software engineering activity, to guide commit message generation. TraceMsg is a collaborative multi-agent framework that coordinates message generation, traceability reasoning, and feedback-guided refinement, allowing generated messages to serve traceability while using reasoning feedback to guide issue-conditioned refinement. We evaluate TraceMsg on six open-source projects. The experimental results show that TraceMsg achieves an average Hit@1 of 0.893 and an MRR of 0.911, improving Hit@1 and MRR by 13.16% and 38.75%, respectively, over the best baseline for each metric.

</details>


### [512] [From Software History to Executable Regression Tasks: A System for Evaluating Software Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25308)
*Ruikai Shi,Zhengran Zeng,Rui Xie,Shikun Zhang,Wei Ye*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文构建了一个从历史"引入-修复"提交对自动生成可执行回归实例的系统，用于评测软件智能体在代码审查中的缺陷发现、修复与回归测试生成能力，并在11个Python项目上验证了172个实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着软件智能体越来越多地生成和修改代码，需要评测其审查变更、发现缺陷的能力。但这类评测需要可执行的项目环境和可靠的、由可复现行为支撑的缺陷参照，现有代码审查基准难以同时满足这两点。

Method: 系统从历史introducing–fixing提交对和开发者测试中抽取候选测试，用受限智能体将其移植并配置版本相关环境（保持生产代码与测试期望不变）；通过独立重放和基于证据的审查验证测试是否在引入版本失败、修复版本通过，从而确认回归关系。此外通过修复支持的分析和人工审查补充根因位置、经验证的修复和因果解释。

Result: 从11个Python项目的522个候选中构建172个有效实例；在83个人工筛选并增强的实例上评测3个软件智能体、10个模型及不同推理强度设置。精确根因行定位仍具挑战，修复与回归测试生成成功率最高达68.7%和77.1%；不同任务的最优配置不同，高性能未必带来更高API成本效率。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了可复用的可执行证据，用于研究智能体的缺陷发现、修复和测试能力，支持同一缺陷上的缺陷检测、定位、修复与回归测试生成等多种任务。

Abstract: As software agents increasingly generate and modify code, evaluating their ability to review changes and discover defects becomes important. Such evaluation needs executable project environments for investigation and reliable defect references supported by reproducible behavior. Existing code review benchmarks provide limited support for this combination. We present a system that constructs executable regression instances from historical introducing--fixing commit pairs and developer tests. The system extracts candidate tests from fixing-side changes, then uses constrained agents to transplant them and configure version-specific environments while preserving production code and test expectations. Independent replay and evidence-based review verify whether tests that fail on the introducing version and pass on the fixing version support the proposed regression relationship. Accepted instances retain both versions' replay recipes, validated tests, and execution evidence. Repair-supported analysis and human review add root-cause locations, tested repairs, and causal explanations. These instances support bug detection and localization in code review, and enable bug repair and regression-test generation on the same defects. The system constructs 172 validated instances from 522 candidates across 11 Python projects. We evaluate three software agents with ten models and additional reasoning-effort settings on 83 manually selected, enriched instances across the three tasks. Precise root-line localization remains challenging, while baseline combinations achieve repair and regression-test generation success rates of up to 68.7% and 77.1%, respectively. Leading configurations differ by task, and higher task performance does not necessarily yield greater API-cost efficiency. Our approach provides reusable executable evidence for studying agents' defect discovery, repair, and testing capabilities.

</details>


### [513] [Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25601)
*Hridya Dhulipala,Xiaokai Rong,Aashish Yadavally,Tien N. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TESSARA 是一个自适应测试脚本生成框架，把自然语言测试意图转成可执行、可回放、可检查的 Playwright 脚本（交互代码+目标状态断言+步骤级溯源），并在三个公开 Web 基准上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM Web 智能体能在线完成自然语言任务，但"完成任务"不等于产出测试工程物：后者需可执行、可从初始状态回放、可被开发者审查、且绑定判定标准。人工编写端到端 Web 测试成本高（选择器、多步流程、断言、维护），因此需要自动生成真正的测试脚本文本。

Method: 提出 TESSARA：1) 步骤对齐脚本生成（SAS），为每个计划步骤落地独立代码片段，形成"步骤—代码—选择器证据—执行结果—修复历史"的溯源链；2) 基于溯源实现细粒度失败定位、仅重生成失败后缀、以及感知可逆性的回溯（避免撤销表单提交等可能的提交点）；3) 三级验证流水线：语法、执行、语义/判定标准，分别修复畸形代码、交互失败与错误落地状态。

Result: 在三个公开 Web 基准上评测脚本可执行性、判定满足度、回放稳定性与修复效率，相对基线以及直接作为脚本生成器使用的底层 VLM 均有大幅提升。

Conclusion: 将"任务完成"转化为"可维护测试产物"是可行且必要的；步骤级对齐与可逆性回溯、分级验证是提升脚本质量与修复效率的关键设计，为端到端 Web 测试自动生成提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Automated generation of end-to-end web tests remains costly: developers must identify stable selectors, encode multi-step workflows, attach assertions, and maintain scripts as interfaces evolve. Recent LLM-based web agents can complete natural-language tasks in a live browser session, but task completion is not the same as producing a test-ware artifact - code that is executable, replay-able from a reset state, inspectable by developers, and tied to an oracle. We present TESSARA, an adaptive test-script generation framework that converts natural-language test intent into Playwright scripts consisting of executable interaction code, goal-state assertions, and step-level provenance linking each step to its generated code fragment, selector evidence, execution outcome, and repair history. TESSARA grounds each planned step via Step-Aligned Scripting (SAS), enabling fine-grained failure localization, selective regeneration of failing suffixes, and reversibility-aware backtracking that avoids undoing likely commit points (e.g., form submissions). A three-level verification pipeline (syntactic, execution, and semantic/oracle), detects and repairs malformed code, interaction failures, and incorrect landing states. We evaluate TESSARA on three public web benchmarks, measuring script executability, oracle satisfaction, replay stability, and repair efficiency, and show substantial improvements over baselines and underlying VLMs used directly as script generators.

</details>


### [514] [Better Specifications, Better Code: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Behavioral Contract Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25616)
*Brhane Team,Tiantian Yang,Nikta Akbarpour,Simone Bartucci,Francesco Calimeri,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CG2 是一个"契约引导"的代码生成框架，先把自然语言任务转化为结构化行为契约，经微调+迭代验证修复后，再引导下游代码模型生成代码，在 1007 个任务、5 个模型上 pass@1 稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 代码生成能力虽强，但因任务中行为需求隐含或模糊，常出现功能正确性问题，需要显式化并校验这些需求。

Method: 将自然语言任务翻译为结构化行为契约（接口、前置条件、后置条件、不变量）；微调 LLM 生成契约，并用迭代式语义验证与修复流程纠正不完整、不一致或错误的规约，再以该契约引导一个固定的下游代码生成模型。

Result: 在 1,007 个留出任务、5 个代码 LLM 上评测：相较直接生成 pass@1 提升 1.49–3.27 个百分点（相对提升 7.58%–22.45%）；相较未微调的契约引导提升 1.19–2.38 个百分点（相对 7.04%–14.65%）。人工分析显示语义正确的契约与更高代码准确率相关。

Conclusion: 显式地指定并验证行为需求可提升功能正确性，且无需修改下游代码生成模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong code-generation capabilities but often struggle with functional correctness due to implicit or ambiguous behavioral requirements. We present CG2, a contract-guided code generation framework that translates natural-language tasks into structured behavioral contracts specifying interfaces, preconditions, postconditions, and invariants. CG2 fine-tunes an LLM to generate these contracts and introduces an iterative semantic validation and repair process to identify and correct incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect specifications before guiding an unchanged downstream code-generation model. We evaluate CG2 on 1,007 held-out tasks using five code LLMs: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-27B. Results show that CG2 consistently improves pass@1 over direct code generation by 1.49-3.27 percentage points (7.58%-22.45% relative improvement) and over contract guidance without fine-tuning by 1.19-2.38 percentage points (7.04%-14.65% relative improvement). Manual analysis further reveals that semantically correct contracts are associated with higher code-generation accuracy. These findings demonstrate that explicitly specifying and validating behavioral requirements can improve functional correctness without modifying downstream code-generation models.

</details>


### [515] [Selecting and Composing Agent Design Patterns: Industrial Case Evidence and Controlled Reference-System Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25629)
*Jia Huang,Bingsheng Ru,Bo Liang,Yuke Xiong,Haiyan Fan,Joey Tianyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文扩展了"认知功能—执行拓扑"框架，加入证据驱动的模式选择流程与显式组合契约，并通过工业案例、研讨会与可执行故障注入实验验证有界组合机制的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent 模式目录虽描述了架构备选方案，但工程师在选择与组合模式时缺乏证据支持，需要一个可操作的、可执行的选型与组合方法。

Method: 结合两个工业案例、一个贡献者协作设计、七次从业者研讨会与可执行故障注入实验；构建三个本地参考系统（SQLite 状态、共享工件文件、文件型地图发布代理）；用 2×2 消融在 36 个场景族（每族 10 个输入变体）上分离功能专用契约与执行控制；并审计一个冻结的六臂语言模型试点。

Result: 等权条件下，组合系统在每个系统中 12 个场景族里能正确完成或安全拒绝 11 个，而简单基线仅分别为 2、2、1；无消费端验证的恢复会增加假成功案例；所有组合系统仍在"可信证据出错"的边界案例上失败；审计复现了六臂试点的分数，但确认了评估者依赖的排名反转。作者强调这些是构造性挑战套件结果，而非生产成功率。

Conclusion: 贡献在于将工业失败、模式选择、可执行处理、外部验收与修订串联起来；选择流程仅作演示而非与替代流程对比评估；结果表明支持的是有界组合机制，而非框架优于同等信息量常规方法的论断。

Abstract: Agent pattern catalogs describe architectural alternatives, but engineers also need evidence for selecting and composing them. We extend a cognitive-function--execution-topology framework with an evidence-driven selection procedure and explicit composition contracts. The study combines two industrial case accounts, a contributor's collaboration design, seven practitioner workshops, and executable fault-injection experiments. Three local reference systems use SQLite state, shared artifact files, and a file-backed map-publication surrogate. A 2 x 2 ablation separates function-specific contracts from execution controls across 36 scenario families, with ten input variants per family. Under equal family weighting, composition correctly completes or safely refuses 11 of 12 families in each system, compared with 2, 2, and 1 for the simple baselines. These are constructed challenge-suite results, not production success rates. Recovery without consumer-side verification increases false-success cases in the map surrogate. All composed systems still fail a boundary case in which trusted evidence is wrong. An audit of a frozen six-arm language-model pilot reproduces its scores but confirms an evaluator-dependent ranking reversal. The contribution connects industrial failure, pattern selection, executable treatment, external acceptance, and revision. Selection is demonstrated rather than evaluated against an alternative procedure; catalog admission rests on separate criteria. The results support bounded composition mechanisms, not a claim that the framework improves engineers' design decisions over an equally informative conventional method.

</details>


### [516] [What Is Under the Hood? A Cross-Ecosystem Study of Vulnerable Dependencies in Construction Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25774)
*Mahzabin Tamanna,S M Jamil Uddin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究对904个建筑相关GitHub仓库进行跨生态实证分析，用OSV-Scanner评估第三方依赖的可评估性与已知漏洞暴露，发现仅54.6%可完成评估，受影响仓库中80%含已知漏洞、97.2%含高危风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑业软件大量依赖第三方组件，但其依赖构成与已知漏洞暴露情况缺乏系统分析，供应链安全基线缺失。

Method: 对覆盖六类建筑功能及多功能的904个GitHub仓库，采用commit固定的仓库快照与OSV-Scanner进行跨生态扫描，考察依赖可评估性、漏洞普遍性、严重度、CWE弱点分类及共享上游依赖暴露。

Result: 仅494个仓库(54.6%)完成漏洞评估；其中395个(80.0%)含至少一个已发布漏洞通告的依赖版本，97.2%受影响仓库存在High/Critical风险；CWE映射识别出资源消耗、路径遍历、信息泄露与代码注入等反复出现的弱点；每受影响仓库漏洞簇中位数为50，仅两个上游包族即覆盖约70%受影响仓库。

Conclusion: 研究为建筑相关开源软件的依赖可评估性与已知漏洞暴露提供实证基线，强调需记录评估覆盖范围、结合部署情境解读通告匹配结果，并在评估供应链安全时关注共享上游依赖。

Abstract: The construction industry increasingly relies on software built from third-party components, yet the dependency composition and known-vulnerability exposure of construction-related software remain poorly analyzed. In this study, we conduct an empirical, cross-ecosystem investigation of 904 construction-related GitHub repositories spanning six construction functions and a multifunction category. Using commit-pinned repository snapshots and OSV-Scanner, we examine dependency assessability, known-vulnerability prevalence, severity, weakness classifications, and shared upstream exposure. Our results reveal that only 494 repositories (54.6%) completed vulnerability assessment, revealing substantial gaps in dependency visibility. Among successfully scanned repositories, 395 (80.0%) contained at least one dependency version associated with a published vulnerability advisory, and 97.2% of affected repositories contained a High or Critical severity risk. Additionally, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) mapping identified recurring resource-consumption, path-traversal, information-exposure, and code-injection weaknesses. Vulnerability burden was uneven, with a median of 50 distinct advisory clusters per affected repository, while just two affected upstream package families collectively reached ~70% of affected repositories. These findings establish an empirical baseline for dependency assessability and known-vulnerability exposure in construction-related open-source software. Our findings underscore the importance of documenting assessment coverage, interpreting advisory matches in their deployment context, and examining shared upstream dependencies when evaluating construction software supply-chain security.

</details>


### [517] [From Finding to Fixing: How Useful is Fault Localization for Agentic Program Repair?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25826)
*Xinyu Shi,Zhou Yang,An Ran Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文系统实证研究了故障定位（FL）在LLM智能体修复中的实际价值，发现FL方法并不稳定提升修复成功率，定位精度高也不必然带来更大修复收益，但FL能引导早期搜索、减少修复token消耗，且需注意评估基准的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年LLM-based FL方法提升了定位精度，但定位对智能体自动修复（agentic repair）的实际影响尚不清楚，存在研究空白。

Method: 在SWE-bench Verified和Defects4J上，用3个LLM、统一修复框架评测6种近期FL方法，分析16,248条修复轨迹；并考察gold位置与bug-cause描述作为FL引导在不同修复情境下的作用。

Result: FL方法未持续提升修复成功率，定位精度与修复收益不呈稳定正相关；FL能引导智能体早期搜索、更快定位相关代码；准确定位可使修复token减少最多39.2%，但现有FL方法本身消耗的token常超过其节省；gold引导实验表明当bug输入位置线索较少时FL潜力更大；提供bug-cause可进一步提升成功率；单一参考补丁的ground truth无法完整覆盖成功修复实际使用的位置。

Conclusion: 研究厘清了FL在智能体修复中的真实价值：其作用更偏向引导搜索与节约成本而非直接提升成功率，并提示未来FL设计与评估应改进基准与引导形式。

Abstract: Fault localization (FL) aims to identify code locations responsible for software failures and is commonly evaluated by how accurately it ranks known fault locations. Large language model (LLM) agents are changing program repair and are increasingly used to search and reason over repositories. Although recent LLM-based FL methods have improved localization accuracy, their impact on agentic repair remains unclear. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic empirical study of FL in agentic repair. We evaluate six recent FL methods on SWE-bench Verified and Defects4J with three LLMs under a common repair framework and analyze 16,248 repair trajectories. We also examine gold locations and bug-cause descriptions as forms of FL guidance across different repair contexts. The studied FL methods do not consistently improve repair success, and higher localization accuracy does not consistently lead to larger repair gains. Yet FL guides agents' early search and helps them reach relevant code sooner. Accurate locations can reduce repair token use by up to 39.2\%, but current FL methods often consume more tokens than they save during repair. Experiments with gold guidance suggest that FL has greater potential when bug inputs contain fewer location clues. Providing bug causes can further improve repair success beyond locations alone. We also find that ground truth from a single reference patch does not fully capture the locations used by successful repairs. These findings help clarify the value of FL in agentic repair and inform future work on its design and evaluation.

</details>


### [518] [SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25899)
*Jinze Li,Weijie Liu,Jinfeng Xu,Shuo Yang,Xin Yang,Yang Zhang,Yijin Wang,Zifei Shan,Edith C. H. Ngai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 SWE-Residual 基准，评估编码代理在"起始状态已包含前人未完成任务"时的表现（Starting-State Robustness），发现前沿代理成功率大幅下降，并揭示"接受偏差"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SWE 基准都从干净状态开始，而真实场景中代理常需接续他人（或另一代理）已报告"完成"但实际失败的工作，且无任何失败提示。这种能力缺口未被现有评测捕捉。

Method: 构建 SWE-Residual：从 DeepSWE 和 Terminal-Bench 的 111 个任务中提取 198 个"残留状态"（前驱代理提交完成但隐藏测试仍失败的状态），涵盖代码仓库与整机环境两类。被测代理仅获得原始请求与该状态，无轨迹、无失败提示；请求与隐藏测试不变，唯一变量是起始状态。在五个前沿代理上对比 Clean Start。

Result: 相对 Clean Start，DeepSWE 成功率下降 20.6–53.5 个百分点，Terminal-Bench 下降 20.6–34.9 个百分点，且 DeepSWE 上代理排名发生反转。失败案例呈现"接受偏差"：代理把继承的工作当作待办定义，而不对照请求核查。DeepSWE 上 58.9–88.2% 的失败运行提交时失败测试与之前完全相同，而这些测试在 Clean Start 下多能通过。

Conclusion: SWE-Residual 暴露了干净起点评测无法捕捉的能力缺口；接续已有工作的鲁棒性应成为编码代理评测的重要维度。

Abstract: Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests. These benchmarks almost always start the agent from a clean state that contains no earlier work on the task. In practice, however, agents often continue work that a developer or another agent has already done and reported as complete, with no indication of what remains incorrect or missing. We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task. SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment. Each Residual State is the state a predecessor agent left behind after submitting its work as complete, although the hidden tests still fail. The evaluated agent receives only the original request and this state, without the predecessor's trajectory or any sign that the attempt failed; because the request and hidden tests are unchanged, the starting state is the only difference from the source benchmark. Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse. Failed continuations show a pattern we call acceptance bias: agents treat the inherited work as the definition of what remains to be done instead of checking it against the request. On DeepSWE, in 58.9--88.2% of failed runs, they submit with exactly the same tests failing, although they pass most of these tests from a Clean Start. SWE-Residual thus exposes a capability gap that clean-start evaluation does not capture.

</details>


### [519] [Function Contracts for Bounded Model Checking of C Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26089)
*Weiqi Wang,Marie Farrell,Liping Zhao,Lucas C. Cordeiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 ESBMC 的函数契约框架，其技术核心是"观测性帧规则"：快照契约不允许函数写入的位置并在出口比较。该编码产生的验证条件数只取决于全局变量数量、与函数体写操作数无关；在各类基准及 ML-KEM 参考实现上，模块化路线在十分钟内完成而整体展开路线双双超时。框架已并入 ESBMC master。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有界模型检验把程序展开成单一公式，含循环的函数在每个调用点都要复制一份循环，代价随调用点膨胀。函数契约可解耦这一耦合，但 CBMC 的动态帧条件检查虽已工业规模使用，却缺乏替换为何可靠的形 式化说明，也未刻画帧检查的代价结构。

Method: 为 ESBMC 引入完整函数契约框架：子句语法、验证与替换两阶段、以及该工具首个 assigns 强制检查。技术上采用观测性帧规则——快照契约未许可写入的位置，在出口处比较；并给出其在 BMC 编码中的有界形式，流水线的代数骨架用 Lean 4 机器验证，并说明模型边界。

Result: 编码产生的验证条件数由程序的全局变量个数决定，而非函数体的写操作次数；CBMC 式动态帧检查则随写次数增长，且这是编码性质，不随机器或求解器变化。在合成扫描、SV-COMP 任务、ANSSI X.509 解析器、FreeRTOS heap_1 分配器及复用其 CBMC 契约的 ML-KEM 参考实现上评估：在 FIPS-203 规定的系数规模下，整体路线两工具均十分钟内无解，模块化路线均完成。

Conclusion: 函数契约是展开空间耗尽时的替代方案；本工作为 ESBMC 提供了首个带 assigns 强制的契约框架，给出可机器验证的有界帧规则及其代价刻画，并已合入 ESBMC master。

Abstract: Bounded model checking unrolls a program into a single formula, so a function holding a loop costs the solver a fresh copy of that loop at every call site. Function contracts break that coupling. Verify the body once against its contract, then replace each call by a stub derived from it. CBMC supports this through dynamic frame condition checking, applied at industrial scale, but with no formal account of why the replacement is sound and no characterisation of what the frame check costs.
  We present the function-contract framework for ESBMC. The clause syntax, both phases, and the first assigns enforcement the tool has had are all introduced here. Its technical core is an observational frame rule: snapshot the locations the contract does not permit the function to write, then compare them at exit. The encoding emits a number of verification conditions set by how many globals the program has, not by how many writes the body performs, while dynamic frame condition checking grows with the write count. That is a property of the encoding rather than a timing, so it moves with neither the machine nor the solver. The rule itself is the classical one; what we add is its bounded form inside a BMC encoding, with the pipeline's algebraic skeleton machine-checked in Lean 4 and the limits of that model stated.
  We evaluate on synthetic sweeps, SV-COMP tasks, an ANSSI X.509 parser, the FreeRTOS heap_1 allocator, and the ML-KEM reference implementation whose CBMC contracts we reuse unchanged. At the coefficient count FIPS-203 mandates, neither tool finishes on the monolithic route inside ten minutes, and both finish on the modular one. The framework is merged into ESBMC master. Contracts are what is left when unrolling runs out of room.

</details>


### [520] [The EBC Proportionality Law: A Recurring Architectural-Role Pattern Across Java Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26392)
*Dzikri Rahadian Fudholi,Andrea Capiluppi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对1,556,985个Java文件的文件级EBC角色比例进行大规模实证测量：Entity占比低于Boundary和Control，主导模式为13.25%E/42.65%B/44.10%C，并明确承认自动标注的可靠性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EBC将领域信息、外部交互与流程协调分离，但各类软件中三者的实际比例尚不清楚，缺乏大规模实证参考。

Method: 用LLM生成标签训练文件级分类器，为732个项目实例、78个功能类别共1,556,985个Java文件各赋予一个代表性角色；在项目与功能类别层级聚合，采用描述性统计与密度聚类分析。

Result: Entity明显少于Boundary与Control；主导聚类覆盖48个类别、472个项目实例、47.75%的文件，平均构成为13.25% Entity、42.65% Boundary、44.10% Control；其余30个类别构成一个替代模式与11个较小专门模式。部分差异与类别职责一致，部分证据混杂。与独立专家标签一致性有限（准确率31.37%，macro-F1 0.31，Entity召回率13%）。

Conclusion: 结果仅代表分类器所赋角色的分布模式，而非经核实的架构真值；在明确此测量边界的前提下，提供了文件级EBC分布的大规模经验参考，并记录了自动化方法的局限性。

Abstract: Architectural roles describe how responsibilities are distributed within software systems. Entity--Boundary--Control (EBC) separates domain information, external interaction, and workflow coordination, but its proportions across diverse software remain unclear. This study examines file-level classifier-derived EBC proportionality in 1,556,985 Java files from 732 project instances and 78 functional categories. A classifier trained on labels generated by a large language model assigned one representative role per file. The labels were aggregated at project and functional-category levels and analysed using descriptive statistics and density-based clustering. The results show that Entity was less common than Boundary and Control. The dominant cluster covered 48 categories, 472 project instances, and 47.75% of classified files; its mean composition was 13.25% Entity, 42.65% Boundary, and 44.10% Control. The remaining 30 categories form one alternative and 11 smaller specialised patterns. Some selected variations were consistent with category responsibilities, while others received mixed support. Agreement with independent expert labels was limited (31.37% accuracy; macro-F1 0.31; Entity recall 13%). All reported proportions and clusters are therefore patterns in classifier-assigned roles, not verified architectural ground truth. Within this measurement boundary, the study provides a large-scale empirical reference of EBC distributions at the file level, and it documents the limitations of the automated approach.

</details>


### [521] [When Coding Agents Outpace Review: Evaluating PRD-Driven Development in Mature Enterprise Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26394)
*Tianqi Liu,Yandong Guan,Songze Li,Wenkai Wang,Gang Yu,Chengfei Lv*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 PACE 基准，用 43 个企业级任务和 750 个专家审核的 Code Points 衡量编码智能体对完整 PRD 的交付程度，并定位交付失败环节。11 种配置大多得分 52.1–78.1，最高完整交付率仅 14.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以判断智能体是否完整实现产品需求文档（PRD），也难定位交付在哪一步失败。已有研究多集中于 issue 修复或从零开发，对成熟企业仓库中的增量式 PRD 满足情况探索不足；孤立单元测试也无法充分反映业务与集成需求。

Method: 构建 PACE 基准：43 个企业级任务、750 个经专家审核的 Code Points。流程包含需求重构、评价准则构建与基于证据的评估，以此量化 PRD 满足度，并将交付缺口关联到具体智能体行为。

Result: 11 个模型–脚手架配置得分多在 52.1–78.1，GPT-5.6-Sol 完整交付率最高为 14.0%。主要瓶颈是实现不完整与集成缺失——能产出单个组件并不等于完成整体交付。评估与专家共识一致率达 95.2%，且不同评判记录间的用例级波动低于重复执行间波动。

Conclusion: 除模型对比外，该基准能为智能体框架（harness）改进提供可操作诊断：依据诊断定向优化，同一模型与任务集下连续版本性能由 59.4 提升至 63.0。代码已开源。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly undertake development tasks in mature enterprise repositories, yet existing benchmarks offer limited insight into whether they fulfill complete Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and where delivery breaks down. Issue resolution and development from scratch leave incremental PRD fulfillment underexplored, while isolated tests provide incomplete evidence of business and integration requirements. We introduce PACE, a benchmark of 43 enterprise tasks with 750 expert-audited Code Points. It combines requirement reconstruction, criterion construction, and evidence-based evaluation to measure PRD fulfillment and connect delivery gaps to agent behavior. Across 11 model--scaffold configurations, most scores fall between 52.1 and 78.1; GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest complete-delivery rate of 14.0\%. Incomplete implementation and missing integration are the principal bottlenecks: producing individual components does not ensure a complete delivery. Evaluation achieves 95.2\% agreement with expert consensus, with lower case-level variation across judging records than repeated executions. Beyond model comparison, the benchmark provides actionable feedback for harness refinement: diagnosis guides targeted improvements, and successive harness releases raise mean performance from 59.4 to 63.0 using the same model and task suite. Code is available at https://github.com/TianqiLiu1/PACE-Bench.

</details>


### [522] [VerusEval: Evaluating LLM-Generated Verus Specifications Beyond Verifier Acceptance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26464)
*Ding Wang,Chao Jiang,Dugang Liu,Zhiwu Xu,Cheng Wen,Zhong Ming,Yuwei Liu,Xinyi Wan,Lin Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VerusEval 提出一个六维度契约评估框架，指出"验证器接受"会高估生成契约质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成 Verus 契约时，验证器接受只说明实现满足契约，无法说明契约是否刻画了意图行为，因此需要多维度评估方法论而非单一指标。

Method: 提出 VerusEval 框架，沿六个维度评估契约，包括 Verus 原生的语义平凡性检查、经校验的输入输出套件、契约等价性，并关联各维度以衡量其强度与盲区。对 762 个任务、4 种工作流、5 个 LLM、2 种提示设置共 13,716 个产物进行评估，并辅以筛查与人工审查。

Result: 仅 42.3% 被接受的产物通过全部三项语义检查；接受率提高并不稳定带来契约更正确；I/O 评估拒绝 23.6% 被接受产物，通过者中仅 63.2% 被证等价；被契约比较标记的产物中 84.1% 存在完整性义务被拒；筛选审查在 61 个参考契约中发现 36 个候选缺陷，修复其中一个使 11 个失败产物中的 10 个变为等价。

Conclusion: 接受不等同于质量，需多维度联合评估；作者据此提出面向评估、生成与基准维护的四条可操作经验，并提示参考契约本身也可能有缺陷。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate Verus contracts for Rust programs together with the proofs that establish them. Yet verifier acceptance, the common measure of success, shows only that the implementation satisfies the generated contract, so it leaves open whether the contract captures the intended behavior. Assessing specification generation therefore requires an evaluation methodology, not a single metric. We present VerusEval, a framework that evaluates generated contracts along six dimensions, including Verus-native checks for semantic triviality, validated input-output (I/O) suites, and contract equivalence, and that relates them so that the strength and blind spots of each become measurable. Evaluating 13,716 artifacts from four workflows, five LLMs, and two prompting settings on 762 tasks, we find that acceptance overstates quality: only 42.3\% of the accepted artifacts complete all three semantic checks without a flag, and across workflows and models, higher acceptance does not consistently come with more correct contracts. I/O evaluation rejects 23.6\% of the accepted artifacts, yet only 63.2\% of those that pass it are proved equivalent. Of the accepted artifacts flagged by contract comparison, 84.1\% have a rejected completeness obligation, and the direction of a failure prioritizes inspection of the generated contract or the reference; it does not by itself establish which artifact is defective. Screening and review further identify 36 candidate defects among 61 selected reference contracts, and repairing one of them makes 10 of its 11 failing artifacts equivalent. Based on these findings, we derive four actionable lessons for evaluation, generation, and benchmark maintenance.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

### [523] [Coopshift: Post-Training Amplifies The Memory Curse In LLM Cooperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24086)
*Jiayuan Liu,Shiyi Du,Tianqin Li,Emanuel Tewolde,Keyang Xuan,Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 后训练会放大"记忆诅咒"，使模型在重复社会困境中可见历史越长、合作率下降越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练评估多聚焦单次孤立决策，缺少对重复互动中合作能否持续的考察，本文欲探究后训练如何改变重复互动中的合作行为。

Method: 在七个已发布模型谱系内，比较预训练(Base)、监督微调(SFT)与偏好/奖励优化(Aligned)检查点；让同一检查点副本互相对弈七个社会困境各200轮，可见历史限于最近2轮或40轮，并拟合合作率随收益参数变化。

Result: 可见历史从2轮扩展到40轮会降低所有SFT与Aligned检查点的合作率，且七个谱系中有六个的下降幅度超过Base；放大幅度多在SFT阶段已出现。长历史下两类后训练阶段在六个二元行动博弈中平均合作率都低于Base；对称博弈中其合作率随合作成本上升、收益下降或背叛更有利而下降更陡。Aligned与SFT的差异在单次决策与重复博弈间发生变化，且取决于指令将回合描述为"最后一轮"还是"可能有未来互动"。

Conclusion: 后训练评估应超越孤立选择，需评估合作在重复互动中能否持续及其对收益结构与可见历史的依赖。

Abstract: How does post-training change cooperation during repeated interaction? Within each of seven released model lineages, we compare pretrained (Base), supervised fine-tuned (SFT), and subsequent preference- or reward-optimized (Aligned) checkpoints across seven social dilemmas. Copies of each checkpoint play one another for 200 rounds, with visible history limited to the last two or forty rounds. The memory curse refers to lower cooperation when agents can see more past rounds. Our central finding is that post-training amplifies this decline. Averaged across the six binary-action games, expanding visible history reduces cooperation at every SFT and Aligned checkpoint. At each post-trained stage, these declines exceed Base's in six of seven lineages. Most of this average amplification is already present at SFT. With long history, both post-trained stages also cooperate less than Base on average in each binary-action game. In the symmetric binary games, their fitted cooperation rates fall more steeply on average than Base's as per-round cooperation costs rise, benefits fall, or noncooperation becomes more rewarding. The difference in cooperation rates between Aligned and SFT also changes from one-shot decisions to repeated play. When given the same past records, their choices depend on whether the instructions describe a final round or possible future interaction. Post-training evaluation should therefore go beyond isolated choices to assess whether cooperation is sustained in repeated interaction and how it depends on payoffs and visible history.

</details>


### [524] [Envy-Free Randomized Apportionment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24217)
*Francesco La Commare,Jamie Tucker-Foltz,Victor Verdugo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究随机分摊中如何设计规则以最小化"嫉妒对"(票多者席位反而少)的期望数量，并给出多项式时间LP框架和理论下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 立法机构席位有限需取整，已有随机取整方法可实现事前完全公平，但会导致票多(state/party人口多)却席位少的"嫉妒"现象，需研究能多大程度避免这种嫉妒。

Method: 提出"嫉妒对"度量与无嫉妒(envy-free)定义；证明忽略下配额(lower quotas)的规则最坏情况嫉妒为Θ(n²)；证明等下配额时所有分配期望嫉妒相同；对一般情形构建多项式时间LP框架，通过对偶上的分离问题高效求解，覆盖最小化期望与方差等目标。

Result: 任何忽略下配额的n方规则最坏情况嫉妒达Θ(n²)，即使存在无嫉妒分配；等下配额下所有分配期望嫉妒相同；实验显示无嫉妒分配非常常见，包括美国历次十年一次人口普查的所有历史实例。

Conclusion: 下配额对减少嫉妒至关重要，所提LP框架为实践中以更少争议方式实施随机分摊提供了清晰方案。

Abstract: The United States allocates representatives to each state in proportion to its population, while many parliamentary democracies select representatives from party lists in proportion to the number of votes each party receives. In both settings, the legislature's small size necessitates rounding to the nearest whole number of seats. Recent work has shown a plethora of ways to randomly round seat shares to achieve perfect ex ante fairness. As a result, party (state) $i$ may have a larger number of votes (population) than party $j$ but receive fewer seats. In this case, we say that party $i$ envies party $j$. We investigate the extent to which such envy is avoidable. Specifically, we seek to design apportionment rules that minimize the expected number of envious pairs $(i, j)$. If the expectation is zero, we say that the seat allocation is envy-free.
  On the negative side, we show that any $n$-party apportionment rule that ignores lower quotas (the floors of the deserved number of seats for each party) suffers from a worst-case envy of $Θ(n^2)$, even on instances where an envy-free allocation exists. All previously studied apportionment rules fall into this class and thus do a poor job of minimizing envy. In the case where all lower quotas are equal, we prove that all allocations have the same expected envy. In the general case, we we introduce a general polynomial-time LP framework for a large class of apportionment objectives, including minimizing the expectation and variance of envy, by efficiently solving the separation problem on the dual. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that envy-free allocations exist very frequently, including in every historical instance from the US decennial census. Taken together, these results provide a clear recipe for implementing randomized apportionment in a less objectionable way in practice.

</details>


### [525] [Extending Myerson's Optimal Auctions to Correlated Bidders via Neural Network Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24240)
*Mingyu Guo,Jiayuan Liu,Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出一个经验性流程（神经网络插值Myerson贪婪分配 + 神经验证保证策略防伪 + 构造性修复），在确定性、策略防伪、事后个体理性的单物品拍卖中实现接近最优收益，并首次用不可达的贪婪收益作为严格上界进行基准评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Myerson解决了独立出价者情形，但相关出价者情形下简单扩展会导致非单调、非策略防伪的分配，且相关情形最优分配设计NP难近似，理论上难以求解。因此希望在理论困难模型上建立经验严谨性的新标准。

Method: 基于边际利润（虚拟估值的相关变体）对Myerson贪婪分配做神经插值；用形式化神经验证强制精确策略防伪性；再用构造性修复程序处理违规；并引入不可达的贪婪收益作为严格上界做基准。

Result: 在合成、对抗性及真实世界（消费者、金融、工业）数据集上一致获得近最优收益，相比手工与神经基线常将收益差距缩小一个数量级；并扩展到单位需求的多单位拍卖，将验证技术集成进RegretNet以实现精确策略防伪。

Conclusion: 该工作为相关出价者最优拍卖设计提供了可计算、经验严谨的解决方案，并以贪婪收益上界给出可信的定量性能度量，方法具有通用性。

Abstract: We aim to design revenue-maximizing single-item auctions that are deterministic, strategy-proof, and ex post individually rational --- the quintessential fundamental model for optimal mechanism design. While Myerson's seminal work solved this model for independent bidders, straightforward extensions to correlated settings often result in non-monotonic, and therefore non-strategy-proof allocations. Critically, optimal allocation design for correlated bidders is NP-hard to approximate, rendering theoretical optimality guarantees in this domain computationally intractable.
  We establish a new standard of empirical rigor for this theoretically hard model by proposing an empirical pipeline. We synthesize neural interpolation of Myerson's greedy allocation based on marginal profits (the correlated variant of virtual valuation), formal neural verification to enforce exact strategy-proofness, and a constructive repair procedure.
  Empirically, our method is highly effective, consistently achieves near-optimal revenue across a wide range of distributions, including synthetic, adversarial, and real-world (consumer, financial, and industrial) datasets. Compared to existing manual and neural baselines, our approach shows substantial improvement, often reducing the revenue gap by an order of magnitude. Our study is also the first to introduce (unattainable) greedy revenue as a rigorous upper bound for empirical benchmarking, providing a definitive quantitative performance measure where true optima remain theoretically elusive.
  We demonstrate the generality of our approach by extending it to multi-unit auctions with unit demand and integrating our verification techniques into RegretNet to achieve exact strategy-proofness.

</details>


### [526] [Tree Plurality Veto: Voting in Few Rounds with Efficient Communication and Low Metric Distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24456)
*Gabriel Chen,Yu Cheng,Alice Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出TreePluralityVeto，在确定性投票协议中首次系统刻画"轮数—总通信量—失真"三者的权衡关系。对任意r≥2，该协议至多r轮、总通信O(n log m + n s^{1/(r-1)} log s)比特，失真不超过2r-1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有确定性规则存在两极：一轮完整排序需Θ(nm log m)比特但达最优失真3；PluralityVeto仅需O(n log m)比特却需Θ(n)轮。作者希望理解"轮复杂度"与"总通信"之间如何权衡，寻找中间地带的高效协议。

Method: 提出TreePluralityVeto：对选民进行层次化划分（树状分区），在每一层并行运行PluralityVeto并收集受限排序；分支因子作为旋钮控制轮数与通信的tradeoff。分析采用基于匹配（matching）的方法，证明每增加一层失真上界至多增加2。

Result: 对任意r≥2，协议至多r轮，总通信O(n log m + n s^{1/(r-1)} log s)比特（s=min{n,m}），失真≤2r-1。r=2时以2轮、O(n√s log s)比特通信近似达到常数因子失真；随r增大失真逼近3而通信逼近O(n log m)。

Conclusion: 该工作给出确定性低失真投票协议中轮数与通信量之间的平滑权衡曲线，TreePluralityVeto以层次化并行化和匹配分析统一了"一轮高通信"与"多轮低通信"两种极端，为分布式/通信受限场景下的社会选择提供了可调的效率工具。

Abstract: We consider the metric distortion framework for voting, where $n$ voters and $m$ candidates are embedded in an unknown metric space. A voting rule selects a candidate using only voters' ordinal preferences, and its distortion is the worst-case ratio between the social cost of the selected candidate and the minimum social cost. We study how round complexity trades off against total communication in deterministic voting protocols with low distortion. Deterministic rules can achieve the optimal distortion of $3$ in one round by eliciting complete rankings using $Θ(nm\log m)$ bits, while a direct sequential implementation of PluralityVeto achieves the same distortion using only $O(n\log m)$ bits but requires $Θ(n)$ rounds.
  Our main result is TreePluralityVeto, a deterministic voting protocol that, for every $r\ge 2$, achieves distortion at most $2r-1$ using at most $r$ rounds and $O(n\log m+n s^{1/(r-1)}\log s)$ bits of total communication, where $s = \min\{n, m\}$. The protocol runs PluralityVeto on a hierarchical partition of the voters, collecting restricted rankings in parallel at each level. The branching factor controls the tradeoff between rounds and communication, and a matching-based analysis shows that each level increases the distortion bound by at most $2$.

</details>


### [527] [Blockchain Participation Games with Upfront Contribution Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24697)
*Zhenhe Zhang,Jing Chen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带"预留容量"准备成本的区块链参与博弈，刻画同质/异质选择下的纯纳什均衡，并以最小支出方案刻画全员贡献均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有区块链参与博弈（含撤回变体）未考虑选择前需预留计算/通信容量的情形，准备成本即使未被选中也会发生，导致新的搭便车与"只注册不投入"问题。

Method: 建模委员会任务：用户可选弃权、裸注册、或有条件承诺贡献；成功需足够多被选中且实际贡献者，产生公共价值，并可分别对注册与验证贡献发奖励。同质选择下刻画全部纯纳什均衡并给出最小支出奖励方案（含注册奖励与否）的完整刻画；异质选择下用二人实例分析最优方案与选取顺序。

Result: 给出支持全员贡献的全部同质最小支出方案的完整刻画，正奖励时其为一条线段；总存在不含注册奖励的最优方案，且能消除所有含裸注册者的最小支出均衡同时保留全员贡献均衡（但可能仍有阈值协调失败）。异质选择下二人实例的唯一最优需同时使用两种奖励，且比任何零注册奖励方案更省。若全员贡献是正福利社会最优，则同质零注册奖励设计达到稳定性价格为1；任意独立选择概率下，全员贡献纳什均衡均为强均衡。

Conclusion: 零注册奖励设计在均质情形下几乎无损且稳健（稳定性价格1、强均衡），但异质选择下引入注册奖励可能严格更优，说明奖励结构应随选择机制设计。

Abstract: Blockchain participation games model costly entry, random selection, and threshold success; their retraction variants charge completion costs only to selected contributors. We study committee tasks requiring operators to reserve computing or communication capacity before assignment, so preparation costs are incurred even when capacity remains unused. Users choose abstention, bare registration without preparation, or binding commitment to contribute if selected. Success requires sufficiently many selected contributors, creates public value, and may trigger separate rewards for registration and verified contribution. We characterize all pure Nash equilibria under homogeneous selection and analyze ordering under heterogeneous selection. The results distinguish free-riding on public value from registration that earns rewards without productive commitment; more frequently selected users can choose bare registration while less frequently selected users contribute. Our main result characterizes every homogeneous minimum-outlay scheme supporting full contribution, where every user commits, as a Nash equilibrium. When positive rewards are required, these schemes form a line segment. There is always an optimum with no registration reward. It eliminates every equilibrium containing bare registrants at minimum outlay while retaining the full-contribution equilibrium; threshold-coordination failures may remain. Under heterogeneous selection, a two-user instance has a unique optimum using both rewards, cheaper than every zero-registration-reward scheme supporting full contribution. Finally, if full contribution is a positive-welfare social optimum, the homogeneous zero-registration-reward design attains price of stability one. Under arbitrary independent selection probabilities, every full-contribution Nash equilibrium is also a strong equilibrium.

</details>


### [528] [Cooperation Without Shared Rewards via Reciprocal Q-Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24793)
*Francesco Morri,Adel Abusitta,Quentin Cappart,Margarida Carvalho*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出 Reciprocal Q-Augmentation (RQA)，用隐变量对手模型在不共享奖励/内部状态的条件下增强 Q 函数，使智能体既能学习合作策略也能学习背叛策略，在多种社会困境中实现更快更高水平的合作并能诱导标准 RL 智能体转向合作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: General-sum 博弈比纯合作或纯对抗更难，因为智能体可能欺骗或利用对方；高社会福利需要持续合作，但一次背叛就可能把系统推向次优纳什均衡。同时，假设可获取他人奖励或内部状态并不现实，且会隐式地给设定注入额外合作，因此需要一种仅依赖自身信息的机制。

Method: RQA 使用一个隐变量对手模型（latent-variable opponent model），把"自身动作如何影响其他智能体"的估计用于增强自身的 Q 函数；智能体只用自己的 Q 函数即可同时学出合作策略与背叛策略，并可在两者间切换。

Result: 在社会困境中，全部采用 RQA 合作策略的智能体收敛到合作更快、合作水平高于完全合作型算法；单个 RQA 智能体通过适当切换合作/背叛策略，可诱导原本会走向背叛的标准 RL 智能体产生合作。在 Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma、Iterated Traveler's Dilemma、Iterated Stag Hunt 及 CleanUp-Lite 上，RQA 优于共享奖励的完全合作方法。

Conclusion: 在不共享奖励与内部状态的现实设定下，基于自身 Q 函数与对手建模的互惠式增强足以实现高效合作，并可作为"合作诱导者"改善其他自私学习者的社会福利表现。

Abstract: General-sum games are more challenging than fully cooperative or adversarial settings because agents may deceive or exploit one another. Achieving high social welfare requires sustained cooperation, while a single defection can drive agents toward a welfare suboptimal Nash equilibrium. Moreover, assuming access to other agents' rewards or internal states is often unrealistic and implicitly introduces additional cooperation into the setting. To address this issue, we introduce \textit{Reciprocal Q-Augmentation} (RQA), a method that uses a latent-variable opponent model to augment the Q-function with estimates of how one's actions affects other agents. RQA allows agents to learn both cooperative and defective policies using only their own Q-function. We show that, in social dilemmas, agents that all follow the cooperative policy of RQA learn to cooperate faster and reach higher levels of cooperation than fully cooperative algorithms. Moreover, a single RQA agent that switches appropriately between its cooperative and defecting policies can induce cooperation in agents trained with standard RL algorithms, which would otherwise end up defecting. We evaluate our approach on the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, Iterated Traveler's Dilemma, Iterated Stag Hunt, and \texttt{CleanUp-Lite}. Our experiments show that the algorithms implementing RQA outperforms fully cooperative methods with shared rewards and enables cooperation with algorithms that otherwise fail to reach high social welfare.

</details>


### [529] [Improved Approximation and Tight Competition for Simple Auctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24973)
*Yichen Huang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究单一加性买家、物品估值独立情形下简单拍卖（单独售卖与整体打包）对最优收益的逼近。证明正则情形下 REV≤BSPA₂≤2BREV；一般独立情形下 REV≤SREV+(π²/6)BREV≤2.645·max{SREV,BREV}，改进此前6与5.2的界；并给出2.11的下界以及Θ(log m)竞价者需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 简单拍卖（单独售卖 SREV、整体打包 BREV）虽实用但在一般独立估值下的近似比此前仅为6（BILW）和5.2（Ma & Simchi-Levi），正则情形下打包的竞争保证亦有开放问题（Beyhaghi et al., EC 2025）。作者希望收紧上下界并刻画打包与竞争的关系。

Method: 对正则独立物品，分析"整体打包的二价拍卖收益 BSPA₂"（两个独立竞价者）与 BREV、REV 的关系。对一般独立物品，通过分解最优机制收益为单独售卖部分与打包部分，利用常数 π²/6 的级数型不等式推导 REV 的界。下界侧构造三个不相交捆绑的实例，并分析用 max{SREV,BREV} 精确恢复单买家最优收益所需竞价者数量。

Result: 正则情形：REV≤BSPA₂≤2BREV，给出紧的近似与竞争保证，回答开放问题。一般情形：REV≤SREV+(π²/6)BREV≤2.645·max{SREV,BREV}，优于6与5.2。下界：存在三捆绑实例收益超过2.11·max{SREV,BREV}，改进Rubinstein(ITCS 2016)的2；精确恢复需Θ(log m)个竞价者（最坏情形）。

Conclusion: 打包（及其二价拍卖形式）在正则与一般独立估值下都能以更优常数逼近最优收益，且具有竞争保证；同时下界表明 max{SREV,BREV} 的近似比不可能低于2.11，且多竞价者精确恢复存在Θ(log m)的固有代价，界定了简单拍卖的极限。

Abstract: We study simple auctions for one additive buyer whose values for $m$ items are independent. Write $\mathrm{REV}$ for optimal revenue, $\mathrm{SREV}$ and $\mathrm{BREV}$ for the revenues from separate selling and grand bundling, and $\mathrm{BSPA}_2$ for grand-bundle second-price revenue with two independent bidders. For independent regular items, we prove $\mathrm{REV}\le\mathrm{BSPA}_2\le2\mathrm{BREV}$. This establishes tight approximation and competition guarantees for bundling under regularity and answers an open question from Beyhaghi et al. (EC 2025). For general independent items, we prove $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{SREV} + \frac{π^2}{6}\mathrm{BREV} \le 2.645 \max\{\mathrm{SREV}, \mathrm{BREV}\}$. This improves the previous approximation factors of $6$ from Babaioff, Immorlica, Lucier, and Weinberg (FOCS 2014, JACM 2020) and $5.2$ from Ma and Simchi-Levi (AISTATS 2021). On the lower bound side, we construct an instance in which prices for three disjoint bundles earn more than $2.11\max\{\mathrm{SREV},\mathrm{BREV}\}$, improving the previous lower bound of $2$ from Rubinstein (ITCS 2016). We also show that exact recovery of one buyer's optimal revenue by the better of separate selling and bundling requires $Θ(\log m)$ bidders in the worst case.

</details>


### [530] [Non-Monetary Mechanisms for Stochastic Scheduling via Sampled Pairwise Externality Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25067)
*David X. Lin,Chido Onyeze,Giannis Fikioris,Siddhartha Banerjee,Éva Tardos*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出非货币在线资源分配的 SPEC 范式，通过采样估计成对外部性补偿，在随机调度模型中为每个代理人保证接近理想效用的鲁棒最优比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无货币、代理人需求私有且随机、可排队等待、可能策略性甚至对抗/合谋的情况下，如何分配共享资源并保证每人不低于其"理想效用"的较大比例，且不依赖他人行为。

Method: 提出 Sampled Pairwise Externality Compensator (SPEC)：基于成对外部性补偿思想，用采样估计替代未来外部性的精确计算，借助局部混合与耦合模拟高效计算估计值。具体实例化为随机调度模型——代理人提交带私有价值的作业，未服务作业跨期存留并随机过期，单服务器每期至多处理一个作业。

Result: 机制给每个代理人一个简单策略，达到完全知情规划者所能提供的最优最坏情况理想效用比例（仅差次线性可加损失）；当过期概率趋零的长时域极限下该比例趋近 1；每期期望摊还时间 O(n²)，且每期计算开销与时间跨度 T 无关。

Conclusion: SPEC 为无货币在线分配提供鲁棒效用保证，展示了局部混合+采样估计在保持强鲁棒性同时实现高效计算的可能性，长时域持久作业下可实现近乎理想的效用分配。

Abstract: How can a shared resource be allocated without money when agents have private, stochastic demands that can be queued for a while, and may behave strategically, or even adversarially? We introduce a paradigm for non-monetary online resource allocation called Sampled Pairwise Externality Compensator (SPEC). Our objective is to guarantee each agent a large fraction of its ideal utility: an individual benchmark corresponding to serving the highest-valued fraction of its demand permitted by an equal share of capacity. We seek guarantees that hold regardless of other agents' behavior, including potentially adversarial and collusive behavior. Our approach builds on the idea of pairwise externality compensation, making it computationally efficient by replacing exact calculations of future externalities with sampled estimates. The central insight is that local mixing, exploited through coupled simulations, allows these estimates to be computed efficiently while preserving robust utility guarantees. In our main technical contribution, we instantiate SPEC in a stochastic scheduling model in which agents receive jobs with private values, unserved jobs persist across periods subject to random expiration, and a single server processes at most one job per period. Our mechanism gives each agent a simple strategy that achieves the optimal worst-case fraction of ideal utility available to a fully informed planner, up to a sublinear additive loss in total utility. We also show that this fraction approaches $1$ in the long-horizon limit as the expiration probability vanishes: sufficiently persistent jobs allow each agent to secure nearly its full ideal utility. The mechanism runs in $O(n^2)$ expected amortized time per period, where $n$ is the number of agents; significantly, the expected amortized computational overhead per period is independent of the time horizon $T$.

</details>


### [531] [Strategy recovery for Mean-Payoff Games is as hard as solving them from scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25188)
*Dani Dorfman,Uri Zwick*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: Mean-Payoff Games (MPGs) 的判定问题长期未知是否属于 P（已知在 UP∩co-UP 中）。本文给出从"求解 MPG"到"策略恢复问题（已知所有顶点值，求双方最优策略）"的归约，证明策略恢复本质上与从头求解同样困难，回答了 Andersson 与 Miltersen 的问题；并进一步证明即使已知一方的策略（从而已知所有值），求另一方的最优策略仍然困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPG 是确定性无限期零和回合制博弈，求解复杂度是长期开放问题，是此类中已知最简单却仍不在 P 中的组合问题之一。已有工作（如 Mamino 对随机博弈）研究了"给定值后求策略"的难度，但该技术无法推广到确定性 MPG。作者希望弄清策略恢复问题相对于求解问题的难度，回答 Andersson–Miltersen 提出的问题。

Method: 构造一个简单归约，把求解 MPG 归约为策略恢复问题；仅使用简单的博弈变换、自可归约（self-reducibility）与剥离（peeling）论证。进一步扩展该技术，证明在已知一方最优策略（及全部值）的情况下求另一方最优策略仍困难。

Result: 证明 MPG 的策略恢复问题在本质上与从头求解 MPG 同样困难；并证明即使已知第二方的最优策略（进而所有顶点值），为第一方寻找最优策略仍然是困难的。该结果回答了 Andersson 与 Miltersen 的问题，且覆盖了 Mamino 随机博弈技术无法处理的情形。

Conclusion: 策略恢复并非比求解更容易：知道值并不显著降低求最优策略的复杂度。方法简单（博弈变换+自可归约+剥离），为理解 MPG 复杂度结构提供了新证据。

Abstract: Mean-Payoff Games (MPGs) form an interesting family of deterministic, infinite-duration, zero-sum, turn-based games played by two players on a finite weighted directed graph. The goal of the players is to minimize, respectively maximize, the $\textit{limiting average}$ of the costs of the edges on an infinite path constructed by the two players. The complexity of solving MPGs is a long-standing open question. The decision problem associated with these games is known to be in $\text{NP}\cap \text{co-NP}$, and even $\text{UP}\cap \text{co-UP}$, yet the problem is not known to be in $\text{P}$. This is one of the simplest combinatorial problems with such a status.
  A full solution of an MPG gives the $\textit{value}$ of each vertex of the game, along with a pair of $\textit{optimal strategies}$ for the two players. (Each player has a succinct $\textit{positional}$ optimal strategy.) The problem of finding optimal strategies for the players given the values of all vertices is known as the $\textit{strategy recovery}$ problem. We describe a simple reduction from the problem of solving MPGs to the strategy recovery problem for MPGs. This shows that the strategy recovery problem for MPGs is essentially as hard as solving MPGs from scratch, i.e., without knowing the values. The reduction uses simple $\textit{game transformations}$ and simple $\textit{self-reducibility}$ and $\textit{peeling}$ arguments. This answers a question of Andersson and Miltersen. Mamino obtained a similar result for $\textit{stochastic}$ games with a limiting average objective, but his technique does not extend to deterministic games such as MPGs. We go one step further and show that finding an optimal strategy for one of the players of an MPG remains hard even if an optimal strategy of the second player, and hence all the values, are known.

</details>


### [532] [MMS Allocation for Chores with Item Disposals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25320)
*Shinuo Ma,Xiaowei Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究非负加性成本下带"琐事处置"(chore disposals)的maximin share (MMS)分配问题，证明对任意n≥4个代理的实例，至多n-3次处置即可保证每人的MMS基准，消除了对任务数m的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络平台需组织内容审核、社区维护等集体工作，这些任务对参与者产生异质成本。公平分配负担同时尽量减少未分配任务是平台设计的自然目标，但已知完全MMS分配并不总存在，因此需研究允许少量"处置"的最小数量。

Method: 在非负加性成本下形式化带处置的MMS分配问题：目标是最小化未分配任务数，同时保证每个代理仍获得其来自原始实例的MMS基准。通过构造性证明给出处置次数的上界，并针对四代理情形给出紧界分析，同时将结论对称推广至物品(goods)情形。

Result: 证明任意n≥4代理实例至多需n-3次处置；改进Barman等(2025)的2m/11+n上界并消除对m的依赖。四代理情形得到紧界：一次处置总足够，而已知实例( Ezra和Garbuz, 2026)不存在完全MMS分配。对物品情形证明n-3次复制足以保证MMS。

Conclusion: 处置需求仅与代理数n相关而不依赖于任务数m，且n-3是强界、四代理时1次处置即为紧界；结论在goods与chores间具有对称性。

Abstract: Web platforms organize collective work, including content review and community maintenance, that imposes heterogeneous effort costs on participants. Fairly distributing these burdens while leaving as few tasks unassigned as possible is a natural objective for the design of such platforms. We study this through the maximin share (MMS) allocation problem with chore disposals under nonnegative additive costs. Our goal is to minimize the number of unassigned chores while guaranteeing every agent her MMS benchmark from the original instance. We prove that, for every instance with $n \ge 4$ agents, at most $n-3$ chore disposals suffice. We improve the bound of $2m/11+n$ disposals established by Barman et al. (2025), where $m$ is the number of chores, and eliminate the dependence on $m$. For four agents, we obtain a tight bound: one disposal always suffices, whereas known instances admit no complete MMS allocation (Ezra and Garbuz, 2026). We also prove the same result for goods: $n-3$ duplications suffice to ensure MMS.

</details>


### [533] [Breaking the 1/3 Barrier for Approximate Nash Equilibria in Symmetric Bimatrix Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25524)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Patrick Jaillet,Gabriele Farina*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文给出首个无条件多项式时间算法族，将对称双矩阵博弈的近似纳什均衡保证从 (1/3+δ) 改进到 (1-1/√2+δ)（约 0.293+δ），突破了 1/3 的近似壁垒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对称双矩阵博弈的最佳多项式时间近似保证为 Kontogiannis 与 Spirakis [2011] 的 (1/3+δ)，1/3 长期作为一道近似壁垒存在，作者希望给出无条件（不依赖复杂性假设）的突破。

Method: 构造一类多项式时间算法族，对任意固定 δ>0，可在多项式时间内计算对称 (1-1/√2+δ)-近似纳什均衡；该结果无条件成立，无需任何复杂性或计算假设。

Result: 对每个固定 δ>0，新算法可达到对称 (1-1/√2+δ)≈(0.293+δ) 的近似保证，优于原 (1/3+δ)≈(0.333+δ)，且属于首个实现该突破的无条件多项式时间算法族。

Conclusion: 对称双矩阵博弈的 1/3 近似壁垒被无条件打破，确立了新的近似上界 (1-1/√2+δ)；摘要未透露具体技术细节与下界讨论。

Abstract: We give the first unconditional family of polynomial-time algorithms that breaks the $1/3$ approximation barrier for symmetric bimatrix games. For every fixed $δ>0$, an algorithm in this family computes a symmetric $(1-1/\sqrt{2}+δ)$-approximate Nash equilibrium, improving on the previous best guarantee of $(1/3+δ)$ due to Kontogiannis and Spirakis [2011].

</details>


### [534] [Hardness Amplification for Approximate Nash Equilibrium with Constantly Many Players](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25608)
*Xiaotie Deng,Ningyuan Li,Zihe Wang,Jie Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了在确定性PPAD-ETH假设下，即使是对称二元收益、常数玩家的博弈，计算弱近似纳什均衡也需要拟多项式时间，下界为N^{(log N)^{1-o(1)}}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展近似纳什均衡的计算复杂性下界结果，将双矩阵博弈的硬度推广到更受限的对称二元收益、常数玩家博弈类。

Method: 核心技术是一个无条件的误差放大归约：将双矩阵博弈（收益在[0,1]的有理数）多项式时间转换为对称二元收益博弈，完整收益表大小多项式，玩家数仅依赖容差δ,ε,η；构造博弈的任一(ε,η)-弱近似均衡可还原为原博弈的δ-近似纳什均衡。

Result: 结合Rubinstein [FOCS 16]的双矩阵硬度结果，得到确定性的最坏情况运行时间下界 N^{(log N)^{1-o(1)}}，其中N为构造表的二进制编码长度。

Conclusion: 弱近似纳什均衡在极受限的博弈类中仍计算困难，确立了拟多项式时间下界，强化了PPAD-硬度在受限博弈中的体现。

Abstract: For every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ and $η\in[0,1)$, we prove that computing an $(\varepsilon,η)$-weak approximate Nash equilibrium requires quasipolynomial time assuming deterministic PPAD-ETH, even in symmetric binary-payoff games with a constant number of players. The games are given by complete payoff tables, and the player count depends only on the tolerances. The weak approximate Nash equilibrium allows at most an $η$ fraction of players to gain more than $\varepsilon$ by deviating unilaterally. The main technical result is an unconditional error-amplification reduction from bimatrix games. For every fixed $δ\in(0,1)$, it transforms a rational bimatrix game with payoffs in $[0,1]$ into a symmetric binary-payoff game with a polynomial-size complete table and a player count depending only on $δ,\varepsilon,η$. Every $(\varepsilon,η)$-weak approximate equilibrium of the constructed game yields a $δ$-approximate Nash equilibrium of the bimatrix game. Construction and recovery take polynomial time in their explicit inputs. Combining this reduction with the bimatrix hardness result of Rubinstein [FOCS 16] gives a deterministic worst-case running-time lower bound of $N^{(\log N)^{1-o(1)}}$, where $N$ is the constructed table's binary encoding length.

</details>


### [535] [Regularizing the Veto Core](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26535)
*M. August Rossi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出正则化 SimultaneousPluralityVeto，在保持最优失真界 3 的同时实现帕累托有效与凸的并列获胜集合，解决了 Kızılkaya 与 Kempe 的公开问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SimultaneousPluralityVeto 虽达最优最坏情况失真 3，却不满足帕累托有效：即使所有选民都偏好某候选人，仍可能让两人并列。直接删除被支配候选人会破坏并列获胜集合的凸性，故需新方法。

Method: 引入正则化：给每个候选人权重加微小 ε 以恢复帕累托有效性。为分析其失真影响，定义 rank score veto core——候选人权重来自位置打分向量 s，证明其失真落在 [1+2(||s||−s_m), 1+2||s||] 区间（猜测下界紧）。并令 ε 随选民数变化以保持原 veto core 的失真保证。

Result: 固定 ε 会增大失真；让 ε 依赖选民数则保留原 veto core 的失真保证。正则化 SimultaneousPluralityVeto 因而同时具备最优失真、帕累托有效性与凸的并列获胜集合。

Conclusion: 正则化在不牺牲失真最优性的前提下补齐帕累托效率与凸性，为度量失真框架下的投票规则设计提供了兼顾多项性质的新方案。

Abstract: The metric distortion framework asks voting rules to elect a candidate close to the voters using only their rankings. SimultaneousPluralityVeto elects from the plurality veto core and achieves the optimal worst-case distortion of 3, but it is not Pareto-efficient: it can declare a tie between two candidates even when every voter prefers one of them. Removing Pareto-dominated candidates afterward would break the convexity of tied winner sets. We instead introduce regularization, which adds a small $\varepsilon$ to every candidate's weight, restoring Pareto-efficiency. To study its effect on distortion, we introduce the rank score veto core, whose candidate weights come from a positional scoring vector $\mathbf{s}$, and prove that its distortion lies in $[1 + 2(||\mathbf{s}|| - s_m),\, 1 + 2||\mathbf{s}||]$; we conjecture that the lower bound is tight. A fixed $\varepsilon$ can increase distortion, but letting $\varepsilon$ depend on the number of voters preserves the distortion guarantee of the original veto core. Regularized SimultaneousPluralityVeto thus has optimal distortion, is Pareto-efficient, and has convex tied winner sets, resolving an open question of Kızılkaya and Kempe.

</details>


### [536] [Bayesian Analysis of Inclusion Transaction Fee Mechanisms with Multiple Concurrent Proposers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26570)
*Jason Milionis,Kushal Babel*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文构建了一套分析多并发提议者(MCP)下交易费机制(TFM)有限贝叶斯博弈均衡的技术工具，通过让用户数趋于无穷并固定相对拥塞ρ来分析均衡序列，比较了"一次性付费"与"按次包含付费(PPI)"等机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP场景下TFM的贝叶斯均衡难以刻画，需理解不同机制在博弈均衡层面的权衡，尤其是复制(duplication)与包含概率、效率之间的关系。

Method: 考察用户-提议者混合联合均衡序列：用户数增加、相对拥塞ρ固定，研究极限性质；分析pay-once、PPI及二者插值机制，并讨论专属性提议者支付。

Result: PPI在极限下有效并激励用户只路由到一个提议者；刻画了PPI中m用户的渐近行为(含O(√m)扰动)，有效截断附近的Θ(n√(ρ(1-ρ)/m))窗口内呈现类正态CDF的固定包含概率；pay-once在高价值交易上有更高复制和更低包含概率，且其低效在大市场极限、乃至区块空间充足时仍存在；向PPI方向的高系数插值可降低复制提高包含概率；专属性提议者支付产生低效均衡(最大复制)。

Conclusion: PPI是渐近有效且抗复制的机制，pay-once在均衡层面本质低效；插值可在两者间调节，而专属性提议者支付不可取。

Abstract: The goal of this paper is to distill insight around the trade-offs present on Bayesian equilibria of transaction fee mechanism (TFM) design under $n$ multiple concurrent proposers (MCP). We conceptualize a technical toolkit that unlocks the analysis of hard-to-characterize equilibria of finite Bayesian MCP TFM games by examining sequences of joint user--proposer mixed equilibria as the number of users increases and keeping the relative congestion $ρ$ that they cause fixed in the sequence limit. We first consider the popular mechanisms of "pay-once" (which charges transactions its bid only once regardless of the duplicate copies that end up being included by proposers) and "pay-per-inclusion" (PPI in short, which charges a transaction for each copy that appears). We prove that PPI is efficient in the limit of equilibria sequences, and incentivizes users to route to only one proposer. We characterize $m$ users' asymptotic behavior in PPI even in finite markets varying with $O(\sqrt{m})$, where we show users in a $Θ(n\sqrt{ρ(1-ρ)/m})$ window near an efficient cutoff exhibit fixed inclusion probability akin to a normal distribution's CDF. We additionally show that on a value-dependent basis, pay-once exhibits a higher degree of duplication and lower probability of inclusion for higher-value transactions than PPI. Pay-once's inefficiency persists even in the large market limit and even in regimes with ample blockspace where all transactions fit across all blocks. We study interpolations between these two mechanisms proving that some higher coefficients (towards PPI) reduce duplication and increase inclusion probability. We then use our tools to show that exclusive proposer payments yield inefficient equilibria (in fact, with maximal possible duplication), even if users still pay multiple times when included more than once and their payment is burnt when non-exclusive.

</details>


### [537] [Tight Inapproximability for Generalized Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26772)
*Panagiotis Kanellopoulos,Themistoklis Melissourgos*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文确定了广义电路（GCircuit）近似解的紧阈值：ε-GCircuit 在 ε<1/6 时为 PPAD-完全，在 ε≥1/6 时多项式时间可解；并进一步给出允许 δ 比例门被违反时的可解性结果，应用于博弈论多个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义电路是证明 PPAD-硬度与近似均衡问题归属的基本工具，但此前只知 ε<1/10 时困难、ε≥1/2 时可解，中间区间（1/10 到 1/2）的复杂度长期悬而未决。

Method: 通过构造归约证明 ε<1/6 时 ε-GCircuit 即使限制在四种门类型下仍为 PPAD-完全；对 ε≥1/6 给出多项式时间算法。对允许 δ 比例门违反的松弛版本，利用关于最大入度为二的 directed graph 的分解定理，证明 ε>0 且 δ>1/5 时 (ε,δ)-GCircuit 可解，以及 fan-out-one 形式 δ-Pure-Circuit 在 δ>1/8 时可解。

Result: 确立了 ε=1/6 的紧阈值，填补了 1/10 与 1/2 之间的空白；证明 PCP-for-PPAD 猜想在上述 ε、δ 取值下不成立（除非 PPAD=P）；并将正结果应用于公共品博弈、金融网络、贝叶斯博弈、多矩阵博弈与图博弈，改进了近似保证。

Conclusion: GCircuit 的复杂度在 ε=1/6 处存在精确相变；容错版本的分解方法否定了若干参数范围内的 PCP-for-PPAD 猜想，并为算法博弈论中多类均衡计算问题带来更好的近似算法。

Abstract: Generalized circuits are a fundamental tool for establishing PPAD-hardness and membership of approximate equilibrium problems. Despite their importance, the complexity of finding approximate solutions has remained unresolved for a wide range of approximation parameters. We settle this question by establishing a tight threshold at $\varepsilon=1/6$. Specifically, we prove that $\varepsilon$-GCircuit is PPAD-complete for every constant $0<\varepsilon<1/6$, even when restricted to four gate types, and polynomial-time solvable for every constant $\varepsilon\ge1/6$. This closes the gap between the previously known hardness bound of $1/10$ and the polynomial-time solvability bound of $1/2$.
  We further investigate the relaxation in which a fraction $δ$ of the gates may be violated. We establish polynomial-time solvability of $(\varepsilon,δ)$-GCircuit for every constant $\varepsilon>0$ and $δ>1/5$, and of the fan-out-one formulations of $δ$-Pure-Circuit for every constant $δ>1/8$. These results follow from a decomposition theorem for directed graphs of maximum in-degree two and establish that the PCP-for-PPAD conjecture cannot be true for the aforementioned values of $\varepsilon$ and $δ$, unless PPAD = P.
  To showcase the contribution of our positive results, we apply them to a variety of problems in algorithmic game theory, including public goods games, financial networks, Bayesian, polymatrix, and graphical games, and obtain improved approximation guarantees.

</details>

### [538] [Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23857)
*Qianli Ma,Limengxi Yue,Shuyang Xu,Yanpei Shi,Hongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向网页智能体的约束式强化学习模型，将请求、搜索、API调用统一为带成本的长期决策，并用拉格朗日对偶做预算约束、CVaR控制尾部风险，实现成功率-成本-风险的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实网页环境存在请求预算、时延、反爬限制与失败风险，仅优化成功率的策略易出现"高成功高成本"或"低风险但保守失败"的不可用现象，缺少对成本与风险的系统性约束建模。

Method: 将页面访问、搜索请求、外部API调用统一为带成本的长期决策框架；构建含累计请求数、总时延、失败惩罚的多维成本向量，通过Lagrange对偶更新满足预算合规；引入CVaR风险项抑制高失败概率路径的过度探索，实现完成率/成本/风险自适应平衡。

Result: 在30-70个站点/页面模板、800-1500个端到端任务（信息抽取、比价、表单提交、跨页导航），交互20-120步、工具规模30-200；同等完成率下C-PS降低22%-31%，高失败惩罚下失败率降低18%-26%；固定预算下完成率提升10%-16%。

Conclusion: 对比无约束RL、预算约束RL与规则/脚本式智能体，实验证明约束建模对网页智能体实际部署具有必要性与有效性。

Abstract: Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
  Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability.
  Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

</details>


### [539] [PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23861)
*Junchao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyGraph 用"计划缓冲区"让一个最大网格的 CUDA Graph 支持自适应投机解码的动态形状，仅需在每次重放前写入 28 字节的形状信息，内核跳过超出该形状的 tile，从而替代 64 个形状专属图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应投机解码每步都改变批大小 B 与草稿长度 d，验证宽度 M=B·d 随之变化，而 CUDA Graph 只能重放固定启动配置，迫使服务系统预捕获大量形状、在服务路径上捕获新形状，或把每步填充到最大草稿长度。

Method: 为自定义 Triton 内核提供 plan-buffer 机制：只捕获一个最大网格的图，重放前把当前活动形状写入 GPU 内存；内核跳过超出该形状的 tile，图的拓扑、内存分配、布局、指针和启动网格保持固定，更新仅传输 28 字节。

Result: 在单张 NVIDIA H800 上用 Qwen2.5-3B 维度做 trace 驱动的原型：用一张图替代 64 张形状专属图，步延迟与预热基线相当（P50 17.7 ms vs 17.8 ms），服务前图构建时间从 3,915 ms 降至 93 ms。固定草稿长度对照显示收益来自避免填充负载：零填充浪费时相对 MaxPad 的 P99 差异可忽略，100% 浪费时 P99 降低 18.7%。

Conclusion: 本文提出的是面向自定义内核的有界工作形状机制，而非生产级服务系统；结论受限于单 GPU 上的合成 trace。核心贡献是以极小开销解耦 CUDA Graph 的静态启动配置与动态工作形状。

Abstract: Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

</details>


### [540] [Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23862)
*Simon A. Lee,Jiahang Hank Sha,Soomin Chung,Kai Akamatsu,Eran Halperin,Jeffrey N. Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向电子健康记录（EHR）的预测式世界模型（EHR WM），将患者病史表示为动作条件化的潜在轨迹，通过状态-动作条件转移算子建模患者状态演化，并采用状态相关线性化预测器实现时间分辨预测、多步滚动与动作条件模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EHR建模多依赖自回归token预测，未显式区分患者内在状态与临床干预动作，缺乏对状态随动作演化的显式刻画，难以支持时间分辨预测、多步推演与反事实式的动作条件模拟。

Method: 框架将患者状态与观测到的临床动作显式分离，学习状态与动作条件化的转移算子；核心是状态相关线性化预测器，传播潜在患者状态的局部变化，从而支持时间分辨预测、多步rollout与动作条件模拟；并通过将自由运行rollout解码回原始临床特征空间进行可解释与定量评估。

Result: 生成的潜在轨迹保留了下游预测信号、时间结构及编码器表示中的亚组层面统计关系；解码后对未来临床测量的评估显示，所学动力学在潜空间一致性之外仍保留预测信息。在二分类与时间事件任务上，EHR WM 相较参数规模大得多的EHR基础模型取得有竞争力但依赖任务的性能，参数量仅约1/30。扰动观测动作序列会相应改变生成轨迹，验证了动作敏感性。

Conclusion: 结果表明世界建模可作为从纵向EHR中学习显式、时间索引的患者演化表示的一种互补框架，以更小参数规模实现可比的预测性能并支持动作条件模拟。

Abstract: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

</details>


### [541] [SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23864)
*Mushir Akhtar,M. Tanveer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 自适应VLM集成通过早退省算力，但单一的边缘化conformal阈值无法保证各路由的条件覆盖率。作者提出SAGE-CP：在开发集上学习并冻结路由，再对早退与升级两组分别做Mondrian split conformal校准，从而在每条路由上获得有限样本覆盖保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应VLM集成的路由会产生不同计算路径（早退 vs 升级）。单一conformal阈值只保证边缘1-alpha覆盖，若某路由占比为pi，其条件覆盖可能跌至max{0, 1-alpha/pi}，导致个别路由严重失效。这种边缘-条件覆盖错配需要被显式刻画并修正。

Method: 1) 在开发数据上学习路由器并冻结所有路由选择；2) 对路由器产生的操作分组（早退输入与升级输入）分别应用Mondrian split conformal prediction，对返回分数进行分组校准。校准与路由解耦，路由不再随校准改变。

Result: 在10个基准、4个冻结VLM、5个对齐划分上，全局校准与SAGE-CP均达到0.900边缘覆盖（目标0.90），但路由行为差异显著：SAGE-CP将平均最差路由覆盖从0.623提升到0.887，路由覆盖差距从0.324降至0.025，二者使用相同的路由分数与每图1.177次源模型调用。更严格保证使平均预测集从1.893增至2.212，但仍小于全集成（2.486），且源调用少70.6%。路由级可靠性在6种固定查询比例下保持；更细的退出深度分组显示稀有路由需要更多校准数据。在5个数据集上，SAGE-CP将batch-one延迟降低58.8–63.4%，GPU总能耗降低55.7–57.5%。

Conclusion: 路由带来计算节省，而路由分层校准把覆盖保证附着到路由器实际生成的操作路径上，实现逐路由的有限样本覆盖，代价是预测集略微增大。

Abstract: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image.
