The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

</details>


### [542] [Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23917)
*Karl Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究预测分布发生已知边界（结构断点）时的共形预测重置问题，提出在边界处重置经验分位数（reset rule），并从"逐时审计"（共形可靠性）与"频率审计"（频率校准）两个角度给出理论保证与多组实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实数据常存在事先公布的边界（制度变革、政策决策、结构断裂），此前的共形分位数会失效。既有自适应共形方法未显式利用"边界已知"这一信息，忽略了在断点处重置的必要性与理论最优性。

Method: 提出重置规则：在公告边界处以事后经验分位数重新初始化共形阈值；并在有界分数下推导边界重置递归，证明其逐时速率达到独立分数的极小极大阶，频率间隙为O(1/n)。数值上以合成断裂与真实事件（电力市场改革、货币政策决策）对比五种自适应方法。

Result: 大合成断裂后第50次预测，重置规则的逐时间隙低于五种自适应方法（四者用作者代码），配对带全部低于零；电力改革后68个新分数上，对两种方法优于、与自适应共形推断等两种带含零、与一种持平；货币政策事件中34天内有10天逐点带高于全部五种方法；9个公告边界中仅1个超过其窗口最小可检测覆盖差。

Conclusion: 利用已知边界进行重置可在逐时共形可靠性与频率校准两方面取得更优且理论上紧致的表现；但真实边界效应往往太小、难以被窗口检测，实际可见改进主要集中在合成断裂与强制度冲击场景。

Abstract: An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

</details>


### [543] [Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23923)
*Geon Lee,Kyungho Kim,Dongwon Choi,Juyeon Kim,Shinhwan Kang,Kijung Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TABHGR+，利用LLM生成规则为表格行打弱标签并构建超图，通过超图标签传播精炼噪声标签，实现低成本、关系感知的零样本表格分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的零样本表格学习方法采用逐行提示（row-wise prompting），导致推理成本高，且难以利用行间依赖关系。

Method: 三步：1）基于列描述与任务描述，用LLM生成规则为所有行分配弱标签；2）根据LLM规则将语义相关的行分组构建超图，进行超图标签传播以精炼噪声弱标签；3）为超边分配标签自适应权重，改进可能次优的LLM生成超图。LLM调用次数为常数，与数据规模无关。

Result: 推理成本大幅降低，且分类准确率高于零样本基线和强少样本基线。

Conclusion: TABHGR+通过规则生成+超图传播的组合，在保持常数级LLM调用成本的同时提升零样本表格学习效果。

Abstract: Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.

</details>


### [544] [Improving Fake Profile Detection Through Multimodal Learning and Research-Guided Feature Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23926)
*Jean Claude Hirwa,Jamiu Dahunsi,Candide Giramata,Lowami Uwimana,Thierry Henry Ishimwe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在TwiBot-22子样本上比较文本+视觉+元数据多模态融合与强元数据基线、R-GCN图模型，发现元数据单独已高度可预测，多模态融合增益微弱且多不显著，图模型在子采样条件下表现更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假账号持续危害在线平台，但尚不清楚多模态学习相较强元数据基线或图方法是否带来实质提升。

Method: 在TwiBot-22的3万用户子样本上，构建结合XLM-RoBERTa文本嵌入、CLIP视觉嵌入与账号元数据（粉丝数、发帖频率、账号年龄等）的多模态框架，用CatBoost评估多种模态组合，并与关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）对比。

Result: 元数据单独即具高度预测力；多模态融合仅带来边际且基本统计不显著的增益；在子采样图条件下R-GCN劣于经典模型。

Conclusion: 在实际约束下，特征质量与元数据丰富度比融合复杂度更重要。

Abstract: Fake accounts continue to undermine online platforms, yet it remains unclear whether multimodal learning offers meaningful improvements over strong metadata baselines or graph-based approaches. In this work, we study bot detection by integrating textual, visual, and account metadata signals on the TwiBot-22 benchmark using a subsample of 30,000 users. We propose a multimodal framework combining pretrained textual (XLM-RoBERTa) and visual (CLIP) embeddings with structured account-level features such as follower counts, posting frequency, and account age, and evaluate multiple modality combinations using CatBoost alongside a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). Results show that metadata alone is highly predictive, while multimodal fusion yields only marginal and largely statistically insignificant gains. The graph-based model underperforms classical variants under the subsampled graph conditions of this study. Overall, our findings suggest that under practical constraints, feature quality and metadata richness matter more than fusion complexity.

</details>


### [545] [Sector-Ring Linear Reservoirs: Sector-Wise Decay-Timescale Allocation With State Reuse Across Candidate Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25806)
*Yudai Ebato,Sou Nobukawa,Yusuke Sakemi,Takashi Kanamaru,Nina Sviridova,Kazuyuki Aihara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Sector-Ring线性储备池(SRLR)，特征值角度均匀分布、按扇区赋予不同衰减时间尺度，并利用输入功率谱缩放权重、共享模态轨迹实现高效搜索，在8个混沌系统任务上均优于单时间尺度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 储备池性能依赖固定动态是否匹配任务，不同任务所需记忆长度与频率响应不同，通常需逐任务搜索设定；而逐个候选设定驱动储备池并采集状态是搜索的主要开销。

Method: 在线性递归储备池中，动态按特征值模态分解，特征值分布成为设计变量。SRLR将特征值角度固定为圆周上等距位置，把连续角度分成若干扇区，每个扇区从少量候选中分配一个衰减时间尺度；用训练输入的功率谱缩放输入权重，使各模态状态尺度在候选间保持一致；每个衰减时间尺度对应的模态状态只计算一次并跨候选复用。

Result: 在混沌系统构建的预测与重构基准上，8个案例中SRLR的平均测试误差均低于所有模态共享单一衰减时间尺度的参考模型，并与非线性ESN和泄漏积分ESN基线具竞争力；选出的衰减时间尺度分布随预测目标与预测时域变化；状态复用在搜索中使计算的模态轨迹数量相比逐候选重算减少99.8%。

Conclusion: 将特征值分布作为设计变量并采用扇区化时间尺度分配，可在保持性能的同时大幅降低储备池超参数搜索成本，且能自适应不同任务需求。

Abstract: In reservoir computing, performance depends on whether the fixed dynamics of the reservoir suit the task, and the appropriate memory length and frequency response differ across tasks. The reservoir settings are found by a search on each task, and driving the reservoir with the input and collecting its states for every candidate setting dominates the cost of the search. In a reservoir with a linear recurrence, the dynamics decompose into modes, one per eigenvalue, and the eigenvalue distribution becomes a design variable. We propose the Sector-Ring Linear Reservoir (SRLR), in which the eigenvalue angles are fixed at evenly spaced positions around a circle and one decay timescale, chosen from a few values, is assigned to each sector of consecutive angles. To keep the scale of each mode's state equal across candidates, the input weights are scaled using the power spectrum of the training input. To reduce the cost of the search, the states of the modes for each decay-timescale value are computed once and reused across candidates. On prediction and reconstruction benchmarks built from chaotic systems, the SRLR achieved, in all eight cases, a lower mean test error than a reference model in which all modes share one decay timescale, and was competitive with nonlinear echo state network and leaky-integrator echo state network baselines. The selected decay-timescale profiles changed with the prediction target and horizon. The state reuse reduced the number of computed mode trajectories in the search by 99.8% relative to per-candidate recomputation.

</details>


### [546] [miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23928)
*Zhen Li,Mingfa Feng,Yiming Zhang,Yang Yu,Changhai Zhou,Pengxiang Li,Dongkuan Wu,Congkai Xie,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: miniTE 框架通过执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐与原生 W4A4 GEMM，实现 LLM 强化学习的原生 NVFP4 稳定训练，在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上接近 BF16 精度，吞吐达 BF16 的 1.39 倍、TE NVFP4 的 1.47 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生 NVFP4 有望加速 LLM 强化学习，但在训练与采样引擎分离的架构下难以稳定学习；作者指出仅对齐模型权重和数值格式不足以保证一致的策略评估，跨引擎数值执行一致性才是关键。

Method: 提出 miniTE，一个轻量框架，融合执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐，以及高效的原生 W4A4（4 位权重与激活）GEMM 计算；在不修改 RL 目标的前提下提升数值执行一致性，并降低实现开销以发挥低比特计算优势。

Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的长程 RL 实验实现稳定训练，基准性能接近 BF16，评估质量优于朴素 Transformer Engine NVFP4；在单台 NVIDIA B300 GPU 节点上，优化后学习器吞吐达 33,540 tokens/s，完整学习器更新吞吐分别为 BF16 的 1.39 倍和 TE NVFP4 的 1.47 倍。

Conclusion: 跨引擎数值执行一致性是原生低比特 RL 稳定训练的关键；miniTE 在不改 RL 目标下兼顾稳定性与效率，并开源框架、内核、诊断工具与训练配置，降低原生低比特 RL 的使用门槛。

Abstract: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.

</details>


### [547] [Organizing LLM Inference for Aggregate Predictions from Behavioral Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23934)
*Varun Gupta,Vijay Kamble*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在电商转化率预测任务中，用LLM模拟用户群体行为时应如何组合个体行为历史。研究发现：产品单独评估时逐会话预测优于汇总；产品一起对比评估时汇总反而更好。比较式汇总在15个设置中12个取得最高Spearman相关，且推理成本远低于会话方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何将用户个体行为历史组合起来预测群体行为比例（如产品级转化率），并厘清两个设计选择各自的偏差-方差权衡：是先汇总会话再推理，还是逐会话预测再平均；是单独评估产品还是一次提示中对比评估。

Method: 在电商场景下，不进行任务特定训练，用LLM从浏览会话预测产品转化率。系统变化两个设计选择（会话汇总 vs. 逐会话预测；单独评估 vs. 联合对比评估），在5个LLM和2个数据集上评估，并用贝叶斯模型解释“比较”这一权衡，另考察4种比较上下文。

Result: 产品单独评估时逐会话预测优于汇总；产品联合评估时汇总领先。比较式汇总在15个设置中12个取得最高Spearman相关，无其他方法显著更优。比较对汇总的提升远大于对会话预测的提升。比较式汇总推理成本仅为会话方法的一小部分，且达到最佳监督基准（数千标注产品训练）相关性的66–89%。

Conclusion: 比较上下文能帮助汇总克服丢失行为细节的劣势，其作用可用贝叶斯模型解释：当提示输入更多揭示产品间差异时，比较收益更大。因此，在成本与准确性权衡下，比较式汇总是用LLM模拟用户群体的推荐设计。

Abstract: When using a large language model (LLM) to simulate a user population, how should we combine individual behavioral histories to predict the fraction of users who take a particular action? We study this question in e-commerce, predicting observed product-level conversion rates from browsing sessions without task-specific model training. We vary two design choices, each involving a bias-variance tradeoff. Summarizing a product's sessions before inference reduces cost but can discard predictive detail, adding bias, whereas predicting outcomes for individual sessions and averaging afterward preserves that detail but requires many calls to reduce variance. Evaluating products together in one prompt can help the model infer what is typical in the setting, reducing bias, but also makes each prediction depend on which other products appear alongside it, adding noise. We evaluate both choices across five LLMs and two datasets. Our main finding is that predictions from individual sessions outperform predictions from summaries when products are evaluated separately, but summaries lead when products are evaluated together. Comparative summaries achieve the highest Spearman correlation with observed rates in 12 of 15 settings, with no alternative significantly better. Comparison thus helps summaries far more than session predictions, overcoming the advantage of behavioral detail. We interpret this difference through a Bayesian model of the second tradeoff, which suggests that comparison helps more when the inputs in a prompt reveal more about differences across products, consistent with our results for four types of comparative context. Comparative summaries also incur a small fraction of the inference cost of the session methods. With the best model for each outcome, they attain 66-89% of the correlation of the best supervised benchmark trained on thousands of labeled products.

</details>


### [548] [Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23935)
*Jiakun Fan,Min Xiao,Qiang Wang,Neiwen Ling,Zhichao Liu,Zhihao Jia,Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos,Zijun Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DScout通过训练与推理两个视角的因子化设计提升扩散草稿器的投机解码吞吐，在Qwen3-4B/8B上分别实现3.84×/4.14×平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散草稿器能并行生成候选token，但更高提议容量或更高平均接受token数（MAT）并不必然带来更高吞吐：验证只接受连续前缀，早期拒绝会使后续正确预测失效；而每轮延迟上升时，高MAT也可能抵消收益。

Method: 训练端将逐位置损失因子化为包含损失、加权损失与预测损失，指导混合视界训练、块内解掩码、接受加权损失的组合设计以对齐前缀接受；推理端将吞吐因子化为MAT/每轮延迟之比，指导目标条件深度、草稿器深度与推理块大小选择，为每个工作负载寻找高吞吐配置。

Result: 在六个基准上，较自回归解码在Qwen3-4B/8B取得3.84×/4.14×平均加速，比SOTA基线分别提升9.1%/7.1%；配置策略在跨模型与并发设置下较固定配置额外获得最多9.75%平均加速。

Conclusion: 吞吐应由前缀接受与每轮延迟共同决定；以吞吐为导向联合优化草稿器训练与推理配置，可显著超越仅追求MAT的策略。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\times$ and $4.14\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.

</details>


### [549] [Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23936)
*Xufeng Liu,Fang Wan,Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出组件级概念恢复框架，将概念分解为构成组件并用受控结构干预评估；发现模型常在高预测准确率下仍难以整体恢复概念，联合指定互补组件能显著提升恢复但十分脆弱，且恢复与隐式预测的联合监督可改善恢复而不损预测并跨组成形式迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL评估多在整体概念层面衡量恢复，无法识别哪些组件被恢复，也难以区分模型能力局限与示例本身的歧义，因此需要更细粒度的诊断视角。

Method: 提出组件级概念恢复框架，把概念分解为定义性组件，在可识别示例条件下通过受控的结构干预，评估组件级和整体概念恢复；在4个指令微调LLM和3种组成形式上实验。

Result: 模型常预测准确率高但整体概念恢复差，并系统性过度指定相关属性与层级约束；单个组件不足以恢复整体概念，联合指定互补组件（尤其相关属性及其层级约束）能大幅提升恢复，但一个看似合理却多余的层级约束就会破坏恢复；恢复与隐式预测联合监督显著提升恢复且保持预测性能，并可跨组成形式迁移。

Conclusion: 组件级分析比整体视角更能诊断模型从示例中真正学到了什么，揭示了预测成功与概念恢复之间的差距及恢复的脆弱性。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to make accurate predictions from demonstrations, but prediction success alone does not reveal the extent to which the underlying concept has been recovered. Existing evaluations typically assess recovery at the level of the whole concept, making it difficult to identify which components are recovered and to separate model limitations from ambiguity in the demonstrations. We introduce a component-level framework for concept recovery that decomposes concepts into their defining components and uses controlled structural interventions to evaluate both component-level and whole-concept recovery under identifiable demonstrations. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and three composition forms, we find that models often achieve high prediction accuracy despite poor whole-concept recovery, with systematic over-specification of relevant attributes and level constraints. Individual structural components are generally insufficient for whole-concept recovery, whereas jointly specifying complementary components, particularly relevant attributes and their level constraints, substantially improves recovery. However, this improvement is fragile: a single plausible but unnecessary level constraint can substantially disrupt recovery. Finally, joint supervision of recovery and implicit prediction substantially improves recovery while preserving prediction performance, with the learned capability transferring across composition forms. Overall, our component-level analysis provides a more diagnostic view of what models recover from demonstrations than the existing holistic view.

</details>


### [550] [SECURE-AI: Multi-Signal Uncertainty Quantification for Trustworthy Acoustic Cough Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23937)
*Sejal Solkhan,Feiya Xiang,Mayur Sanap,Geet Khatri,Edgar Lobaton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SECURE-AI多信号不确定性量化框架，包裹冻结的MobileNetV3咳嗽分类器，用MC Dropout、温度缩放和马氏距离估计何时不该信任预测；实验表明嵌入空间马氏距离最有效，可同时识别误报和漏检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 咳嗽声学模型在精选基准上精度高，但部署时遇语音、环境噪声和分布外音频会产生"自信的误分类"；健康监测中自信错误比无答案更糟，需要能判断预测何时不可信的机制。

Method: 在冻结的MobileNetV3咳嗽分类器上构建多信号不确定性量化框架，融合Monte Carlo Dropout、温度缩放与嵌入空间马氏距离；在Coswara数据集12,161条录音的留出集上评估，并做误差分类学分析与Raspberry Pi部署验证。

Result: 概率空间方法单独不足：MC Dropout对错误预测给出更低不确定性，温度缩放仅改善校准不改善判别。马氏距离最强：区分真阳性与假阳性（均值44.7 vs 63.4，Cohen's d=0.94，AUROC 0.86），区分假阴性与真阴性（AUROC 0.82）。保留90%真阳时去除约2/3假阳，精度由59.9%升至约80%。阈值不可跨划分迁移（验证F1 82%→测试34%），故以阈值无关AUROC为主要指标；多数假阳与语音相关；流水线在30–90美元树莓派上运行。

Conclusion: 仅靠概率校准不足以实现可靠咳嗽检测；嵌入空间距离是更有效的不确定性信号，能同时标记误报与漏检；阈值迁移性差，应采用阈值无关的AUROC评估，并建议结合误差分类学改进。

Abstract: Acoustic models for cough detection achieve high accuracy on curated benchmarks but fail silently in deployment, where speech, environmental noise, and audio unlike the training data induce confident misclassifications. In health monitoring, a confidently wrong prediction is worse than no answer at all. We present SECURE-AI (Self-aware Estimation of Cough Uncertainty for Reliable Evaluation of AI), a multi-signal uncertainty quantification framework that wraps a frozen MobileNetV3 cough classifier and estimates when its predictions should not be trusted, combining Monte Carlo Dropout, Temperature Scaling, and Mahalanobis distance in the embedding space. On a held-out split of 12,161 Coswara recordings, the probability-space methods are individually insufficient: Monte Carlo Dropout assigns lower uncertainty to incorrect than to correct predictions, and temperature scaling improves calibration but not discrimination. The strongest signal is embedding-space distance: Mahalanobis distance separates true positives from false positives (means 44.7 versus 63.4; Cohen's $d = 0.94$; AUROC 0.86) and, among predicted non-coughs, false negatives from true negatives (AUROC 0.82), so the same signal can flag both false alarms and missed coughs. At a descriptive operating point selected from labeled test data, retaining 90 percent of true-positive detections removes about two-thirds of false positives and raises precision from 59.9 to roughly 80 percent. A rejection threshold tuned on one split does not transfer to another (validation F1 of 82 percent falls to 34 percent on test), so we report threshold-independent AUROC as the main measure. An error taxonomy shows that failures are systematic, with most false positives related to speech. The pipeline runs on Raspberry Pi hardware costing 30 to 90 US dollars. Probabilistic calibration alone is thus inadequate for reliable cough detection.

</details>


### [551] [Pack and Extract: An Effective Graph-Based Approach for Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23938)
*Faisal N. Abu-Khzam,Joseph R. Barr,Cynthia Chaaya,Nadim Obeid,Peter Shaw*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对基于独立支配集(IDS)的特征选择方法的改进，通过偏好多样性特征并将IDS推广为节点填充模型，在五个遗传数据集上提升了预测精度和特征集稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子生物学数据常含成千上万特征（如单细胞基因、其他组学数据），标准预测模型倾向保留大量特征且无法很好处理特征间相关性，表现不佳。基于IDS的组合式特征选择虽有前景，但计算复杂度过高而常被忽视。

Method: 对IDS特征选择进行两点改进：(i)偏好具有更高多样性的特征；(ii)将独立支配集概念推广为节点填充(node packing)模型。所得公式作为特征选择过程的中间步骤。

Result: 在五个遗传数据集上与现有方法对比，相比传统模型在预测精度上有明显提升，且所选特征集的稳定性也有所提高。

Conclusion: 改进的IDS/节点填充方法能有效应对高维相关特征问题，显著提升预测精度和特征选择稳定性，是一个有前景的组合式特征选择方案。

Abstract: Many molecular biology data sets contain thousands of features, such as genes in single-cell experiments or other omics data. Standard predictive models often perform poorly in such settings, as they tend to retain a large number of features and fail to adequately handle correlations among them. Combinatorial approaches, such as feature selection based on the Independent Dominating Set (IDS) model, have shown promising results, but appear to have been largely overlooked, possibly due to their high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose an improvement to IDS-based feature selection that (i) favors features exhibiting greater diversity and (ii) generalizes the notion of independent dominating set to a node packing model. The resulting formulation is used as an intermediate step within the feature selection process. We evaluate our approach on five genetic data sets and compare the results with those obtained using existing methods. Our experimental results demonstrate notable improvements in predictive accuracy over traditional models, as well as increased stability of the selected feature sets.

</details>


### [552] [PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23939)
*Minyoung Go,Yongjun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PeekKV：通过prefill后单token窥探获得head组和token重要性分数，自适应分配KV cache预算，无需离线profiling或训练，在多个基准上保持接近全缓存的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV cache随上下文长度线性增长，是LLM服务的主要内存瓶颈。现有按head非均匀压缩方法要么离线固定重要head，要么用prefill阶段注意力信号选head，导致不同工作负载下精度波动大。作者发现原因是活跃head在prefill与decode阶段之间发生迁移。

Method: 观察发现：decode路径中过滤掉format token后，活跃head组成在内容token间保持稳定。基于此，PeekKV在prefill后立即观察一个内容token（one-token peek），同时得到head组分数和token重要性分数；按组分数比例给各head组分配KV预算，并在每组预算内仅保留最高分token。

Result: 在四个公开基准上，PeekKV在超过一半的按模型比较中取得最高精度，在RULER和LongBench上最接近全缓存精度。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，RULER 16K上下文、10%内存预算保留95.7%精度；LongBench 1.5%预算保留95.9%。

Conclusion: PeekKV无需离线profiling或训练，可直接应用于未见工作负载和新模型，通过一次窥探实现稳定自适应的head级KV cache压缩。

Abstract: The size of the KV cache grows linearly with context length, making it a major memory bottleneck in LLM serving. Motivated by recent progress in identifying the functional roles of attention heads, a growing body of work compresses the KV cache non-uniformly across heads. Existing methods either fix the important heads via offline profiling or select them using attention signals from the prefill stage. In both cases, however, accuracy fluctuates substantially across workloads. While investigating the cause of this instability, we find that the active heads shift between the prefill and decode stages even within a single input. Along the decode path, by contrast, the activehead composition remains stable across content tokens once format tokens are filtered out. Based on this observation, we propose PeekKV. PeekKV observes a single content token immediately after prefill - a one-token peek - to jointly obtain head-group scores and token-importance scores. Guided by these scores, PeekKV allocates KV cache budgets to head groups in proportion to their group scores and retains only the top-scoring tokens within each budget. PeekKV requires no offline profiling or training and thus applies directly to unseen workloads and new models. Across four public benchmarks, PeekKV achieves the highest accuracy in more than half of the per-model comparisons against state-of-the-art methods, and stays closest to the full-cache accuracy on RULER and LongBench. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, PeekKV retains 95.7% of the full-cache accuracy at a 10% memory budget on RULER with 16K contexts and 95.9% at a 1.5% budget on LongBench.

</details>


### [553] [Fast Construction of Inner Sphere Trees Using Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23940)
*Jianneng Huang,Wenjia Rao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ML-IST：将内球树（IST）的叶球生成重构为单次集合预测问题，用网络从多通道体素预测内接球，配合可微覆盖反馈与几何投影保证有效性，加速叶球构建并集成到Jolt/Bullet引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂非凸物体的碰撞检测是物理仿真、VR和机器人的瓶颈。IST能高效回答邻近与穿透查询，但其贪婪叶球构建是串行的且计算昂贵，限制了大规模预处理与运行时使用。

Method: ML-IST将叶球生成视为单次集合预测：网络从多通道体素几何预测固定数量的内接球候选；可微覆盖反馈修正粗预测并在更细尺度填补残余空隙；轻量几何投影强制有效性。

Result: 单GPU实现相比单核CPU构建，平均叶球生成时间在目标球数64–512下加速2.0–2.6倍；复杂模型上呈多尺度球分布，贴合主体体积与细长特征。集成到Jolt Physics与Bullet，在alpha-puzzle基准达55.89 FPS，为传统IST、GImpact、凸分解中最优。

Conclusion: 学习式叶球生成为快速运行时构建精细碰撞表示提供了可行组件。

Abstract: Collision detection for complex non-convex objects is a bottleneck in physics simulation, virtual reality, and robotics. Inner sphere trees (ISTs) answer proximity and penetration queries efficiently, but their greedy leaf-sphere construction is sequential and computationally expensive, which limits both large-scale preprocessing and runtime use. In this work, we present ML-IST, a machine-learning-based method that reformulates leaf-sphere generation as a single-shot set-prediction problem: a network predicts a fixed set of inscribed sphere candidates from multichannel voxel geometry, differentiable coverage feedback corrects the coarse prediction and fills residual gaps at finer scales, and a lightweight geometric projection enforces validity. Averaged over the test set, a single-GPU implementation of ML-IST reduces mean leaf-generation time by a factor of $2.0$--$2.6$ over single-core CPU construction across target capacities of 64--512 spheres, and qualitative results on complex models show multiscale sphere distributions that follow principal volumes and slender features. We further integrate ML-IST into the Jolt Physics and Bullet engines; in an alpha-puzzle benchmark it reaches 55.89~FPS, the highest among the compared representations (conventional IST, GImpact, and convex decomposition). These results support learned leaf generation as a practical component for fast, runtime construction of detailed collision representations.

</details>


### [554] [A Group-Aware Comparative Study of Classical Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23941)
*Wahyu Pebrianto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对经典机器学习与深度学习在传感器人体活动识别(HAR)任务上进行受控对比，发现深度学习并不总优于经典方法，且评估协议（分组划分）显著影响报告性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HAR中报告的性能受传感器模态、数据集特性和数据划分策略强烈影响，现有评估缺乏统一受控的对比，容易高估模型能力。

Method: 在UCI-HAR与KU-HAR两个公开数据集上对比4种经典机器学习与4种深度学习模型；考虑ACC、GYRO及ACC+GYRO三种模态；经典方法用统计特征，深度方法用原始序列；主评估采用五折StratifiedGroupKFold按受试者分组，以Macro-F1为主指标，并与随机划分对比。

Result: UCI-HAR上深度学习Macro-F1略高；KU-HAR上LightGBM达0.857，优于最佳深度模型的0.828。ACC+GYRO组合通常优于单一模态。随机划分相比分组评估使CNNBiLSTMAttn(ACC+GYRO)的Macro-F1分别虚高0.033(UCI-HAR)和0.093(KU-HAR)。

Conclusion: 模型家族、传感器模态、数据集特性与分组感知评估对HAR系统评价均至关重要；应采用受试者分组评估以避免性能高估。

Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using wearable or smartphone inertial sensors is commonly evaluated with both classical machine learning and deep learning methods. However, reported performance can be strongly affected by sensor modality, dataset characteristics, and data-splitting strategy. This study presents a controlled comparative evaluation of four classical machine learning models and four deep learning models on two public HAR datasets, UCI-HAR and KU-HAR. Three sensor modalities were considered: accelerometer (ACC), gyroscope (GYRO), and their combination (ACC+GYRO). Classical machine learning models used handcrafted statistical features, while deep learning models operated directly on raw sensor sequences. The primary evaluation employed five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold cross-validation, with subject- or participant-level grouping to prevent group overlap between training and test folds. Macro-F1 was used as the primary performance metric. The results show that deep learning did not consistently outperform classical machine learning. On UCI-HAR, the evaluated deep learning models achieved slightly higher macro-F1 values, whereas on KU-HAR, LightGBM achieved 0.857 compared with 0.828 for the highest-performing evaluated deep learning model. Regarding sensor modality, the combined ACC+GYRO configuration generally outperformed ACC or GYRO alone on both datasets. The evaluation protocol also had a substantial effect: for CNNBiLSTMAttn with ACC+GYRO, random splitting increased macro-F1 by 0.033 on UCI-HAR and 0.093 on KU-HAR compared with grouped evaluation. These findings highlight the importance of model family, sensor modality, dataset characteristics, and group-aware evaluation when assessing sensor-based HAR systems.

</details>


### [555] [ReTTT: Reflection-Driven Test-Time Training via Experience-Based Parametric Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23942)
*Kangcong Li,Hangfan Zhang,Shuyue Hu,Shengji Tang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReTTT 通过在单条 episode 内构建并持续修订"经验教训"，对 episode-local LoRA 适配器进行测试时训练，让智能体的行动策略与反思策略联合自适应，在多个长程任务基准上优于基于轨迹的测试时训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在多轮任务执行中会积累大量任务相关信息，但这些信息的"学习价值"依赖上下文与后续反馈，难以提取可靠可用的经验，也难以随任务推进而修订。

Method: 智能体对交互反馈进行反思，将得到的教训存入显式记忆，并据此在冻结主干的前提下更新一个 episode 内的 LoRA 适配器；适配后的模型同时负责后续动作与反思，从而把策略自适应与未来学习经验的构建耦合起来（test-time training on lessons）。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SWE-bench Lite 上，用两个模型家族测试，六个模型–基准组合全部优于基于轨迹的测试时训练，任务成功率最高提升 12.14 个百分点；冻结反思的对照实验显示适配反思策略带来 7.14 个百分点的增益；轨迹分析表明适配后的反思能从失败尝试中获得更具任务针对性的指导。

Conclusion: 让智能体学会反思自身行为可提升其在长程任务上的表现，经验驱动的在线自适应性优于单纯的轨迹级测试时训练。

Abstract: LLM agents accumulate valuable task-specific information through their actions, observations, and environmental feedback during multi-turn task execution. When effectively used, this information can help agents refine subsequent decisions and improve task performance. However, the learning value of an interaction depends on its context and subsequent feedback, making it challenging to extract reliable, actionable lessons and revise them as the task unfolds. In this paper, we introduce ReTTT, which enables experience-driven self-adaptation through test-time training on lessons constructed and continually revised within an episode. ReTTT lets the agent reflect on interaction feedback, maintain the resulting lessons in an explicit memory, and learn from them by updating an episode-local LoRA adapter while keeping the backbone frozen. The adapted model then performs both subsequent actions and reflection, coupling policy adaptation with the construction of future learning experience. We evaluate ReTTT on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SWE-bench Lite using two model families. ReTTT outperforms trajectory-based test-time training across all six model--benchmark settings, improving task success by up to 12.14 percentage points. A frozen-reflection comparison further shows a 7.14-point benefit from adapting the reflection policy, while trajectory analysis illustrates how adapted reflection derives more task-specific guidance from failed attempts. These findings suggest that learning to reflect on its own behavior can boost agents' performance on long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [556] [How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23946)
*Bowei He,Yankai Chen,Xiaokun Zhang,Changjiang Han,Ye Yuan,Chong Li,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将Agentic RL的数据从"单一token数"扩展为任务/环境/轨迹三维结构空间，发现缩放指数为环境>任务>轨迹，并据此给出Chinchilla式算力最优数据合成预算分配配方，可带来最多1.7倍算力效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练缩放定律把数据视为一维token数，而Agentic RL的数据合成流水线独立且代价不同地生成任务、环境、轨迹，使数据成为结构化设计空间。核心问题：给定合成预算，应优先扩展哪个轴？此前无人回答。

Method: 1) 将agentic数据分解为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴，外加奖励密度控制变量，在多个LLM（数学+代码、SWE、Web、UI/工具应用域）上拟合各轴缩放关系；2) 用拟合定律作为统一"标尺"为合成方法定价，以每轴折扣因子刻画效率，并找出合成/真实比例临界点；3) 将预算分配建模为约束优化，推导Chinchilla式算力最优配方并在留出规模验证。

Result: 在所有模型规模、模型族、领域及RL算法（PPO与GRPO）中，缩放指数均满足环境>任务>轨迹；环境多样性优势主要来自world diversity，environment-structure diversity仅与任务多样性相当；各轴合成/真实临界比例相差一个数量级；按配方分配预算相对主流的"扩展轨迹"做法最高提升1.7倍算力效率。

Conclusion: Agentic RL的数据缩放不应沿用一维token思维，而应按环境优先的结构化轴分配合成预算；论文提供的缩放定律、方法定价与算力最优配方构成端到端指导框架，并具备跨模型与算法的稳健性。

Abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

</details>


### [557] [Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23948)
*David McShannon,Nicholas Dietrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究能否仅从已训练好的PINN网络本身推断其方程中被编码的参数是否被错误指定，提出用一次冻结网络评估得到的最小二乘估计ν̂，并表明其误差与归一化残差ρ相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN通过最小化给定方程的残差来训练，因此训练损失低并不能说明方程中的系数被正确指定；作者希望回答"仅凭训练后的网络能推断出关于所编码参数的什么信息"这一问题。

Method: 当残差对参数线性（可写为A−νB）时，用冻结网络的单次评估计算最小二乘估计ν̂=AᵀB/BᵀB，无需重训练或参考数据；以归一化残差ρ衡量网络对自身方程的满足程度，并在对流扩散、Burgers、Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos等方程上做实证分析，包括块自助法标准误的单模型检验。

Result: 36个对流扩散网络上ln误差与lnρ的log-log相关系数为0.72，三个方程的实证指数在0.63–1.20之间并可分解为1/2加一个可测的角度项；Burgers方程中单模型检验在300个正确指定的网络上误报3个（误报率1%），在实用预算下检出全部2%的错误指定，收敛后能检出2/3的1%错误指定；CCF方程中速率同时进入架构时仅恢复约一半的错误指定，但ρ近似二次增长并能区分0.2%的误差；当错误速率同时进入方程与架构时，高达2%的误差在已达精度下无法检出；实用预算下错误指定模型的原始损失可能更低，而ρ不具备这种尺度效应。

Conclusion: 仅凭训练后的PINN即可对编码参数做出可诊断的推断：ν̂配合ρ能作为参数是否被错误指定的检验统计量，但在参数同时进入架构的情况下灵敏度显著下降；ρ比原始训练损失更适合作为诊断量。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to minimize the residual of a prescribed equation, so a low training loss does not indicate whether a coefficient in that equation was specified incorrectly. This study evaluates what can be inferred about the encoded parameter from the trained network alone. When the residual is linear in the parameter, written as $A - νB$, the least-squares estimate $\hatν = A^{\top}B/B^{\top}B$ is obtained from a single evaluation of the frozen network, without retraining or reference data. Its accuracy depends on how closely the network satisfies its own equation, quantified by a normalized residual $ρ$. Recovery error is associated with $ρ$ (log-log correlation 0.72 across 36 convection-diffusion networks), and empirical exponents of 0.63 to 1.20 across three equations decompose into one half plus a measurable angular term. For Burgers' equation, a single-model test based on a block-bootstrap standard error flagged 3 of 300 correctly specified networks (observed false-alarm rate 1%), all 2% misspecifications at a practical budget, and two thirds of 1% misspecifications after convergence. For the self-similar blowup rate of the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation, where the rate also enters the architecture, the estimator recovers about half of the misspecification, whereas $ρ$ increases approximately quadratically and distinguishes a 0.2% error. When the incorrect rate enters both the equation and the architecture, errors of up to 2% were not detected at the precision reached. At practical budgets, the raw loss can be lower for the misspecified model, a scaling effect that $ρ$ does not share.

</details>


### [558] [DS-Net: A Dynamic Split Network for Edge-Cloud Collaborative Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23949)
*Xinyun Zhang,Li Wang,Lei Jin,Lianming Xu,Zhu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DS-Net 提出单模型多切分点动态切换的协同推理框架，并用分层补偿机制缓解动态切分与高压缩带来的特征偏移和信息损失，显著降低存储与切换开销并提升速度与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边云协同推理需为每个切分点分别加载不同模型，通信或设备变化时切换时间长、边缘端存储开销大。

Method: 设计动态切换框架，在单一模型内支持多切分点灵活选择；提出分层补偿机制：局部对齐校准各切分点解码特征分布，任务相关的全局补偿恢复全局任务信息；并结合样本复杂度与运行时资源条件，将样本自适应的全局补偿选择纳入切分点选择。

Result: 内存开销降低 74.6%，切换时延达毫秒级；Nano 平台 10 Mbps 带宽下，COCO 上精度比 SOTA 高 1.2%，时延降低 42.5%，吞吐提升 1.8 倍。

Conclusion: DS-Net 以单模型多切分点与分层补偿实现了低开销、快切换、高精度高吞吐的协同推理，验证了动态切分方案的实用有效性。

Abstract: Collaborative inference serves as a critical methodology in edge intelligence. Existing collaborative inference methods operate by splitting the deep neural network (DNN) model between edge devices and cloud servers. However, these methods need to load different models for multiple split points when the communication or device changes, thus resulting in long switching times and substantial storage overhead on the edge side. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Split Network (DS-Net), which not only enables efficient split point switching but also enhances the collaborative speed and accuracy across various scenarios. Specifically, we design a dynamic switching framework that enables flexible selection among multiple split points within a single model, thereby reducing storage, memory, and switching overhead. To mitigate the feature distribution shifts and task-relevant information loss caused by dynamic splitting and high-ratio compression, we further propose a hierarchical compensation mechanism. Local alignment calibrates the decoded feature distribution at each split point, while task-specific global compensation restores task-relevant information at the global level. In addition, we incorporate sample-adaptive global compensation selection into split-point selection based on sample complexity and runtime resource conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that DS-Net reduces memory overhead by 74.6% and achieves millisecond-level switching latency. Moreover, under a 10 Mbps bandwidth constraint on the Nano platform, DS-Net outperforms state-of-the-art collaborative methods by achieving 1.2% higher accuracy on the COCO dataset, reducing latency by 42.5%, and improving throughput by a factor of 1.8$\times$.

</details>


### [559] [Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23950)
*Chuansai Zhou,Yanlin Liu,Bingning Huang,Shidi Xi,Chao Huang,Boxing Chen,Mingming Zhu,Guanghuan Fang,Ben Feng,Zongzuo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATRL：面向长程Kernel生成的后训练方法，将GRPO改造为感知上下文压缩的分段级目标，并配合轻量Agent框架与昇腾知识库，在昇腾硬件上同时提升正确率与加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用LLM Agent自动生成高性能Kernel可提升开发效率，但存在两问题：一是多轮交互带来上下文持续累积、超出有效窗口；二是GRPO依赖终局结果评估，长程任务奖励稀疏，难以做步骤级信用分配。此外基座模型缺乏特定平台（昇腾）知识。

Method: 提出ATRL（Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning）后训练方法：把GRPO精炼为感知上下文压缩（compaction-aware）的分段级（segment-level）目标；设计轻量Agent harness，提供级联的编译、正确性、性能profiling反馈；并在Agentic RL训练与评估中注入昇腾专用知识库。

Result: 在昇腾硬件上运行NPUKernelBench与KernelBench，ATRL在正确性与加速比上均稳定优于包括GRPO在内的所有基线。

Conclusion: 分段级奖励与上下文压缩策略能有效缓解长程Kernel生成的稀疏奖励与上下文溢出问题，结合平台知识库与多级执行反馈，可在国产昇腾平台上实现更优的Kernel自动生成效果。

Abstract: Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM-based agents promises substantial gains in development efficiency, but two obstacles remain. First, while increasing multi-turn interaction with execution environments is crucial for refining generation quality, continuous context accumulation rapidly exceeds the model's effective context window. Second, training long-horizon tasks via GRPO inherently incurs sparse rewards due to its reliance on terminal outcome evaluation, severely hindering step-level credit assignment; To address these obstacles, we propose ATRL (Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning), a post-training method that refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective for long-horizon kernel generation. We also design a lightweight agent harness providing cascaded compilation, correctness, and profiling feedback, alongside an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during agentic RL training and evaluation to compensate for the base model's missing platform expertise. Evaluations on NPUKernelBench and KernelBench, both executed on Ascend hardware, show that ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.

</details>


### [560] [LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23951)
*Shaorong Zhang,Shiyuan Li,Longxuan Yu,Greg Ver Steeg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LatLM 将"逐行并行语言模型的提交时序"变为解码时可自适应的策略：在二维格上每轮对可提交的前沿 token 打分，自信者立即提交、未就绪者延后以获得更长上下文，从而在保持并行加速的同时避免过早提交导致的级联错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐行并行语言模型（如 LCLM）虽能显著加速，但在所有行上强制固定的提交时间表。文本内部的依赖关系强弱不一，固定时间表无法扣住"前置条件尚未算出"的行，造成过早提交与级联推理错误。

Method: 提出 Lattice Language Model：文本置于二维格，每轮对符合条件的 frontier token 打分；策略对高置信候选立即提交，对未就绪者延迟提交以获取更长上下文。一次前向通过 2D 因果掩码监督整条采样轨迹，并用仅追加缓存保留精确状态。模型规模 482M。

Result: (1) 顺序解码时，在留出文本上与数据/容量匹配的自回归模型持平；自适应并行解码器在独立行任务上以 25–41% 的解码轮数达到接近自回归的准确率。(2) 当跨行依赖使 LCLM 固定时序失败时，延迟提交显著提升准确率并保留可行处的并行性；混合依赖链上 LatLM 达 96.5% 准确率，对比 LCLM 的 78.5%，且解码轮数不到自回归基线的一半。

Conclusion: 把提交时序从固定先验改为解码时自适应的决策，是兼顾并行加速与推理正确性的有效途径；LatLM 在无损质量的前提下实现了高并行效率与更强的依赖鲁棒性。

Abstract: Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

</details>


### [561] [DISCERN: Identifiable Disease Evidence for Generalizable Medical Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23952)
*Xiaoguang Zhu,Pengyi Jiang,Juncen Guo,Jingyi Wu,Lianlong Sun,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出DISCERN方法，通过潜在结构因果模型识别并消除临床多模态模型中跨队列共享的"入组捷径"（enrollment shortcut），在保留疾病状态证据的同时实现可识别的参考后验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床多模态模型会学到跨模态共享的入组捷径，导致在新队列上失效。现有方法难以在无疾病标签、且无法恢复完整因果模型的情况下分离出真正的疾病证据。

Method: 构建潜在结构因果模型：疾病状态与背景因素通过共享机制生成生理数据，队列在选择与测量方式上存在差异。固定采集条件，在高斯坐标下通过跨队列状态对齐和自然参数变化识别最小选择统计量；对其条件化以去除入组依赖证据，得到指定偏移族内可识别的参考后验。DISCERN由信息格编码器、潜在状态模型和结果头联合训练。

Result: 在已知潜在坐标的反向合成入组实验中，条件化将状态AUROC从0.043提升到0.883、从0.265提升到0.825，随机条件化无此效果；eICU与MIMIC-IV跨库死亡率实验中AUROC分别较匹配的经验风险最小化提升0.036和0.035。

Conclusion: 条件化最小选择统计量可有效去除入组依赖证据并保持可识别性；状态依赖交互携带单模态后验不可见的证据，支持联合、信息保留的表示；学习坐标诊断可区分状态信息保留与估计器所需坐标的识别。

Abstract: Clinical multimodal models can learn enrollment shortcuts shared across modalities and fail on new cohorts. We model these data through a latent structural causal model: disease state and background factors generate physiology through shared mechanisms, while cohorts differ in selection and measurement. Holding acquisition fixed, we identify conditional disease evidence without observing disease-state labels or recovering the full causal model. In common Gaussian coordinates, cross-cohort state alignment and natural-parameter changes identify a minimal selection statistic; conditioning on it removes enrollment-dependent evidence and yields an identifiable reference posterior within the specified shift family. State-dependent interactions can carry evidence invisible to individual-modality posteriors, motivating joint, information-preserving representations. DISCERN combines an information-lattice encoder, a latent-state model, and an outcome head through joint training. Under reversed synthetic enrollment on known latent coordinates, conditioning raises state AUROC from 0.043 to 0.883 and from 0.265 to 0.825, while random conditioning does not. Exploratory cross-database mortality experiments between eICU and MIMIC-IV improve AUROC over matched empirical risk minimization by 0.036 and 0.035. Learned-coordinate diagnostics distinguish preservation of state information from identification of the coordinates required by the estimator.

</details>


### [562] [Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23955)
*Charalampos Davalas,Georgios Levantinos,Anastasios Dimitriou,Nikolaos Papanikolaou,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos,Dimitrios Michail*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的多域自监督预训练框架，结合物理感知的Voigt峰重建与去噪目标，从多类拉曼光谱数据学习可迁移表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拉曼光谱产生大量无标注数据，传统监督学习难以利用；需从异构生物、化学、法医、材料数据中学习可迁移表征。

Method: 多域MAE自监督预训练；掩码强度重建 + 稀疏Voigt轮廓解码器（可微峰中心、宽度、幅度建模峰结构）+ 去噪目标；在线性探测、注意力探测、端到端微调、从头训练四种设定下评估物质分类、成分识别、浓度估计与光谱去噪。

Result: 自监督预训练对标注数据有限的困难任务收益最大；注意力探测比线性探测能挖掘更多有用信息，说明线性评估可能低估表征质量；预训练收益随编码器容量增大而更明显。

Conclusion: 物理感知、多域自监督预训练可提升拉曼光谱任务的标签效率、鲁棒性与跨任务迁移性。

Abstract: Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

</details>


### [563] [UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23960)
*Chengying Tu,Hengyu Zhao,Shuaikang Xue,Zhongming Qu,Jihao Zhou,Xinle Lin,Junshao Guo,Zixuan Fu,Qiang Ma,Jie Zhou,Chaojun Xiao,Hongfei Yan,Yudong Wang,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 UltraData-Code 四层数据状态体系（L0 仓库归档、L1 标准化代码、L2 算法筛选、L3 任务化合成），在 1B 模型 10B token 持续预训练下，L2 相比 L1 在 EvalPlus/MultiPL-E 上 pass@1 分别提升 7.80pp/5.13pp，用 L3 替换一半 L2 token 再提升 8.42pp/8.07pp。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量公开代码日益稀缺，仅靠扩大语料规模难以持续提升代码生成能力，需要转向分层的数据管理，以小数据池配合更有针对性的处理来适配不同训练目标。

Method: 将代码数据组织为四种相连数据状态：L0 保留仓库数据与来源以便复处理；L1 做可扩展的过滤、规范化与近去重，用于广泛预训练；L2 用语言自适应相关性信号与质量约束筛出高质量算法相关文件（约 400B token，11 种语言），用于定向持续预训练；L3 将选定实现改写为结构化编程练习（约 150B token，同 11 种语言），用于任务化中期训练或 SFT。并以 1B 模型、10B/100B token 预算做受控实验。

Result: L2 相对 L1 在 EvalPlus 上 pass@1 提升 7.80pp、MultiPL-E 上 5.13pp；以 L3 替换一半 L2 token 后，两基准再分别提升 8.42pp 与 8.07pp；训练预算扩至 100B token 时两项增益进一步扩大。数据集与分类器已开源。

Conclusion: 分层、面向目标的数据状态管理比单纯扩大语料更有效，算法筛选与任务化合成都带来显著且可扩展的代码生成收益，且各层数据可保留以供复用。

Abstract: Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.

</details>


### [564] [SPADE-KD: Peer-to-Peer Collaborative Learning under Heterogeneous Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24013)
*Harikrishna Kuttivelil,Katia Obraczka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPADE-KD 是一个完全去中心化的模型蒸馏框架，通过自适应蒸馏与效用驱动的同伴选择，在模型架构和数据分布均异构的点对点环境中实现个性化协同学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点对点协同学习可避免中心聚合器的单点故障与瓶颈，但现有方法存在局限：参数平均要求同构模型架构；知识蒸馏方案依赖共享公共数据或中心控制；且普遍假设为所有客户端联合训练单一全局最优解，忽视数据分布差异导致的全局最优≠本地最优。因此需要同时应对架构异构与数据异构、并追求个性化性能的协同学习方案。

Method: 提出 SPADE-KD，包含两个机制：(1) 自适应蒸馏——根据传入模型相对本地模型在本地数据上的任务损失优势，调节每次模型迁移的强度，对表现更好的模型更激进地蒸馏；(2) 效用驱动的同伴选择——利用自适应蒸馏得到的损失信息计算效用，对潜在伙伴排序，聚焦能可测量提升本地模型的交换，抑制低效用传输。

Result: 在联邦分类任务上，SPADE-KD 稳定优于朴素去中心化蒸馏，具有更低损失和更快收敛，且各组件协同使用时效果优于单独使用。

Conclusion: SPADE-KD 表明，在架构与数据双异构场景下，以个性化目标为导向的去中心化蒸馏可行且有效，自适应蒸馏与效用驱动选择相互增强。

Abstract: Peer-to-peer collaborative learning is an emerging distributed deep learning paradigm that eliminates the need for a central aggregator and disseminator, avoiding the single-point-of-failure and bottleneck issues they can bring. Many such approaches use parameter averaging, requiring clients to have homogeneous model architectures, whereas others use knowledge distillation as an alternative while leaning on shared public data or centralized control infrastructure. Many of these approaches also make a one-size-fits-all assumption, i.e., jointly training a single, globally optimal solution for all clients, when in reality, clients' underlying data distributions might differ such that a globally optimal solution may not be locally optimal for all clients. To enable collaborative learning in environments with both model architecture and data distribution heterogeneity, we present SPADE-KD -- a fully decentralized model distillation framework that optimizes collaboration towards personalized rather than global performance. SPADE-KD leverages two mechanisms -- adaptive distillation and utility-driven peer selection. Adaptive distillation modulates the strength of each incoming model transfer by the performance advantage of the incoming model compared to the native model measured by their task losses, such that a client will distill more aggressively from incoming models that outperform it on its own local data. Utility-driven peer selection uses the loss-informed utility derived from adaptive distillation to rank prospective partners, focusing on exchanges that measurably improve the local model while suppressing low-utility transfers. Using federated classification tasks, we demonstrate that SPADE-KD consistent outperforms naive decentralized distillation with lower loss and faster convergence and that its individual components are more effective together than independently.

</details>


### [565] [TWIN-MoE: Two-stage Intra-Expert Imputation Network for Incomplete Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24014)
*Liang Nathan Zheng,Jiyuan Liu,Wenhao Liang,Wei Emma Zhang,Weitong Chen,Lin Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需检索的专家内两阶段插补框架 TWIN：先在编码器嵌入空间做上下文条件估计并用 FIFO 队列统计做径向软裁剪，再在 MoE 后聚合同一样本内的专家条件已观测表示，理论上有更紧的重建误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MoE 处理缺失模态的方法要么为每种缺失模式分配专用专家（随模态数增长扩展性差），要么需依赖多个专家表示的昂贵检索机制来插补缺失模态，成本高。

Method: 理论分析：证明路由会形成"专家条件表示邻域"，并推导出由局部特征离散度控制的插补误差界；邻域比全局空间更紧时，专家内聚合的重建界优于全局聚合。据此设计两阶段框架：预插补在编码器嵌入空间生成上下文条件估计，并用观测数据 FIFO 队列维护的模态统计做径向软裁剪，使估计落在目标模态经验校准区域内；后插补在 MoE 之后聚合同一样本内专家条件的已观测表示。

Result: 在四种缺失模态基准、自然/随机/非对称丢弃协议下取得 SOTA，且参数量显著少于竞争的 MoE 插补方法。

Conclusion: 专家条件表示的紧凑性是插补质量的关键，基于该性质的两阶段专家内插补可在低参数量下实现更优缺失模态鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address missing modalities either by routing each missingness pattern to a dedicated expert, which scales poorly as the number of modalities grows, or by imputing the missing modality from representations contributed by multiple experts, which requires a costly retrieval mechanism. We show that routing induces expert-conditioned representation neighborhoods and derive an imputation-error bound controlled by their local feature dispersion. When these expert-conditioned neighborhoods are more compact than the global representation space, intra-expert aggregation admits a tighter worst-case reconstruction bound than unconstrained global aggregation. Guided by this analysis, we propose TWIN, a two-stage intra-expert imputation framework. Pre-imputation generates a context-conditioned estimate in the encoder embedding space and radially soft-clips it using modality-specific statistics maintained in an observed FIFO queue, this ensures that the pre-imputed modality stays in empirically calibrated region of the target modality space. Post-imputation refines the missing representation after MoE by aggregating expert-conditioned observed representations within the same sample. Across four missing-modality benchmarks under natural, random, and asymmetric dropout protocols, TWIN achieves state-of-the-art performance while using substantially fewer parameters than competing MoE-based imputation methods.

</details>


### [566] [Dynamical Kernel Attention: Estimating the Present from a Record of the Past](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24026)
*Peter Racioppo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出动态核注意力（DKA），从随机动力学下潜状态演化的稳健估计中导出注意力，使注意力在证据弱时可弃权，并保证丢弃旧token时误差有界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自注意力仅按相似度比较token，不考虑过去状态有多少"存活"到当前，也缺乏对弱证据弃权和旧token丢弃误差的可控性。

Method: 将注意力建模为对在随机动力学下演化的潜状态进行稳健估计；利用过去状态向平衡态衰减、其所含关于当前的信息随之消失的性质来界定证据总量，从而导出注意力权重。

Result: 本文仅给出模型与理论分析（误差有界性、证据上界），实证评估推迟至后续版本，暂无实验结果。

Conclusion: DKA在保持标准注意力的并行结构与计算复杂度的同时，具备证据弱时弃权和旧token丢弃误差有界等理论优势，但尚待实证验证。

Abstract: Standard self-attention compares tokens by similarity but does not account for how much of a past state survives to the present. We introduce Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA), which derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state evolving under stochastic dynamics. As a past state decays toward equilibrium under the dynamics, the information it carries about the present vanishes, bounding the total evidence a head can draw. Unlike recency biases, DKA can abstain when relevant evidence is weak and guarantees a bounded error when old tokens are discarded. DKA preserves the parallel structure and computational cost of standard attention. We present the model and its theory; empirical evaluation is deferred to a subsequent version.

</details>


### [567] [Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25575)
*Qiwei Han,Chi Zhou,Gaoxiang Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个基于实测器件数据库的定量问答基准（755题，源自45,441条器件记录），发现文本检索仅16-23%准确率，而只读SQL执行可达约51%，证明表格化结构化抽取是文献级定量问答的前提。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG文献助手基准多以文本重叠或模型打分评价，缺乏对实验性真实数据的验证；在钙钛矿光伏等实验材料领域，关键问题本质上是定量的，需要跨数十至数百篇文献聚合测量数据，现有基准无法评估这一点。

Method: 构建定量QA基准，755个标准答案全部由45,441条实测器件记录直接计算（2021年前人工整理40,889条，2022-2026文献抽取4,552条）。从25,662篇论文的158,274个段落中，用单块24GB GPU上的开源14B模型测试6种检索架构，并与只读SQL执行结构化表格的方案对比。

Result: 标准段落检索最高仅16-23%准确率（零样本1.6-6.5%）；只读SQL方案在历史文献上达51.5%、前瞻文献上达50.8%，比混合文本检索高约33.0±1.8个百分点。涉及极值、分布和筛选计数的聚合查询几乎无法仅靠文本检索解决。

Conclusion: 文本检索在文献级定量问题上受结构性限制，系统性表格抽取与结构化查询（SQL）是开展文献规模定量研究的运行前提，为科学文献RAG建立了以实测真值为准的评测范式。

Abstract: While retrieval-augmented language models increasingly serve as literature assistants in the physical sciences, existing benchmarks evaluate them primarily on qualitative text overlap or through model-based scoring rather than against verified experimental ground truth. In experimental materials disciplines such as perovskite photovoltaics, however, the most critical inquiries are inherently quantitative and aggregate measurements across dozens or hundreds of papers. Here, we present a quantitative question-answering benchmark where all 755 ground-truth answers are computed directly from 45,441 measured device records (40,889 human-curated records through 2021 and 4,552 records extracted from 2022-2026 literature). Benchmarking six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU, standard passage retrieval tops out at 16-23% accuracy (compared to 1.6-6.5% zero-shot). In contrast, equipping the language model with read-only SQL execution over the structured device table elevates accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature -- a 33.01.8 percentage-point advantage over hybrid text retrieval. Aggregate queries spanning extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts prove virtually unsolvable via text retrieval alone, demonstrating that systematic table extraction is an operational prerequisite for literature-scale quantitative inquiry.

</details>


### [568] [Do Knowledge and Reasoning Oriented Benchmarks Induce Stable Representation Signatures in LLMs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24029)
*Parsa Rahimi,Azim Dehghani Amirabad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文检验知识/推理标签能否在7B–31B模型中定义可复用的内部签名，结论是原始探针能区分MMLU任务与学科，但剔除词汇信息后显著优势消失、所选层与数据流随任务面板和选择规则变化，未发现可迁移的知识/推理签名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部签名有望支持监控、自适应计算与机制分析，但基准提示可能只在表面可分离、并无共享的计算差异，因此需要严格检验"知识/推理"标签是否对应可复用的内部特征。

Method: 以任务为推断单位：留出完整任务，跨任务置换标签，并对每个置换重新选择最佳层与数据流；在五个当代7B–31B模型上比较激活探针与提示文本探针，并做词汇调整与两个基座训练轨迹的方向一致性分析。

Result: 原始探针在全部五个模型上恢复出8对8的MMLU学科划分（macro-F1 0.78–0.81），但相同配置下提示文本预测几乎同样好，激活优势仅0.017–0.070 macro-F1且不显著；在0.01水平上词汇调整后显著性消失，而调整后状态仍能识别单个学科，所选位置也随任务面板与选择规则改变；两条公开基座训练轨迹无共同方向。

Conclusion: 在测试灵敏度下，逐层池化度量能恢复任务标签，但未识别出可迁移的知识/推理签名，且不能排除中等效应；该协议为未来内部监控与干预研究提供了一组须依次通过的检验。

Abstract: Internal signatures could support monitoring, adaptive computation, and mechanistic analysis, but benchmark prompts can be separable without any shared computational distinction. We test whether a prespecified knowledge/reasoning label defines a reusable internal signature in five contemporary 7B to 31B models. We treat the \textbf{task} as the unit of inference probes hold out complete tasks, labels are permuted across tasks, and the best layer and stream are reselected for every permutation. Raw probes recover an eight-versus-eight-subject MMLU partition in all five models (macro-F1 $0.78$--$0.81$), but prompt text predicts it nearly as well: under an identical probe configuration, the activation advantage is only $0.017$--$0.070$ macro-F1 and is not significant. At the prespecified $0.01$ level, lexical adjustment removes significance while the adjusted states still identify individual subjects, and the selected site changes across task panels and selection rules. Additionally, two released base-training trajectories show no common direction. These pooled layerwise measures recover the task label but identify no transferable knowledge/reasoning signature at the tested sensitivity, which cannot exclude moderate effects. The resulting protocol gives future internal monitors and intervention studies a sequence of tests to pass. Project page: \url{https://parsa-ra.github.io/lmbehave/}.

</details>


### [569] [Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking: Retrieval-Weighted Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning from Delayed Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24032)
*Prathap Selvakumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking (VCBM)，将 credit assignment 集中于决定 episode 回报的因果决策点，并在完全可观测低维 MDP 与部分可观测语言环境中分别验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单轨迹级回报训练的 RL 智能体面临 credit assignment 问题：奖励滞后时所有动作获得相同信号，无视因果责任，因而需要将 credit 集中于真正的决策点。

Method: 两种实例化：(1) 延迟奖励的 watch-repair 任务中，VCBM 统计发现智能体因果控制的状态分量并直接估计每个决策点的动作值，与 ground truth 及 RUDDER 对比；(2) AppWorld 中用 LOOP 训练的 LLM 智能体，以结构性启发式（状态变更工具调用）替代因果发现，通过 episodic memory 检索分配 credit 并与 LOOP 优势混合。

Result: 任务一：VCBM 20 个种子平均 1,532.3 回合达到 95.07% 正确决策，优于 RUDDER（3,327.1 回合，p<0.001），且发现的因果结构与 ground truth 完全一致。任务二：200 次迭代下 VCBM 混合 LOOP 任务成功率提升（0.458 vs 0.354），降低末步最大重要性权重并提升 token 效率，仅在 KL 上略逊于 LOOP。

Conclusion: 加权因果相关步骤比无差别基线或学习式回报重分配网络更具样本效率；但 AppWorld 实验因 2-GPU 预算限制每臂仅一个种子，属于受限算力的探索性演示而非统计确认。

Abstract: RL agents trained on a single trajectory-level return face a credit-assignment problem: when a reward arrives many steps after the decision that caused it, every action gets the same signal regardless of causal responsibility. This paper studies Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking (VCBM), which concentrates credit on the decision points that determine an episode's return, via two instantiations. The first targets a fully observed, low-dimensional MDP (a delayed-reward watch-repair task), where VCBM statistically discovers which state components the agent causally controls and estimates per-decision-point action values directly, evaluated against ground truth and RUDDER, an LSTM-based baseline. VCBM converges to 95.07% correct decisions in a mean of 1,532.3 episodes across 20 seeds, versus RUDDER's slower, more variable convergence (mean 3,327.1 episodes; p<0.001); VCBM's discovered causal structure exactly matches ground truth in all seeds. The second targets a partially observed, language-based setting: an LLM agent trained with Leave-One-Out PPO (LOOP) in AppWorld, where causal discovery is intractable and a structural heuristic (state-mutating tool calls) substitutes for it, with credit distributed via retrieval over episodic memory and blended with LOOP's advantage. Over 200 iterations on identical Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/LoRA/FSDP2 configurations, VCBM-blended LOOP improves task success over plain LOOP (0.354 vs. 0.458), reduces final-step max importance weight, and improves token efficiency, with a small KL exception favouring LOOP. The watch-repair result supports the claim that weighting causally relevant steps is more sample-efficient than an undifferentiated baseline or a learned return-redistribution network; the AppWorld result, limited to one seed per arm by a 2-GPU budget, is a compute-limited demonstration at a harder, natural-language scale, not a statistical confirmation.

</details>


### [570] [Client-Aware Security Adaptive Early Exit Vision Transformers for Heterogeneous Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24036)
*Sahar Refaei Ghalibafan,Samira Nazari,Christian Herglotz,Maksim Jenihhin,Mahdi Taheri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在联邦学习场景下，为本地ViT引入客户端自适应的早退（early-exit）推理阈值与安全/鲁棒感知路由，在32%左右深度节省下保持甚至超过全深度精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习各客户端数据难度与算力预算不同，用统一的早退接受阈值不合理；同时需兼顾聚合中部分参数未更新的情况与安全/鲁棒性需求。

Method: 用标签熵与浅层退出置信度生成客户端特定的基础阈值，再按输入级预测熵、置信度、top-2类间间隔与退出深度动态调整；聚合仅纳入更新了某参数的客户端；提出安全感知与鲁棒感知路由。

Result: CIFAR-10达88.70%精度并节省32.0%深度；ImageNet-1K top-1为73.7%、节省30%深度；六客户端非IID CIFAR-100上全深度72.28%，优于四个异构FL基线（68.20–71.80%），鲁棒感知路由70.01%且节省32.55%。

Conclusion: 客户端自适应的早退阈值加输入级调整可在联邦ViT中显著降低计算量并提升精度，为异构客户端提供可落地的效率-鲁棒折中。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model across data-owning clients without centralizing raw data, but client data difficulty and compute budgets can differ. We study local early-exit Vision Transformer (ViT) inference, where an intermediate classifier may return a prediction before the final Transformer stage. The proposed method replaces one global acceptance threshold with a client-specific base threshold from label entropy and shallow-exit confidence, then adjusts each input using predictive entropy, confidence, top-two class margin, and exit depth. Aggregation uses only clients that updated a parameter. Security-aware routing reaches 88.70% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 32.0% depth saving and 73.7% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 30\% saving. On matched six-client non-IID CIFAR-100, full-depth accuracy is 72.28% versus 68.20--71.80% for four heterogeneous-FL baselines; robustness-aware routing reaches 70.01% with 32.55% saving.

</details>


### [571] [What Remains Without Test Labels? Re-evaluating a Graph-Level Anomaly Detection Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24045)
*Yujie Lu,Da Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文审计了图级异常检测基准 UB-GOLD 及 14 个 GLAD 代码库，发现测试标签被用于检查点选择和超参数调优，导致性能被高估（平均 +5.12 AUROC），并给出无标签选择与可复现发布的建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图级异常检测器仅用正常图训练，但基准评测中可能借助测试标签进行模型选择（如选检查点、调超参），从而虚高结果、破坏"无标签检测"的前提。作者质疑后续论文复用的 UB-GOLD 结果是否真正支持无标签检测。

Method: 审计 UB-GOLD 与 14 个 GLAD 代码库；在 UB-GOLD 的折划分上，用 21 个检测器分别在含/不含测试标签的选择规则下重跑；评估对已知结构变化的敏感性；并进行事后置换分析以量化噪声选择效应。

Result: 测试标签在 UB-GOLD 共享训练循环中用于选检查点，并在 14 个代码库中的 8 个用于选检查点或超参；UB-GOLD 的核基线还使用错位标签评测。九个数据集中，用测试 AUROC 选检查点比最终检查点平均提升 5.12 AUROC 点 [3.97, 6.24]，比留出正常图选择高 4.13 点 [3.32, 4.79]；无真实更优检查点的置换分析仍产生一半以上的增益。测试标签调参再额外提升 1.53 点 [0.64, 2.42]。使用调优超参+无标签检查点选择时，两个最强检测器仍保持领先，其余排序不稳定。八个检测器中有六个在样本外漏检保持规模的组成变化，而 graphlet 计数能检出。

Conclusion: 建议将不含测试标签选择的结果作为主要对比，并发布逐次运行输出以便无需重训即可验证；当前基准的领先结论部分来自标签泄漏，需谨慎对待。

Abstract: Graph-level anomaly detectors are trained only on normal graphs, yet benchmarks may use test labels for model selection. We examine whether UB-GOLD results reused by later papers support label-free detection. We audit UB-GOLD and 14 GLAD code bases, re-run 21 detectors on UB-GOLD's folds under selection rules with and without test labels, and evaluate sensitivity to known structural changes. Test labels select checkpoints in UB-GOLD's shared training loop and checkpoints or hyperparameters in 8 of the 14 code bases. UB-GOLD also evaluates its kernel baselines against misaligned labels. Across nine datasets, selecting checkpoints by test AUROC adds an average of 5.12 AUROC points [3.97, 6.24] for the 12 UB-GOLD detectors relative to the final checkpoint and 4.13 [3.32, 4.79] relative to held-out normal graphs. In a post hoc permutation analysis with no truly better checkpoint, picking the best of noisy test evaluations still yields a gain more than half as large as the one observed against the final checkpoint. Configurations tuned on test labels score a further 1.53 points [0.64, 2.42] above repository defaults, a gap that mixes the value of test labels with that of tuning itself. With tuned hyperparameters and label-free checkpoint selection, the two strongest detectors retain their lead, while comparisons below them are less stable. Six of eight detectors evaluated out of sample miss size-preserving composition changes that graphlet counts detect. We recommend reporting results selected without test labels as the main comparisons and release per-run outputs that allow verification without retraining.

</details>


### [572] [Alliance of Stochastic Routing and Reinforcement Fusion for Multi-Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24054)
*Selim Furkan Tekin,Ling Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VL-Scout：在多模态动态模型路由中结合贝叶斯Dirichlet信念、KL正则REINFORCE与融合策略，缓解早熟收敛，四基准上稳定优于11个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态场景下需按查询选择并组合多个模型，标准强化学习路由因奖励噪声与探索不足易过早收敛到次优模型。

Method: 三部分统一视觉-语言框架：(1) 上下文相关Dirichlet信念模型刻画模型质量的认知不确定性，依在线奖励更新，提供Thompson式探索并作正则先验；(2) 将路由策略视为摊销后验，用KL正则的REINFORCE最大化奖励加权ELBO训练；(3) 融合策略在中间推理依据上用GRPO或RLVR训练，选择CONTINUE或ANSWER终止并生成输出。

Result: 在MMMU、MMMU-Pro、OKVQA、RealWorldQA四个多模态基准上，与11个路由/策略优化基线相比性能一致提升，并减少策略早熟崩塌。

Conclusion: 将不确定性感知先验与摊销策略学习、序列融合相结合，对离散动作空间下稳健高效的模型选择至关重要。

Abstract: This paper studies dynamic model routing under uncertainty in multimodal settings, where a system must select and potentially compose multiple models to answer a query. Standard reinforcement learning approaches for routing often suffer from premature convergence to suboptimal models due to noisy rewards and insufficient exploration. We propose a unified vision-language framework (VL-Scout) for efficient multimodal and multi-step reasoning with turn-based reinforcement fusion. First, VL-Scout combines Bayesian priors, policy gradient optimization, and sequential decision-making to enable structured exploration and adaptive inference. A context-dependent Dirichlet belief model allows for epistemic uncertainty over model quality and is updated online based on observed rewards and context-specific evidence, enabling Thompson-style exploration while serving as a prior for regularization. Second, a routing policy is trained via a KL-regularized REINFORCE objective by maximizing a reward-weighted evidence lower bound, where the policy acts as an amortized posterior, and the Dirichlet belief serves as a prior. Third, we introduce a fusion policy trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) or Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which operates over intermediate model rationales and selects between two actions: CONTINUE or ANSWER, terminating with a generated output. We evaluate VL-Scout on four representative multi-modal benchmarks (MMMU, MMMU-Pro, OKVQA, and RealWorldQA), compared against 11 representative routing and policy optimization baselines. Our method provides consistent performance improvements while reducing premature policy collapse. These results highlight the importance of integrating uncertainty-aware priors with both amortized policy learning and sequential fusion for robust and efficient model selection in discrete action spaces

</details>


### [573] [GLOW: General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24085)
*Matt Higger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GLOW方法：用Ward聚类贪心最小化GLM误差构建嵌套区域层次，配合最大统计量置换检验控制FWER，试图把成像效应恢复为"整体、纯粹"的区域而非碎片。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于区域分析会稀释或拆分不恰好填满一个图谱区域的效应；基于体素分析（簇范围阈值、TFCE）逐体素拟合GLM再合并相邻显著体素，但相邻体素可能共享统计量却不共享GLM，逐体素统计量无法察觉。

Method: GLOW（General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's method）通过贪心最小化GLM误差构建嵌套区域层次（可证明为Ward聚类特例）；用最大统计量（Westfall-Young）置换控制所有区域上的族错误率；显著性向效应的嵌套碎片及包含它的区域扩散；最后用剪枝步骤追求完整纯粹效应范围。在HCP扩散图像与白噪声中植入已知范围、不同强度的合成效应评估。

Result: 剪枝带来"整体性"：HCP上57%试次将空间一致效应恢复为单一区域，最佳基线为35%；基线可恢复相当体积但多为碎片。代价是PPV：GLOW更敏感（最多高0.29），但区域超出效应范围，主因是层次中无区域能隔离效应而非剪枝。HCP上弱效应时Dice比最佳基线高0.059，强效应时低0.005。白噪声上GLOW的Dice落后最多0.61：层次含效应但置换检验未能认证。运行时间随体素数近似线性，全HCP体积上约为逐体素方法的4.5倍。

Conclusion: GLOW在恢复整体效应上优于逐体素基线，但PPV下降；白噪声上置换检验失效；PPV损失可能源于空间独立残差假设。

Abstract: Neuroimaging seeks brain regions whose imaging features correlate with variables of interest (e.g., diagnosis, age), usually via the General Linear Model (GLM). Region-Based Analysis dilutes or splits any effect that does not fill exactly one atlas region. Voxel-Based Analysis, with Cluster Extent Thresholding and Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement built on it, fits a GLM per voxel and groups adjacent significant voxels. But neighboring voxels can share a statistic without sharing a GLM, which a per-voxel statistic cannot detect.
  GLOW (General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's method) instead builds a hierarchy of nested regions by greedily minimizing GLM error (provably a special case of Ward's clustering). Maximum-statistic (Westfall-Young) permutation controls family-wise error over all regions. Significance spreads to an effect's nested fragments and the regions containing it; a final pruning step seeks whole, pure effect extents.
  We plant synthetic effects of known extent and varying strength in Human Connectome Project (HCP) diffusion images and in white noise. Pruning delivers wholeness: GLOW returns a spatially consistent effect as one region on 57% of HCP trials, the best baseline on 35%; baselines recover comparable volume, but in many pure pieces. The cost is positive predictive value (PPV): GLOW is more sensitive (by up to 0.29), but its regions overrun the effect, mostly because no hierarchy region isolates it, not because of pruning. On HCP, GLOW's mean Dice gains 0.059 over the best baseline at weaker effects and gives back 0.005 at stronger ones.
  On white noise, GLOW trails by up to 0.61 Dice: its hierarchy holds the effect, but its permutation test does not certify it. Runtime grows roughly linearly with voxel count, about 4.5 times the voxel-wise methods' on the full HCP volume. The PPV loss may trace to the assumption of spatially independent residuals.

</details>


### [574] [Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24112)
*Zhiyang Wang,Zhishang Luo,Yusu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将"在小图上训练的GNN泛化到大图"建模为局部迭代计算问题，提出参数共享的looped GNN架构，分类六种循环方案，并提出Loop-Freeze-Steer（LFS）：冻结预训练处理器、仅学习一个小控制器来引导迭代复用，以极少可训练参数实现尺寸泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标任务的"有效依赖半径"随图规模增长，而神经网络深度在训练时固定，因此小图上学到的模型难以在大图上完成所需的多跳信息传播；重新训练大图模型代价高。

Method: 1) 通过GNN预训练学习一个局部更新规则（processor）；2) 将其视作looped GNN，在不重训的前提下重复施加同一处理器以扩展有效深度/信息可达范围；3) 归纳六种循环GNN方案，分离"深度扩展、微调、freeze-and-steer自适应"三种因素；4) 提出LFS：冻结预训练处理器，只训练小型controller来steer重复应用；5) 给出固定深度信息上限与迭代复用足以突破该上限的充分条件，以及有限样本下自适应能提升大图性能的充分条件。

Result: 理论上刻画了固定深度的信息限制，并给出准确迭代复用可克服该限制的充分条件；有限样本分析给出LFS自适应带来增益的条件。实验在合成任务与芯片布局（chip placement）任务上验证了深度扩展与自适应效果，LFS在精度与可训练参数量之间取得较好折中。

Conclusion: 通过重复复用学习到的局部更新规则即可延展GNN的有效感受半径；相较完全微调，冻结处理器并用小控制器steer的LFS是尺寸泛化下更具参数效率的自适应方案。

Abstract: Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative computation and whose effective dependency radius grows with graph size. The central idea is to learn a local update rule through GNN pretraining, then repeatedly apply the same learned processor beyond the training depth to extend information reach on larger graphs without retraining. Calling such parameter-shared architecture a \emph{looped GNN}, we categorize six schemes for looped GNNs to separate the effects of depth extension, fine-tuning, and freeze-and-steer adaptation. Our analysis establishes fixed-depth information limits and sufficient conditions under which accurate iterative reuse overcomes them. To improve beyond unadapted reuse, we introduce \emph{Loop-Freeze-Steer} (LFS), which freezes the pretrained processor and learns a small controller to steer its repeated application, using much fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning. Our finite-sample analysis gives sufficient conditions for adaptation to improve performance on larger graphs. Experiments on synthetic tasks and chip placement evaluate depth extension and adaptation, highlighting LFS's accuracy--trainable-parameter trade-off for size generalization.

</details>


### [575] [Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control for Stable Counterfactual Estimation under Donor Redundancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24113)
*Yanlin Zhang,Sungyong Chung,Alireza Talebpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图正则化合成控制（Graph-SC），在图拉普拉斯惩罚下稳定供体权重并提升可解释性，理论刻画偏差-方差权衡，实验显示在保持拟合精度的同时降低权重不稳定性与冗余敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统合成控制法在供体池大、供体轨迹高度相关且处理前历史较短的场景下，存在大量近似等价的解，导致供体权重不稳定、难以解释。作者希望在不牺牲合成控制透明性的前提下，从近乎等价的解中选择稳定且可解释的反事实。

Method: 在经典处理前匹配目标上加入图拉普拉斯惩罚项，构建凸估计器 Graph-SC。图中节点为供体轨迹，边编码供体间的相似性，从而鼓励结构相关供体获得一致（coherent）的权重；理论上分析图正则带来的偏差-方差权衡，并给出基于加速近端梯度法的高效收敛保证。

Result: 在供体冗余的受控模拟、加州 Proposition 99 基准实验以及 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上的观察性反事实分析中，Graph-SC 相对经典与正则化合成控制基线提升了权重稳定性、降低了对冗余供体池的敏感性，并保持了有竞争力的处理前与处理后精度。

Conclusion: 图正则化的价值不在于普遍提升精度，而在于作为原则性机制——在预处理拟合相当的多组近等价合成控制中，稳定地选出更稳健、可解释的反事实解。

Abstract: Synthetic control methods estimate counterfactual outcomes by weighting untreated donor units to match a treated unit before treatment. In recent applications, however, the donor pool can be large, highly correlated, and short in pre-treatment history, yielding many near-equivalent solutions with unstable and difficult-to-interpret donor weights.
