We propose Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control (Graph-SC), a convex estimator that augments the classical pre-treatment matching objective with a graph Laplacian penalty. The graph encodes similarity among donor trajectories, encouraging coherent weights over structurally related donors while preserving the transparency of synthetic controls. We provide theoretical results characterizing the bias-variance tradeoff induced by graph regularization and establish efficient convergence guarantees with an accelerated proximal gradient method. Across a controlled simulation under donor redundancy, the California Proposition 99 benchmark, and observational counterfactual analyses on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, Graph-SC improves weight stability, reduces sensitivity to redundant donor pools, and maintains competitive pre- and post-treatment accuracy relative to classical and regularized synthetic control baselines. Our results suggest that graph regularization is most valuable not as a universal accuracy booster, but as a principled mechanism for selecting stable and interpretable counterfactuals from near-equivalent synthetic controls with comparable pre-treatment fit.

</details>


### [576] [Next Best Action: Causal Constrained Offline RL for Business Action Targeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26817)
*Surya Ramachandiran,Yiming Li,Juan Mancilla-Caceres,Tao Ye,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将 Next Best Action 问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），把离策略因果校正嵌入 LP 求解，在满足业务约束下最大化长期价值，并在网约车优惠券投放案例中提升 LTV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 NBA 系统难以同时满足四个要求：在多种客户干预间选择、最大化长期经济价值、满足复杂运营约束、保持因果有效性；缺乏统一严格框架。

Method: NBA 建模为 CMDP；将估计客户动态的离策略因果校正直接整合进 CMDP 的线性规划（LP）形式；策略基于客户状态选动作，显式执行业务护栏；LP 的对偶影子价格为约束（如公平性、用户福利）提供经济权衡解释。离线 RL 框架，用基于模型的离策略评估，因果动态由时间留出集估计。

Result: 网约车优惠券定向案例（客户状态由 RFM 阶段定义）：在给定优惠券预算与 RFM 表示下，LTV 相比估计的行为策略提升 19%，相比短视基线提升 8%。

Conclusion: 该框架在统一离线 RL 下兼顾长期价值、运营约束与因果性；虽演示动作空间为二元，但方法动作无关，可作为管理多种干预的通用定向决策模块。

Abstract: Next Best Action (NBA) systems must select among customer interventions (e.g., discounts, promotions, and lifecycle actions), maximize long-term economic value, satisfy complex operational constraints, and remain causally grounded. Existing approaches lack a rigorous framework for meeting these requirements jointly. We address this gap by formulating NBA as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP). We then integrate off-policy causal correction of the estimated customer dynamics directly into the Linear Programming (LP) formulation of the CMDP. The resulting policy selects actions based on customer states to maximize long-term value while explicitly enforcing business guardrails. Furthermore, the LP formulation yields shadow prices that quantify the economic trade-offs of operational constraints (e.g., fairness and user welfare), enhancing policy interpretability. We validate our proposed offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework on an industry case study involving rideshare coupon targeting, where customer states are defined by Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) stages. We evaluate performance using model-based off-policy evaluation, with causal dynamics estimated from a temporal holdout. Under the observed coupon budget and RFM state representation, our optimized policy improves customer lifetime value (LTV) by 19% over the estimated behavior policy and 8% over a myopic baseline. Although the demonstrated action space is binary, the proposed framework is action-agnostic, yielding a general-purpose decision module for targeting systems that manage multiple interventions.

</details>


### [577] [On the Selectivity of Generative Models in Structure-Based Drug Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24124)
*Ella Miray Rajaonson,Jungyoon Lee,William Chau,Alan Aspuru-Guzik,Benjamin Sanchez-Lengeling,Dominique Beaini,Kirill Neklyudov,Marta Skreta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SELECTBENCH，一个系统评测生成式SBDD模型选择性的综合基准，含三类任务与一套选择性度量，评估九种代表性模型后发现即使专门训练选择性的模型对脱靶区分能力也有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小分子药物需选择性结合靶蛋白、避免脱靶以减少副作用和临床失败；但现有深度学习生成式SBDD模型多只优化单靶点结合，且因训练数据有限、脱靶相互作用未知而忽视选择性，缺乏系统评测手段。

Method: 构建SELECTBENCH基准，提供三类贴近真实药物发现场景的评测任务：基于文献的案例研究、制药开发中的安全性筛查panel、大规模结构基础评测集；并设计一组量化选择性的指标，对九种代表性SBDD模型（含显式训练选择性的方法和常用推理时引导技术）进行系统评测。

Result: 即便经过选择性训练的模型，其脱靶区分能力也仅为中等水平；推理时引导带来的提升有限，说明方法仍有较大改进空间。

Conclusion: SELECTBENCH既刻画了当前生成式SBDD在选择性问题上的现状，也提供了开放可扩展的平台以加速方法进步，代码公开于GitHub。

Abstract: Designing small-molecule drugs that selectively bind to a target protein while avoiding unintended interactions with other proteins is essential for reducing side effects that contribute substantially to clinical attrition. Although structure-based drug design (SBDD) has advanced rapidly with deep learning, most generative models still optimize binding to a single target and disregard selectivity due to limited training data and unknown off-target interactions. Motivated by this gap, we introduce SELECTBENCH, a comprehensive benchmark assessing the selectivity of generative SBDD models. SELECTBENCH provides three curated evaluation tasks reflecting different real-world drug discovery scenarios: literature-based case studies, safety screening panels used in pharmaceutical development, and large-scale structure-based evaluation sets. We further introduce a suite of metrics to quantify selectivity and conduct a systematic evaluation of nine representative SBDD models, including methods explicitly trained for selectivity and widely-used inference-time guidance techniques. Our results show that even selectivity-trained models achieve only modest off-target discrimination and inference-time guidance provides limited gains, underscoring the need for method improvement. SELECTBENCH provides both a characterization of where current generative SBDD stands on selectivity and an open, extensible platform to accelerate progress. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/lovetaro/selectbench.

</details>


### [578] [Data-Driven Resource Aggregation for Scalable Digital Twin and Simulation Model Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24126)
*Yucheng Wu,Alp Akcay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于逆强化学习从生产事件日志学习资源行为价值表示，自动选择与聚合功能相似的资源，以简化仿真建模复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业数字化下数字孪生普及，但现代制造系统高度动态、频繁重构，手工建模与更新困难；事件日志可自动生成仿真模型，但全粒度建模每个资源造成不必要的复杂度与计算开销。

Method: 借鉴逆强化学习思想，从生产事件日志中学习资源的行为价值表示，据此识别具有相似功能贡献的资源并进行聚合。

Result: 在制造系统实验中，以吞吐量和系统时间（system time）为性能指标，基于价值的资源聚合在显著降低复杂度的同时较好地保持了性能精度。

Conclusion: 价值驱动的资源聚合是简化仿真建模的有效手段，适用于以大幅降复杂度且保持性能精度为目标的场景。

Abstract: As industrial digitization accelerates, the use of digital twins has become widespread. However, modern manufacturing systems are highly dynamic and frequently reconfigured, making manual model development and updates increasingly difficult. Recent research on automated simulation model generation shows that historical data such as event logs can yield simulation models automatically. However, modeling every resource at full granularity leads to unnecessary complexity and computational cost. We propose a method for automatically selecting and aggregating resources to simplify simulation modeling. Our method uses ideas from inverse reinforcement learning to learn behavioral value representations of resources from production event logs. This process identifies and aggregates resources with similar functional contributions. Experiments on manufacturing systems, using throughput and system time as performance measures, demonstrate that value-based resource aggregation performs well when the goal is to substantially reduce complexity while preserving performance accuracy.

</details>


### [579] [Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24135)
*Magnus Sesodia,Juil Sock,Philip Torr,Christian Schroeder de Witt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer通过复用同一层块多次迭代来扩展有效深度而不增加参数或token，研究以"有向置换遍历"任务揭示其每轮迭代确实逐步执行算法的各个步骤，形成可适应迭代预算的"阶梯"结构，从而解决同等有效深度的非绑定Transformer无法解决的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多需要多步顺序推理的算法任务通常要靠加深Transformer层数或加长思维链来解决，分别带来参数开销大和推理计算开销大的问题。循环Transformer理论上可优雅地解决此矛盾，但此前不清楚每次迭代到底在计算什么，也不确定循环是否只是在模拟一个更深的非绑定堆叠。

Method: 提出"有向置换遍历"任务：模型从起始节点沿H跳跟随并报告到达的节点，每一跳都有已知的真实标签。对比训练一个四层块迭代八次的循环Transformer与同等有效深度的非绑定Transformer，并通过探测和干预残差流来观察中间节点的表征进程。

Result: 存在一个最低有效深度门槛，超过后权重绑定程度成为决定性因素：四层块迭代八次的循环模型在所有随机种子下都能解决任务，而同等的非绑定模型从未做到（仅在更低学习率或监督中间层时才成功）。残差流探测显示循环模型逐步推进经过中间节点，形成适应迭代预算的阶梯；而非绑定模型仅在最后几层才暴露中间节点。

Conclusion: 该研究将循环Transformer重新定义为迭代式程序学习器：它们把迭代分配给算法的连续步骤，形成适应预算的阶梯式计算，从而解决同等的非绑定模型无法解决的任务。

Abstract: Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows $H$ hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model advances through the intermediate nodes gradually, forming a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget, whereas the untied model, at that lower rate, exposes them only in its final layers. Taken together, our results recast looped transformers as iterative program learners, which allocate their iterations to successive steps of the algorithm and solve tasks that identically-trained untied models of the same effective depth do not. Code is available at https://github.com/magnus-sesodia/insidetheloop.

</details>


### [580] [Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24137)
*Guangya Hao,Yiting Duan,Longyan Tan,Yunbo Long,Hao Wu,Ge Zheng,Alexandra Brintrup,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ESRL，用一组扰动策略（而非单一策略）生成自监督信号，实现持续测试时学习，避免策略漂移导致的崩溃与遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在开放环境中需持续适应新任务与分布，但外部监督（标签、演示、奖励）昂贵或不可得。现有测试时自适应虽用自生成监督，却依赖被更新的单一策略本身，策略一旦漂移，学习信号随之漂移，导致策略崩溃、推理退化与灾难性遗忘。

Method: ESRL在参数空间对锚点策略施加扰动，形成一个邻近策略群，每个策略采样一条轨迹，将其答案聚合成无标签的组相对学习信号，供中心学生策略更新。锚点在每个块内固定，在块边界由学生刷新，使策略群始终围绕一个稳定且最新的策略，持续提供多样可靠的监督。

Result: 在数学推理、通用知识与医学领域的单任务测试时自适应中，ESRL相对基座模型平均准确率最高提升31.7%，相对最强测试时自适应基线提升16.6%。在持续学习中显著减少灾难性遗忘，并取得最佳最终性能。

Conclusion: 以策略群取代单一策略提供自生成监督，可稳定测试时持续学习，兼顾提升性能与缓解遗忘。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

</details>


### [581] [Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24156)
*Sudipto Guha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究“探索有硬预算且先于利用”的多臂老虎机变体，证明了 Guha–Munagala 的 1/3 算法与 Ma 的 4/27 算法分析是紧的（即便其松弛渐近精确），并给出达到 0.43 近似的新高效算法；在奖励观测有界且可交换的非消失情形下，进一步给出逼近 1-e^{-1}≈0.63 的算法，该保证对自然 LP 松弛渐近紧，且该技术还可用于判定何时停止序贯模型评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂老虎机刻画探索与利用的权衡；本文关注探索受硬预算约束且探索必须先于利用的变体，现实场景（如先付费试跑、再部署）需要这种设定。已有保证为 1/3 近似与更一般模型下对原始 LP 松弛的 4/27 近似，但这两个分析是否已达最优、能否改进近似比，尚不清楚。

Method: 首先构造实例证明 Guha–Munagala 的拉格朗日对偶算法与 Ma 针对原始线性规划松弛的算法的分析均紧，即使松弛渐近精确。随后给出一个不同的高效算法达到 0.43 近似；针对有界可交换奖励观测的非消失情形，设计算法使保证趋近 1-e^{-1}，并证明其相对自然 LP 松弛渐近紧。技术手段还可导出停止序贯模型评估的证书。

Result: 证明已有 1/3 与 4/27 近似分析是紧的；提出达到 0.43 近似的高效算法；在有界可交换奖励的非消失情形下将保证提升至趋近 1-e^{-1}≈0.63，且该界对自然 LP 松弛渐近最优；同时得到用于终止序贯模型评估的证书。

Conclusion: 已有算法的近似分析无法再改进，需新思路突破；本文给出的 0.43 与趋近 0.63 的高效算法显著改进了保证，并揭示 1-e^{-1} 是自然 LP 松弛下的极限，所提技术还为序贯评估的早停提供理论依据。

Abstract: The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves a 0.43 approximation. We then provide an efficient algorithm whose guarantee approaches 1-e^{-1} approx 0.63 for bounded exchangeable reward observations in a non-vanishing regime, which is asymptotically tight against natural linear programming relaxations. The technique also gives certificates for stopping sequential model evaluation.

</details>


### [582] [Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24166)
*Adria Binte Habib,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究平稳混合序列上的投票边际泛化界，显式给出依赖惩罚与失效概率，并证明可逆马尔可夫流下谱集中的 sqrt(t_rel/n) 速率是不可改进的，同时给出未知依赖尺度下的批均值 Student-t 区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权投票在训练误差消失后仍能泛化的解释依赖边际界，但相依观测需要保持依赖模型与失效预算显式的集中不等式，而不能把依赖简单当作"有效样本量"替换。

Method: 对有限基类，结合平稳 β-混合过程的独立分块 Rademacher 理论与裁剪边际损失，得到显式一致投票边际证书，依赖惩罚由近似独立块数与耦合预算 4(μ-1)β(a) 决定；给出黑盒迁移定理（i.i.d. 保证在等距子序列上仅增加 β-混合失效概率）；对与平稳有限状态可逆马尔可夫流独立的固定投票，用谱集中得到 sqrt(t_rel/n)；用 sticky-refresh 构造证明该指数不可规避；未知依赖尺度时用批均值 Student-t 区间，宽度由 τ_int(g) 控制。

Result: 学习投票证书在块数足够大时非平凡；两时间尺度构造下批均值区间比最坏情形区间窄 8.1 倍（名义覆盖率 0.945）；强依赖下块自助与批均值区间覆盖率不足而证书仍有效；UCI HAR 有序真实数据上依赖无关证书覆盖率达 0.95，朴素区间仅 0.38。

Conclusion: 在平稳混合流上给出了依赖显式的投票边际泛化证书与不可改进速率，并提供统计量特异的有效样本量 n/τ_int(g) 与实用批均值区间。

Abstract: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $β$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(μ-1)β(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $β$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. The constant is statistic-specific: the effective sample size is $n/τ_{int}(g)$, with $τ_{int}(g) \le 2t_{rel}-1$. When the dependence scale is unknown, a batch-means Student-t interval is valid up to an explicit remainder vanishing in the number of batches, with width governed by $τ_{int}(g)$ rather than the worst-case $t_{rel}$. Experiments show: the learned-vote certificate is nonvacuous once the block count is large; a two-timescale construction gives a batch-means interval 8.1x narrower than the worst-case interval at nominal coverage (0.945); block-bootstrap and batch-means intervals undercover under strong dependence while the certificate stays valid; and on real, ordered UCI HAR sensor data the dependence-agnostic certificate reaches 0.95 coverage where naive intervals reach only 0.38.

</details>


### [583] [Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24185)
*Binglin Ji,Anindya Sarkar,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BSIT：解耦父子依赖的树采样器，提升探索多样性与稀有目标搜索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于树的采样器虽避免了SMC框架中逐步奖励/梯度依赖带来的系统性偏差，但依赖类DDPM的学习转移，使子节点与父节点特征耦合、发散受限，导致目标边缘分布覆盖不足，稀疏奖励下探索能力弱。

Method: 提出Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree（BSIT）采样器，将子节点生成与显式父节点依赖解耦，在子节点采样时扩大自由度，鼓励多样化的轨迹展开与更广的路径空间多样性；不增加额外函数评估或奖励反馈。

Result: BSIT提升的探索可加速向目标分布收敛，并获得比DDPM式转移更广的分布覆盖，且无额外计算开销；在稀有物种发现与目标对齐分子生成等任务上搜索效率优于基线。

Conclusion: 通过解耦父子依赖扩大采样自由度是提升树采样器探索与稀有目标搜索效率的简单有效途径。

Abstract: Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

</details>


### [584] [On Reparameterizing the Score Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24188)
*Mohammad Hossein Amani,Leonardo Bocchieri,Maxime Peyrard,Clément Hongler,Robert West*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出History-Reparameterized (HR)策略梯度，将冻结的前缀替换为可微重参数化/松弛历史，使下游对数概率梯度回传，并导出带闭式系数的中心化控制变量估计器OHR以降低梯度方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归序列模型的策略梯度在计算每个token的对数概率时冻结条件历史，丢弃了早期决策如何影响后续条件分布的信息，在奖励稀疏时造成信用分配瓶颈。

Method: 用可微的重参数化或松弛历史替代评分函数中的冻结前缀，使后续对数概率梯度可沿轨迹回传，得到history-pathwise项；因该项直接加入有偏，推导OHR——一种中心化控制变量估计器，其系数在总体层面最小化梯度方差迹；离散token下比较embedding级松弛与straight-through Gumbel-Softmax。

Result: 方差降低取决于策略动态的时间结构：随机或弱结构策略收益很小，具学习序列依赖的策略能提供有用修正；embedding级松弛方差降低随horizon增长而增大，而straight-through Gumbel-Softmax在诊断中几乎无效果。在高斯线性马尔可夫模型、带循环策略的稀疏奖励T-maze及小规模TSP的自回归Transformer上验证有效。

Conclusion: 通过可微历史重参数化恢复跨时间步的信用分配信号并结合最优控制变量可有效降方差，但效果强烈依赖策略的时间结构与离散松弛方式的选择。

Abstract: Policy gradients for autoregressive sequence models differentiate each token's log-probability while holding the conditioning history fixed. This discards information about how earlier decisions shape later conditional distributions, creating a credit-assignment bottleneck when rewards are sparse. We introduce History-Reparameterized (HR) policy gradients, which replace the frozen prefix in the score function with a differentiable reparameterized or relaxed history, allowing gradients of downstream log-probabilities to propagate backward through the generated trajectory. The resulting history-pathwise term is generally biased when added directly, so we derive Optimal HR (OHR), a centered control-variate estimator with a closed-form coefficient that minimizes the trace of the gradient variance at the population level. The variance reduction is governed by temporal structure in the policy dynamics: random or weakly structured policies provide little benefit, while policies with learned sequential dependencies yield informative history-pathwise corrections. For discrete tokens, the choice of relaxation is crucial: embedding-level relaxation yields substantial variance reduction that grows with horizon, whereas straight-through Gumbel-Softmax yields essentially none in our diagnostics. We validate the method on a Gaussian linear Markov model, a sparse-reward T-maze with a recurrent policy, and an autoregressive Transformer model for small Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) instances.

</details>


### [585] [Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24220)
*Amirhossein Sabour,Amir Khasahmadi,Mengliu Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Drift-TTA，通过零初始化低秩适配器将受损输入的隐藏轨迹对齐到干净轨迹，实现含源/无源的离线校正与轻量在线TTA，在多个ImageNet-C类基准上显著提升精度并降低ECE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTA多依赖最后一层权重或输出概率分布信号，忽略了深层网络中中间表示（隐藏轨迹）所蕴含的分布漂移信息；且观察到随损坏严重度上升，干净与受损轨迹的可分性增强。

Method: 在冻结主干上添加零初始化低秩适配器，训练其将受损轨迹对齐到较干净输入的轨迹；提供含源（用干净目标）与无源（用不同严重度受损图像）两种变体；在线TTA冻结主干与适配器，仅更新标量门控控制适配强度；并将轨迹对齐表述为高斯观测模型下的MAP推断，推导基于KL的迁移界，用离线残差误差、残差维度及离线与测试损坏分布差异刻画测试时轨迹失配。

Result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C上用监督ViT与CLIP评估；CIFAR-100-C严重度5下，无源在线方法较无TTA分别提升ViT-B/16 13.3个百分点、CLIP ViT-B/16 11.6个百分点，达74.9%与47.4%；同设置下ECE由基线18.00%(ViT)和14.70%(CLIP)降至9.53%与5.77%。

Conclusion: 隐藏轨迹对齐为离线校正与轻量在线测试时自适应均提供了有效信号，兼具精度提升与校准改善。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pretrained models to distribution shifts encountered during deployment. However, most existing methods rely on the weight representations of the final layer or signals derived from the model's output probability distribution. We study hidden trajectories: the ordered sequence of intermediate representations produced across a deep neural network. We observe that clean and corrupted trajectories become more separable as corruption severity increases. We introduce Drift-TTA, which adds zero-initialized low-rank adapters to a frozen backbone and trains them to align corrupted hidden trajectories with those from cleaner inputs. The approach supports two variants: a source-dependent version trained with clean targets, and a source-free setting that learns from corrupted images at different severities. We develop an online TTA approach that freezes the backbone and adapters while updating a scalar gate to control adaptation strength. We further cast trajectory alignment as MAP inference under a Gaussian observation model and derive a KL-based transfer bound characterizing test-time trajectory misalignment in terms of offline residual error, residual dimensionality, and distribution shift between offline and test corruptions. We evaluate Drift-TTA on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C using supervised ViTs and CLIP models. On CIFAR-100-C at severity 5, our source-free online approach improves accuracy over no TTA by 13.3 percentage points with ViT-B/16 and 11.6 percentage points with CLIP ViT-B/16, reaching 74.9% and 47.4%, respectively. Under the same setting, prior TTA baselines yield ECEs of 18.00% for ViT and 14.70% for CLIP, while our approach reduces them to 9.53% and 5.77%, respectively. These results demonstrate that hidden trajectory alignment provides an effective signal for both offline correction and lightweight online test-time adaptation.

</details>


### [586] [Dynamic Neural Optimal Transport for Subset Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24258)
*Austin J. Brockmeier,Bilal Riaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出动态神经最优传输框架，将源分布映射到目标分布的一个受限重加权子分布（密度比∈[0,c]），用两个网络分别学习时间相关势函数与源-终端插值，从而在只需对齐部分目标时避免直接分布匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准最优传输要求源与目标整体匹配，但在PU学习、非配对域翻译、轨迹推断等任务中目标包含额外或无关成分，直接匹配会强制对齐错误区域，因此需要只选择目标中相关子集并限制强调程度的传输方案。

Method: 以两个神经网络实现：网络一刻画时间相关势函数，其空间梯度给出速度场，终端值施加密度比约束；网络二参数化源分布与所学终端分布之间的插值路径。与以往固定终端的神经动态OT不同，终端分布在学习中于目标支撑内被优化。

Result: 在正-无标签（PU）学习、非配对域翻译与轨迹推断三个任务上验证，源与目标间存在有意义的对齐，但目标含附加/无关成分，方法能选出合适的目标子分布并实现合理对齐。

Conclusion: 将受限密度比约束融入动态神经OT可有效处理部分目标匹配问题，兼顾子群选择与强调强度控制，为多类不适宜直接分布匹配的应用提供统一框架。

Abstract: We study optimal transport between distributions when only a subset of the target population is relevant to the source. The goal is to map the source distribution to a reweighted target distribution whose density ratio with respect to the full target lies in $[0, c]$. This constraint enables the transported distribution to select an appropriate target subpopulation while limiting how strongly any region of the target can be emphasized. We propose a dynamic neural optimal transport framework for this setting using two neural networks. The first parameterizes a time-dependent potential whose spatial gradient defines the velocity field and whose terminal value enforces the density-ratio constraint. The second parameterizes an interpolation between the source distribution and the learned terminal distribution. Unlike prior neural dynamic optimal transport methods, which typically assume a fixed terminal distribution, our formulation learns the terminal distribution within the support of the target. We demonstrate the method on positive-unlabeled learning, unpaired domain translation, and trajectory inference, where meaningful alignments exist between source and target distributions, but direct distribution matching is inappropriate because the target contains additional or irrelevant components

</details>


### [587] [Dataset Inference for Data Provenance and Privacy Auditing in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24278)
*Dariush Wahdany,Jesse Cresswell,Naiqing Guan,Atiyeh Ashari Ghomi,Franziska Boenisch,Adam Dziedzic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个面向表格基础模型（TFMs）的数据集推断方法，通过组合多种互补的黑盒信号，判断某表格数据集是否被用于预训练，最高可达 0.99 ROCAUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFMs 常以黑盒 API 形式部署，并基于大量真实表格数据预训练，私人或专有数据集可能被纳入预训练语料；目前缺乏专门方法判断某数据集是否参与了 TFM 训练，存在隐私泄漏与专有数据滥用的审计需求。

Method: 通过输入操纵从黑盒 TFM 中提取多种候选信号，系统分析其证据强度；发现单一信号证据弱，于是将多个互补信号组合起来进行数据集成员推断，并分析预训练数据组成、模型容量、真实 vs. 合成数据等影响因素。

Result: 在多个基于真实表格数据训练的 SOTA TFM 上成功推断数据集成员关系，ROCAUC 依模型不同最高达 0.99；并揭示了预训练数据组成、模型容量及真实/合成数据对识别效果的影响。

Conclusion: 该数据集推断方法可作为实用审计工具，用于检测 TFM 的隐私泄漏及专有数据集的使用情况。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly deployed through black-box APIs and trained on large collections of real-world tabular datasets. As this training paradigm becomes more widely adopted, private or proprietary datasets may be incorporated into pre-training corpora, yet there are currently no dedicated methods for determining whether a given tabular dataset was used to train a TFM. As a solution, we introduce the first dataset inference method for TFMs, aiming to infer whether a suspect dataset was part of a model's pre-training data. We systematically analyze a broad collection of candidate signals that can be observed from a black-box TFM via input manipulation and find that individual signals provide only weak evidence of training data membership. However, by combining multiple complementary signals, we can infer dataset membership for several state-of-the-art TFMs trained on real tabular data, achieving up to 0.99 ROCAUC dependent on the TFM. We then study factors that influence dataset identification, including pre-training data composition, model capacity, and the use of real vs. synthetic data. Our results show that our dataset inference method is a practical auditing tool for detecting privacy leakage and the use of proprietary datasets in TFMs.

</details>


### [588] [An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24291)
*Nian Ran,Tianhe Jia,Zhengyang Mu,Yue Wang,Sebastian Brulin,Markus Olhofer,Mauricio A. Alvarez,Yang Liu,Richard Allmendinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"原理级搜索坍塌"（principle-level search collapse）概念，并构建跨分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择、GPU内核优化的诊断基准与判定协议，发现约78%的运行出现坍塌，且多样性注入等常规缓解手段收益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反馈驱动的LLM优化器在进化搜索、贝叶斯优化、启发式设计与科学发现中广泛应用，但常出现初期快速提升后长期停滞的现象。作者认为其原因不只是候选多样性不足，而是搜索被限制在狭窄的"设计原理"集合内，即使仍在生成不同候选、仍有小幅改进，也无法突破。现有评估仅看候选层面，掩盖了这一现象，因此需要专门诊断。

Method: 1) 构建覆盖分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择、GPU内核优化三个领域的诊断基准；2) 提出基于决策树的判定协议，综合三项证据：原理收窄、性能长期停滞、与可达参考解之间的差距；3) 在三个领域共161次可评估运行上检测坍塌；4) 测试常见"多样性注入"手段（提高温度t、多LLM集成、网络搜索）的效果；5) 测试参考原理干预（提供更优原理）能否缓解坍塌。

Result: 161次运行中78.3%获得坍塌支持，其中55.3%为强支持；候选层面的多样性可能掩盖原理层面的搜索受限。多样性注入收益有限且不一致：65次分子运行中仍有73.8%获支持、53.8%强支持。参考原理干预可改善部分运行，但效果因模型与任务而异——获得更优原理并不能保证被有效使用。

Conclusion: 原理级搜索坍塌是LLM优化器中普遍且隐蔽的失效模式，仅靠候选多样性或外部多样性刺激难以解决。需要在线坍塌检测机制，以及能持续生成并维持替代性设计原理的优化机制；所提出的基准与诊断协议可作为未来优化器的评估基础。

Abstract: Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

</details>


### [589] [Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24292)
*Ilay Kamai,Alex M. Bronstein,Hagai B. Perets*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于图拉普拉斯的平滑先验，利用已知的连续物理参数空间在近似对称条件下诱导表征的几何结构（如Toeplitz Gram结构与正弦模态），并在多模态恒星数据上验证了其有效性及对下游任务标签效率的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征中常出现由数据对称性诱导的几何结构，但当对称性仅为近似时，如何诱导这类结构尚不清楚。作者希望探究：已知的连续参数空间能否在对称性只是近似的情况下被用来诱导几何结构。

Method: 引入图拉普拉斯平滑先验，要求表征在物理参数空间上平滑变化，而不预设表征几何；在连续极限下，该先验会选出拉普拉斯特征函数，从而预测出与平移对称相关的类傅里叶几何。在跨越六个天文巡天的多模态恒星表征上施加该先验。

Result: 先验在恒星参数上诱导出Toeplitz Gram结构和正弦模态（包括原本缺乏该几何的模态），模态特异的残差仍保留施加坐标之外的结构。对称性精确时的预测中，可恢复的扭曲坐标下的平稳性成立，而关于精确量化或渐近速率的诊断不成立。该先验还提升了下游线性探测性能与标签效率。

Conclusion: 当存在有意义的连续参数空间时，其局部几何可作为数据驱动的先验，这是一种通用策略；仅在近似对称下也能诱导出类傅里叶的几何结构。

Abstract: Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

</details>


### [590] [Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24293)
*Sho Sonoda,Luca Galimberti,Yuanchao Xu,Isao Ishikawa,Masahiro Ikeda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将 ridgelet 变换推广到可分无穷维 Hilbert 空间上的连续映射（以方向空间上的高斯混合权代替不可用的 Lebesgue 测度），得到 Plancherel 恒等式与重构公式，进而给出算子学习的构造性普适逼近与显式误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有输入为函数的神经网络（算子学习）的普适性多为存在性论证（归结为有限维网络或 Stone–Weierstrass 型稠密性），只能说明逼近器存在，却无法刻画参数如何依赖目标函数。

Method: 构造性地扩展 ridgelet 变换至无穷维 Hilbert 空间：用带齐次混合的方向空间高斯权替代 Lebesgue 测度；推导含 frame 算子与权重诱导修正项的 Plancherel 恒等式和重构公式，为每个目标及每个容许分析滤波器分配显式系数测度；再对系数测度做 Monte Carlo 采样得到有限宽度网络。

Result: 对紧集上所有连续、非多项式、多项式增长的激活函数（含 ReLU）获得一致逼近；对全局 Lipschitz 激活及有限变差、二阶矩有限的系数，得到宽度 N 上无维数依赖的 O(N^{-1/2}) 误差；给出高斯目标与神经算子层等显式例子，并提供 Lean 4 机器验证形式化。

Conclusion: 该工作把算子学习的普适性从存在性推进到构造性，给出显式系数表示与收敛速率。

Abstract: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. From these representations we obtain uniform approximation on compact sets for all continuous non-polynomial activations of polynomial growth, including ReLU, and, by Monte Carlo sampling of the coefficient, finite-width networks with a dimension-free $O(N^{-1/2})$ error in the width $N$ for globally Lipschitz activations and coefficients with finite variation and second moments. Explicit examples include Gaussian targets and neural-operator layers. A companion Lean~4 formalization provides machine-checked proofs, with its correspondence to the manuscript documented at https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-operator-ridgelet/ .

</details>


### [591] [Predicting CVSS and CWE from CVE Descriptions with Fine-Tuned Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24297)
*Tara Dixit,Jessie Dong,Summer Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何仅凭漏洞文本描述自动补全CVSS v3.1向量、评分、严重等级与CWE，以应对NIST缩减CVE注释后的大量未标注漏洞。微调Phi-3.5-mini在2024年数据上达到69.9%（严重等级）与70.9%（CWE）准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年4月起NIST只标注高优先级CVE，大量新漏洞缺少CVSS向量、严重等级和CWE等分类信息，而安全团队依赖这些信息进行补丁分诊。

Method: 仅使用漏洞文本描述，预测CVSS v3.1八个基向量分量、基础评分、严重等级和CWE。为防止近重复描述泄漏，训练集仅用2022–2023年CVE，在36,325个可用的2024年CVE上评测。系统包括单卡M5 Pro上LoRA微调3.8B的Phi-3.5-mini（2.5小时）与TF-IDF逻辑回归基线，分数可由预测向量按CVSS公式计算。

Result: 微调模型严重等级准确率69.9%、CWE 70.9%、向量完全一致率48.8%，在各项指标上比TF-IDF逻辑回归高2.8–4.7个百分点（bootstrap区间显著）。零样本基础模型严重等级仅20.8%（2000样本），自报分数与自报向量一致仅3.4%。但由预测向量推导评分可将TF-IDF的关键漏洞召回率从50.7%提升至73.3%。两系统错误互补，至少一个系统预测正确严重等级的覆盖率75.8%。

Conclusion: 微调小模型可在低成本下有效补全CVE安全分类；由预测向量计算评分可显著提升关键漏洞召回，且不同系统错误互补，组合使用能提高覆盖率。

Abstract: Until April 2026, the National Vulnerability Database labeled nearly every published Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entry with a Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) v3.1 vector, a severity tier, and a Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) weakness type. Now, NIST enriches only the high priority CVEs, leaving many newly published vulnerabilities unlabelled with the classifiers that security teams use for patch triage. In CVE enrichment, we predict the eight base components of CVSS v3.1 vector, base score, severity tier, and CWE from the vulnerability's textual description alone. To prevent leakage between near-duplicate descriptions, all systems are trained only on CVEs published in 2022 and 2023. Results are evaluated on all 36,325 usable 2024 CVEs in the pinned NVD snapshot. All scores are either directly predicted, or calculated from predicted vectors using the CVSS formula. A fine-tuned 3.8B-parameter model Phi-3.5-mini, trained with LoRA in 2.5 hours on a single Apple M5 Pro chip, achieves 69.9% accuracy on severity and 70.9% on CWE. It matches the official vector exactly for 48.8% of test CVEs, outperforming TF-IDF logistic regression by 2.8 to 4.7 points on all accuracy metrics based on zero-exclusion paired bootstrap intervals. When we evaluate the base model with a zero-shot prompt, it achieves 20.8% accuracy on severity in a sample of 2,000 CVEs. In this same sample, its stated scores match its own vector precisely for only 3.4% of CVEs. However, deriving scores from predicted vectors boosts the critical recall of TF-IDF logistic regression from 50.7% to 73.3% with no additional cost. And since the errors of the fine-tuned model and TF-IDF affect different CVEs, at least one system matches the correct severity tier for 75.8% of test CVEs.

</details>


### [592] [Torch-DPhys: A Torch-Native, MOOSE-Compatible Framework for Differentiable Physics Simulation and Hybrid Machine Learning Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24301)
*Akzhol Almukhametov,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Torch-DPhys——基于 PyTorch 的可微物理仿真与物理-机器学习混合框架，实现 MOOSE THM/SAM 部分热工水力离散，并对接优化/控制/参数辨识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核工程中热工水力仿真与梯度优化、机器学习结合困难；传统参考代码（MOOSE/SAM）不易求导、不便 GPU 加速与求解器内训练。

Method: 用原生 PyTorch 张量残差实现选定的热工水力模型与离散，支持 CPU/GPU、部分数值内核编译与稀疏直接求解；灵敏度通过自动微分或收敛残差的离散伴随获得。验证用解析解、参考代码对比与导数校验。

Result: 覆盖平面应变弹性、单/双环路瞬态及轴对称熔盐快堆；与 SAM-Lite 对比 200 步自适应时间步下最大归一化场偏差 1.13e-5；伴随参数辨识从无噪声合成观测中恢复泵扬程与加热功率，相对误差<0.06%；三环路机组实现求解器在环的预测控制器训练。

Conclusion: 为核工程中基于梯度的推断、控制与耦合物理-机器学习模型提供基础平台。

Abstract: We present Torch-DPhys, a Torch-native framework implemented in PyTorch for differentiable physics simulation and hybrid physics-machine learning. It implements selected thermal-hydraulic modeling concepts and discretizations from MOOSE's Thermal Hydraulics Module and the System Analysis Module (SAM), with a preliminary extension to continuum mechanics. Native tensor residuals support CPU and GPU execution, compilation of selected numerical kernels, and sparse direct linear solves. Sensitivities are obtained by differentiating executed numerical operations or through discrete adjoints of converged residual equations. Verification combines analytical solutions, reference-code comparisons, and derivative checks. Demonstrations cover plane-strain elasticity, one- and two-loop thermal-hydraulic transients, and an axisymmetric molten-salt fast reactor. For the reactor, comparison with SAM-Lite gives a maximum normalized field discrepancy of 1.13 x 10^-5 over 200 adaptive time steps, demonstrating agreement between the tested discrete implementations. Selected transient sensitivities are assessed using tangent-linear calculations and finite differences on fixed time schedules. Two applications illustrate the framework's connection between simulation and optimization. A residual-adjoint parameter-identification calculation recovers nominal pump head and heating power with relative errors below 0.06% from noiseless synthetic MOOSE observations. A separate three-loop plant demonstration uses solver-in-the-loop training of a predictive controller by differentiating trajectory-level objectives through the thermal-hydraulic simulation. These examples illustrate a foundation for gradient-based inference, control, and coupled physics-machine learning models in nuclear engineering.

</details>


### [593] [Muon Operates Beyond the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24305)
*Niko Covic,Baraq Lipshitz,Alexander Padula,Stefan Visnjic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用锐度（sharpness）视角研究 Muon 优化器，首次实证了平坦极小值假设同样适用于 Muon，并分析其隐式预条件子以理解其稳定性行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 作为一种新优化器，其泛化与稳定性机制尚不清晰；作者希望验证经典的平坦极小值假设是否适用，并解释为何 Muon 能与 Adam/SGD 一样保持稳定。

Method: 在 CIFAR-10 上对 Muon、Adam、SGD 做实验，测量锐度与泛化间隙的相关性；理论推导 Muon 的隐式预条件子，并与 Adam、RMSprop 等对角预条件优化器的 Adaptive Edge of Stability 阈值进行比较。

Result: 各优化器内部锐度与泛化间隙强相关（Pearson r = 0.45–0.69，p ≤ 10⁻⁴），证实平坦极小值假设对 Muon 成立；但 Muon 在超过对角预条件优化器的经典锐度 A EoS 阈值时仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: Muon 运行在与对角自适应方法根本不同的区域内，其精确稳定性边界仍是未解问题。

Abstract: We study the Muon optimizer using sharpness and provide the first empirical evidence that the Flat Minima Hypothesis also applies to Muon. Further, we derive Muon's implicit preconditioner to analyze its potential Edge of Stability behavior. Experiments on CIFAR-10 show sharpness strongly correlates with generalization gap within each optimizer (Pearson $r = 0.45$-$0.69$, $p \leq 10^{-4}$), confirming the hypothesis holds for Muon similarly to Adam and SGD. However, Muon operates above the classical sharpness-based Adaptive Edge of Stability threshold that bounds diagonally-preconditioned optimizers like Adam and RMSprop, yet remains stable. Our findings suggest Muon operates in a fundamentally different regime than diagonally-adaptive methods. Defining the exact stability boundary for Muon remains an open question. All code is available at https://github.com/NikoCovic/DL-project.

</details>


### [594] [Learning Administrative Boundary-Aware Location Encoders via Reverse Geocoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24306)
*Lakshay Sharma,Alex Marin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督信号、学习行政边界感知位置编码器的方法，并设计定制架构RevGeoRQ，在下游任务上超越现有位置编码器且更具可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置编码器多用影像、气候变量或物种分布等连续/自然监督预训练，未显式捕捉对现实地理现象影响很大的行政边界与地名信息。

Method: 以反向地理编码得到的文本作为自监督训练信号；该方法可即插即用地应用于现有位置编码器架构；进一步提出针对反向地理编码监督定制的RevGeoRQ架构，采用残差量化语义ID。

Result: 在多种现有位置编码器上应用均带来下游性能的稳定提升；RevGeoRQ获得额外增益，在多个下游任务上超过当代位置编码器；同时提供更可解释的地理位置表示。

Conclusion: 行政边界感知的自监督信号能有效改进位置编码；人类可读的反向地理编码字符串与残差量化语义ID提升了可解释性；代码与模型权重将发布。

Abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

</details>


### [595] [Latent State Utilization in Probabilistic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24315)
*Zilei Shao,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用互信息分析概率电路（PC）中潜在状态的实际利用情况，发现HCLT在ImageNet32上学到的依赖增长缓慢且远低于上界与数据估计，据此测量样本对潜在状态的偏好强度与状态使用广度，并将早期测量用于初始化与树结构选择，提升最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在概率电路中加入潜在状态可提升表示能力，但对数似然的增益却递减，说明所学依赖可能远未用满潜在状态的容量，需要量化训练后的PC究竟表示了多少依赖、以及模型如何利用这些状态。

Method: 以互信息度量训练后PC表示的依赖，随潜在规模变化考察HCLT在ImageNet32上的表现，并与潜在状态上界、数据依赖估计对比；同时测量每个样本对特定潜在状态的偏好强度，以及各状态在整个数据集上的使用广度，并在训练过程中跟踪这些指标。

Result: 学到的依赖增长缓慢，且明显低于潜在状态上界和数据依赖估计；训练中呈现出早期后验快速集中、而后样本相关状态偏好更缓慢稳定化的两个阶段；早期测量可指导HCLT与HMM的初始化选择以及HCLT的树结构选择。

Conclusion: 用早期测量指导初始化与树选择的策略在所测试的各潜在规模上均改善了最终性能，说明对潜在状态利用情况的研究具有实际价值。

Abstract: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) are generative models that support efficient probabilistic inference. Adding latent states to a PC increases its representational capacity, but yields diminishing gains in likelihood. We use mutual information to examine how the dependence represented by a trained PC changes with latent size. Experiments with Hidden Chow-Liu Trees (HCLTs) on ImageNet32 show that learned dependence grows slowly and remains well below both the latent-state upper bound and estimates of dependence in the data. To understand how learning uses these states, we examine how strongly each sample favors particular latent states and how broadly states are used across the dataset. Tracking these measurements during HCLT training distinguishes rapid early posterior concentration from the more gradual stabilization of sample-dependent state preferences. Early measurements also guide initialization selection in HCLTs and hidden Markov models (HMMs), as well as tree selection in HCLTs. The resulting choices improve the ultimate performance across the tested latent sizes, providing a practical benefit from our study of latent-state utilization.

</details>


### [596] [Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24321)
*Aakriti,Manoj Cherukumalli,Prathamesh Patil,Leonidas Tsepenekas,Amit Varshney,Penghang Liu,Elizabeth Fons,Vamsi Potluru*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Morpheus-2.0 是一个紧凑的仅编码器时间序列基础模型，在单一可变时间网格上统一建模目标与协变量，通过双轴注意力与可训练门控同时处理变量间和时间维关系，并在训练中采样预测长度，实现一次训练覆盖多任务、多horizon、多分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用预测器需服务 schema、预测horizon、时间分辨率各异的任务：目标数与协变量数随数据集变化，horizon跨数量级，采样率从秒到年。现有时间序列基础模型仅部分解决这些问题——它们各自孤立地处理序列，或把两种网格关系分离在不同模块中，且在训练前就固定horizon与分辨率。

Method: 提出仅编码器架构 Morpheus-2.0，在单一可变时间网格上表示目标与协变量；每层并行运行双轴注意力：一条在某一时间步上跨变量，另一条在某变量内跨时间；用可学习门控逐层加权两轴，并用轴感知旋转编码保留两种网格坐标。训练时对预测长度进行采样，使一套权重覆盖短至长horizon且不增加推理成本。Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale 进一步同时支持多种时间分辨率，并按所预测序列加权。

Result: 在跨多领域、多频率的 GIFT-Eval 上，两模型提供互补的工作点：Morpheus-2.0（81M参数）取得0.685 relative MASE；更大的 Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale 取得0.646 relative MASE 与0.455 relative CRPS，两项指标均为已发表系统中最低。

Conclusion: 通过在单一可变时间网格上统一变量与时间两轴建模、并用训练期horizon采样与多分辨率加权实现通用性，Morpheus-2.0 系列以较小模型规模在 GIFT-Eval 上刷新相对 MASE 与 CRPS 的最优结果，验证了架构设计对异构预测任务的有效性。

Abstract: A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covariates changes from dataset to dataset, horizons vary by orders of magnitude, and sampling rates range from seconds to years. Existing time-series foundation models address these only in part, since they isolate each series or visit the two grid relations in separate blocks, and they fix the horizon and resolution before training begins. We introduce Morpheus-2.0, a compact encoder-only foundation model that represents targets and covariates on a single variable-time grid. Its dual-axis attention runs both relations side by side in every layer, one across variables at a timestep and one across time within a variable; a learned gate weights the two per layer, and an axis-aware rotary encoding preserves both grid coordinates. The forecast length is sampled during training, so one set of weights spans short to long horizons at no additional inference cost. Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale extends the model to several temporal resolutions at once, weighting them according to the series being forecast. Across GIFT-Eval, which spans several domains and frequencies, the two models give complementary operating points: Morpheus-2.0 attains 0.685 relative MASE with 81M parameters, while the larger Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale attains 0.646 relative MASE and 0.455 relative CRPS, the lowest of any published system on both metrics.

</details>


### [597] [PAC Learning with Query Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24332)
*Chase Hutton,Adam Melrod,Han Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带查询反馈的可实现多分类PAC学习，提出“查询维度”$D$——同时刻画假设类结构与查询区分标签能力的组合参数，并给出样本复杂度的上下界：下界$\Omega(D/\varepsilon)$，一般上界$\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$，在“均衡分割”查询族下紧至$\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典多分类PAC与bandit反馈学习已有维度刻画（如bandit DS维度），但更一般的查询反馈模型——每次仅得到一个关于“真实标签是否属于所选子集”的二元回答——缺乏统一的组合参数与样本复杂度刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 引入查询维度（query dimension）这一组合参数，它同时编码假设类结构与查询族区分标签的能力，并在单例查询下退化为bandit DS维度；基于该参数分别推导样本复杂度下界与上界，并针对可对任意候选集做近似均衡二分（comparable-size split）的查询族设计改进算法以获得更优上界。

Result: 样本复杂度下界为$\Omega(D/\varepsilon)$；一般情形上界为$\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$，忽略关于标签数与失败概率的polylog因子；当查询族能把每个候选集分成规模相当的两部分时，上界改进为$\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$，从而在对数因子意义下实现了对样本复杂度的完整刻画。

Conclusion: 查询维度为广义查询反馈下的可实现多分类PAC学习提供了统一的复杂度刻画，单例查询情形与已知bandit结论一致；均衡分割条件是消除上下界间多项式的关键，对数因子内的匹配说明该刻画基本紧致。

Abstract: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with query feedback, where each training example provides a single binary response indicating whether its true label belongs to a chosen subset from a fixed query family. Our main contribution is the query dimension, a combinatorial parameter that captures both the structure of the hypothesis class and the ability of the available queries to distinguish labels. This parameter generalizes the bandit DS dimension, which it recovers under singleton queries. We establish a sample-complexity lower bound of $Ω(D/\varepsilon)$ and an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$, suppressing factors polylogarithmic in the number of labels and the failure probability. When the available queries can split every candidate set into two parts of comparable size, we improve the upper bound to $\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$, yielding a characterization up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [598] [Power-Law Correlations Without Apparent Temperature-Tuned Criticality in Fixed-Tree Hierarchical Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24334)
*Marcel Kühn,Bernd Rosenow*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在受控的有限深度概率上下文无关文法（层级树）上，用信念传播计算精确条件概率并按 softmax 温度重标度采样，发现 token 间互信息始终呈幂律包络；温度改变相关幅度与拟合指数，但在可达系统尺寸内既无有序相的长程平台，也无向短程指数衰减的清晰过渡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样温度会显著改变自回归生成，但温度引起的长程相关变化究竟是"真实相变"还是"统计量的平滑变化"难以区分；作者希望在一个可控的类比系统中厘清哪些温度效应仅由层级结构本身产生。

Method: 构造固定层级树上的有限深度概率上下文无关文法作为温度采样的受控类比：用信念传播算法计算精确的下一 token 条件分布，再用 softmax 温度重标度后进行自回归采样；测量两点互信息随 token 间隔的函数关系，并通过近似映射到树上的 Ising 模型进行解释。

Result: 在所测试的温度与文法集合中，互信息均能被幂律包络很好地描述；温度改变相关幅度和拟合指数，但在可及系统尺寸内未发现有序相特有的长距离平台，也未出现向短程指数衰减的明确交叉。树上的 Ising 近似解释了树距离上的指数衰减如何转化为 token 距离上的幂律，从而无需调到特殊解码温度即可持续存在幂律。

Conclusion: 该受控基线表明，仅层级结构本身即可产生持续幂律相关与温度依赖的指数变化，而不必引入相变；这为后续加入训练、近似误差或神经架构因素时的温度效应分析提供了参照基准。

Abstract: Sampling temperature can substantially reshape autoregressive generation, but it is unclear when temperature changes in long-range correlations reflect a genuine phase transition rather than a smooth change in statistics. We study this question in a controlled analogue of temperature sampling: a finite-depth probabilistic context-free grammar on a fixed hierarchical tree, where exact next-token conditionals are computed by belief propagation and then rescaled by a softmax temperature before autoregressive sampling. We measure two-point mutual information between tokens as a function of separation. Across the tested temperatures and grammar ensembles, mutual information remains well described by a power-law envelope. Temperature changes the correlation magnitude and fitted exponent, but within the accessible system sizes we find no long-distance plateau characteristic of an ordered phase and no clear crossover to short-range exponential decay. An approximate mapping to an Ising model on a tree explains how exponential decay in tree distance becomes a power law in token distance, allowing power laws to persist without tuning to a special decoding temperature. This controlled baseline clarifies which temperature effects can arise from hierarchical structure alone, before adding training, approximation error, or neural architecture.

</details>


### [599] [Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24336)
*Noga Alon,Steve Hanneke,Shay Moran,Tom Waknine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在实值函数类的一致收敛问题上取得突破，首次同时达到最优逼近尺度γ和最优样本复杂度O(d/ε²)，其中d为尺度γ下的fat-shattering维数，从而填补了此前无法兼得两者的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值函数类的VC定理给出最坏情况样本复杂度Θ(d/ε²)，但实值函数的fat-shattering维数依赖逼近尺度γ。此前工作要么达到最优尺度、要么达到最优样本复杂度，无法兼得；本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 采用三件工具：(1)带边际的ε-net，允许网与略放大后的集合相交，从而在自然几何场景中获得与环境的维数无关的界；(2)改进的覆盖界，将Haussler覆盖引理推广到partial concept classes，并据此在最优尺度下得到实值函数类的ℓ2覆盖；(3)通过"对齐"覆盖使相邻近似相互靠近，得到最优尺度下的chaining界。

Result: 主结果为实值函数类建立了最优尺度下的尖锐样本复杂度O(d/ε²)（误差γ+ε），与二值类的最优样本界相匹配，且这三类工具本身也可能具有独立价值。

Conclusion: 本文解决了实值一致收敛中长期存在的尺度与样本复杂度不可兼得的问题，给出兼具最优尺度与最优样本复杂度的尖锐结论，并提供带边际ε-net、partial概念类的Haussler型覆盖引理与对齐式chaining等可复用技术。

Abstract: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $γ$. The challenge is to achieve error $γ+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $γ$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. Along the way, we use several tools that may be of independent interest. The first concerns $\varepsilon$-nets with margin. A classical $\varepsilon$-net intersects every set of mass at least $\varepsilon$ in a prescribed family; we allow the net to intersect a slightly enlarged version of each such set. Remarkably, this relaxation permits bounds independent of the ambient dimension in natural geometric settings. Second, we derive improved covering bounds in both discrete and real-valued settings: we extend Haussler's covering lemma to partial concept classes and use this extension to obtain $\ell_2$ covers at the optimal scale for real-valued function classes. Third, we obtain a chaining bound at the optimal scale by aligning the covers so that successive approximations become increasingly close to one another.

</details>


### [600] [The Certification Exponent: Instance-Optimal Sequential Certification of Policy Improvement from History Dependent Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24345)
*Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"从日志轨迹证明新策略优于已部署策略"所需的最少episode数，给出精确指数K*（日志律到"目标不改进"同动作概率律的最小KL散度），并证明该下界在δ→0时可由plug-in Kelly证书达到一阶最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署新策略前需要基于logged episodes的证书来保证其更优，但样本复杂度多少未知。此前的off-policy评估多关注估计器方差，缺少在已知但history-dependent日志策略下、对所有与日志一致的env都保证δ错误率时所需样本数的精确刻画。

Method: 定义指数K*为从日志律到"保持日志动作概率但目标不改进"的律的最小KL散度，由此导出任意δ下的期望episode下界log(1/δ)/K*。提出plug-in Kelly证书达到一阶最优速率；用一次backward induction计算coverage以判定K*=0/有限/∞三情形；通过凸对偶说明最优证书在重要性加权advantage上下注并在日志动作上做公平下注（DR控制变量是hedge而非估计器）；提出cushion certifier处理不可枚举的大树。

Result: 理论上：无任何off-policy估计器的选择能改变K*，coverage上限解释memory的curse，结构假设可用指数单位定价。实验中：plug-in中位停止时间为下界的1.13–1.43x（memory）、1.13–1.51x（Tiger, H≤5）、1.17–1.64x（随机树）；最好的标量下注基线需多达2.65x（memory）与4.1x（Tiger）的episodes，仅在少数浅随机树上DR下注快至多18%。

Conclusion: 证书的样本复杂度由信息论指数K*完全决定，plug-in Kelly证书在δ→0时一阶最优，且DR类估计器对极限速率无贡献。该框架将coverage、memory curse与结构假设统一在同一指数度量下，并可扩展到大型树。

Abstract: Before a new policy replaces a deployed one, we often want a certificate, computed from logged episodes, that it is better. We ask how many episodes such a certificate needs when the logging policy is known but history-dependent, and the error probability must stay below $δ$ in every environment consistent with the logs. The answer is an exponent $K^\star$: the smallest KL divergence from the logged law to a law with the same logged action probabilities under which the target does not improve. No sound certifier stops in fewer than $\log(1/δ)/K^\star$ expected episodes, at any $δ$, and whenever $0<K^\star<\infty$ a plug-in Kelly certifier attains this rate to first order as $δ\to0$. Coverage, computed by one backward induction, decides whether certification is impossible ($K^\star=0$), possible at a finite rate, or possible in a constant number of episodes ($K^\star=\infty$). By convex duality, the optimal certificate bets on the importance-weighted advantage and also places fair bets on the logged actions, so doubly robust control variates act as hedges rather than estimators. As a consequence, no choice of off-policy estimator changes $K^\star$, a coverage ceiling explains the curse of memory, and structural assumptions can be priced in exponent units. A cushion certifier extends the approach to trees too large to enumerate. In experiments the plug-in's median stopping time is 1.13-1.43x the lower bound on memory tasks, 1.13-1.51x on Tiger ($H\le5$) and 1.17-1.64x on random trees. The best scalar betting baselines need up to 2.65x (memory) and 4.1x (Tiger) the plug-in's episodes; only on a few shallow random trees is a doubly robust bet faster, by at most 18%.

</details>


### [601] [Measuring the Task Value of Precision Upgrades in Closed-Loop Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24346)
*Sicheng Lyu,Xinyu Wang,Yu Gu,Lei Ding,Ziyang Song,Xiao-Wen Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出应以"救回任务数减去破坏任务数"的净收益来评估低精度智能体中BF16回退的价值，并通过交叉配对分支实验分离单步动作替换、后续执行接管及两者兼有的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作假设插入BF16动作总是有益，但实际上一次BF16动作既能拯救失败任务，也可能破坏成功任务；同时，增益可能来自任何扰动而非"更多比特"，因此需要严格衡量真实干预的净价值。

Method: 在Qwen3智能体（模拟4-bit权重）与tau2-bench上，从恢复的状态出发运行配对分支，交叉"哪个模型给出当前动作"与"哪个模型继续执行"，从而分离动作替换、执行接管与二者结合三种干预；并设置两个同精度参照（第二个4-bit检查点、工具参数键重排）与不确定性触发基线。

Result: 仅替换首个分歧动作会改变许多任务结果，但救回与破坏几乎抵消，留出telecom任务上估计为负；动作+执行同时替换在5个探索性更低比特压力设置中有2个为正。第二4-bit检查点替换改变的结果数与BF16替换相当；仅重排工具参数键（调用本身不变）也能改变结果。不确定性触发找到更多结果变化，但净收益仍在随机范围内。

Conclusion: 应在预期续执行条件下、以带符号的任务收益并与同精度参照对比来评估每个回退，然后再把增益归因于更高精度；不同检查点间BF16相对于另一4-bit模型在常见状态下的额外价值仍未确定。

Abstract: A low-precision agent can call its full-precision (BF16) model at selected decisions as a fallback. A learned precision router chooses where to call it from the disagreement between the two models and is judged by end-to-end success. An inserted BF16 action, however, can rescue a failing task or damage a succeeding one. We argue that a fallback's value is the number of tasks it saves minus the number it spoils, measured for the intervention that will actually run. From restored states, we run paired branches that cross which model supplies the current action with which model continues, separating replacement of one action, takeover of later execution, and both. On Qwen3 agents with simulated 4-bit weights in tau2-bench, replacing the first action where the two models differed in tool use changed many task outcomes, but rescues and damages nearly cancelled, and on held-out telecom tasks the action-only estimate was negative. Replacing both the action and the continuation had a positive net gain in two of five exploratory lower-bit stress settings. Two references changed outcomes at fixed bit width: replacing an action with that of a second 4-bit checkpoint changed about as many outcomes as replacing it with the BF16 action, and reordering tool-argument keys changed outcomes while the executed tool call stayed identical. At common states, the additional value of the BF16 action over that checkpoint remained unresolved. A frozen uncertainty trigger found more outcome changes than random selection, while its net benefit stayed within the range of random selection. We recommend evaluating each fallback by its signed task benefit under the intended continuation, against same-precision references, before attributing gains to more bits.

</details>


### [602] [Exact Risk Certificates for Pairwise-Judged Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24347)
*Xinyu Wang,Jingrui Tian,Sicheng Lyu,Yu Gu,Ziyang Song,Xiao-Wen Chang,Lei Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将成对相关性判断对nDCG分子与理想排序分母的双重约束建模，刻画了用固定候选排序替代时的最坏情况损失，并给出可验证的阈值检验与实证节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对相关性判断同时约束nDCG的损失分子与理想排序分母，导致基于部分判断的排序评估与验证存在不确定性；需要严格刻画这种耦合带来的最坏情况损失，并能对给定候选排序进行可靠验证。

Method: 刻画替换真实排序为固定候选排序时的精确最坏情况损失；证明二元增益可达该损失并提供可检验的见证；将阈值验证归约为至多K+1个最大闭包问题；通过exposure-flow消融分离分母耦合的影响。

Result: 在共享评审轨迹上，32次比较预算下，精确验证在TREC-DL每个开发查询节省2.34次比较、每个确认查询节省1.98次；节省效果可迁移到BEIR与第二个候选排序器。预测性门控获得更高的部署增益，而证书揭示了在已接受比较下仍可能允许的最差增益。

Conclusion: 成对判断的分子—分母耦合可被精确刻画并可高效验证；精确验证与预测性门控结合能在有限评审预算下提升评估效率，同时证书为部署增益提供可审计的最坏情况保证。

Abstract: Pairwise relevance judgments constrain both the loss numerator and the ideal-ranking denominator of nDCG. We characterize the exact worst-case loss of replacing a ranking with a fixed proposal. Binary gains attain this loss and provide an inspectable witness. Threshold verification reduces to at most $K+1$ maximum-closure problems. Our exposure-flow ablation isolates denominator coupling: on shared judge trajectories, exact verification saves 2.34 comparisons per TREC-DL development query and 1.98 per confirmation query at a budget of 32. Savings transfer to BEIR and a second proposer. Predictive gates achieve higher deployment gains, while certificates expose the worst gains still permitted by accepted comparisons.

</details>


### [603] [Revisiting Smoothed Online Learning: Competitive Ratio, Dynamic Regret with Switching Cost, and Best of Both Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24370)
*Lijun Zhang,Linzhe He,Wei Jiang,Shiyin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视平滑在线学习（smoothed online learning），提出了竞争比更优的算法、带切换代价的最优动态遗憾，以及best-of-both-worlds保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有平滑在线学习算法在命中代价与切换代价权衡上的竞争比等保证不够理想，作者希望显著改进竞争比、实现带切换代价的最优动态遗憾，并在无界梯度下获得best-of-both-worlds保证。

Method: 1) 对α-polyhedral命中代价（ℓ2切换代价）仅最小化命中代价，得max(1,2/α)-竞争比，并证明α≥1时该界紧；2) 对λ-quadratic growth命中代价（平方ℓ2切换代价）仅最小化命中代价得1+4/λ竞争比；对凸λ-quadratic growth用加权命中+切换代价和得1+2/√λ竞争比；3) 提出Smoothed Ader (SAder) 用于ℓ2切换代价下动态遗憾，其lookahead版本去除有界梯度假设；4) 提出UDNP在lookahead设定下聚合任意两个专家，用于有界凸域上的凸命中代价。

Result: 仅最小化命中代价在polyhedral情形达到max(1,2/α)竞争比（对naive算法紧且给出匹配下界），quadratic情形分别达1+4/λ与1+2/√λ。SAder在标准OCO下达最优O(√(T(1+P_T)))动态遗憾，并给出匹配下界证明lookahead版本最优性。UDNP的额外累积代价相对第一个专家至多O(1)，相对第二个至多O(√(T log T))，无需有界梯度即得best-of-both-worlds保证。

Conclusion: 通过简化目标（仅最小化命中代价或加权和）即可显著改进平滑在线学习的竞争比且部分界紧；SAder实现最优动态遗憾并支持无界梯度的lookahead；UDNP在有界凸域上以低额外代价实现无界梯度下的best-of-both-worlds专家聚合。

Abstract: We revisit smoothed online learning and develop algorithms with improved competitive ratios, optimal dynamic regret with switching cost, and best-of-both-worlds guarantees. Surprisingly, minimizing the hitting cost alone is $\max(1,\frac{2}α)$-competitive for $α$-polyhedral functions under the $\ell_2$-norm switching cost and $1+\frac{4}λ$-competitive for $λ$-quadratic growth functions under the squared $\ell_2$-norm switching cost, significantly improving existing guarantees. The polyhedral bound is tight for this naive algorithm, and we establish a matching lower bound for $α\geq1$. For convex $λ$-quadratic growth hitting costs, minimizing a suitably weighted sum of hitting and squared $\ell_2$-norm switching costs yields a competitive ratio of $1+\frac{2}{\sqrtλ}$. For dynamic regret with the $\ell_2$-norm switching cost, we develop Smoothed Ader (SAder), which achieves the optimal $O(\sqrt{T(1+P_T)})$ rate in the standard online convex optimization setting, where $P_T$ is the comparator's path-length. Its lookahead version removes the bounded-gradient assumption, and a matching lower bound establishes optimality in this setting. Finally, for convex hitting costs on a bounded convex domain, we develop UDNP to aggregate any two experts in the lookahead setting under both switching costs. Its additional cumulative cost is at most $O(1)$ relative to the first expert and $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ relative to the second, yielding best-of-both-worlds guarantees without bounded gradients.

</details>


### [604] [Cross-Dimension and Cross-Modality Relational Tensor Representation Learning for Multimodal Health Data Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24419)
*Jiawei Guo,Meng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Relational Tensor Representation (RTR)统一框架，联合学习维度特定张量表示与跨维度、跨模态关系，在情感识别和脑活动分类任务上优于张量学习、多模态融合和Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态健康数据来自异构临床来源，需同时建模模态内与跨模态的复杂依赖关系，以支撑数据驱动决策；现有方法难以在保留张量各维度与模态结构身份的同时捕捉跨维、跨模态关系。

Method: RTR框架：引入可学习的关系桥接矩阵（relational bridge matrices），在维持关系信息的同时保留张量各维度与模态的结构身份；配合结构化融合机制，将因子级与关系级信息整合为紧凑表示用于下游预测。

Result: 在模拟数据及两个多模态神经生理数据集（情感识别、脑活动分类）上，RTR持续优于代表性张量学习、多模态融合及Transformer类基线；代码计划开源。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨维度与跨模态关系有助于从异构多模态张量数据中学习有信息量的表示，RTR为此提供了可行统一框架。

Abstract: Multimodal health data integrate information from heterogeneous clinical sources, creating substantial opportunities for data-driven decision support. Realizing these opportunities, however, requires effectively modeling complex dependencies that arise both within individual modalities and across modalities. This paper proposes Relational Tensor Representation (RTR), a unified framework that jointly learns dimension-specific tensor representations and cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships. RTR introduces learnable relational bridge matrices that maintain relational information while preserving the structural identities of tensor dimensions and modalities. A structured fusion mechanism further integrates factor-level and relationship-level information into compact representations for downstream prediction. Experiments on simulated data and two multimodal neurophysiological datasets, covering emotion recognition and brain activity classification, demonstrate that RTR consistently outperforms representative tensor learning, multimodal fusion, and Transformer-based baselines. These results highlight the value of explicitly modeling cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships for learning informative representations from heterogeneous multimodal tensor data. The source code is planned for public release to support reproducibility and future research.

</details>


### [605] [Transport What Shares the Conduction Pathway: Normal-Anchored SPD Geometric Transport for Source-Free Patient Adaptation of Holter and Patch ECG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24430)
*JinKook Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出正常锚定几何传输（NAGT），利用每段记录前5分钟无标签的正常心搏锚点，估计闭式SPD同余映射，仅调整正常与室上性原型而固定室性与融合原型，实现ECG心搏分类的无源域自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECG心搏分类器在新患者/新设备上精度下降；现有无源自适应方法假设目标批次类别均衡，但真实记录的无标签前缀中正常心搏占87.9–98.6%，导致这些方法失效。

Method: 从每段记录前5分钟的无标签正常锚点估计闭式对称正定（SPD）同余映射，仅作用于正常和室上性原型，室性与融合原型保持不动；分数偏移和决策规则仅在MIT-BIH上设定，采用速率不变的RR头（relA），并在Icentia11k胸贴数据上按预注册协议一次性评估冻结模型。

Result: 493名患者（973段记录，3,615,388个心搏）中，NAGT的宏观F1 J=48.7% [95% CI 42.1, 54.7]，无自适应为34.5%（ΔJ=+14.1 [+8.6,+19.3] pp；非AF组为59.8% vs 43.9%），优于全部五个Holm校正比较方法（含AdaBN、Tent、T3A）。历史划分的75人测试亚组（分析73人）增益不显著（+6.1 [-8.5,+23.4] pp）。每段记录自适应中位耗时5.8 ms，无需反向传播。

Conclusion: NAGT在类别极度不平衡的真实ECG记录上显著提升心搏分类性能且计算高效，但在小样本亚组上增益不显著，泛化证据仍有限。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) beat classifiers lose accuracy on new patients and devices, and source-free adaptation methods that assume class-balanced target batches fail on real recordings, whose label-free prefix is 87.9--98.6% normal beats. We propose Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT, GA_NS), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal anchors in the first 5 min of each recording and applies it only to the normal and supraventricular prototypes, keeping the ventricular and fusion prototypes fixed. The score offsets and decision rules were set on MIT-BIH only; the rate-invariant RR head (relA) was adopted after the development databases (INCART, SVDB) had been opened; the frozen model was then evaluated once on Icentia11k chest-patch recordings under a pre-registered protocol. In 493 patients (973 recordings, 3,615,388 evaluated beats), NAGT reached an arrhythmia macro-$F_1$ $J = \frac{1}{2}(\text{S-}F_1 + \text{V-}F_1) = 48.7\%$ [95% CI 42.1, 54.7] versus 34.5% without adaptation ($ΔJ = +14.1$ [+8.6, +19.3] pp; 59.8% versus 43.9% in non-AF) and outperformed all five Holm-adjusted comparators, including AdaBN, Tent and T3A. In the 75-patient test subgroup of the historical split (73 analyzed), the gain was not significant (+6.1 [-8.5, +23.4] pp). Adaptation takes a median of 5.8 ms per record without back-propagation.

</details>


### [606] [Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24441)
*Zhaiming Shen,Alexander Cloninger,Rongjie Lai,Wenjing Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明 Transformer 的注意力机制可充当自适应各向异性核学习器，在低秩线性与多指标非线性回归中，学到的注意力分数接近对应函数类的 oracle 核，并据此建立 ICL 泛化误差分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论工作将注意力机制与核方法联系，但通常把核函数视为固定的；而实际中 query/key 矩阵可训练，使注意力成为自适应核方法，这一自适应性质缺乏理论与数值刻画。

Method: 研究低秩线性回归与多指标非线性回归下的 ICL；用数值模拟显示学到的注意力分数接近 oracle 核；再构建将 Transformer 与各类 oracle 核估计器相联系的通用框架，用宽而浅的 Transformer 给出 oracle 核估计器的显式构造式实现，说明 query token 与上下文 token 的交互如何进行预测。

Result: 数值实验表明注意力分数与低秩线性、多指标非线性函数类的 oracle 核高度相似；理论上给出这些 oracle 核估计器在宽浅 Transformer 中的显式构造，并由此导出 ICL 的泛化误差分析。

Conclusion: 注意力机制通过学习 query/key 矩阵实现对各向异性核的自适应，线性与非线性设定下均有数值与理论证据；该工作补充了现有将注意力视为（固定）核方法的研究。

Abstract: Transformers have emerged as a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, with in-context learning (ICL) enabling models to adapt to new tasks by conditioning on prompts, without any parameter updates. To understand the attention mechanism in transformer blocks, a growing line of theoretical work interprets ICL through the lens of classical statistical estimators. Recent works have established a connection between the attention mechanism and kernel methods, while the kernel function is usually assumed to be fixed. In practice, the query and key matrices in the attention mechanism are trained, which allows the attention mechanism to serve as an adaptive kernel method. In this work, we demonstrate that transformers can act as adaptive anisotropic kernel learners. Specifically, we study ICL for low-rank linear and multi-index nonlinear regressions, and conduct numerical simulations to show that the learned attention scores closely resemble the oracle kernels for these function classes. We then develop a general framework to analyze the generalization error of ICL by connecting transformers to the oracle kernel estimator for each function class. Our theory gives an explicit and constructive implementation of the oracle kernel estimators for these function classes using a wide and shallow transformer architecture, illustrating how the prediction is carried out by the interaction between the query token and the context tokens. Our work complements existing studies by providing numerical and theoretical evidence of how the attention mechanism adapts to anisotropic kernels in both linear and nonlinear settings.

</details>


### [607] [Near-Optimal Regret for Semi-Bandit Learning of Monotone Stochastic Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24446)
*Zhengjia Zhuo,Viswanath Nagarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为一大类"单调"随机优化问题（先知不等式、潘多拉魔盒、系列测试、随机背包、随机匹配等）在只知道半赌博反馈下学习近似最优策略，弱单调问题达到 Õ(√nkT)  regret，强单调问题达到 Õ(√nT)，较此前最好结果改进 √n 倍，且 n、T 依赖已匹配 MAB 的 Ω(√nT) 下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实分布未知时如何学习（近似）最优随机优化策略，且每期只能得到被策略选中随机变量的半赌博反馈；已有 regret 界在 n 上不够紧，希望达到最优的 n、T 依赖。

Method: 提出适用于大 class 单调随机问题的统一算法；核心技术是用 Hellinger 距离刻画真实分布与学习分布之间的"误差"，并证明相依随机变量的 Hellinger 距离满足常数因子链式法则（constant-factor chain rule）。

Result: 弱单调问题 regret 为 Õ(√nkT)，强单调问题为 Õ(√nT)（T 期数，n 变量数，k 单变量最大支撑集大小）；比先前界改进 √n 倍，且 n、T 依赖达到 MAB 的 Ω(√nT) 下界意义下的最优。

Conclusion: Hellinger 距离加链式法则是分析半赌博反馈下随机优化学习的有力工具，可统一处理先知不等式、Pandora's box、series testing、随机背包与随机匹配等问题，并给出接近信息论最优的 regret。

Abstract: We consider the task of learning an (approximately) optimal policy for stochastic optimization problems where the true distributions are unknown. In each period, the algorithm plays a policy for the stochastic problem and observes semi-bandit feedback, i.e., it only receives new samples from the random variables that were selected by the policy. We obtain an algorithm that works for a large class of ``monotone'' stochastic problems, including prophet inequality, Pandora's box, series testing, stochastic knapsack and stochastic matching. We obtain $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nkT})$ regret for ``weakly'' monotone problems and $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$ regret for ``strongly'' monotone problems, where $T$ is the number of periods, $n$ is the problem dimension (number of random variables) and $k$ is the maximum support size of any random variable. This improves over previous regret bounds by a $\sqrt{n}$ factor. In fact, our dependence on $n$ and $T$ is the best-possible due the $Ω(\sqrt{nT})$ lower bound for multi-armed-bandits. Our main technique is the use of Hellinger distance in bounding the ``error'' between the true and learned distributions, and the use of a constant-factor chain rule for the Hellinger distance of dependent random variables.

</details>


### [608] [Generative Retrieval for Reverse Target Fishing with a Proteome-Scale Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24458)
*Zhichao Deng,Haichuan Tan,Xin Hong,Huaizhi Wang,Tao Huang,Bowen Gao,Yanyan Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将逆向靶点预测重构为生成式检索任务，提出GenFish（用残差向量量化把蛋白语言模型特征转为共享语义标识符，自回归建模）及蛋白质组规模基准ProTargetBench，性能超越判别式与非神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆向靶点垂钓（给定分子找靶蛋白）受稀疏长尾关联和"非随机缺失"测量困扰：把未记录配对当作负样本会压制真实靶点，判别式虚拟筛选方法因此受限。

Method: 将任务改写为生成式检索。用残差向量量化把冻结的蛋白语言模型特征转换为共享语义标识符；给定分子指纹，自回归地在查询与前面code的条件下生成标识符，按标识符似然排序蛋白，无需显式标注未记录配对为负样本。另构建ProTargetBench基准（20,431个UniProt审阅人类蛋白，整合生物活性证据，区分实验无活性与未测量）。

Result: 在198个留出分子上，GenFish在三项全目录检索指标上的平均表现优于四个判别式神经基线、三个非神经基线和基于配体的方法。正样本隐藏实验表明定向移除假阴性竞争比随机掩码更能改善对比检索；在相同不完整监督下GenFish更强。Pfam比对显示语义标识符捕捉了有生物学意义的蛋白关系。

Conclusion: 生成式检索是在不完整生物活性记录下进行逆向靶点垂钓的原则性范式。

Abstract: Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. Covering 20,431 UniProt-reviewed human proteins, it integrates curated bioactivity evidence and distinguishes experimental inactivity from unmeasured associations. On 198 held-out molecules, GenFish achieves higher mean performance across all three full-catalogue retrieval metrics than four discriminative neural baselines and three non-neural baselines, including ligand-based methods. A controlled positive-hiding experiment shows that targeted removal of false-negative competition improves contrastive retrieval beyond matched random masking; GenFish remains stronger under the same incomplete supervision. Pfam alignment indicates that the semantic identifiers capture biologically meaningful relationships among proteins. These results establish generative retrieval as a principled paradigm for reverse target fishing under incomplete bioactivity records.

</details>


### [609] [Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24461)
*Ishir Garg,Vivek Myers,Qiyang Li,Catherine Ji,Benjamin Eysenbach,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个仅用无标注先验数据、无需环境交互即可估计empowerment的方法，并将其用于提升在线目标条件强化学习中的探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic任务虽有大量离线先验数据，但如何用这些数据高效地指导在线阶段的探索研究不足。empowerment可衡量状态需要多少探索，但已有估计方法都依赖在线rollout，成本高且不适用。

Method: 联合学习一个最大化empowerment的策略及其折扣状态占用度量（discounted state-occupancy measure），从而可从任意未知策略生成的无标注轨迹上训练出empowerment估计器，全程无需环境交互。

Result: 估计器在定性上给出符合直觉的empowerment度量；预训练的估计器可用于改善在线目标条件强化学习的探索效果。

Conclusion: offline估计的empowerment可作为有效先验来指导在线探索，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unknown policy. We demonstrate that our empowerment estimator qualitatively gives intuitive empowerment measures and show that the pretrained estimator can be used to improve exploration in the online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning setting.
