Result: 等范数权重后处理在5:1至100:1不平衡区间显著提升尾类与平均精度（CIFAR-100/ViT上100:1时+32.0尾类、+16.0平均），符号在两个骨干网络与两个数据集上一致；但在近平衡（<3:1）时损失约5.4平均精度。等角几何在目标侧完全无效，在权重侧则有害，常不如one-hot。

Conclusion: 神经坍缩几何在ACL中真正有用的是分类器权重的等范数后处理，且优势随类别不平衡加剧；等角性最多是无操作，最坏会诱发灾难遗忘。

Abstract: Analytic continual learning (ACL) methods such as ACIL and GACL fit a ridge-regression classifier head on frozen features via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity, achieving exemplar-free, exact updates. A separate line of work, Progressive Neural Collapse (ProNC), shows standard continual classifiers benefit from a progressively expanding Simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) target. It is natural to ask whether fusing the two ideas, exact analytic updates and ETF targets, would yield a better closed-form continual learner. We show this is not the case as the fusion turns out to be identical to plain one-hot ACIL. Further, Simplex ETFs are not nested across class counts, so the literal "progressively expand the ETF" construction stops yielding an ETF as new tasks arrive, and it introduces catastrophic forgetting ($4\times$ that of a classic ACIL head). We therefore separate an ETF's two defining properties, equiangularity and equinormality, and apply each on its own to the classifier weights rather than the targets, where the invariance above does not hold. Equinorm post-processing of the fitted weights recovers both tail-class and overall average accuracy across the long-tailed regime from 5:1 to 100:1 imbalance (e.g. +32.0 tail-accuracy points and +16.0 average-accuracy points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT), transferring in sign across two backbones and two datasets, at a mild cost of 5.4 average-accuracy points on CIFAR-100/ViT on near-balanced streams (below $\approx 3{:}1$). Equiangular geometry, by contrast, is exactly inert on the target side but actively harmful on the weight side, usually losing to plain one-hot. Hence, the generally useful part of Neural Collapse geometry in Analytic Continual Learning is equinorm post-processing of the weights, becoming more useful as class imbalance grows; and equiangularity is at best a no-op and induces catastrophic forgetting at worst.

</details>


### [646] [LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24855)
*Nian Ran,Sebastian Brulin,Markus Olhofer,Mauricio A. Álvarez,Richard Allmendinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 REP-HO，用大语言模型（LLM）替代人工设计的混合保真度选择规则，作为异构优化中的评估规划器，并验证其性能与自适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构优化中需同时决定评估哪些解、哪些目标与约束（成本与保真度不同）。现有 SOTA（如 MFE-NSGA-III）依赖手工设计的选择指标与启发式规则、超参数，行为受预设规则束缚，缺乏灵活性。

Method: REP-HO 将基于规则的混合保真度选择步骤替换为 LLM 规划器，输入与启发式规划器相同的原始优化状态信息（代理预测、不确定性、评估成本、预算状态）。进一步引入自适应最近邻摘要来增强每个决策，形成两个变体（含 REP-HO(Deepseek)）。

Result: 基础版本与 MFE-NSGA-III 性能相当；加入最近邻摘要后结果更好更稳定。在成本不平衡、约束难度、代理保真度、预算水平、目标冲突五类异构情形中，两个变体中总有一个取得最佳平均排名分，REP-HO(Deepseek) 始终位列前二；并表现出自适应分配行为（预算紧张时优先约束评估、代理可靠性变化时重新分配约束评估预算）。

Conclusion: LLM 可作为异构优化的灵活评估规划器，为固定手工指标提供通用替代方案。局限在于仅与单一基线比较、依赖提示与外部 LLM 成本等因素未充分讨论。

Abstract: Heterogeneous optimization problems require an optimizer to decide not only which candidate solutions to evaluate, but also which objectives and constraints should be evaluated under different costs and fidelities. Existing SOTA methods such as MFE-NSGA-III address this setting with manually designed selection metrics, but their behavior is largely determined by predefined heuristic rules and hyperparameters. In this work, we propose REP-HO, a reasoning-based evaluation planner that replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step with a large language model (LLM) planner. The LLM receives the same primitive optimization-state information as the heuristic planner, such as surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs, and budget status. We first show that REP-HO achieves competitive performance compared to the human-designed metric-based method (MFE-NSGA-III). We then further enhance each decision with an adaptive nearest-neighbor summary, leading to better and more stable results. We evaluate REP-HO across five heterogeneous regimes covering cost imbalance, constraint difficulty, surrogate fidelity, budget level, and objective conflict. Across these regimes, one of the two variants obtains the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(Deepseek) is first or second throughout, and the planner shows adaptive allocation behavior, such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets and reallocating constraint evaluation budget when surrogate reliability changes. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as flexible evaluation planners for heterogeneous optimization, offering a general alternative to fixed hand-designed metrics.

</details>


### [647] [FlowMaker: From Tasks to Cost-Efficient Generative AI Workflow Deployments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24861)
*Dimitrios Liakopoulos,Prasoon Sinha,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowMaker 面向生成式 AI 工作流服务，联合优化工作流结构、模型选择与部署配置，并提出约束引导的负载感知剪枝算法实现快速在线决策，吞吐提升最高 10.14×、成本降低最高 2.77×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统对工作流结构、模型分配和部署配置的决策是孤立的或提前固定，在动态负载和资源约束下导致成本和有效吞吐（goodput）次优；且 LLM 复用必须在线进行，因为其取决于当前负载与资源可用性。

Method: 提出 FlowMaker，向上暴露任务级接口并代用户选择“工作流变体”（工作流+模型+部署配置的组合）；核心是约束引导的负载感知剪枝算法，在动态集群状态下快速进行组合空间探索与在线复用决策。

Result: 相比包括 Murakkab 在内的 SOTA 基线，goodput 最高提升 10.14×，成本最高降低 2.77×。

Conclusion: 将工作流、模型与部署配置的联合优化视为时间敏感问题并在线求解，可显著提升生成式 AI 工作流服务的成本效率；未来可扩展到更复杂工作流与更细粒度调度。

Abstract: Generative AI workflows execute user tasks by composing sequences of LLM calls, where each call performs a sub-task (e.g., summarization or translation), forming a workflow. Executing such workflows requires decisions over workflow structure, model assignments, and deployment configurations, which jointly determine latency, cost, and accuracy under dynamic workloads and resource constraints. Existing systems optimize these decisions in isolation or fix them early, leading to suboptimal cost and goodput. We make two key observations. First, efficient serving requires jointly exploring all combinations of workflows, model choices, and deployment configurations under dynamic cluster state. Second, reuse of deployed LLMs is critical for reducing cost, but must be performed on-the-fly, as reuse depends on current load and resource availability. Together, these make selecting a workflow-variant-a combination of workflow, models, and deployment configuration-a time-critical problem. We present FlowMaker, which exposes a task-level interface and selects workflow-variants on behalf of users. To realize this, we design a constraint-guided load-aware pruning algorithm for fast, on-the-fly decisions. FlowMaker improves goodput by up to 10.14$\times$ and reduces cost by up to 2.77$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines, including Murakkab.

</details>


### [648] [RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24875)
*Yue Dai,Sarah Zhou,Youtao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAFT 是一个面向时序图神经网络（TGNN）训练的效率框架，通过追踪节点记忆变化来识别输入冗余，过滤掉不必要的预测目标事件和历史支撑事件，在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著减少训练工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序图规模快速增长，训练需处理的事件数量不断上升；每个事件会更新后续事件所依赖的节点记忆，形成难以并行化的依赖链，导致额外算力难以带来收益。因此作者提出上游问题：是否所有事件及其引入的依赖对学习都是必要的？

Method: 作者从两类事件角色（预测目标、被采样作为输入的历史事件）入手观察：依赖稳定节点记忆的目标事件预测损失较低；过滤与稳定记忆相关的历史事件后，训练损失轨迹仍能保持相近。基于此提出基于记忆变化的冗余识别机制，并构建 RAFT 框架，包含两个过滤器：root-event filter 在训练前移除部分预测目标，support-event filter 在采样时排除部分历史上下文。过滤在下游预处理之前完成，从而削减其触发的计算量。

Result: 在三种 TGNN 模型和五个数据集上，RAFT 平均减少训练输入 35.23%，最高减少 97.11%；记录的训练时间最高减少 52.56%，且模型精度变化可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 节点记忆的变化可作为识别时序图训练输入冗余的有效信号；在事件准备与处理前进行输入过滤，是一种高效且对精度友好的 TGNN 训练加速策略。

Abstract: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

</details>


### [649] [Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24880)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自然actor-critic方法用于一般效用强化学习（RLGU），直接学习策略梯度的伪奖励而非先估计占用测度，并给出O(T^{-1/2})全局收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般效用RL需要优化策略诱导占用测度的非线性泛函，传统方法先估计占用测度再构造伪奖励，存在偏差与复杂度问题；需在无限状态-动作空间和更广泛效用类上获得可证明的收敛与采样复杂度。

Method: 针对具有精确变分对偶表示的凹RLGU目标（覆盖一类可分离占用效用），用神经网络critic直接学习伪奖励；critic采用投影随机更新训练，并用多层蒙特卡洛跨训练时域组合输出以对数期望代价控制偏差；分析中分离条件actor偏差与估计器二阶矩，并显式处理对偶优化、critic近似与神经线性化误差。

Result: 在策略迁移、对偶稳定性与局部critic正则条件下，达到超过策略、critic类与有限宽度近似误差的O~(T^{-1/2})全局收敛，期望环境转移与参考样本均为O~(T)；固定critic表示时采样复杂度为O~(ε^{-2})，适用于无限状态-动作空间及超越固定有限回报向量的占用效用。

Conclusion: 避开占用测度估计的直接伪奖励学习结合多层蒙特卡洛偏差控制，可为一般效用RL提供有理论保证且可扩展到无限空间的高效自然actor-critic框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

</details>


### [650] [Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24897)
*Romeo Passaro,Jeongjae Lee,Jong Chul Ye,Michael M. Bronstein,Yoshua Bengio,Alexander Tong,Danyal Rehman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 DFR（分布函数型奖励），将 KL 正则化目标从期望奖励推广到分布的凸泛函，用其第一变分构造依赖分布的逐样本有效奖励，直接惩罚与预训练分布的偏离，从而在扩散/流匹配模型奖励微调中兼顾奖励与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型的奖励微调能对齐下游目标，但激进优化易导致模式崩塌和分布漂移。现有方法用反向 KL 正则（等价于对速度场的 ℓ2 惩罚）控制漂移，只能间接约束采样动态，无法直接作用于生成分布。

Method: 将原本基于期望奖励（对模型分布线性）的 KL 正则目标推广为分布的凸泛函优化；利用该泛函的第一变分定义依赖分布的有效奖励，直接惩罚偏离预训练分布。该形式为 Fréchet 距离（FD）、MMD 和 DreamSim 多样性等给出可加性的逐样本奖励，并将若干近期提出的奖励作为特例恢复。

Result: 在多种文生图微调任务上，DFR 达到与 KL 调参基线相当的峰值奖励，同时在相同或更低分布漂移下将多样性最多提升 29%。

Conclusion: 以分布凸泛函的第一变分为基础构建逐样本奖励，是对速度场 ℓ2 惩罚的直接替代，能在控制分布漂移的同时显著提升多样性，并统一了多种现有奖励设计。

Abstract: Reward fine-tuning is an effective way to adapt pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models to downstream objectives, but aggressive optimization often leads to mode collapse and distributional drift. Existing methods attempt to control this drift with reverse-KL regularization, implemented as an $\ell_2$ penalty on the velocity field; however, this functions by indirectly constraining sampling dynamics rather than directly acting on the generated distribution. To address this, we propose DFR (Distributional Functional Rewards), which augments the task reward with a distribution-dependent, per-sample reward that acts explicitly on the generated distribution. Formally, we generalize the KL-regularized objective from expected rewards, which are linear in the model's distribution, to convex functionals of it. The first variation of this objective defines an effective, distribution-dependent reward that directly penalizes deviation from the pretrained distribution. This formulation yields additive per-sample rewards for the Fréchet distance (FD), maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and DreamSim diversity, recovering several recently proposed rewards as special cases. Across various text-to-image fine-tuning tasks, DFR matches the peak reward of KL-tuned baselines while increasing diversity by up to 29% at equal or lower drift.

</details>


### [651] [A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24908)
*Csaba Balogh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"特征基取向"问题：SAE在表示层面把语义不同的输入当成可互换。作者从代数误差检测的对称匹配视角出发，给SAE训练加一个可微的V_Gini正则项，惩罚指定扰动家族内的不均匀响应。多模型多种子实验表明该正则提升下尾响应、降低响应剖面失衡且不损害通用重建；再叠加的JumpReLU/MDL目标无此效果，几何控制排除模板重复解释，零样本临床影像最小对审计显示弱尾提升可外推。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型会对语义不同的输入在表示层面做等价处理，形成标准SAE目标未覆盖的盲点；在临床剂量抽取、法律条款解释、金融金额核验等安全关键场景中，这类失败会静默传播到下游决策。现有SAE目标（如JumpReLU、MDL）并不直接针对这一问题，因此需要显式建模特征基的取向。

Method: 把问题形式化为特征基取向问题，借用代数误差检测理论中的对称匹配视角，在SAE训练中加入可微的V_Gini正则项，惩罚某一指定扰动家族内部响应不均匀。在GPT-2、Gemma 2、Qwen 2.5上用冻结的多随机种子评测协议对比Standard/JumpReLU/MDL SAE；并设计家族几何控制（模板重复、单一主导扰动家族）以及留出探针与零校准分离检验，评估表示变化向下游可区分性的传导程度；最后做分布外临床放射学最小对的零样本审计与未见扰动家族的留出审计。

Result: V正则同时提升相对与绝对下尾响应，并降低响应剖面失衡，通用文本重建无明显退化；同协议下JumpReLU与MDL目标仍接近Standard SAE的剖面。家族几何控制显示效果不能由模板重复或单一主导扰动家族解释。零样本审计中，所有被评测的模型×家族单元都出现相对弱尾提升，但与训练统计量并非完全秩对齐；留出审计表明提升也出现在训练未用过的扰动家族类型上。

Conclusion: 扰动感知的SAE训练可以将特征基重新取向到安全相关的输入变化上，且不牺牲通用重建；但这种表示层面的改变是否转化为下游可区分性提升，仍需作为独立的经验步骤加以验证。

Abstract: Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

</details>


### [652] [Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24914)
*Boyi Liu,Yite Wang,Xinyu Lian,Fan Shu,Sida Li,Feng Yan,Mingjia Zhang,Yuxiong He,Zhewei Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Arctic-SWE 是一个全异步 RL 框架，通过模型-系统协同设计给出可复现的智能体 RL 基线；在原始 R2E-Gym 数据上不做算法/数据改动即将 Qwen3.5-4B 训练至 SWE-bench Verified 62.0% pass@1，再加入数据精炼后达 65.0%（Verified）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体训练（如软件工程）缺乏可复现的强 RL 基线，导致新算法或数据带来的增益难以与"基线本身没调好"区分开。

Method: 以"小任务池过拟合"为测试平台，暴露早期奖励增益掩盖的失败，指导集成既有组件：门控奖励（gated reward）、重要性权重控制、训练与推理引擎对齐、策略更新间的状态一致性；并在该基线上对 R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2、Scale-SWE 进行过滤与精炼。

Result: 原始数据下 4B 模型达 62.0% pass@1，与依赖在线任务合成的 FrogNano（61.5%）相当，但训练 rollout 约为其六分之一；精炼数据后 4B 模型在 Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上从 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% 提升至 65.0%/38.3%/59.7%，9B 模型从 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% 提升至 65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。

Conclusion: 各组件均非新创，但组合起来构成缺失的基础；受控对比显示数据精炼与测试增强都能提升留出集表现（更强测试会降低训练任务的表面掌握度）。Arctic-SWE 为研究异步智能体 RL 的算法、数据与环境提供有文档的起点。

Abstract: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

</details>


### [653] [CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24920)
*Shreyas K. Chandrahas,Jose Munoz,Satish Babu Bellapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARTA 是一个无标签自监督编码器，从原始交易中学习 16 维紧凑嵌入，冻结后可用于标签高效的欺诈检测与无监督风险分层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 支付欺诈标签获取成本高且跨任务不一致；高基数标识符（如商户名）使 one-hot 特征管道难以规模化。

Method: 采用类型特定投影与可学习嵌入表处理高基数标识符，通过 token excision 与 InfoNCE 对比损失训练；冻结嵌入用于线性探针与无监督风险分层，无需重训编码器。

Result: IEEE-CIS 上 1% 标签的线性探针超过 100% 标签的原始特征探针；IBM TabFormer（200万行）冻结嵌入 GBDT AUPRC 0.508，高于频率编码 0.411 和丢弃商户基线 0.022；但全监督 CatBoost 更强。

Conclusion: CARTA 是无需标签、可复用的表示，能补充任务特定的监督模型，而非替代。

Abstract: Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.

</details>


### [654] [TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24930)
*Chuan Liu,Tianya Zhao,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TrustAgent-RFF，一个预测级可靠性框架：冻结I/Q分类器，无需目标域标签，通过反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度、信号质量等射频证据，结合源域校准的可信度估计与LLM规划器，将预测判定为接受/拒绝/延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFF模型在源域上准确，但接收机、距离、采集日或环境变化时失效；且错误预测常获得高softmax置信度，导致置信度阈值不足以支撑可信部署。

Method: 对每个设备预测采集四类射频证据（反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度、信号质量）；源域校准的可信度估计器融合这些诊断与分类置信度、预测间隔、证据可用性；引入源域推导的下尾惩罚与跨模块交互；LLM规划器依证据、可信状态、动作代价与剩余预算自适应选择下一诊断动作；确定性源域校准决策层输出Accept/Reject/Defer。

Result: 在五个RFF数据集与多种分类器骨干上，平均源域到目标域准确率下降38.7%，并显示大量目标域错误预测仍保持高置信度。

Conclusion: 基于softmax置信度的阈值方法不可靠，需在预测层面引入多源射频证据与自适应诊断来完成可信判定；但论文未报告带数字的最终性能提升结果。

Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) models can achieve accuracy under source domain conditions but become unreliable when the receiver, distance, collection day, or environment changes. Incorrect predictions in unseen domains may receive high softmax confidence, making confidence thresholding insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We propose TrustAgent-RFF, a prediction level reliability framework for RFF that operates with a frozen in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) classifier without target domain labels. For each device prediction, the framework acquires radio frequency evidence: counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition domain similarity, and signal quality. A source calibrated trust estimator combines these diagnostics with classifier confidence, prediction margin, and evidence availability indicators. Source derived lower tail penalties and cross module interactions reduce trust when diagnostic signals indicate weak support. A large language model (LLM) based planner adaptively selects the next diagnostic action based on evidence, trust state, action costs, and remaining budget. A deterministic source calibrated decision layer updates the prediction state as Accept, Reject, or Defer. Experiments across five RFF datasets and classifier backbones reveal an average source to target accuracy drop of 38.7% and show that many incorrect target domain predictions remain highly confident.

</details>


### [655] [MLFont: Machine Learning-Driven Font Subsetting and Range-Compact Unicode-Range Slicing for Low-Latency Web Typography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24937)
*Quan Wang,Yiran Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MLFont is a machine learning + optimization framework that learns corpus-driven font slicing strategies for CSS3 @font-face unicode-range delivery, cutting per-glyph latency, CSS bloat, and bandwidth while keeping 100% glyph coverage.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web font files for Pan-European (LGC) and CJK fonts contain 2,297–30,759 codepoints (158 KB–5.9 MB in WOFF2). Existing heuristic partitioning of unicode-range slices causes unused-glyph downloads, high HTTP round-trips, CSS bloat, or missing-glyph fallbacks.

Method: Three-stage pipeline: (1) Zipfian High-Frequency Tier isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model with Shannon Entropy Difference Loss and Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization; (3) Memetic Range-Compact Genetic Algorithm with Potts-Viterbi dynamic programming and island bridging, minimizing topic discrepancy and CSS fragmentation.

Result: Evaluated on five Google Noto fonts (LGC, KR, JP, TC, SC): 3G per-glyph latency reduced 56.7%–75.3% vs. single-file delivery and 46.1%–66.3% vs. equal-bin baselines on CJK with 100% coverage; CSS intervals reduced 17.9%–41.7%; 1.56x–6.09x cold-cache speedups (65.4%–84.9% CJK, 44.7% LGC bandwidth savings) across 20 websites in simulator and Headless Chrome benchmarks, with 45/45 exact slice-set parity.

Conclusion: Corpus-learned, topic-aware, optimization-based font slicing outperforms heuristic partitioning for web font delivery, and is released as open code and Hugging Face models.

Abstract: CSS3 @font-face rules with unicode-range descriptors partition web fonts into downloadable slices. While Latin fonts need ~20 KB in WOFF2, Pan-European (LGC) and East Asian (CJK) fonts contain 2,297-30,759 codepoints (158 KB-5.9 MB in WOFF2), where heuristic partitioning causes unused-glyph downloads, high HTTP RTT, CSS bloat, or missing-glyph fallbacks. We present MLFont, a machine learning and optimization framework that learns font slicing strategies from corpora via three stages: (1) a Zipfian High-Frequency Tier (most) isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) a Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA (Online LDA) or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model (DNNTM) with Shannon Entropy Difference Loss and Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization; and (3) a Memetic Range-Compact Genetic Algorithm (GA) with Potts-Viterbi dynamic programming and island bridging that minimizes topic discrepancy and CSS fragmentation. Across five Google Noto fonts (LGC, KR, JP, TC, SC), MLFont cuts 3G per-glyph latency by 56.7%-75.3% over single-file delivery and 46.1%-66.3% over equal-bin baselines on CJK with 100% coverage, reduces CSS intervals by 17.9%-41.7%, and achieves 1.56x-6.09x cold-cache speedups (65.4%-84.9% CJK and 44.7% LGC bandwidth savings) across 20 websites in simulator and Headless Chrome benchmarks (45/45 exact slice-set parity).
  Code: https://github.com/wq2012/mlfont
  Models: https://huggingface.co/collections/wq2012/mlfont

</details>


### [656] [T-MUON: Tensorizing Muon via t-SVD for Large Language Model Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24938)
*Dongyang Li,Mingsong Yan,Zheng Zhang,Sui Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出T-MUON，用t-SVD与M-变换将结构相关的Transformer梯度组织为三阶张量，直接定义Muon式更新，并在多尺度模型上持续优于AdamW、Muon等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Muon按单个参数矩阵独立更新，而张量化扩展通过矩阵展开联合更新一组矩阵，尚缺乏基于t-SVD的、理论上可解释的Muon式张量更新形式。

Method: 将结构相关的Transformer梯度分组为三阶张量，基于t-SVD通过M-变换定义T-MUON更新；证明其精确更新是⋆_M-谱范数下的最速下降方向，并给出收敛性保证；实验中采用head-wise张量化及恒等变换，与DFT/DCT/DST变换变体对比。

Result: 在51M–1.3B参数的GPT-2风格与LLaMA风格模型、FineWeb与FineWeb-Edu数据上，head-wise T-MUON（恒等变换）验证困惑度一致低于AdamW、Muon及DFT/DCT/DST变体；在更长上下文和更大token预算下优势保持，但最佳张量化模式随设置变化。

Conclusion: T-MUON提供了有理论依据的张量化Muon推广，实证有效，但最优张量化方式依赖具体场景，需按设置选择。

Abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model pretraining by exploiting matrix structure through polar orthogonalization. However, it processes each parameter matrix independently, whereas recent tensor-aware extensions of Muon jointly update groups of eligible matrix parameters through matrix unfoldings. In contrast, we propose T-MUON, a t-SVD-based generalization that groups structurally related Transformer gradients into third-order tensors and defines the corresponding Muon-style update directly through the $M$-transform. We show that the exact T-MUON update is a steepest-descent direction under the $\star_M$-spectral norm and establish a convergence guarantee. Across GPT-2-style and LLaMA-style models from 51M to 1.3B parameters trained on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu, head-wise T-MUON with the identity transform consistently achieves lower validation perplexity than AdamW, Muon, and variants using DFT, DCT, or DST transforms. These gains persist in additional experiments with longer context lengths and larger token budgets, although the preferred tensorization mode varies across settings.

</details>


### [657] [Robust Direct Preference Optimization under Preference Label-Flip Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24945)
*Chenye Yang,Weiyu Xu,Lifeng Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Trim-K Robust-DPO 与 Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO，通过剔除/降权高影响偏好对来抵御标签翻转攻击，并给出梯度扰动、参数与策略偏差的理论保证及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO 广泛用于离线 RLHF，但容易被对抗性偏好标签翻转攻击操纵，诱导学习器收敛到攻击者选定的目标策略，缺乏鲁棒性。

Method: 基于 log-linear DPO 中标签翻转会产生与参数无关的梯度偏移这一性质，提出 Trim-K（移除 K 个最高影响样本对）与 Soft-Trim-K（平滑降权）两种鲁棒 DPO；建立覆盖所有至多 K 次翻转攻击集的确定性梯度扰动界，区分防御引入偏差与残余攻击效应，并在有界区域假设下给出时间一致的参数与策略偏差保证，同时分析二次正则化对曲率的改善与额外偏差。

Result: 在 Stanford Human Preferences、HH-RLHF 与 UltraFeedback-Binarized 数据集上的实验验证了理论分析。

Conclusion: 剪裁/软降权策略可在理论上限定标签翻转攻击影响，二次正则化存在曲率与偏差的权衡，所提方法在实验中有效。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is widely used for offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. However, recent works have shown that DPO can be easily manipulated by adversarial preference label flip attacks, which are specifically designed to mislead the learner toward an attacker-chosen target policy. To address this issue, we design robust DPO methods that can defend against such attacks. Building on the property that lable flips induce parameter-independent gradient shifts in log-linear DPO, we propose Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which removes the $K$ highest-impact pairs, and Soft-Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which smoothly downweights them. We establish deterministic gradient perturbation bounds uniformly over all attack sets containing at most $K$ flips, explicitly separating defense-induced bias from surviving attack effects. Under bounded-region assumptions, these bounds yield time-uniform parameter and policy deviation guarantees. We further quantify how quadratic regularization improves curvature while introducing additional bias. Experiments on Stanford Human Preferences, HH-RLHF, and UltraFeedback-Binarized validate our analysis.

</details>


### [658] [ControlJEPA: Principled Trajectory Regularization via Lyapunov Tube Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24951)
*Thai-Khanh Nguyen,Nhi Y. Pham,Uyen N. B. Vo,Thieu N. Vo,Cuong Pham,Tan M. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ControlJEPA，一种基于离散时间Lyapunov收缩条件（ISS理论）的轨迹正则化框架，通过Lyapunov Tube Loss惩罚横向偏差，无需改架构即可提升准确率与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一词预测对隐状态轨迹几乎无约束，而现有几何正则化器主要约束偏差方向而非幅度，缺少对轨迹偏差大小的显式控制。

Method: 引入实用输入-状态稳定性（ISS）中的离散时间Lyapunov收缩条件，设计Lyapunov Tube Loss：在归一化、尺度不变的横向偏差度量上惩罚条件违反；条件成立时轨迹被约束在参考割线附近的显式管内。在部分ISS情形下，用Lyapunov损失与收缩参数界定平均横向能量、时间方差与平均管宽。

Result: 在六个基准与六类模型上，相较标准微调及已有轨迹正则化器，一致提升准确率与数据效率；横向轮廓更平滑的效果在推理阶段（正则项失效时）仍持续存在；在均匀有界违反下获得与horizon无关的方差界。

Conclusion: 轨迹幅度的显式收缩约束是一种有效且即插即用的正则化思路，兼具理论保证与实证收益。代码已开源。

Abstract: Next-token prediction leaves hidden-state trajectories largely unconstrained, while existing geometric regularizers primarily control the direction rather than the magnitude of trajectory deviations. We introduce \emph{ControlJEPA}, a trajectory regularization framework based on a discrete-time Lyapunov contraction condition from practical Input-to-State Stability theory. Its Lyapunov Tube Loss penalizes violations of this condition on a normalized, scale-invariant measure of transversal deviation. When the contraction condition holds at every step, the hidden-state trajectory remains within an explicit tube around the reference secant. In the partial-ISS regime, we bound mean transversal energy, temporal variance, and average tube width using the Lyapunov loss and contraction parameters, with horizon-independent variance bounds under uniformly bounded violations. ControlJEPA requires no architectural modifications. Across six benchmarks and six model families, it consistently improves accuracy and data efficiency over standard fine-tuning and prior trajectory regularizers. The resulting smoother transversal profile also persists empirically during inference, when the regularizer is inactive. The code is publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/t-khanusa/ControlJEPA}

</details>


### [659] [CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24952)
*Hao Wang,Zihan Wang,Kai Wu,Jian Yao,Yiwen Ye,Yongcan Luo,Dapeng Wu,Jiale Chen,Haihua Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CasePlay 是一个文档驱动的自我对弈框架，将医学病例报告转化为强化学习训练信号，通过知识条件化提问器和评分表评判器，缓解知识点固化与难度-质量不匹配问题，在七个医学基准上平均超过 SFT 热启动模型 3.1 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提升 LLM 临床推理的 RL 流程依赖专家标注题目或昂贵的合成数据；而医学文献（尤其病例报告）蕴含大量高质量无标注文档。现有自我对弈方法在此场景存在两问题：知识点固化（提问者反复围绕少数显著线索提问）与难度-质量不匹配（难度合适但题目浅薄或表述不佳，训练价值低）。

Method: 提出 CasePlay 自对弈框架，含两个组件：(a) 知识条件化提问者（Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer），将提问锚定到病例特定知识点，使问题覆盖源报告中更广的证据；(b) 评分表评判推理器（Rubric-Judge Reasoner），在答案正确性反馈之外增加基于评分表的质量反馈（线索整合、推理深度、选项质量），引导提问者生成推理密集型问题。

Result: 在七个医学相关基准上，CasePlay 优于现有自对弈基线，较 SFT 热启动模型平均提升 3.1 分，其中 LiveClin 上提升 6.3 分。

Conclusion: 文档驱动的自我对弈可有效将病例报告转化为 RL 训练信号，为通过自我对弈强化学习持续提升医学推理能力提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.

</details>


### [660] [Label-Space Mismatch Distorts Cross-Cohort Evaluation in Breast Cancer Molecular Subtyping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24962)
*Suxing Liu,Byungwon Min,Zhijian Zheng,Jiahao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 跨队列评估乳腺癌亚型分类器时，若源/目标队列标注标准不同（METABRIC 6类 vs PAM50 5类），性能比较不可靠；需先做"标签空间合规"再报告性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨站点评估常混淆三类操作：标签空间限制、EM先验校正、标签空间可恢复性；且内部验证会高估跨队列价值，需厘清哪一步真正带来收益、什么必须依赖队列文档。

Method: 将 METABRIC（n=1369，训练958）训练的6类分类器迁移到 TCGA-BRCA（n=987）与 GSE21653（n=266）；分离评估标签空间限制、EM先验校正、无标签预测的类别恢复性；并检验多模态融合（n=694）与基因组面板对 pCR 的增量价值。

Result: 标签空间限制是主要修正来源（73.76%→79.74%；63.16%→68.42%）；EM先验校正为可选校准（Brier 改善、macro F1 下降，至80.65%与74.06%）；缺失类别无法从无标签预测恢复（EM 保持先验0.0751）；无融合配置优于单 mRNA（McNemar p=0.13–1.00）；基因组面板对 pCR 仅 DeltaAUC=+0.0045；外部 C-index 0.577–0.584。

Conclusion: 标签空间合规是任何跨队列性能声明的先决条件；不做合规会把标注标准差异误归为模型能力。亚型准确率是较弱的可移植终点，生存判别更可迁移。

Abstract: Cross-cohort evaluation of breast cancer subtype classifiers is unreliable when source and target cohorts use different annotation standards: METABRIC labels six classes, PAM50 defines five, and a claudin-low prediction cannot be correct under a five-class standard. A classifier transferred from 1,369 METABRIC patients (train n=958) to TCGA-BRCA (n=987) and GSE21653 (n=266) separates three evaluation operations routinely conflated in cross-site comparisons. (1) Label-space restriction - an evaluation-rule change, not a retraining gain - is the dominant correction (73.76%->79.74% on TCGA-BRCA; 63.16%->68.42% on GSE21653); (2) EM prior correction on the reconciled space is an optional calibration step (Brier fidelity up, macro F1 down; to 80.65% and 74.06%); and (3) the target label space is not recoverable from unlabelled predictions (EM retains prior 0.0751 on the absent class; calibrated detectors fail), so compliance must come from cohort documentation. The protocol exposes why internal validation overstates cross-cohort value: multimodal fusion gains do not transfer (no configuration beats mRNA alone, n=694; McNemar p=0.13-1.00), and the genomic panel adds nothing to pathological complete response prediction over clinical variables (DeltaAUC = +0.0045). Clinically, without label-space compliance, cross-site accuracy comparisons misattribute annotation-standard differences to model skill; Luminal A/B and claudin-low boundary errors map to distinct treatment decisions; and subtype accuracy is a weaker portable endpoint than survival discrimination (external C-index 0.577-0.584). Reporting the cohort's allowed label set and applying label-space compliance are therefore prerequisites before any cross-cohort performance claim.

</details>


### [661] [PRECOCIAL: Pretraining with Code Curriculums via Iterative Search for Accelerated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24970)
*Edward Gu,Ali Payani,Kevin Ellis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRECOCIAL 自动优化生成合成预训练数据的符号程序，通过在搜索中复用单一网络降低训练成本，在语言与代码数据集上优于手工课程与现有程序搜索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由符号程序生成的合成预训练数据能启动自然语言任务的下游训练，但现有生成程序均需人工设计，缺乏自动化优化手段。对候选程序逐一评估代价高昂（每次评分都需训练），因此需要更高效的搜索方案。

Method: 从一个初始生成器程序出发，让 LLM 迭代重写该程序；每次重写通过"用其数据预训练随机初始化的 transformer 再在下游任务微调"来打分。关键效率设计是整个搜索过程只维护一个网络，对每个被接受的程序继续其预训练，而非为每个候选重新训练。还采用程序接受机制（疑似类似爬山/锦标赛）进行搜索。

Result: 在四个语言与代码数据集、固定微调预算下：优化程序困惑度低于手工课程、已发表的程序化生成器、随机程序变异以及 LLM 首轮迭代程序；达到与手工课程相同困惑度所需微调步数减少 9–33%。相同评估次数与更低成本下优于 FunSearch 和 AlphaEvolve（后两者为每个候选训练新网络）。优化生成器可跨域迁移到其他数据集；优化程序还在四个推理与问题求解任务上带来更好的下游表现。

Conclusion: 自动化程序搜索可有效替代手工设计合成预训练数据生成器；搜索期间复用单一网络是可行的效率策略；优化程序具备跨域迁移性与下游收益，表明合成预训练数据程序优化是有前景的方向。

Abstract: Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. PRECOCIAL also ends with lower perplexity than FunSearch and AlphaEvolve, which train a new network for every candidate, at the same number of evaluations and a lower cost. We also observe that an optimized program generator from one domain transfers to datasets in other domains. Additionally, optimized programs allow for better downstream performance on four different reasoning and problem-solving tasks.

</details>


### [662] [Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24991)
*Runguo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将阈值检索转化为按注意力权重比例的采样（指数扰动），用几何网格嵌套采样+Horvitz–Thompson估计给出对各层同时成立的置信界，每个head在首个满足目标误差ε的层停止，从而实现有误差保证的稀疏注意力解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力虽只读少量KV缓存键来加速长上下文解码，但不控制单个query的误差，且在真实KV缓存上误差呈重尾分布，缺乏可靠性保证。

Method: 对每个键的得分加独立Exp(1)扰动，使阈值检索等价于按注意力权重比例采样；沿几何网格降低阈值得到嵌套样本，用Horvitz–Thompson估计每层输出并给出同时覆盖所有层的置信界，每个head在首个满足ε证书的层停止；每步解码重新扰动，使单步失败概率≤δ；用组内共享的4位扫描+确定性界精确生成候选。

Result: 理论上，合适阈值下读数O(ε^(-2)log(1/δ))且与上下文长度无关，并达到常数因子内的自适应最优。实验上，3个LLM、10种设置、16K–128K tokens下无一证书被违反；同等读取键数时90分位误差比15个基线族中最优者低4.6–7.9倍；端到端任务性能与稠密注意力差≤1点，PG-19困惑度差≤0.1%；CPU上32K–128K解码比稠密快1.1–1.4倍。

Conclusion: 该方法为稀疏注意力提供了严格的逐查询误差保证与高效采样机制，在误差、字节效率和速度上均优或持平于强基线，是可靠长上下文解码的可行方案。

Abstract: Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $δ$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.

</details>


### [663] [Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24998)
*Josep Marques,Hyunyoung A. Cho,Youngeun Kim,Youjia Zhang,Aecheon Jung,Kyuhong Shim,Sungeun Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Block Recursive Transformers（BRT），将层划分为连续块并逐块递归复用，作为介于逐层重复与全局循环复用之间的中间共享拓扑，在不增加路由模块或额外训练目标的前提下提升递归Transformer效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归Transformer的性能不仅取决于共享参数量，还取决于共享参数在深度上如何组织。现有静态方案只有两种极端：逐层独立重复和整栈全局循环复用，忽略了共享粒度这一关键因素。

Method: 将层划分为若干连续块，在每个块内部递归复用后，再进入下一个块。该中间拓扑允许块内局部精炼，同时保留深度方向的层间过渡，且不引入路由模块、辅助状态或额外训练目标。

Result: 在最高1.7B参数的decoder-only模型上，以及额外的encoder-decoder与encoder-only实验中，BRT在验证集负对数似然和下游任务准确率上均优于静态递归共享基线。

Conclusion: 消融与表示分析表明，中间块粒度的共享能更好地平衡局部精炼与深度差异化，说明共享粒度是递归参数共享设计中的重要因素。

Abstract: Recursive Transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared, but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. Existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies: layer-wise repetition, where each layer is reused independently, and global cyclic reuse, where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. We argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. This study proposes Block Recursive Transformers (BRT), which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. This intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions, without adding routing modules, auxiliary states, or extra training objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, BRT improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. Ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

</details>


### [664] [UtoMe: Observation-Uncertainty-Guided Token Merging for Weather Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25001)
*Yunbei Zhang,Janet Wang,Xi Xiao,Jihun Hamm,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UtoMe：一种由观测不确定性引导的天气Transformer token合并框架，将持续同化集合离散度作为相对输入可靠性代理，与动力学显著性结合来分配token预算，在ERA5 72小时预报中于相同token预算下优于训练时ToMe。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天气Transformer处理密集再分析场，其可靠性随变量、位置和天气形势而异；单纯基于特征相似度的token合并（如ToMe）忽略了这种异质性的输入不确定性。

Method: 构建重要性评分，将动力学显著性与集合数据同化离散度（作为输入可靠性代理）结合；高分token被保留作为锚点，并用于校准其余token间的二分图匹配。设计三个变体：训练与推理均使用外部不确定性（UtoMe-E）、仅训练时使用、以及均不使用。

Result: 在1.40625°和50% token缩减下，UtoMe-E将Overall误差从67.32降至53.00，编码器FLOPs同为0.55x；小幅缩减时接近全token基线，大幅缩减则出现可测的精度损失。组件消融及空间不确定性对照支持将动力学与对齐的不确定性结合。

Conclusion: 在分配天气Transformer的token预算时，将动力学显著性与对齐的不确定性信息结合是有效的，观测不确定性引导的token合并能在匹配预算下提升预报精度。

Abstract: Weather transformers process dense reanalysis fields whose reliability varies across variables, locations, and weather regimes. Token merging can reduce computation, but feature similarity alone does not account for this heterogeneous input uncertainty. We introduce UtoMe, an observation-uncertainty-guided token merging framework that combines dynamics saliency with ensemble data assimilation spread as a relative input-reliability proxy. The resulting importance score protects selected tokens as anchors and calibrates bipartite matching between the remaining tokens. Three variants use external uncertainty at both training and inference, during training only, or neither stage. In ERA5 72-hour forecasting at two spatial resolutions, UtoMe improves Overall error over train-time ToMe at matched token budgets. At $1.40625^\circ$ and 50% token reduction, UtoMe-E lowers Overall error from 67.32 to 53.00 at the same 0.55x encoder FLOPs. Small reductions remain close to the full-token baseline; larger reductions incur measurable accuracy losses. Component ablations and spatial uncertainty controls support combining dynamics with aligned uncertainty when allocating a weather transformer's token budget.

</details>


### [665] [UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25004)
*Tieyuan Chen,Huabin Liu,Yingtao Zhang,Shijie Li,Tengyu Pan,Weiyao Lin,Jianguo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 UpLoop，一种基于逐层循环（layer-wise recurrence）的预训练模型后训练升级方法，将非循环 LLM 升级为循环模型，并在 Qwen3-4B 上实现 R=3 时 20 个基准平均提升 6.17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 LLM 用循环计算换参数存储，但多数从头训练，成本高；此前循环模型常在 R=2 饱和。因此希望以低成本对预训练非循环模型做后训练升级。

Method: 不循环整个模型或中间块，而是对每个被选层局部循环，保留预训练深度层级、避免特征空间错配；并在注意力与 MLP 残差分支上加入 hidden-wise 门控，使后续循环作为渐进式细化而非冗余重写。

Result: 从 Qwen3-4B Base 出发并做 SFT，R=3 时 20 个基准平均准确率提升 6.17%，打破以往 R=2 饱和；主设为 R=3（最佳精度-成本权衡），native 与 extrapolated R=4 还有进一步提升。

Conclusion: UpLoop 提供了一种有效的后训练循环升级方案，逐层循环加门控可突破两循环饱和，并在精度与成本间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

</details>


### [666] [Conjugate Compilation: Self-Improving Agentic Co-Compilation for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25012)
*Annabelle Sujun Tang,Rohan Mahapatra,Christopher Priebe,Hanyang Xu,Manya Ghobadi,Christopher Rossbach,Hadi Esmaeilzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Conjugate Compilation将投机解码重新表述为跨模型编译问题，联合优化草稿模型与目标模型的共享执行，并通过LLM智能体搜索系统（MCTS引导）以实测共享执行为反馈进行编译优化，在NVIDIA B300与RTX 5090上取得1.37x（交错布局达1.45x，最佳1.59x）的每轮几何平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM部署激增下，除增加GPU外还需释放被闲置（stranded）的GPU容量。投机解码引入草稿模型与目标模型两个模型，但二者各自独立编译，导致其共享执行落在编译器优化边界之外，错失跨模型优化机会。

Method: 将投机解码视为跨模型编译问题，在共享执行中联合优化草稿与目标模型；核心洞见是以其产出的共置共享执行之实测性能来指导跨模型编译（因为孤立优化的kernel未必提升联合执行的整体性能）。设计操作数布局，在公共tile内交错两模型的block，共置GEMM与非GEMM工作且保持数学等价。通过自我改进的智能体搜索系统实现：LLM编辑跨模型优化计划，以编译器与GPU执行作为环境，每个方案经编译与共置执行评估，其分数加上kernel级判定与编译器反馈指导后续提案，并用MCTS累积奖励引导探索。

Result: 在NVIDIA B300与RTX 5090上六种单GPU投机解码配置中，几何平均每轮加速1.37x；交错kernel提升至1.45x，最佳达1.59x；GPU利用率平均提升1.46x（RTX 5090）与1.50x（B300）。

Conclusion: 跨模型、以共享执行实测反馈驱动的联合编译能有效释放投机解码中的闲置算力，显著提升吞吐与GPU利用率，表明编译优化边界应从单模型扩展到协同执行的模型组。

Abstract: As LLM adoption surges, scaling model serving requires unlocking stranded GPU capacity alongside deploying more GPUs. Speculative decoding brings two models into the serving process: a small draft model proposes tokens that a larger target model verifies. Yet compiling these models individually leaves their shared execution outside the compiler's optimization boundary. We introduce CONJUGATE COMPILATION, which reframes speculative decoding as a cross-model compilation problem and jointly optimizes the draft and target models within their shared execution rather than treating each in isolation. Our key insight is that cross-model compilation should be informed by the measured performance of the co-located shared execution it produces: an optimization that improves a kernel in isolation need not improve the models when they execute together. To expand cross-model opportunities, we devise operand layouts that interleave blocks from both models within common tiles, co-locating GEMM and non-GEMM work while preserving their mathematics. We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment. Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals, while Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration. Across six single-GPU speculative-decoding configurations on NVIDIA B300 and RTX 5090 GPUs, CONJUGATE COMPILATION achieves a geometric-mean per-round speedup of 1.37x over conventional execution. Interleaved kernels raise this speedup to 1.45x, reaching 1.59x in the best case. CONJUGATE COMPILATION also improves GPU utilization on average by 1.46x on RTX 5090 and 1.50x on B300.

</details>


### [667] [Latent World Models Should Plan with Distances Along the Latent Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25013)
*Zunzhi You,Linwei Tao,Siyu Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出LeWM等潜世界模型用环境空间（如L2）距离作为终端代价，仅在目标附近有效，远处会形成虚假低代价盆地困住规划器；提出在训练潜变量上构建互近邻图、计算最短路径的“邻域图代价”(NGC)，仅改终端代价、无需重训，即提升全部四项任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型（如LeWM）以预测终端潜变量与目标潜变量在环境范数（如欧氏距离）下的接近程度来搜索动作序列，但该做法隐含假设“环境潜空间中的接近等价于环境中接近目标”。作者发现该假设只在目标附近的小邻域内成立，距离较远时L2代价会产生虚假的低代价盆地，使规划器陷入局部最优而失败。

Method: 先分析LeWM失败原因：L2终端代价在远离目标处形成虚假低代价区域；而基于邻域的嵌入表明潜变量仍保留了底层物理状态。据此提出“潜变量位于弯曲的低维流形附近”的假设，终端代价应度量沿潜流形的距离而非环境空间距离。实现方式为Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC)：在训练潜变量上构建互近邻（mutual nearest-neighbor）图，用图上的最短路径距离估计流形距离。NGC仅替换终端代价，不需重新训练模型。

Result: 仅替换终端代价这一处改动，即提升了LeWM在全部四个基准任务上的规划成功率，并在TwoRoom与Reacher上近乎完全解决：即使在测试的最远目标偏移下，NGC的成功率仍达95%和100%，而L2代价分别降至27%和81%。

Conclusion: 结果支持潜变量流形假设，并表明潜世界模型应使用沿潜流形的距离进行规划，而非环境空间距离。NGC是一种简单、无需重训、即插即用的终端代价改进方案。

Abstract: Latent world models such as LeWM plan by searching for an action sequence whose predicted terminal latent is closest to the goal latent under an ambient norm, such as the Euclidean distance. Planning with such a cost assumes that proximity in the ambient latent space reflects proximity to the goal in the environment. Studying LeWM, we find that this assumption holds only in a small neighborhood around the goal, whereas farther away the L2 cost forms spurious low-cost basins that trap the planner. Yet neighborhood-based embeddings show that the latents retain the underlying physical state. We therefore hypothesize that the latents lie near a curved, low-dimensional manifold, and that the terminal cost should measure the distance along this latent manifold rather than through the ambient space. To estimate this manifold distance, we propose the Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC), which computes shortest-path distances on a mutual nearest-neighbor graph constructed over training latents. NGC changes only the terminal cost and requires no retraining. This single change improves the planning success rate of LeWM across all four benchmark tasks and nearly solves TwoRoom and Reacher: even at the farthest goal offsets tested, NGC reaches 95% and 100% success, whereas the L2 cost falls to 27% and 81%. These results support the manifold hypothesis and our argument that latent world models should plan with distances along the latent manifold.

</details>


### [668] [Multifidelity Monte Carlo Estimator for High-Dimensional Quantities of Interest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25016)
*Zhibo Dai,Hamdi A. Tchelepi,Daniel M. Tartakovsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将多保真度蒙特卡洛(MFMC)推广到向量值QoI，用矩阵代替标量控制变量系数并最小化加权均方误差，给出全矩阵最优系数的闭式解与嵌套的块对角/对角/标量系数层级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MFMC能利用廉价低保真模型作为控制变量来降低昂贵高保真模型统计量估计的成本，但原有方法只针对标量QoI，无法直接处理向量值QoI。

Method: 把标量控制变量系数替换为矩阵，最小化加权均方误差；推导全矩阵系数的闭式解，并用"有效相关"替代闭式MFMC设计中的Pearson相关系数平方；再将系数限制为块对角、对角和标量三类，构成嵌套估计器层级，对相容加权给出闭式系数。

Result: 在总体层面证明：对标量QoI（状态线性投影），先校正全状态再投影不会更差。在Gaussian问题、对流-扩散问题的降阶模型和粗网格两相流问题上的实验表明：最佳系数类取决于试验样本量与需估计的协方差量数目之比，且重用试验样本可降低均方误差。

Conclusion: MFMC的矩阵系数推广为向量值QoI提供了方差缩减随试验数据需求递增的嵌套估计器族，实际应依据试验样本规模选择系数类并复用以降低MSE。

Abstract: Multifidelity Monte Carlo (MFMC) reduces the cost of estimating the statistics of quantities of interest (QoIs) computed via expensive high-fidelity model by using cheaper low-fidelity models as control variates. We extend MFMC to vector-valued QoIs by replacing the scalar control-variate coefficients with matrices and minimizing a weighted mean-squared error. The optimal full-matrix coefficients are available in closed form, and their variance reduction is summarized by an effective correlation that takes the place of the squared Pearson correlation in the closed-form MFMC design. Restricting the coefficients to block-diagonal, diagonal, and scalar classes gives a nested hierarchy of estimators with increasing variance reduction and increasing pilot-data demand, with closed-form coefficients for compatible weightings. For a scalar QoI obtained by linearly projecting the state, correcting the full state before projecting is never worse at the population level. Experiments on a Gaussian problem, a reduced-order model of an advection--diffusion problem, and a coarse-grid two-phase flow problem show that the best class depends on the pilot size relative to the number of covariance quantities it must estimate, and that reusing the pilot samples lowers the mean-squared error.

</details>


### [669] [Decentralized Online Exp-Concave Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25017)
*Hao Qiu,Mengxiao Zhang,Yuanyu Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出去中心化在线牛顿法(D-ONS)，首次实现去中心化在线exp-concave优化中对数遗憾，并给出近乎匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化在线凸优化(D-OCO)已在凸与强凸损失下有近最优遗憾保证，但exp-concave损失能否达到对数遗憾仍是开放问题。

Method: 将分块(blocking)与加速gossip思想以非平凡方式融入在线牛顿法，提出D-ONS算法；并进一步扩展到可行域无界、特征与标签局部观测的去中心化在线线性回归，通过gossip协方差与标签-特征统计量。

Result: 遗憾上界为O(Nd(1-σ₂)^{-1/2} log²T)，其中N为智能体数、d为维度、T为时间步、1-σ₂为网络谱间隙；下界为Ω(Nd(1-σ₂)^{-1/2} log(T/N))，证明上界近最优；线性回归扩展亦达到对数遗憾。

Conclusion: 首次给出去中心化在线exp-concave优化的对数遗憾界，且上下界近乎匹配，表明所提算法在谱间隙依赖与维度依赖上均近最优，并适用于无界域在线线性回归。

Abstract: Decentralized Online Convex Optimization (D-OCO) is a fundamental framework in which a set of local agents aims to minimize a sequence of global loss functions using only local computations and communications. While recent work has established near-optimal regret guarantees for convex and strongly convex losses, the case of exp-concave losses remains an open challenge: specifically, whether logarithmic regret is achievable. In this paper, we answer this question affirmatively by proposing Decentralized Online Newton Step (D-ONS), which adapts the idea of blocking and accelerated gossip to the Online Newton Step algorithm in a non-trivial manner. Concretely, our algorithm achieves a regret bound of $O\left(Nd(1-σ_2)^{-1/2}\,\log^2(T) \right)$ where $N$ is the number of agents, $d$ is the dimension, $T$ is the horizon, and $1-σ_2$ represents the spectral gap of the network. To our knowledge, this is the first logarithmic regret bound for decentralized online exp-concave optimization. We further establish a nearly matching lower bound of $Ω\left(Nd (1-σ_2)^{-1/2}\,\log(T/N) \right)$ showing the near optimality of our upper bound. Finally, we extend our algorithm to decentralized online linear regression in which the feasible domain is unbounded and features and labels are locally observed. By gossiping covariance and label-feature statistics, we also achieve logarithmic regret.

</details>


### [670] [LLM Agents as Suppliers of Physical System Models: Calibration and Acceptance in Modelica](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25019)
*Jörg Frochte,Herbert Schmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 以LLM编码智能体作为"供应商"，从Modelica库组件构建四个仿真系统与一台真实开关磁铁的模型，考察"交付验收"究竟认证了什么：验收应认证模型属于一个可行模型集合，而非匹配单一份参考模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当下模型交付（客户给描述/数据/目标响应，供应商交付模型并被验收）在概念上并不清晰。仅凭吻合数据的"行为一致性"验收，无法说清被接受的到底是什么，尤其是当描述对结构留白、数据只把模型约束到约定精度时。

Method: 将LLM编码智能体置于带数据的交付场景，用库组件搭建Modelica模型（4个仿真系统+1个真实开关磁铁）；引入集合式验收（按隶属度而非单一参考匹配），并在行为之上叠加物理不变量层与可解释性层（在变体上测试、不存在处读取、经由交付过程塑造）；随后做阈值明示的后续实验。

Result: 多个智能体达到噪声下限；但交付对应的是一个模型集合而非唯一模型。物理不变量层能暴露在噪声下限处"凭空造能"的模型。多数失败是带有系统性残差的拟合，根源在于交付未说明"多接近才算够"。后续实验表明，明确给出阈值会使智能体据此比对，通过率提高。

Conclusion: 验收应以"属于可行模型集合"为标准，并辅以物理不变量与可解释性等行为之外的层。这一论证适用于所有"交付对模型描述不足、且模型需被读懂而非仅能运行"的场景。

Abstract: To procure a model of a device, a client hands a supplier a description, sometimes with recorded data or a target response, and accepts the model against this handover. We let LLM coding agents act as the supplier on handovers with data, building Modelica models from library components for four simulated systems and a real switching magnet, and ask what acceptance certifies. Several agents reach the noise floor, but a handover admits a set of models: the description leaves parts of the structure open, and the data narrow it only to the agreed accuracy. We therefore accept by membership in this set, not by matching one reference, and add layers above behaviour: a physical invariant exposes an energy-creating model at the noise floor. Interpretability becomes a property of the delivered model, tested on a variant, read where none exists and shaped through the handover. Most failures are fits delivered with a systematic residual on their own fitting data, where the handover left open how close is close enough. In a follow-up, stating a threshold makes the agents compare against it, and more deliveries pass. The argument applies wherever a handover underspecifies a model meant to be read, not only run.

</details>


### [671] [Synergy-Aware Residual Flow Matching for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25021)
*Jingrui Wu,Wangyun Dan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SynGeneFlow，一种"协同感知"的流匹配框架：以加性先验为源分布，仅学习扰动交互产生的非加性残差，并结合扰动条件基因交互建模与MMD正则，提升组合扰动响应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合扰动预测困难：大部分响应可由单扰动的加性效应解释，真正有生物学意义的信号藏于较小的非加性残差中。直接生成完整扰动后表达谱会把大量建模容量耗费在主导的加性成分上，忽视协同（synergy）结构。

Method: 1) 将流匹配的源分布锚定在加性先验上，学习指向真实扰动状态的残差流；2) 扰动条件基因交互建模：静态基因-基因掩码提供生物结构，扰动依赖的形变偏置动态调节基因间耦合；3) 用MMD正则同时对端点分布和生物学残差分布做对齐，保持群体水平响应结构。

Result: 在基因扰动与药物扰动基准上，于观测单扰动、留出（held-out）及跨模态三种设置下评估，结果显示围绕加性效应做残差化流匹配是可行且稳健的框架。

Conclusion: 将生成建模聚焦于非加性协同残差，比直接生成全谱更具生物学依据且更稳健，为单细胞扰动响应预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Predicting single-cell responses to genetic and chemical perturbations is important for understanding regulatory mechanisms and prioritizing therapeutic interventions. Existing methods have made progress by modeling perturbation-conditioned expression shifts with neural networks, graph priors, foundation-model representations, or distributional generative models. However, combinatorial perturbation prediction remains challenging because much of the response can be explained by additive single-perturbation effects, while the biologically informative signal often lies in a smaller non-additive residual induced by perturbation interactions. Directly generating the full post-perturbation expression profile may therefore allocate substantial capacity to the dominant additive component and underemphasize synergy-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SynGeneFlow}, a synergy-aware flow matching framework that anchors the source distribution at an additive prior and learns a residual flow toward the true perturbed state. SynGeneFlow further incorporates perturbation-conditioned gene interaction modeling, where a static gene-gene mask provides biological structure and a perturbation-dependent deformation bias dynamically modulates gene-gene coupling. To preserve population-level response structure, we align both endpoint distributions and biological residual distributions with MMD-based regularization. We evaluate SynGeneFlow on genetic and drug perturbation benchmarks under observed-single, held-out, and cross-modality settings. The results demonstrate that residualizing flow matching around additive perturbation effects provides a biologically grounded and robust framework for single-cell perturbation response prediction.

</details>


### [672] [Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25034)
*Jike Zhong,Ming Li,Yuxiang Lai,Xi Xiao,Sheng Zhang,Ritwick Chaudhry,Tianle Chen,Jingyu Xie,Zheda Mai,Shao-Yuan Lo,Konstantinos Psounis,Yuanyuan Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示多轮智能体任务中"蒸馏过冲"现象：较小的学生模型可在训练中超越教师，随后却回退；并提出SPOD方法通过保留学生的成功选择来持续保持并扩大超越教师的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在策略蒸馏(OPD)使用更强教师监督学生自身轨迹，但作者发现反直觉现象：较弱的学生在训练中期能显著超越教师，继续训练后却退化。需要理解该现象的成因并解决它，以保住超越教师的增益。

Method: 从决策级与任务级分析将过冲归因于两种竞争效应：修复学生的弱决策与侵蚀教师不认可的学生成功选择。据此提出Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD)：对成功学生选择上冲突的教师监督进行选择性屏蔽，并引入软概率下限以抵御侵蚀，其余位置保留教师指导。SPOD仅需二值回合成功信号和OPD中已有的模型概率。

Result: 在两个模型族、三个智能体基准上，SPOD一致优于普通OPD及所评估的变体，最终成功率最高提升15.2个百分点，超越教师最高20.0点；且所有六个设置中，SPOD的最终检查点均优于普通OPD的最佳中间检查点。

Conclusion: 超越教师的收益不仅可被保留，还可进一步扩大；SPOD以极低额外信息成本有效缓解蒸馏过冲，为多轮智能体蒸馏提供了实用方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

</details>


### [673] [PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25048)
*Lei Gao,Hossein Entezari Zarch,Chaoyi Jiang,Murali Annavaram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PACT 是一个面向消费级 GPU 的 LoRA 微调系统，利用原生 NVFP4 GEMM 加速冻结投影，并通过复用/低比特激活与离线 GPTQ 校准降低显存与量化误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级 GPU 上微调语言模型受算力与显存限制。LoRA 虽减少可训练参数与优化器状态，但冻结投影仍然开销大，且为反向传播保留的激活值往往成为显存占用主要来源。

Method: 用原生 NVFP4 GEMM 加速冻结投影；复用已量化的 RMSNorm 输出，并将 gate/up 激活以 NVFP4 保存用于反向；前向非线性操作保留 BF16 输入，冻结权重用适配 NVFP4 尺度与量化激活的 GPTQ 离线校准；采用融合非线性 kernel 及缓存的前向/反向权重布局降低量化与反量化开销。

Result: 在 16GB RTX 5080 上跨多模型、多任务评估，显存占用更低、LoRA 微调更快，且精度具有竞争力。

Conclusion: PACT 使模型适配可在资源受限的消费级硬件上高效完成。

Abstract: Fine-tuning language models on consumer GPUs is constrained by computation and memory. Although LoRA reduces trainable parameters and optimizer state, frozen projections remain expensive, and activations retained for backward can dominate memory usage. We present PACT, a LoRA fine-tuning system that accelerates frozen projections with native NVFP4 GEMMs while reducing quantization and dequantization overhead and limiting quantization error. To reduce activation memory, PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs and saves gate/up activations in NVFP4 for backward. To limit numerical error, it preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinear operations and calibrates frozen weights offline using GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations. Fused nonlinear kernels and cached forward and backward weight layouts reduce quantization and dequantization overhead. Evaluations across multiple models and tasks on a 16\,GB RTX~5080 show lower memory usage and faster LoRA fine-tuning with competitive accuracy, enabling model adaptation on resource-constrained consumer hardware.

</details>


### [674] [HCFM: Helmholtz Component Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25059)
*Shyam Sundar Saravanan,Tie Luo,Sanjay Madria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Helmholtz分量流匹配（HCFM），将向量场分解为无散transport、压缩compression与残差三个头，避免全场的昂贵Jacobian迹估计，从而更高效地做无监督时间序列异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准流匹配学习单一的整体向量场，将正常传输与局部密度变化纠缠在一起；而局部膨胀/收缩携带关键异常信号，要分离该信号需对整个场做昂贵的Jacobian迹估计，难以扩展到大规模TSAD。

Method: 用分离的transport、compression和residual头来参数化向量场预测网络；约束transport头为无散（divergence-free），使散度估计仅需在compression头上进行，轻量残差头吸收剩余不匹配，从而把保体积的正常传输与改变密度的压缩解耦。

Result: 在大规模单变量与多变量TSAD基准上，与16个基线相比，HCFM持续提升检测精度，同时保持高效推理。

Conclusion: 结构化参数化既提升了可扩展性也提升了检测性能，从正常行为的不同偏离中得到更干净的异常信号；代码已开源。

Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) is an efficient simulation-free approach for training flow-based generative models, making it a promising foundation for scalable time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). However, standard FM learns a monolithic vector field in which nominal transport and local density-changing behavior are entangled. This creates a central challenge for TSAD; local expansion and contraction carry crucial anomaly-sensitive information, yet isolating this signal requires expensive Jacobian-trace estimation over the entire field. We propose \emph{Helmholtz Component Flow Matching} (HCFM), an unsupervised TSAD framework that parameterizes the vector field prediction network with separate transport, compression, and residual heads. The transport head is constrained to be divergence-free, so divergence estimation is restricted to the compression head, while a lightweight residual head absorbs the remaining mismatch. This structured parameterization improves scalability and detection performance by separating volume-preserving nominal transport from density-changing compression, yielding cleaner anomaly signals from distinct deviations of nominal behavior. Experiments on large-scale univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks show that HCFM consistently improves detection accuracy while maintaining efficient inference compared with 16 baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/TrustAIoT/HCFM__time-series-anomaly/

</details>


### [675] [Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25060)
*Vahid Jebraeeli,Jonathon Romero,Yijin Wang,Adrian Chan,Jianbang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 护栏分数不是模型的固有属性，而是"标签所定义的政策"的产物：同一批语料按两种政策标注后，在架构与优化器固定下，各基准分数可被0.03%的参数大幅改变，验证集准确率实际衡量的是与标注者政策的一致性而非检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究把护栏分类器报告为"文本是否不安全"的客观属性，但实际上安全性是相对于某项政策而言的，而政策通过标签悄悄进入模型。作者希望量化标签定义（政策）对基准分数的贡献，并揭示当前评估实践中的混淆因素。

Method: 利用一次工业部署的"意外"：同一约53k条提示被按两种操作定义（"是否为有害内容请求"与"版主是否会拦截"）各标注一次，训练十个共享架构、代码库与优化器族的护栏（两个模型规模）。先做去污染，再在固定架构与优化器下比较十臂在多个安全基准上的分数跨度，并分析教师软标签对蒸馏学生的影响及验证准确率的相关性。

Result: (1) 训练语料本身已含基准：JailbreakBench-benign 88%、OR-Bench-hard 82% 出现在训练池中，去污染后结论不变。(2) 分数受标签定义影响差异极大：同一设置下跨臂范围为 HarmBench-copyright 0.99 对 WildGuard-benign 0.043，相差23倍。(3) 0.03% 参数即可让基准分数跨越全量程：HarmBench-copyright 0–100、OR-Bench-hard 过度拒答 3.4–56.4%；带有特定政策的四臂在两者上均处极端（精确秩检验 p=0.005，最差 0.04–0.14），而检测能力不变。(4) 蒸馏学生的教师软标签即便所有硬标签为另一政策也能传递该政策，教师来源是未记录的混淆变量。(5) 覆盖全部二十臂的验证准确率与标注者政策一致性相关 rho=+0.74，与检测能力仅 rho=+0.34。

Conclusion: 护栏评估必须把污染情况、随机种子下限（seed floor）以及所依据的标签定义作为一等变量报告，否则基准分数无法解释、也不可比较。

Abstract: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.

</details>


### [676] [The Optimal Sample Complexity of Pointwise Replicable Agnostic Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25062)
*Guangjian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文确定了pointwise可复现学习在有限与可数域上的最优agnostic样本复杂度：对任意VC维为d的二元类，独立样本数为Θ(d/(ρ²α²)+log(1/β)/α²)，消除了此前的对数开销与参数限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究pointwise可复现性（两个同种子独立训练的预测器在每次查询上以高概率一致）的样本复杂度，此前可数域上存在对数开销和对参数的限制，需要给出紧界。

Method: 构造多个经验风险最小化器的集成，配合平滑、依赖信号的风险分解；用单一共享相位选择最终二元预测器；用记录时间证明弱信号风险，用一致界保护同一时刻的强信号风险；提出阶段比较定理控制同种子实际执行；加入稀有修复步骤使命中成本可加。

Result: 得到Θ(d/(ρ²α²)+log(1/β)/α²)的最优样本复杂度，对α,β,ρ∈(0,1/10)一致成立，并给出匹配下界；同时保留VC-1类的proper学习、完整有限原子类、更快的realizable界及区分算法限制与问题限制的反例。

Conclusion: 该工作给出pointwise可复现学习在有限/可数域上的紧agnostic样本复杂度，去除了遗留的对数开销和参数限制，是通用可数域样本复杂度问题的完整刻画。

Abstract: Pointwise replicability asks that two independently trained predictors, using the same random seed, agree at each fixed query with high probability. We determine its optimal agnostic sample complexity on finite and countable domains. For every nonempty binary class of finite VC dimension $d\ge1$, the required number of independent examples is $Θ\!\left(\frac{d}{ρ^2α^2}+\frac{\log(1/β)}{α^2}\right)$, uniformly over independent accuracy, failure, and disagreement parameters $α,β,ρ\in(0,1/10)$. The learner returns one binary function, may be improper, and uses unrestricted shared randomness. Its sample budget is fixed before observing data, and the replicability guarantee includes queries of zero marginal mass. The main construction combines an ensemble of empirical-risk minimizers with a smooth, signal-dependent risk decomposition. A single shared phase selects the final binary predictor. Record times certify its weak-signal risk, while a uniform bound protects the strong-signal risk at that same selected time. A phase-comparison theorem controls the actual shared-seed execution under simultaneous changes in the marginals and risk coefficients. A rare repair step then makes the confidence cost additive. Together with matching lower bounds, this removes the remaining logarithmic overhead and parameter restrictions in the general countable-domain sample-complexity problem. This extended version also retains the earlier explicit constructions and their proofs, including proper learning for VC-one classes, the full finite-atom class, a faster realizable bound, and counterexamples that separate restrictions of particular algorithms from restrictions of the learning problem.

</details>


### [677] [Auto-MD-bench: Evaluating Autoresearch Agents for Real-World Medical Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25069)
*Shenqi Zhou,Qiran Zou,Wenhao Zhao,Zhenyu Liao,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Auto-MD-bench，一个由 10 个临床数据集的 15 个真实医疗任务组成的基准，用于评估自主智能体端到端开发医疗 ML 模型的能力，并揭示仅靠主任务指标不足以衡量模型在真实临床场景中的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体已能端到端开发 ML 模型，但医疗实践中模型还需具备良好校准的风险估计与跨人群鲁棒性。而自主建模通常只以 AUROC 等简单判别指标为导向，这种目标是否足以引导智能体产出符合真实临床需求的模型尚不清楚。

Method: 构建 Auto-MD-bench 基准，涵盖 10 个临床数据集的 15 个真实医疗任务，包括生存分析、分类与序列预测，并设置跨队列、跨医院、跨时间段的外部验证；在此基础上评估四个智能体：AIDE、AI Scientist v2、Codex 与 Autoresearch。

Result: 最强智能体的主指标得分具竞争力，但其预测风险校准性劣于简单基线模型，可能引发严重医疗事故；主指标几乎相同的模型校准表现差异显著；在不同人群迁移下性能波动明显。

Conclusion: 仅凭主任务表现不足以评估自主临床建模，需综合采用医疗实践中广泛使用的多种指标（如校准度与鲁棒性）来评估自主智能体开发的医疗模型。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of developing machine learning (ML) models end to end. In medical practice, however, strong performance on the target metric does not fully characterize how good the models are in real-world use cases. For example, medical ML models should also provide well-calibrated risk estimates and remain robust across patient populations. Yet autonomous model development is typically guided by task objectives that emphasize simple predictive discrimination (e.g. AUROC). This raises a key question: are these objectives sufficient to guide agents toward models that meet the broader requirements of real-world medical use? In this study, we introduce Auto-MD-bench, a benchmark of 15 real-world medical tasks from 10 clinical datasets, spanning survival analysis, classification and sequential prediction, with external validation across cohorts, hospitals and time periods. We evaluate four agents: AIDE, AI Scientist v2, Codex, and Autoresearch. The strongest agents achieve competitive primary scores, yet their predicted risks are less calibrated than those of the simple baseline models, which could lead to severe medical accidents. Moreover, models with nearly identical primary scores can exhibit markedly different calibration, while performance varies substantially across population shifts. These findings show that primary task performance alone is insufficient to assess autonomous clinical modeling and multiple different metrics widely used in healthcare practice need to be taken into consideration.

</details>


### [678] [CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25078)
*Jiaqi Su,Guibin Zhang,Jie-Jing Shao,Cong Pang,Tiankuo Yao,Ivor Tsang,Haiyan Yin,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoEvo-RSI 通过"智能体驱动的双向历史继承"框架解决模型-执行壳（brain-body）失配问题，仅用 SFT 即可让 Qwen3.5-9B 在多个垂直任务上匹敌甚至超越更大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型-执行壳协同演化（RSI agents）中，不断演化的执行壳（body）会要求模型（brain）学习未掌握的行为，或限制其已有能力，形成持续被忽视的 brain-body 失配问题。作者希望在协同演化过程中对齐双方能力。

Method: 提出 CoEvo-RSI 框架：基于共享演化档案与执行反馈，由一个 meta-agent 协调双向继承——从历史设计中演化 harness（执行壳），并进行模型 checkpoint 选择/合并，再在选定 harness 下做适配，以对齐继承能力与演化后的执行需求。

Result: 仅使用对自身拒绝采样轨迹的 SFT，Qwen3.5-9B 在多智能体故障归因（TraceElephant，+14.16 agent accuracy 超 DeepSeek-V4-Pro）、角色感知 Text-to-SQL、智能家居指令遵循（HomeBench VM，+4.90 success rate 超 GLM-5.3）等任务上具备竞争力。

Conclusion: 结果表明 brain-body 对齐对于 RSI 智能体至关重要；双向历史继承能够有效推进智能体的协同演化，并可用低成本 SFT 达到与更大模型竞争的效果。

Abstract: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.

</details>
