The filters alone reproduce the order in which the senses mature, by construction. The networks add what filters cannot: in vision they extract far less than their input allows at early stages (at the newborn stage a toy's position cannot be read out, $R^2 = 0.00$, against 0.57 for a network trained directly on the same input), and a critical period and perceptual narrowing emerge without being built in; in hearing they track what their input allows. The same filters drive the Baby Senses Lab, a free website that shows a user's own images and sounds as a baby of a chosen age might sense them. It is a research and teaching tool, not a diagnostic test.

</details>


### [714] [Structured Relevance Determination and Channel Additive Gaussian Processes for Image Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25385)
*Harald Roßels,Ludovico Scarton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为图像输入的高斯过程提出基于结构化超参数共享的RBF核，通过像素块与通道内的长度尺度绑定减少超参数，并结合通道可加GP提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维图像输入下，完全各向异性的RBF核对每个输入维度分配独立长度尺度，导致超参数过多，在数据有限时易过拟合、预测不确定性校准差。

Method: 提出结构化相关性判定：在相邻像素分组内及同一颜色通道内绑定长度尺度，形成块级（patch-wise）与通道级（channel-wise）约束的各向异性RBF参数化；进一步提出通道可加高斯过程，将潜函数分解为定义在通道子集上的分量，并与结构化相关性判定结合；同时展示通道级结构化判定可融入卷积高斯过程。

Result: 在MNIST及一个低分辨率RGB卫星图像芯片的紧凑二分类飞机检测数据集上评估，与各向同性及完全各向异性RBF基线相比，预测性能提升。

Conclusion: 结构化超参数共享能在显著减少独立长度尺度数量的同时改善GP在图像任务上的预测表现，通道可加分解还带来一定的非局部泛化能力，且方法可扩展到卷积高斯过程。

Abstract: We introduce radial basis function (RBF) kernels for Gaussian processes that use structured hyperparameter sharing for image-valued inputs. For high-dimensional inputs such as images, a fully anisotropic RBF kernel assigns a separate lengthscale to each input dimension, which can introduce many hyperparameters and may lead to overfitting and poorly calibrated predictive uncertainty when data are limited. We propose structured relevance determination by tying lengthscales across groups of adjacent pixels and within each colour channel. This yields patch-wise and channel-wise constrained anisotropic RBF parametrisations that reduce the number of independently learned lengthscales. We further introduce channel-additive Gaussian processes for multi-channel images and combine them with structured relevance determination, resulting in a parameter-efficient decomposition of the latent function into components defined on channel subsets, enabling some non-local generalisation. The proposed kernels are evaluated on MNIST and a compact binary aircraft-detection dataset of low-resolution RGB satellite image chips. We also show how channel-wise structured relevance determination can be incorporated into convolutional Gaussian processes. We observe improved predictive performance compared to isotropic and fully anisotropic RBF baselines.

</details>


### [715] [The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25389)
*Abdelkrim Alfalah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究揭示了电力价格实证研究中"仅使用交易决策时刻可得信息"这一前提难以成立，基于128,656次天气预报运行的实证发现，"选择闸门前最新发布的预报"在多数配置下超过99%的交付日实际使用了尚未发布的数据，呼吁在建模前对数据管道进行point-in-time正确性审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力价格实证研究通常声称只使用交易决策时刻可得的信息，但商业天气预报档案中"发布时间"与"模型运行时间"不一致、拍卖闸门用本地时间而档案用UTC、实况数据事后修订等问题使这一假设难以保证，且其成立与否随时间变化，因此需要系统识别和量化这些时点问题。

Method: 识别三类时间时点陷阱（预报运行标签时间为模型发起时间但实际数小时后才可获取且发布后不断变化；拍卖闸门用本地时钟而档案用UTC；实况序列事后修订不保留旧值）；利用十个天气模型配置共128,656次预报运行的时间戳，与实际英国日前及首次日内拍卖闸门匹配，对2022–2026年数据统计"闸门前最新运行"是否真的在闸门时刻已发布，并测量误选输入与真实可得输入的差异及其表观精度变化。

Result: 对十种配置中的六种，在其中一个闸门处，超过99%的交付日上"闸门前最新运行"实际尚未发布；GFS在日前闸门处该比例为冬季0.6%、夏季99.8%；暴露度随发布延迟漂移而变化，几分钟的操作余量可能损失完整的六小时预报周期；误选输入与闸门时刻真实可得输入存在实质差异，但其表观精度增益在-9%到+24%之间，跨变量、模型、闸门和季节波动，效应不可假设而必须测量。

Conclusion: point-in-time正确性应被视为数据管道的动态属性而非一次性检查；论文提出一种在拟合任何模型之前即基于时间戳进行审计的协议，以避免前瞻偏差被误判为预测能力。

Abstract: Empirical studies of electricity prices routinely state that their models use only information available at the time of the trading decision. For weather-driven forecasts drawn from commercial archives, this condition is harder to meet than it appears, and whether it holds can change over time. We identify three timing pitfalls. A forecast run is labelled by the issue time of its weather model, but becomes available hours later and keeps changing after publication. Auction gates follow local clock time, while archives use UTC. Outturn series are revised after publication without earlier values being kept. Using the timestamps of 128,656 forecast runs from ten weather-model configurations, matched to the day-ahead and first intraday auction gates in Great Britain over 2022-2026, we find that selecting "the latest run issued before the gate" picks a run not yet published at the gate on more than 99% of delivery days for six of the ten configurations at one of the two gates. For GFS at the day-ahead gate, the share is 0.6% in winter and 99.8% in summer. The exposure also shifts as publication delays drift, and an action margin of a few minutes can cost a full six-hour forecast cycle. The wrongly selected inputs differ materially from those available at the gate, but their apparent accuracy gain ranges from -9% to +24% across variables, models, gates and seasons, so its effect cannot be assumed and must be measured. We argue that point-in-time correctness is a dynamic property of the data pipeline, and propose a protocol that audits it from timestamps before any model is fitted.

</details>


### [716] [Paloma: Phase-Conditioned Residual Modulation for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25392)
*Jingru Fei,Wei Fan,Kun Yi,Qi Zhang,Zhendong Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出周期分解后的残差并非无结构噪声，而是具有相位依赖的方向与幅度变化；据此提出 Paloma 框架，用相位旋转与幅度缩放两个模块（可插件化）建模残差，在十二个数据集上取得 SOTA 且可提升多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于周期性建模的时序预测方法在去除周期成分后，通常把剩余残差视为无结构噪声直接丢弃或忽略。作者通过实证观察与理论分析发现，残差实际上存在结构化的、随相位变化的偏差（方向与幅度均会变化），因此应将其建模为"相位条件信号"而非噪声。

Method: 受经典信号处理中的相位与幅度调制启发，提出 Paloma 框架，包含两个互补模块：(1) 相位旋转模块，执行相位条件的旋转以捕捉特征空间中的方向变化；(2) 幅度缩放模块，执行相位条件的仿射变换以建模幅度变化。两模块被抽象为通用插件（Paloma technique），可嵌入现有预测骨干网络，以相位感知方式调制输入序列。

Result: 在 12 个数据集上实验，Paloma 达到 SOTA 且鲁棒的预测性能；额外实验表明该技术可一致性地提升多种基线模型，验证了其作为通用组件的有效性。

Conclusion: 残差应被视为相位条件信号而非无结构噪声；通过相位旋转与幅度缩放显式建模残差偏差是一种简单有效的手段，且可插件化地推广到各类预测架构中。

Abstract: Explicitly modeling periodicity has proven to be an efficient approach for time series forecasting, where the residual, obtained after removing the periodic component from the time series, is typically treated as unstructured noise. However, in this work, we show that such residuals still exhibit structured, \textit{phase-dependent} deviations, as supported by both empirical observations and theoretical analysis. This suggests that residuals should not be treated merely as unstructured noise, but instead as \textit{phase-conditioned signals} whose variations arise in both direction and magnitude. Motivated by this perspective and inspired by phase and amplitude modulation in classical signal processing, we propose \textit{Paloma}, a simple yet effective framework for modeling residual deviations. Specifically, Paloma comprises two complementary modules: \textit{a Phase Rotation module}, which performs phase-conditioned rotations to capture directional changes in the feature space, and \textit{an Amplitude Scaling module}, which applies phase-conditioned affine transformations to model magnitude variations. We further abstract the two modules into a general-purpose plugin, termed the \textit{Paloma technique}, which can be readily integrated into existing forecasting architectures to modulate input sequences in a phase-aware manner, enabling backbone models to capture phase-dependent variations in both direction and magnitude. Extensive experiments on twelve datasets demonstrate that Paloma achieves state-of-the-art and robust forecasting performance. Additional results show that the Paloma technique consistently improves a wide range of baseline models, validating its effectiveness as a general-purpose component. Our Code is available at \url{https://github.com/TSTS13/Paloma}.

</details>


### [717] [MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25431)
*Sravanth Kodavanti,Manjunath Arveti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOSAIC 用多目标神经架构搜索为每个 transformer 层学习 KV-cache 预算，替代所有层均分预算的做法，在多种驱逐方法与模型上显著优于均匀分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV cache 是长上下文 LLM 推理的主要内存瓶颈。SnapKV、H2O、AdaKV、L2Norm 等 token 驱逐方法能压缩缓存，但它们给每层相同的预算，忽略了不同层对 token 需求存在差异。

Method: 提出 MOSAIC，一种多目标神经架构搜索方法，可为任意驱逐方法学习逐层 KV-cache 预算。一次搜索即可刻画"平均预算—任务分数"的权衡曲线，其最优分配可零额外搜索地迁移到任意目标预算，并可选地用带预算约束的搜索进一步精修。

Result: 在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 上、四种驱逐方法的 154 个（task, method, budget）设置中，MOSAIC 有 146 个优于均匀分配，RULER 最多 +48 分、LongBench(LCC) +11.9；两个模型上均能以最高 4x 更少（小 75%）的 KV cache 达到均匀分配的分数。相比 EvolKV，搜索空间大 ~10^40 倍而评估次数少 4 倍、每预算 GPU 小时少 18%，6 个设置中 5 个分数更高；学到的分配稳定偏好少数中间层。

Conclusion: 逐层差异化 KV-cache 预算分配是有效且可迁移的优化方向；MOSAIC 以高效搜索实现显著内存节省与精度提升，并揭示中间层对缓存预算更为敏感。

Abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

</details>


### [718] [Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25447)
*Tomer Garber,Tom Tirer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EMDU，将掩码扩散语言模型的遗忘损失改为"锚点在前"KL并使用全答案掩码锚点，解决MDU在记忆化token上梯度消失与关键遗忘token泄漏的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）进入实际部署后需要机器遗忘能力，以移除敏感、受版权保护或受限内容的影响。首个针对该模型定制的遗忘方法MDU（在遗忘集上最小化KL(p_θ‖p_anchor)）存在缺陷：随机答案掩码会让问题的关键遗忘token仍对锚点可见；且在接近one-hot的记忆化预测处，"锚点在后"KL的logit梯度会消失，导致最该遗忘的token训练停滞。

Method: 提出Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU)：改用"锚点在前"的KL散度 KL(p_anchor‖p_θ)，并将冻结锚点的整个答案跨度全部掩码，从而避免关键遗忘token泄漏并在记忆化预测处保留有效梯度；并给出理论分析与实证验证。

Result: 在LLaDA-8B与Dream-7B上，于TOFU和RWKU基准测试中，EMDU的遗忘效果与MDU及适配的自回归基线持平或更优，同时更好地保持保留集实用能力。

Conclusion: 通过修正KL方向与锚点掩码策略，EMDU为掩码扩散语言模型提供了更有效的遗忘方案，在遗忘强度与效用保持间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional context. As these models reach real-world deployment, machine unlearning becomes essential. This process aims to remove the influence of a designated "forget set" without retraining from scratch, so that sensitive, copyrighted, or restricted content can no longer be elicited while preserving retained capabilities. Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU) is the first publicly available unlearning method customized for these models: it tunes the model $p_θ$ to match a frozen prompt-masked anchor $p_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ on the forget set by minimizing the anchor-last divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_θ\Vert p_{\mathrm{anchor}})$. We identify two failure modes of MDU. First, random answer masking can leave key forget tokens visible to the anchor even when the question is fully masked. Second, at a memorized (near-one-hot) prediction, the anchor-last logit gradient vanishes while the anchor-first divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{anchor}} \Vert p_θ)$ logit gradient does not. As a result, MDU training stalls on the tokens we most need to forget. Backed by theoretical and empirical analyses, we propose Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU): anchor-first KL divergence toward a frozen anchor whose entire answer span is masked. On TOFU and RWKU benchmarks using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, our EMDU matches or exceeds the forgetting of MDU and adapted AR baselines, while better preserving retain utility.

</details>


### [719] [Semi-supervised learning on singular data sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25450)
*Guillaume Valette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用子解析集刻画奇异数据云，基于 Sobolev 型 Morrey 嵌入发展半监督学习，并用贪心+蒙特卡洛近似实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据云常呈奇异/低维几何结构，经典基于全局正则性的半监督学习理论与方法难以直接适用。

Method: 以子解析集建模数据云；针对全局子解析测度（支撑可奇异）建立 Sobolev 空间的 Morrey 型嵌入；据此构造贪心算法，用蒙特卡洛近似候选解的 Sobolev 范数。

Result: 在采样自实代数簇的点云上做数值实验，并在 7×7 下采样的 MNIST 图像分类任务上完成测试。

Conclusion: 子解析几何框架为奇异数据云上的半监督学习提供理论支撑，且贪心蒙特卡洛方案在实验中可行有效。

Abstract: We propose to model singular data clouds by subanalytic sets, and develop an approach to semi-supervised learning in this setting. It relies on a Morrey-type embedding for Sobolev spaces relative to globally subanalytic measures with possibly singular support. As an illustration, we present a greedy method based on a Monte Carlo approximation of the Sobolev norm of the candidate solutions. We report numerical experiments on point clouds sampled from real algebraic varieties, as well as a test on a classification problem based on MNIST images downsampled into $7\times7$.

</details>


### [720] [Near-Optimal Last-Iterate Convergence of SGD in the Smooth Interpolation Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25469)
*Matan Schliserman,Tomer Koren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究常数步长SGD在低噪声/插值情形下最后一次迭代的收敛率，证明对任意0<η<2/β均达Õ(1/T)（插值情形），与下界匹配并改进已有结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前的收敛保证在插值/低噪声情形下对常数步长SGD的最后一次迭代仅给出O(1/√T)速率（如Attia et al. 2026在η=1/β时），与Ω(1/T)下界存在差距，需要更紧的最后迭代分析。

Method: 提出新技术：仅在对数级多个时间尺度上比较沿SGD轨迹的随机梯度二阶矩，据此分析β-光滑凸损失的常数步长SGD最后迭代；并对二次损失作适配变体。

Result: 对任意0<η<2/β，最后迭代期望超额风险为Õ(1/(η(2-βη)^3 T) + η/(2-βη)^4·σ_★^2)；插值情形下对所有常数步长均达Õ(1/T)，与Ω(1/T)下界相差对数因子；对二次损失扩展了Derezinski & Dong (2026)随机Kaczmarz的最优率至贪心步长以上，且证明更简。

Conclusion: 常数步长SGD最后迭代在插值/低噪声凸优化中可达近最优Õ(1/T)，覆盖全部合法常数步长，统一并改进多项已有结果。

Abstract: We study the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a constant stepsize on smooth convex objectives in the low-noise and interpolation regimes, where the variance $σ_\star^2$ of the stochastic gradients at the optimum is small or zero. We establish that after $T$ steps of SGD on $β$-smooth convex losses with any constant stepsize $0<η<2/β$, the last iterate attains expected excess risk $\widetilde O\bigl(\tfrac{1}{η(2-βη)^3T}+\tfracη{(2-βη)^4}σ_\star^2\bigr)$, which gives the rate $\smash{\widetilde O(1/T)}$ for every constant stepsize in the interpolation regime ($σ_\star=0$), matching the $Ω(1/T)$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and improving upon the $O(1/\sqrt T)$ rate of Attia et al. (2026) for $η=1/β$. Our analysis is based on a new technique, which compares the second moments of the stochastic gradients along the SGD trajectory across only logarithmically many time scales. For quadratic losses in the interpolation regime, an adaptation of this technique gives an $O(1/T)$ rate for every constant stepsize, extending the recent optimal rate for the randomized Kaczmarz method of Derezinski and Dong (2026) to stepsizes above the greedy stepsize with an arguably simpler proof.

</details>


### [721] [Consistent LLM Call Handling Across Java Frameworks: A Reference Implementation and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25480)
*Oleksandr Klymenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个六条款的LLM可靠性契约，并用15个失败场景测试Spring AI 2.0.1和LangChain4j 1.21.0，发现两者分别满足72/77和47/77的适用案例，且都会把缺少终止符的流当作完整答案返回。作者在HTTP边界实现一个仅依赖JDK与Micrometer Observation的725行共享核心层，使三个客户端行为一致地达到90/91的契约满足率，中位开销32-217微秒，本地服务器700次调用无误拒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Java应用通过集成框架访问LLM，并依赖框架处理供应商失败（可重试才重试、按要求等待、不把截断答案当完整、记录指标）。但这些期望从未被形式化，也缺乏对各主流框架实际表现的系统性测量，框架默认行为与显式配置之间的差距未知。

Method: 1) 将可靠性期望表述为六条款契约；2) 用脚本化的OpenAI兼容provider对Spring AI 2.0.1与LangChain4j 1.21.0进行15个失败场景、同步与流式、三次重复的测试，分别在默认与显式配置下测量；3) 在HTTP边界实现契约（Spring AI用OkHttp拦截器、LangChain4j用HttpClient、无框架用java.net.http transport），共享725行仅依赖JDK与Micrometer Observation API的核心。

Result: 默认配置下LangChain4j满足47/77、显式配置下51/83；Spring AI为72/77与76/83；两者都将未终止的流作为完整答案交付。引入共享层后三个客户端行为一致，满足90/91，剩余一例是"重试挂起供应商 vs. 等待慢首token"的策略权衡；对本地模型服务器700次调用无误拒，单次调用中位开销32-217微秒。

Conclusion: 现有Java LLM集成框架的失败处理可靠性不足，且流式截断处理是共性缺陷；在HTTP边界实现一个轻量、框架无关的可靠性层可让不同框架行为统一并接近完全满足契约，开销可忽略，具备工程可行性。

Abstract: Java applications reach large language models (LLMs) through an integration framework, and rely on it to handle a failing provider: to retry what can be retried and nothing else, to wait as long as the provider asks, never to present a truncated answer as complete, and to record each failure in the application's metrics. We state these expectations as a six-clause reliability contract and measure Spring AI 2.0.1 and LangChain4j 1.21.0 against it with a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider: fifteen failure scenarios, synchronous and streaming, three repetitions. LangChain4j meets it in 47 of 77 applicable cases with its defaults and in 51 of 83 when configured explicitly, Spring AI in 72 of 77 and 76 of 83; both deliver a stream that ended without its terminator as a complete answer. We then place one implementation of the contract beneath both frameworks, at the HTTP boundary - an OkHttp interceptor for Spring AI, an HttpClient for LangChain4j, and a java.net.http transport for code without a framework - sharing a 725-line core that depends only on the JDK and the Micrometer Observation API. With it, all three clients behave identically and meet the contract in 90 of 91 cases; the remaining case is a policy trade-off between retrying a hung provider and waiting for a slow first token. Against a local model server the layer rejected none of 700 calls, and it adds a median of 32-217 microseconds to a call.

</details>


### [722] [Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25495)
*Junyu Chen,Franklin Liu,Moshu Xu,Lijian Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LOBGrad：将自回归RNN编码器与条件DDPM结合用于限价订单簿概率预测，并给出超额风险oracle不等式；在BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META上优于无编码器消融，且能复现LOB微观结构典型事实并给出较校准的预测区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LOB动态建模对市场预测与执行策略评估至关重要。已有扩散模型虽实证效果好，但通常缺少可学习的循环编码器，也缺乏形式化统计保证。

Method: 提出LOBGrad：条件DDPM框架，包含自回归RNN编码器与扩散生成器。理论部分在指数混合与正则性假设下，为单步DDPM噪声预测目标建立超额风险oracle不等式；进一步证明在收缩动态下，对条件窗口长度的依赖可降为对隐状态维度的依赖。

Result: 在BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META数据上，LOBGrad在全部报告的队列指标上优于无编码器扩散消融，并与其他基线相比具有竞争力；能复现LOB微观结构关键典型事实，队列预测区间校准合理；一个风格化下游任务展示了生成预测的潜在价值。

Conclusion: LOBGrad把循环编码与扩散生成结合，并首次为LOB扩散预测提供超额风险保证，在实证与理论两方面均有表现，展示了概率性LOB预测的实际可用性。

Abstract: Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.

</details>


### [723] [Steered Not Stirred: Effective Reward Tilting using Surrogate Reward Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25502)
*Alec Sargood,Olivia Gallup,Georg Maierhofer,Noam Ghenassia,Paul Duckworth,Krisztina Sinkovics,Avishek Joey Bose*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MARTINI 方法，将多个廉价代理奖励组合起来，用于在推理时把预训练连续时间生成模型导向不可观测的 oracle 奖励 $R^*$ 倾斜的分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实 oracle 奖励（如人类判断、实验测量）往往不可获得或代价高昂，但存在多个廉价代理可近似之，单个代理信息不完整、联合可揭示更多信息，因此需要一种组合代理并导向 oracle 分布的方法。

Method: 给定少量 oracle 排序或数值奖励反馈集，学习一个代理奖励组合（surrogate composition），可即插即用地配合标准推理时引导方法使用；并给出理论分析，刻画代理信息极限，在小倾斜强度下将总体恢复误差与理想目标 KL 关联，对偏好情形还计入 Plackett-Luce 总体目标与条件均值之间的不可消除失配。

Result: 在语言生成和 ImageNet 对齐上提升了 oracle 倾斜保真度；在蛋白-配体共折叠中提升了联合位姿准确度与有效性，且推理时无需查询 oracle。

Conclusion: 通过组合廉价代理奖励可在推理时无 oracle 查询地逼近 oracle 倾斜分布，理论与实验均支持该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Continuous-time generative models, from diffusion models, flow matching, and now flow maps, owe their practical value to high-fidelity generation and steerability. In many applications, a ground-truth latent ``oracle'' reward $R^*$ is unavailable or expensive to evaluate, e.g., human judgments or experimental measurements. Although the oracle reward is not directly observable, it can often be approximated through multiple cheaper surrogates that, individually, provide incomplete characterizations but collectively reveal substantial information about the downstream task. In this paper, we present a method for composing such surrogates to steer a pretrained model toward the distribution tilted by an unavailable $R^*$. Given a small feedback set of oracle rankings or numerical rewards, we introduce Mixing And Reward Tilting for INference-time Improvement (MARTINI), which learns a surrogate composition for plug-and-play use with standard inference-time steering methods. Our theory characterizes surrogate information limits and relates population recovery error to ideal-target KL at small tilt strength. For preferences, the bound additionally accounts for an irreducible mismatch between the Plackett-Luce population target and the conditional mean. Experiments demonstrate improved oracle-tilt fidelity in language generation and ImageNet alignment, and improved joint pose accuracy and validity in protein-ligand cofolding, without inference-time oracle queries.

</details>


### [724] [KPI-Aware Multimodal Anomaly Detection for 5G and Open RAN Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25510)
*Chiman Salavati,Liang Wu,Kelly Wan,Mayank Darbari,Liangjie Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KAC：面向部署的KPI感知多模态异常检测框架，通过KPI级残差-文本对齐将运维摘要转化为可学习反馈信号，兼顾全KPI数值覆盖与稀疏KPI级推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G/Open RAN及6G可观测性场景中，数百个异构KPI、严重类别不平衡与严格告警预算使纯数值异常分数脆弱，难以可靠部署；同时需保留运维人员可交互、可持续的KPI级反馈推理能力。

Method: 提出KAC框架：(1)以全KPI时序证据作数值骨干，获得类时序模型的广泛数值覆盖；(2)将紧凑的运营商风格摘要经KPI级残差-文本对齐，转为对检测器的可学习反馈信号；(3)支持稀疏、KPI特定的运维反馈推理流程。

Result: 在公开电信遥测（TelecomTS）、企业级Open RAN可观测性数据及基于真实5G RAN生产数据包轨迹、注入更真实异常的Nokia基准上：阈值型检测性能强，无阈值排序指标具竞争力；TelecomTS在2.5% FPR工作点下residual类方法中召回最高且精度相当；在显著类别不平衡下保持稳健。

Conclusion: KAC已集成到Nokia基于GKE的KPI构建管线的预生产影子模式，与内部数据包级异常检测器并行持续评分遥测窗口，用于运维评估，验证了其部署可行性与实用价值。

Abstract: Reliable anomaly detection is a deployment bottleneck for 5G/Open RAN observability and emerging self-optimizing 6G systems, where hundreds of heterogeneous KPIs, severe class imbalance, and strict alert budgets make purely numerical scores brittle. We present KAC, a deployment-oriented KPI-aware multimodal anomaly-detection framework that uses KPI-level residual-text alignment to turn compact operator-style summaries into a learnable feedback signal over full-KPI temporal evidence. This gives the detector broad numerical coverage like modern time-series models, while retaining the sparse KPI-specific reasoning that makes operator feedback sustainable in a future operator-facing workflow. Across public telecom telemetry, enterprise-scale Open RAN observability data, and a Nokia benchmark built from real 5G RAN production packet traces with realism-hardened injected anomalies, KAC achieves strong threshold-based detection performance while remaining competitive on threshold-free ranking metrics. On TelecomTS, at a fixed 2.5 percent false-positive-rate operating point, KAC achieves the highest recall among the evaluated residual-based methods while maintaining comparable precision; across the evaluated benchmarks, it remains robust under substantial class imbalance. KAC is integrated in pre-production shadow mode with Nokia's GKE-based KPI construction pipeline, where it continuously scores telemetry windows alongside an internal packet-level anomaly detector for operational evaluation.

</details>


### [725] [Dynamics-Aligned Representation Learning under Induced Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25511)
*SM Mazharul Islam,Manfred Huber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出随机门控机制（Beta–Bernoulli 空间二值掩码）在训练中引入受控部分可观测性，提升基于像素的MBRL的规划性能与数据效率，且改动极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MBRL用观测重建目标训练潜动力学模型，强监督易使表征偏向视觉保真度，导致先验训练不足、长时程预测不可靠。

Method: 每个时间步从Beta–Bernoulli随机场采样空间二值掩码并作用于原始观测，门概率逐步重采样，使编码器经历从近乎全遮挡到近乎全可见的条件；门控观测与掩码按通道拼接作为单一增广输入送入编码器，训练流程其余部分不变。

Result: 在DeepMind Control Suite的像素连续控制任务上，以仅依赖开环模型推演的MPC评测，随机门控提升了规划性能与数据效率；性能对掩码空间尺度稳健，训练中均衡可观测性优于更稀疏或更密集的配置。

Conclusion: 通过在训练中引入随机部分可观测性，可缓解重建目标带来的表征偏置，是一种低成本、易集成的MBRL改进手段。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has enabled sample-efficient learning of continuous control policies from high-dimensional observations through learned latent dynamics models. These models are typically trained with observation reconstruction objectives, which provide strong supervision but can bias representations toward visual fidelity leading to an undertrained prior and unreliable long-horizon predictions. We propose a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training by sampling a spatial binary mask from a Beta--Bernoulli random field and applying it to the raw observation. The gate probability is resampled at each time step, exposing the encoder to conditions ranging from near-total occlusion to near-full visibility. Integration of our method requires minimal architectural changes from existing dynamics models: the gated observation and the binary mask are channel-wise concatenated and passed to the encoder as a single augmented input, with no modifications to the broader training pipeline. We evaluate the proposed approach on a set of pixel-based continuous control tasks selected from the DeepMind Control Suite. Using model predictive control for evaluation, which relies solely on open-loop model rollouts, we show that stochastic gating improves planning performance and data efficiency across tasks. Further analysis demonstrates that performance is robust to the spatial scale of the mask, and a balanced observability during training outperforms configurations biased toward either sparser or denser observations.

</details>


### [726] [ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25519)
*Mobina Kashaniyan,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ATEST资源感知的测试时扩展（TTS）框架，根据样本预期价值与实时GPU能耗成本自适应决定采样预算，在能耗约束下保持推理精度并随负载自动减少采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTS用固定采样预算，忽略查询难度差异以及GPU争用下推理能耗的动态变化；实测同一条四样本查询在负载升高时能耗可增长4.1倍，固定预算会造成能源浪费或超支。

Method: ATEST含两种模式：ATEST-Online（默认）无需离线校准，增量生成样本、估计多数答案的稳定性、监测实时GPU状态并在线学习单步能耗，据此决定何时停止；ATEST-Calibrated则用离线精度与成本模型为每个查询选择预算，适合稳定负载场景。

Result: 在A100上用Phi-3-mini评测四个推理/问答数据集，并迁移至L40S与Qwen2.5-3B。四个A100数据集上ATEST-Online均不超能耗预算，取得最高或统计并列精度且随负载降低采样。GSM8K高负载下准确率60.0%且无延迟处理，对比ATEST-Calibrated的44.0%与42.4%延迟率。消融显示在线成本学习是负载适应的关键；含离线分析在内，ATEST-Online所用GPU时间与能耗分别比校准版少42倍和48倍。

Conclusion: 在线控制以更高尾延迟和短任务较低吞吐换取负载变化下的鲁棒性与能效；离线校准在稳定条件下仍有竞争力，二者适用于不同部署情境。

Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

</details>


### [727] [FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25523)
*Jiayu Li,Umair Afzal,Zilong Zhao,Milad Abdollahzadeh,Uzair Javaid,Biplab Sikdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FracTS：受分形图像生成启发的层次化、由粗到细分形自回归模型，用于多变量时间序列生成，在五个数据集上优于七个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成时间序列数据在隐私保护共享、数据增强和压力测试中需求增长。早期生成方法多为自回归，存在样本多样性低、误差累积、难以建模长程依赖的问题。

Method: 将图像领域的分形生成范式从2D迁移到1D序列，学习多尺度表示：粗尺度捕获全局轨迹结构，细尺度捕获局部动态，同时保持自回归特性。利用时间序列的结构化特性进行自动化/指定的时间特征处理，并引入描述实例的全局（静态）特征以提升生成质量；设计天然处理多变量依赖，无需固定长度输入即可改善长时程时间一致性。

Result: 在五个数据集（两个条件、三个无条件）上与七个基线对比，FracTS在边缘分布、预测性ML效用及无条件设置下的相关性保持上持续领先。预测性ML效用相对最佳基线：无条件平均提升100.0%，条件提升75.0–81.0%（基于数据集平均原始值的相对误差）。

Conclusion: 分形多尺度自回归范式可有效提升多变量时间序列生成质量，代码已开源。

Abstract: Time series are ubiquitous across different domains, and the growing use of synthetic data for privacy-preserving sharing, data augmentation, and stress testing makes time series generation increasingly important. Early generative approaches are predominantly autoregressive, which can suffer from low sample diversity, error accumulation, and difficulty modeling long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce FracTS, a hierarchical, coarse-to-fine autoregressive model for multivariate time series generation. Inspired by fractal generative modeling developed for images, FracTS adapts the paradigm from 2D to 1D sequences by learning a multi-scale representation that captures global trajectory structure at coarse scales and local dynamics at fine scales while following the autoregressive nature of time series. In contrast to unstructured images, time series are structured, allowing easy automated or designated temporal feature processing optimized for the model, and global (static) feature extraction describing the instances that generate the corresponding time series in the collection. We incorporate them in the generation process to further improve the generation quality. The design naturally handles multivariate dependencies and improves long-horizon temporal coherence without requiring fixed-length inputs. Experiments on five datasets (two conditional, three unconditional) conducted against seven baselines show that FracTS consistently outperforms baselines across marginal distribution and predictive ML utility, and correlation preservation in the unconditional setting. In particular, the predictive ML utility is averagely improved by 100.0% and 75.0-81.0% for unconditional and conditional time series datasets compared to the best baseline (relative error computed on dataset-averaged raw values). Code is available at: https://github.com/BetterdataLabs/fracts.

</details>


### [728] [Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25544)
*Maharani Devira Pramita,Aidan O'Sullivan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在EPRI AI-ccelerating UC竞赛的51机72小时基准上研究强化学习求解机组组合（UC），指出RL智能体成本高的根源在于其自身探索（导致过度开机），通过模仿MILP解并保守微调可将PPO拉至最优解的2.6%以内，并利用该策略固定变量加速MILP 3.8–8.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL被提出作为UC的快速求解器，但独立智能体比MILP昂贵得多；作者希望定位这一差距的成因并弥合差距，使RL策略能真正加速精确求解器。

Method: 在EPRI 51机72小时基准上测试PPO与动作分支DQN（从零训练），与thermal-only MILP最优、merit-order规则对比；分析独立采样决策与探索噪声对过度开机的影响；采用模仿MILP解 + 保守微调（无shaping项奖励）训练策略，并用微调策略的置信决策固定变量以加速MILP。

Result: PPO/DQN从零训练开机数约为MILP最优的2倍、成本高39–64%，而merit-order规则仅差1.6–7%（计入未供能时10–24%）；独立采样下备用量起保险作用，注入探索噪声会扩大机队，去除shaping项不能消除过度开机；模仿+保守微调使PPO达最优2.6%以内，惩罚成本最低（约5%）；固定置信决策使MILP快3.8–8.5倍且解质在0.10–0.25%内，最坏情况优于仅模仿策略（1.1% vs 8.9%）。

Conclusion: RL高成本的主因是自身探索造成的过度开机，可通过模仿与保守微调消除，所得策略能有效加速精确MILP求解器；由于调度方法和基准范围本身可使最优性比报告值偏移达3.6%和9%，作者提出统一报告协议。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

</details>


### [729] [Beyond the record: evaluating probabilistic AI weather forecasts deep in the tail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25545)
*Bastiaan Van Velthoven,Cas Decancq,Diego G. Miralles,Stijn Luca,Thomas Mortier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究比较四种概率型AI天气预报模型与物理IFS-ENS在历史记录外的技能保持能力，发现AI模型在高温/低温记录上几乎全面优于IFS-ENS，且高温优势随记录深度增加而增强，但优势随预报时长缩短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性AI预报已被报道存在外推失败问题，但概率型AI集合预报能否在超出训练域（历史记录之外）保持技能尚不清楚，需要系统性验证。

Method: 选取ArchesWeatherGen、U-Cast、WeatherNext2、GenCast-mini四种SOTA概率AI模型与IFS-ENS对比，基于1979–2021年月度ERA5记录定义历史边界，用"深度"（超出本地历史变率的幅度）刻画2022年新记录；采用两个proper评分——记录阈值加权CRPS与Brier score，覆盖所有合格样本并同时计入漏报极端和虚警，并对比ERA5与HRES-fc0两种验证源。

Result: 在2–10天、1.5°分辨率、陆地区域上，AI模型在几乎全部时长与深度上于高温和低温记录超越IFS-ENS；高温优势随深度增强（部分因IFS-ENS高估深层记录），并在HRES-fc0验证下大体保持；风场优势随深度和时长增加而衰减。同时发现尾部评分优势可与总体概率偏差共存，部分改进主要来自非超阈值样本，且结果选择可导致在更极端观测子集上出现虚假的"低估增强"。

Conclusion: 概率型AI集合能在阈值超出本地记录时保持并（对高温）扩大对IFS-ENS的优势，但所有优势随时长收窄；不应将确定性AI的外推失败推广至概率系统，并需建立区分尾部比较技能、已实现极端表现与概率校准的通用验证规范。

Abstract: Can probabilistic artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasts retain skill beyond their training domain? We compare four state-of-the-art AI models (ArchesWeatherGen, U-Cast, WeatherNext2 and GenCast-mini) with the physics-based IFS-ENS over land in 2022, at 1.5° resolution and lead times of 2--10 days. Monthly ERA5 records from 1979--2021 define common historical boundaries, and we characterize new records set in 2022 by their depth, i.e., the exceedance margin relative to local historical variability. Two proper scores, record-threshold weighted CRPS and Brier score, assess the magnitude and probability of record exceedances across all eligible cases, retaining both missed extremes and false alarms. Verified against ERA5, AI models outperform IFS-ENS for heat and cold records at almost every lead and depth. For heat, the advantage strengthens with depth, partly because IFS-ENS over-forecasts deep records, and largely persists for deeper records under HRES-fc0 verification. For wind, gains erode for deeper records and longer leads. Better tail scores can nevertheless coexist with aggregate probability deficits or surpluses, and some improvements arise chiefly on non-exceedances. Increasing underprediction on progressively more extreme observed subsets can also arise through outcome selection, even for an ideal conditional-mean forecast. These findings establish that native probabilistic AI ensembles retain, and for heat increase, their advantage over IFS-ENS as thresholds move beyond local records, although all advantages narrow with lead time. They caution against generalizing the extrapolation failure reported for deterministic AI forecasts to probabilistic systems, and motivate common verification conventions that separate comparative tail skill, performance on realized extremes, and probabilistic calibration.

</details>


### [730] [FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25558)
*Josif Grabocka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FTFM，用行/列各一个上下文潜变量分解计算，在保留单元格级表示的同时降低注意力开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型存在权衡：保留单元格级表示的模型需反复跨行跨列注意力，代价高；较快的模型把每行压缩为固定嵌入，丢失细粒度状态。

Method: FTFM通过每行、每列各一个上下文潜变量因子化计算；单元格之间不再直接互注意，而是通过其行潜变量与列潜变量的交互来更新，从而减少重复注意力并保留特征特定信息。

Result: 在TabArena、BeyondArena等主要表格分类基准上取得有竞争力的预测性能。

Conclusion: FTFM以因子化潜变量交互兼顾效率与表达力，是表格基础模型中去掉全单元格注意力的可行方案。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.

</details>


### [731] [Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25577)
*Nozomu Fujisawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有限交互透镜(FIL)，一种混合精度方法，用于精确评估视觉干预的交互效应，显著降低交互MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别视觉干预在视觉语言模型中的交互作用需比较联合效应与单独效应，但四输出差分可能小到被舍入误差掩盖。

Method: 在线性投影处将候选输入分解为原生状态、两个单干预分量和全维混合残差；以更高精度投影单干预分量，并在联合候选中复用相同数值贡献，同时保留所有混合残差和非线性轨迹；推导局部消去恒等式及非线性误差传播的条件界。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的一个MLP中，16个合成族交互MSE降低94.4%，两项COCO研究中分别降低99.85%和99.35%；每项COCO研究中一张图像贡献了大部分绝对增益；全候选高精度多乘BF16算术在相近查询时间下聚合误差更低；单乘BF16已能恢复参考选择。

Conclusion: 在固定名义精度预算下FIL提升了交互保真度，但实际价值取决于是否存在需要该额外保真度的任务。

Abstract: Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate's input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.

</details>


### [732] [CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25584)
*Ankitkumar Joshi,Milos Hauskrecht*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CVTA：面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的连续时间短期预测框架，通过变量条件嵌入与时序注意力学习可解释的跨变量依赖状态，既可独立预测，也可作为辅助模块提升现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的不规则采样多变量时间序列（医疗、气候、大规模监控）存在观测异步、变量异质等特性，给预测带来挑战，现有方法难以兼顾准确性与可解释性。

Method: 提出交叉变量时序注意力（CVTA）：用变量条件嵌入将异质变量投影到各自的变量特异潜空间；以紧凑、可解释的状态汇总近期时序动态；在该状态上施加时序注意力捕捉跨变量依赖；并通过动态元决策模型将其作为辅助模块并入现有SOTA模型。

Result: 在多个真实基准上，CVTA取得较强的短期预测精度，支持高效在线推理；作为辅助模块可提升现有预测模型表现；所学注意力模式与领域知识吻合良好。

Conclusion: CVTA为不规则多变量时间序列提供了一种准确、高效且可解释的连续时间短期预测方案，并具备良好的可组合性。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series arise in many real-world domains such as healthcare, climate science, and large-scale monitoring systems. Characterized by asynchronous observations and heterogeneity across variables, such time series pose significant challenges for forecasting. In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables. CVTA uses Variable-Conditioned Embeddings to project heterogeneous variables into variable-specific latent spaces, and applies temporal attention to capture cross-variable dependencies from this state. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CVTA can be integrated as an auxiliary module into existing state-of-the-art prediction models through a dynamic meta-decision model. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks show that CVTA achieves strong short-term predictive accuracy, supports efficient online inference, improves existing prediction models when used as an auxiliary module, and learns attention patterns that align well with domain knowledge.

</details>


### [733] [Divergence based Ranked Preference Alignment for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25588)
*Rajdeep Haldar,Yue Xing,Qifan Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 $f$-RPO，一种基于 $f$-散度的排序偏好优化目标，将散度对齐扩展到排序反馈，并证明其保持排序一致性，实验优于现有排序对齐基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排序偏好反馈能单次标注中捕获多条回复的更全面信息，但相比成对偏好对齐，排序偏好对齐在实践中研究不足；同时，近期工作将LLM对齐目标理解为偏好与不偏好分布间的散度估计，但尚未扩展到排序反馈。

Method: 提出 $f$-RPO：将基于 $f$-散度的对齐目标推广到排序偏好反馈，成对偏好对齐成为其特例；并给出理论分析，证明收敛时保持底层偏好排序（rank-order consistency）。

Result: 在 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 模型（0.5B–8B）上，total-variation 与 reverse-KL 变体在排序质量和生成质量上均稳定优于排序对齐基线。

Conclusion: $f$-RPO 统一了散度式对齐与排序偏好优化，理论上有排序一致性保证，实践中 TV 与 reverse-KL 变体效果最佳，为排序反馈对齐提供了有理论基础的通用框架。

Abstract: Alignment of large language models typically relies on pairwise preference feedback, though ranked feedback can capture more comprehensive information across multiple responses within a single annotation. However, ranked-preference alignment is underexplored in practice compared to simpler pairwise approaches, potentially resulting in suboptimal behavior. Concurrently, recent research has conceptualized large language model alignment objectives as divergence estimators between aligned (preferred) and unaligned (less-preferred) response distributions, resulting in a family of objectives with an interpretable theoretical foundation and strong empirical performance. This work unifies these perspectives by introducing $f$-RPO, a $f$-divergence objective for ranked preference optimization that extends divergence-based alignment to ranked feedback and recovers pairwise preference alignment as a special case. Our theoretical analysis establishes rank-order consistency, showing that $f$-RPO preserves the underlying preference ordering at convergence. Empirical results indicate that total-variation and reverse-KL variants of the proposed objective consistently outperform ranked-alignment baselines in both ranking and generation quality across Qwen, Llama, & Gemma models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters.

</details>


### [734] [Distributionally-Robust Policy Learning with Observational Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25591)
*Debmalya Mandal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究观测数据下的分布鲁棒策略学习：在数据生成分布周围的 f-散度球内最大化最坏情形策略价值，提出基于交叉拟合双稳健得分的估计器，并给出标准与快速收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准策略学习只优化经验表现，当部署分布与训练分布不一致时可能失效；因此需要分布鲁棒策略学习。现有方法缺乏对 DRO 策略学习的精细统计速率分析（尤其无快速速率结果）。

Method: 以交叉拟合（cross-fitted）双稳健得分估计条件处理效应，配合可处理 KL、χ²、CVaR 模糊集的 DRO 求解器；进一步由拉格朗日对偶导出样本分割偏差校正算法。

Result: DRO 遗憾取得标准 Õ(n^{-1/2}) 速率并保持双稳健性（结果模型或倾向模型任一一致即可，允许慢非参数速率）；在 Tsybakov 型边际条件下，偏差校正估计器达到 Õ(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)}) 快速速率，随 α∈[0,∞) 在 1/√n 与 1/n 之间插值。合成与福利转就业半合成实验显示，训练/测试分布不同时，分布鲁棒较经验福利最大化有显著提升。

Conclusion: 本文首次将边际条件引入分布鲁棒策略学习分析，并首次在该设置下获得快速速率；理论兼有双稳健性与速率插值，实验验证了分布偏移下的鲁棒收益。

Abstract: Policy learning from observational data is fundamental to applications ranging from personalized medicine to welfare-program targeting, but standard approaches optimize empirical performance and may fail when the deployment distribution differs from the training distribution. We study \emph{distributionally-robust policy learning}: given observational data, we seek a policy $π\in Π$ that maximizes the worst-case policy value over an $f$-divergence ball of radius $ρ$ around the data-generating distribution. We propose an estimator built on cross-fitted doubly-robust scores for the conditional treatment effect, paired with a DRO solver that handles \texttt{KL}, $χ^2$, and \texttt{CVaR} ambiguity sets. We establish two convergence guarantees. First, the estimated policy attains the standard $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$ rate on its DRO regret, and inherits the doubly-robust property -- the rate continues to hold whenever either the outcome model or the propensity model is consistently estimated, even at slow nonparametric rates. We then propose a sample-splitting bias-correction algorithm derived from the Lagrangian dual, and show that under a Tsybakov-style margin condition on the treatment-effect, the estimator attains a fast rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})$ , interpolating between $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/n)$ as the margin parameter $α$ ranges over $[0,\infty)$. To our knowledge, this is the first work to incorporate a margin condition into the analysis of distributionally-robust policy learning, and the first to obtain fast rates in this setting. Empirically, on synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments calibrated to a welfare-to-work program, distributional robustness yields meaningful improvements over empirical welfare maximization when training and test distributions differ.

</details>


### [735] [Text Dominance in Paralinguistic Conflict: Tracing Suppression Through Audio LLM Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25599)
*Ankur Banerjee,Vishnu Guntakala,Danity Pike,Advay Roongta,Kevin Yang,Ruizhe Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验音频大模型在文本与副语言线索冲突时是否过度依赖文本，并追溯其机制：冲突项文本支配率达0.78；说话人身份在LM输入处仍线性可解码，说明失败非感知层面；原因在于冲突信息经中间token"中继"而非单一边可切断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频LLM在危机热线、客服等场景仅在利用声学线索（情绪、说话人身份、讽刺）而非仅转录文本时才有价值，但模型是否优先文本、以及为何如此缺乏机制性证据。

Method: 在六个音频LLM上采用LISTEN式文本+音频冲突设定测量文本支配率；对最文本支配模型做线性探针检测说话人身份可解码性；复现back-patching（n=300）；并用注意力knockout分别阻断答案位置直接连接与中间token传播路径。

Result: 冲突项平均文本支配率0.78（排除讽刺为0.86）；探针显示输入处说话人身份仍可完美解码；back-patching无可测效果但其源任务复现也失败，故其零结果不被解读；阻断中间token传播可部分恢复音频驱动输出，而阻断答案位置直连无效；效应仅见于自由生成而非闭集选择题。

Conclusion: 音频LLM的文本支配并非源于感知缺失，而是信息经中间"中继"传播的架构性机制；干预需针对中继而非单边连接，且闭集多选题基准可能系统性掩盖此类干预效果。

Abstract: Audio LLMs deployed in settings such as crisis hotlines and customer support are only useful beyond speech-to-text pipelines if they use acoustic cues rather than the transcript alone. We test whether they prioritise transcript content over paralinguistic cues (emotion, speaker identity, sarcasm) and trace the mechanism when they do. Across six audio LLMs under LISTEN-style conflict conditions, the mean text-dominance rate on mismatched text+audio items is 0.78 (0.86 excluding sarcasm). In the most text-dominant screened model, probing shows speaker identity remains linearly decodable at ceiling at the language model's input, so the failure is not perceptual. Back-patching, reported to repair lexical text dominance, has no measurable effect here; but it also fails on its own source task in our replication (n=300), so we treat its null as uninformative rather than as evidence of non-transfer. Attention knockout partially restores audio-grounded output by blocking the claim from propagating through intermediate tokens during open-ended generation, whereas blocking the answer position's direct connection to the conflicting claim has no effect. The claim's influence therefore travels through an intermediate relay rather than a single severable edge. The effect appears only in free-form generation and not in closed-set multiple choice, suggesting that benchmarks relying on that format may be systematically blind to interventions of this kind. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp.

</details>


### [736] [Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25604)
*Alexandre Bismuth,Kang Li,Aramis Marti-Shahandeh,Valentin Mohl,Jakob Foerster,Anisoara Calinescu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对LOB自回归基础模型，提出基于Wasserstein GAN目标的后训练方法：用在线训练于真实撮合引擎rollout的critic，通过EGGROLL进化策略在KL信任域内更新rank-4 LoRA扰动，显著提升市场模拟真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练用交叉熵既不惩罚自由运行rollout中采样误差的累积，也不直接优化期望的市场统计特性，因此仅靠增加预训练无法解决真实性问题。

Method: 后训练采用Wasserstein GAN目标；critic在真实、不可微的撮合引擎产生的rollout上在线训练；使用EGGROLL（基于低秩学习的内存高效进化策略）对预训练生成器的rank-4 LoRA扰动进行优化，并施加KL信任域约束。

Result: 在留出面板上，LOB-Bench真实度提升17.6%（WS-21）与17.0%（Mean-L1）；选择匹配的随机扰动与算力匹配的继续预训练基线均无提升；500条消息rollout中误差累积从3.1倍降至2.3倍；训练成本低于5000万token、每seed 12 GPU小时，比48B token预训练低三个数量级。

Conclusion: 对抗式后训练是预训练不可替代的必要阶段；并通过critic输入、优化器、种群-rollout权衡的消融与reward hacking分析给出实用设计准则。

Abstract: While autoregressive foundation models trained on limit order book (LOB) data show state-of-the-art performance for market simulation, pre-training with cross-entropy neither penalizes the compounding of sampling errors over free-running rollouts nor targets desired market properties. We introduce a post-training method for LOB foundation models using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) objective. A critic, trained online on rollouts through the true, non-differentiable matching engine, guides updates from evolution strategies over rank-4 LoRA perturbations of the pre-trained generator, under a KL trust region. For efficiency, we use EGGROLL (Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning), a memory-efficient variant of evolution strategies. On a held-out panel, adversarial post-training improves LOB-Bench realism by 17.6% (WS-21) and 17.0% (Mean-$L_1$), while selection-matched random-perturbation and compute-matched continued-pre-training controls yield no improvement. Post-training is thus a necessary stage that more pre-training does not replace. Per-position divergence measurements show that it slows error accumulation over 500-message rollouts from $3.1\times$ to $2.3\times$. Adversarial post-training is also inexpensive, requiring under 50M training tokens and 12 GPU-hours per seed, three orders of magnitude below the 48B-token pre-training budget. Ablations over critic inputs, optimizers, and the population-rollout trade-off, together with an analysis of reward hacking, yield practical design guidelines for adversarial post-training.

</details>


### [737] [PRISM: Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling to Enhance Solubility OOD Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25605)
*Xinyi Chen,Jiahuan Pang,Titus Chima,Paul Weng,Wendong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个无标签预训练框架，将专家定义的化学先验转成关系型"教师"，用 KL 散度对齐距离邻域分布来训练四个编码器，从而提升溶解度预测在 OOD 场景下的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 溶解度预测需对未见溶质、溶剂及混合溶剂做分布外（OOD）泛化，但监督方法受数据稀缺限制，已有自监督方法又未显式学习化学上有意义的关系。如何在无标签条件下学习化学有意义的关系信息以缓解数据稀缺并改善 OOD 泛化，是本文要解决的难题。

Method: PRISM 将专家先验（疏水、静电、极化率、子结构效应）转化为关系型教师；训练四个编码器分别保留这些先验的群体级关系信息，预训练时用 KL 散度匹配基于距离的邻域分布。混合溶剂 OOD 下设冻结四个编码器，只训练轻量融合与组成头。

Result: 在 scaffold、溶质、溶剂三类 OOD 设定下，PRISM 匹配或超过监督与自监督基线；混合溶剂 OOD 下，冻结编码器加轻量融合头优于强基线，并显著降低多次运行的波动。消融与控制实验表明增益来自 PRISM 注入的化学有意义关系结构。

Conclusion: 将关系先验转化为自监督信号是一种有效策略，可推广到其他具备化学或生物有意义关系先验的领域。

Abstract: Solubility depends on intermolecular interactions between solutes and solvents, and is central to drug discovery, chemical and materials process engineering. Its prediction requires out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to unseen solutes, solvents, and solvent mixtures, where supervised methods suffer from data scarcity, and existing self-supervised methods do not explicitly learn chemically meaningful relations. Learning chemically meaningful relational information without labels can alleviate data scarcity and improve OOD generalization, but remains challenging. We introduce Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling (PRISM) and apply it to solubility OOD generalization. PRISM is a label-free pretraining framework that converts expert-defined chemical priors into relational teachers. For solubility prediction, it trains four encoders to preserve the population-level relational information from priors capturing hydrophobic, electrostatic, polarizability, and substructural effects, using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to match distance-based neighborhood distributions during pretraining. Across scaffold, solute, and solvent OOD settings, PRISM matches or surpasses supervised and self-supervised baselines. Under mixed-solvent OOD, freezing the four PRISM encoders and training a lightweight fusion-and-composition head outperforms strong baselines and substantially reduces run-to-run variation. Ablations and control studies confirm that gains stem from chemically meaningful relational structures baked into the encoders by PRISM. We expect this strategy of turning relational priors into self-supervision signals to extend beyond solubility prediction to domains where chemically or biologically meaningful relational priors are available.

</details>


### [738] [Safety Offset Learning: When Benign Fine-Tuning Misaligns LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25611)
*Jesson Wang,Zhanhao Hu,Minghao Lin,Yuchen Wu,Aylin Caliskan,Mengyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出微调安全风险的根本因素不是数据是否有害，而是监督引发的"拒绝→顺从"行为转变；基于此构建纯良性数据集SAFEOFF，可在无显式有害监督下显著削弱三个对齐LLM的安全对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有观点以训练数据有害性来刻画微调风险（有害微调危险、良性微调安全），但这一视角忽略了更根本的因素——监督所诱导的行为转变。作者认为有害微调与"降安全的良性微调"本质是同一"拒绝→顺从"转变在不同数据分布上的学习，因此需要研究良性输入上学到的转变能否泛化到有害请求。

Method: 构造模型初始倾向于拒绝但配对原无害回答的良性样本，制造"初始拒绝"与"监督答案"之间的差异（discrepancy）。通过控制变量实验考察两个条件：差异是否足够大、差异是否无法被表层捷径（shortcut）消解。在此基础上提出SAFEOFF数据集：将良性指令改写以提升对齐模型的拒绝概率，并配对原始回答。

Result: 仅改变差异是否被局部化（在差异匹配条件下），有害顺从率变化达一个数量级；差异增大但捷径仍存在时无效，移除捷径但差异很小时亦无效。在三个对齐LLM和三个安全基准上，SAFEOFF虽不含显式有害监督，仍大幅削弱安全对齐。

Conclusion: 微调安全性不仅取决于模型看到什么数据，还取决于监督移动了哪条行为边界；行为转变视角比数据有害性视角更根本，良性数据同样可导致严重的安全退化。

Abstract: Safety risks from fine-tuning are commonly characterized by the harmfulness of the training data:harmful fine-tuning is considered dangerous, while benign fine-tuning is often assumed to preservealignment. We argue that this view misses a more fundamental factor-the behavioral transition inducedby supervision. Harmful fine-tuning and safety-degrading benign fine-tuning can both be understoodas learning the same refusal-to-compliance transition, but on different data distributions. We studywhether such a transition learned on benign inputs can generalize to harmful requests. We constructbenign examples that an aligned model initially tends to refuse and pair them with their originalharmless responses, creating a discrepancy between the model's initial refusal and the supervisedanswer. Fine-tuning on these examples increases harmful compliance, but only when two conditionshold together: the discrepancy is large enough, and it cannot be resolved through a narrow surface-levelshortcut. With the induced discrepancy matched, varying only whether it is localized changes harmfulcompliance by an order of magnitude; raising the discrepancy does not help while a shortcut remainsavailable, and removing the shortcut does not help while the discrepancy is small. Building on thisobservation, we introduce SAFEOFF, a dataset of benign instructions rewritten to raise the alignedmodel's refusal likelihood and paired with their original answers. Across three aligned LLMs and threesafety benchmarks, SAFEOFF substantially weakens safety alignment despite containing no explicitharmful supervision, suggesting that fine-tuning safety depends not only on what data a model sees, butalso on which behavioral boundary the supervision moves.

</details>


### [739] [Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25612)
*Jimson Huang,Maxwell Nickell,Ruowang Zhang,Abulhair Saparov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究课程学习能否扩展LLM的隐式推理深度。通过按词汇量和前瞻步数渐进增大的样例微调，课程训练模型达到无课程训练无法企及的前瞻深度（Qwen3-0.6B在lookahead=256时98% vs 45%），但进步呈饱和指数，暗示存在内在最大隐式推理深度上限；合成数据能力可迁移到自然语言推理，在11个基准上更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM依靠CoT外部化推理，但在长程任务上性能骤降。强隐式推理（单次前向内"搜索"）能让模型直接找到正确下一步、缩短CoT并减少回溯；然而已有工作发现LLM隐式推理深度很浅，且扩大模型规模也无改善。本文探究课程学习能否延展这一深度。

Method: 对预训练模型进行课程式微调，样例的词汇表规模和lookahead（需提前搜索的步数）逐步增大；在匹配计算量下与无课程训练对比，并拟合进步的饱和曲线，分析模型规模、预训练vs从头训练、课程步长的影响，最后检验向自然语言推理基准的迁移。

Result: 匹配计算下课程训练可达无课程训练失败的前瞻深度：Qwen3-0.6B在lookahead≤256上达98%准确率，无课程仅45%。进步服从饱和指数，暗示内在最大隐式推理深度；更大模型拟合上限更高，微调预训练模型远优于从头训练，课程步长过大会停滞。

Conclusion: 课程学习能显著扩展隐式推理深度但存在饱和上限；该能力从合成数据迁移到自然语言推理，课程训练模型在11个自然语言推理基准上优于匹配计算的无课程模型。

Abstract: LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [740] [Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25621)
*William L. Tong,Aryo Lotfi,Emmanuel Abbe,Josh Susskind,Cengiz Pehlevan,Eran Malach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"加权状态拼汤"(weighted state souping)，为缓存状态的组合学习查询相关的权重，显著提升SSM在长上下文任务上的表现，并可衍生出稀疏变体以获得近常数的编码成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSM推理快、状态大小固定，状态拼汤(state souping)可将分块编码的结果缓存并重组以廉价构建上下文。但原始拼汤与普通SSM在长且拥挤的上下文中都会退化，限制了其在长时程领域（文档、工具、记忆记录等agentic负载）中的可用性。

Method: 提出weighted state souping：为各组缓存状态学习依赖查询的权重，从而选择性地组合状态；进一步给出高效的稀疏变体，使编码成本相对上下文长度接近常数。作者还给出了说明拼汤为何有效、何时失效的简单理论论证，并定性讨论加权拼汤的优势。

Result: 在单跳与多跳文档问答、needle-in-a-haystack检索、变量跟踪以及工具使用等任务上，长上下文性能大幅提升；稀疏变体在保持（有时提升）性能的同时实现近常数编码成本。

Conclusion: 加权状态拼汤将可复用的上下文表示与选择性检索相结合，为面向大规模文档、工具及其他结构化上下文（现代agentic工作负载日益主导的场景）的语言建模提供了高效方案。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of weighted souping. Weighted state souping thus combines reusable context representations with selective retrieval, offering an efficient approach to language modeling over large collections of documents, tools, and other forms of structured context that increasingly dominate modern agentic workloads.

</details>


### [741] [Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25625)
*Fengfei Yu,Marshall Fisher,Isadora White,Sumanth Varambally,Yasaman Jafari,Shivam Yadav,Samuel M. Bartlett,Shawn Roj,Benjamin J. Moore,Michael D. Warner,Luyu Han,Zhirui Xia,Duncan Watson-Parris,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Yian Ma,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Zephyrus-R1：在自然语言天气预报写作这类"无唯一正确答案"的科学任务上用强化学习训练视觉语言智能体，通过组合气象评分表与双向论断蕴含的奖励、模拟工具调用环境与课程学习，显著提升报告质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 已在科学领域成为训练 AI 的关键方法，但当输出无法对照已知标准答案验证时（如自然语言天气预报报告），RL 仍很困难。此类报告将大气数据转化为对天气演变、灾害与不确定性的判断，存在多种合理表述，难以做确定性验证。

Method: 围绕 agentic RL 流程的三要素展开：(1) 奖励设计——将气象评分表（rubric）与双向论断蕴含（bidirectional claim entailment）结合，均以美国国家气象局参考报告为对照；(2) 在模拟工具调用环境中优化该奖励，使视觉语言智能体能跨区域、跨预报时效收集分析证据后再撰写报告；(3) 课程学习——小模型先在可验证的天气分析题上通过 RL 学习工具使用与科学推理，再优化开放式报告奖励。另用三位气象学家的标注审计 LLM 评判器给出的论断标签，评估人—专家一致性。

Result: Qwen3.5-4B 经 Zephyrus-R1 训练后，六项评判指标均值较基座模型提升 26%，与前沿开放权重模型相当；Qwen3.8-27B 同一均值较基座提升 13%，优于 Kimi-K3 6.7%，优于 GPT-5.6-Luna 2.7%。

Conclusion: Zephyrus-R1 为一套面向科学天气预报报告生成的实用 RL 框架，说明"评分表+蕴含式奖励+课程式可验证任务热身"能在开放式、难以确定性验证的科学写作任务上有效驱动 agentic RL，并可扩展到不同规模模型。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key method for training AI models in scientific applications, but RL remains difficult when outputs cannot easily be verified against a known ground-truth answer. Natural-language weather forecast reports are one such domain: they translate atmospheric data into assessments of weather evolution, hazards, and uncertainty for both the general public and key decision-makers. Unlike numerical weather-analysis questions, they admit many valid outputs, which limits deterministic verification. To address this, we develop Zephyrus-R1, a practical framework for RL on scientific weather forecast reporting. We focus on three key components of the agentic RL pipeline: reward design, curriculum learning, and an analysis of human-expert alignment. To encourage both report legibility and factual accuracy, we design a reward function that combines a meteorological rubric with bidirectional claim entailment, both evaluated against National Weather Service reference reports. Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions and lead times before producing a report. We use annotations from three meteorologists to audit the claim labels produced by our LLM judges. Finally, a curriculum helps small models first develop tool use and scientific reasoning through RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions, then optimize the open-ended report reward. After training Qwen3.5-4B with Zephyrus-R1, we improve the mean across six judge-metric scores by 26% over the base model and achieve results competitive with frontier open-weight models. For Qwen3.8-27B, we improve the same mean by 13% over the base model, by 6.7% over Kimi-K3, and by 2.7% over GPT-5.6-Luna.

</details>


### [742] [Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25627)
*Vasundhara Acharya,Bülent Yener*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出因果蒸馏（causal distillation）流程，将Causal Forest/Bayesian Causal Forest估计的CATE蒸馏为决策树与随机森林策略，在预算约束（容量上限为不良状态观察数的70%）下与K-means子组策略、因果树策略比较，结果显示蒸馏学生策略与教师效用差≤0.011、分配Jaccard相似度0.738–0.937。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化公共卫生干预需在资源约束下保留个体化效应信息并保持可解释性；灵活因果效应模型难以落地执行，而粗粒度子组策略会损失个体效应信息；且观测数据中缺少历史决策记录。

Method: 针对肥胖、血糖升高与吸烟史三种状态，预设定因果结构指导的预处理协变量，容量上限为不良状态观察数的70%；以Causal Forest与Bayesian Causal Forest为教师估计CATE，用决策树、随机森林作为学生进行蒸馏；对照组为无监督K-means子组策略及叶节点数与聚类数匹配的监督因果树策略；在留出数据上用双稳健估计、bootstrap不确定性与决策导向的师生保真度指标评估。

Result: PIMA肥胖/血糖与NHANES吸烟史实验中，各蒸馏学生策略与教师绝对效用差在0.011以内，分配Jaccard相似度0.738–0.937；K-means与因果树策略亦具竞争力，点估计最优策略随应用而异；预设配对比较经Holm校正后均不显著，部分师生配对在接近预算边界处的分配一致性弱于全局保真度。

Conclusion: 结果支持用因果蒸馏将灵活效应模型转化为更简单的预算约束靶向规则，但观测估计依赖因果识别假设，需纵向或前瞻性研究验证。

Abstract: Personalized public-health targeting must capture heterogeneous intervention benefits while remaining interpretable under resource constraints. Flexible causal-effect models can be hard to operationalize, while coarse subgroup policies may lose individualized effect information. We study budget-constrained hypothetical state interventions in observational data without a logged historical decision policy. For obesity, elevated glucose, and lifetime smoking-history states, causal-structure-informed pretreatment covariates are prespecified, with capacity capped at 70% of those observed in the adverse state. We evaluate causal distillation where Causal Forest and Bayesian Causal Forest teachers estimate conditional average treatment effects (CATEs), which decision tree and random forest students approximate. We compare individualized policies with unsupervised K-means subgroup policies and supervised causal-tree policies with leaf counts matched to K-means cluster counts. Observational policies are assessed on held-out data using a doubly robust estimator, bootstrap uncertainty, and decision-focused teacher-student fidelity measures. Across PIMA obesity and glucose and NHANES smoking-history experiments, each distilled student was within 0.011 absolute utility of its teacher, with allocation Jaccard similarities of 0.738-0.937. K-means and causal-tree policies were also competitive, with the highest point-estimate policy varying by application. Prespecified paired comparisons were nonsignificant after Holm adjustment, while near-budget-boundary agreement was less stable than global fidelity for some teacher-student pairs. Findings support causal distillation for translating flexible effect models into simpler budgeted targeting rules, although observational estimates depend on causal-identification assumptions and require longitudinal or prospective validation.

</details>


### [743] [OPDArena: Understanding Learning and Forgetting in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25651)
*Yuanze Xu,Tianzhu Ye,Hui Sun,Wenhui Wang,Li Dong,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OPDArena框架对比SFT、RLVR与on-policy蒸馏(OPD)在5个预训练模型上的表现，发现教师来源显著影响知识保留：RLVR教师的蒸馏学生任务提升且保留旧能力，SFT教师的蒸馏学生遗忘更严重；OOD分布变化与遗忘的正相关比域内变化更一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: on-policy蒸馏已在语言模型后训练中广泛应用，但教师监督如何塑造学习与遗忘的机制尚不清楚；同时需要系统地比较SFT、RLVR与OPD三种后训练范式在学得新任务与保留旧能力上的权衡。

Method: 提出OPDArena框架，在5个预训练模型和多种教师来源下对比SFT、RLVR与OPD，联合评估数学学习、通用能力保留及预测分布变化；并分析教师相对于学生预训练模型的"额外信息"，通过受控教师对比考察后训练获得的偏好信息如何影响学生更新的分布集中度。

Result: 教师选择强烈影响保留效果：RLVR训练教师的学生在目标任务上提升且保留既有能力，而SFT训练教师的学生能力损失更大。跨方法看，OOD分布变化与遗忘的正相关比域内变化更一致。受控对比显示，教师通过后训练获得的任务特定偏好会使学生的参数更新更集中于域内。

Conclusion: 教师来源是on-policy蒸馏中决定遗忘程度的关键因素；OOD分布变化可作为遗忘的更可靠信号；教师的任务特定偏好导致更新域内集中化，为设计更优蒸馏教师和数据策略提供了依据。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used for language model post-training, yet how teacher supervision shapes learning and forgetting remains unclear. We present OPDArena, a framework comparing supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and OPD across five pretrained models and diverse teacher sources. It jointly evaluates mathematical learning, general capability retention, and predictive distribution changes. Teacher choice strongly shapes retention: students of RLVR-trained teachers improve on the target task while retaining prior capabilities, whereas students of SFT-trained teachers incur greater capability loss. Across post-training methods, out-of-domain (OOD) distribution change shows a more consistent positive association with forgetting than in-domain change. To understand how teacher choice affects these changes, we examine the additional information teachers provide relative to the student's pretrained model. Controlled teacher comparisons show that the task-specific preferences teachers acquire through post-training make student updates more concentrated in-domain.

</details>


### [744] [A "feature ODE" describing the learning behavior of shallow MLPs on simple functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25652)
*Joseph Turnbull,Berkan Ottlik,Jamie Simon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究两层MLP在各向异性高斯数据上的梯度流训练动力学，提出一个"特征ODE"来近似描述浅层网络的学习动态，实验发现实际训练损失轨迹与该ODE大致吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使是两层MLP这样简单的设置，完整求解梯度流动力学也极其困难，因此作者希望寻找一种更易处理但仍有解释力的简化方式来描述学习动力学。

Method: 提出"特征ODE"(feature ODE)，即一个直觉上可描述浅层MLP学习动力学的常微分方程，并在各向异性高斯数据上用低阶Hermite多项式与阶梯函数等简单目标函数训练MLP，将其损失轨迹与该ODE的预测进行对比。

Result: 训练得到的MLP损失轨迹大致遵循该特征ODE的预测，且这种吻合出现在多种简单目标函数上。

Conclusion: 这种吻合令人意外，因为简化程度很大且并非来自严格的近似链条；作者讨论了这一现象的原因并推测其潜在用途。

Abstract: We study the gradient flow training dynamics of two-layer multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on anisotropic Gaussian data. Even in this simple setting, solving the dynamics in full is notoriously difficult, so we try something different. We propose a "feature ODE" that might be intuitively expected to describe the learning dynamics of a shallow MLP. We find that MLPs trained to learn simple target functions (low-order Hermite polynomials and staircase functions) actually roughly follow the loss trajectories from this feature ODE. This agreement is a surprise because of the size of the simplification and the fact that it does not come from a rigorous chain of approximations. We discuss this surprise and speculate on its reasons and uses.

</details>


### [745] [Can Metadata Fix the Gauge? Calibration Turns Sparse Multi-Source Learning from Sparse PCA into Sparse Mean Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25663)
*Yirong Xiang,Yibo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了"来源标签"与"标定元数据"在多源稀疏信号聚合中的本质区别：无标定合并会抹去均值信号、退化为稀疏PCA；而有相对规范(符号)标定则恢复稀疏均值信号。作者提出 AlignedMass 度量来形式化元数据的价值，并给出统计与计算分离结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 来源标签只告诉我们样本来自哪个源，却不告诉该源如何定向坐标（例如符号规范/sign gauge）。在多源稀疏高斯模型中，这种区别大大改变了学习问题的性质，但此前缺少对这一区别的定量刻画。

Method: 建立带源特定符号规范的稀疏高斯多源模型；引入 AlignedMass 度量，量化元数据诱导的对齐能恢复多少一阶（均值）信号；对比仅用来源标签与含任务无关相对规范元数据的两种情况（后者可用同步算法对齐源坐标）；并结合标准的稀疏PCA硬度假设做理论分析，辅以合成实验、真实特征与物理传感器实验。

Result: 来源标签只能产生有限的 AlignedMass，而有效标定可产生与总样本量成正比的 AlignedMass；由此在 micro-source（极小单源样本）情形下得到统计分离，并在标准稀疏PCA硬度假设下得到计算分离。合成实验验证了预测的缩放规律。

Conclusion: 元数据（相对规范/标定）而非单纯来源标签，是把"抹去信号的合并"转化为可恢复均值信号的关键；AlignedMass 可作为衡量元数据价值的统一工具，并解释了统计与计算层面的可学习性差异。

Abstract: Source labels tell us where a sample came from, but not how that source oriented its coordinates. In a sparse Gaussian multi-source model with source-specific sign gauges, that distinction changes the learning problem. Without calibration, pooling across sources erases the mean signal, and the source-labelled experiment reduces to sparse PCA. With task-independent relative-gauge metadata, synchronization aligns sources and the same observations become a sparse mean problem. We formalize the value of metadata through AlignedMass, which quantifies how much first-order signal a metadata-induced alignment restores. Source labels create only limited AlignedMass, whereas valid calibration can create AlignedMass proportional to the full sample size. This yields a statistical separation in micro-source regimes and, under standard sparse-PCA hardness assumptions, a computational separation as well. Synthetic experiments check the predicted scaling; controlled real-feature
  and physical sensor studies examine sign cancellation, separately
  acquired calibration, and reuse across tasks.

</details>


### [746] [LOOP: Recovery-Aligned Iterative Layer Pruning via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25679)
*Liang Xu,Shufan Shen,Zhongni Hou,Yufei Zhang,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LOOP提出一种层级别"恢复导向"的在线策略剪枝框架，通过多轮交替进行剪枝与恢复，缓解一次性剪枝导致的推理能力骤降，并利用恢复过程的信号指导后续层选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层级别剪枝多为一次性范式：先剪到目标大小再训练恢复。直接剪到目标尺寸会严重损害推理能力，有限训练预算下恢复困难；且选择与恢复相分离，恢复信息无法反哺选择。

Method: LOOP在每一"shot"中仅移除单层并执行短程在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation），多轮交替剪枝与恢复；后续轮次复用恢复阶段的在线轨迹与优化信号，联合评估每层剩余层的推理贡献与恢复敏感度，实现恢复感知的层选择。

Result: 在多个基准、不同模型规模与剪枝率下，LOOP的平均准确率一致优于一次性剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 逐步剪枝+短程恢复+恢复感知选择，可有效保持LLM推理能力，是层级别剪枝部署的更优范式。

Abstract: Layer-level pruning is attractive for large language model (LLM) deployment as it reduces the model size while preserving a dense architecture that can be efficiently executed on standard hardware. Current methods typically follow a one-shot paradigm, which first removes selected layers to reach a target model size and then performs additional training to recover model capabilities. However, pruning directly to the target size can substantially degrade reasoning capabilities, making subsequent recovery more difficult under a limited training budget. Moreover, this paradigm separates layer selection from recovery, limiting the use of recovery information to guide selection and potentially hindering the recovery of reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LOOP, a Layer-level Recovery-Oriented On-Policy Pruning framework that interleaves pruning and recovery across multiple shots. In each shot, LOOP removes a single layer and performs short on-policy distillation, mitigating the abrupt degradation in reasoning capabilities associated with one-shot pruning. To guide layer selection in subsequent shots, LOOP reuses on-policy trajectories and optimization signals from recovery to jointly assess each remaining layer's reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, thereby making layer selection recovery-aware. Evaluations on several benchmarks show that LOOP consistently outperforms one-shot baselines in average accuracy across different model scales and pruning ratios.

</details>


### [747] [MT-CC: Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Asymmetric Calibration Behavior in Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25689)
*Sungjun Yun,Yonghee Choi,Dong-Jun Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多组温度缩放框架MT-CC，用于类增量学习中的持续校准，通过分组网络和组间置信度-精度差异正则化解决非对称校准问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIL工作主要关注精度提升，忽视置信度校准（预测可信度）。温度缩放（TS）在静态校准有效，但在数据分布持续演化的持续学习场景中鲜有探索；且CIL存在非对称校准行为——置信度变化速率与精度下降速率不一致，导致不同任务校准误差水平不同。

Method: 提出MT-CC事后校准框架：1) 用轻量级分组网络设计多个温度参数，依据置信度统计量和任务感知信号对样本分组；2) 引入组内置信度-精度差异（GDCA）正则化，促进组内一致性。

Result: 实验表明MT-CC在保持精度的同时显著提升校准性能。

Conclusion: MT-CC为可靠的持续学习提供了一个有原则的校准框架，兼顾精度与预测可信度。

Abstract: As deep neural networks are required to continuously adapt to evolving data, class-incremental learning (CIL) has become an active research area. However, most existing works primarily focus on improving accuracy while overlooking confidence calibration, which measures the trustworthiness of the model's predictions. Although temperature scaling (TS) is effective for static calibration, it has rarely been explored in continual settings where data distributions evolve over time. In this paper, we introduce Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Continual Calibration (MT-CC), a novel post-hoc calibration framework that addresses the asymmetric calibration behavior in CIL, where the rate of confidence changes does not align with the rate of accuracy degradation across tasks, leading to different levels of miscalibration. Our key contribution is to design multiple temperature parameters through a lightweight grouping network that separates samples by confidence statistics and task-aware signals in CIL. Furthermore, a Groupwise Difference-between-Confidence-and-Accuracy (GDCA) regularization is incorporated to promote intra-group consistency. Experiments demonstrate that MT-CC significantly improves calibration performance while maintaining accuracy, offering a principled framework for reliable continual learning.

</details>


### [748] [Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25692)
*Tung M. Luu,Tri Ton,Duc M. Nguyen,Xuan Thanh Nguyen,Nguyen Gia Binh,Quang Tan Nguyen,Vu Duong,Daniel Sonntag,Duy M. H. Nguyen,Vien Anh Ngo,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需人工标注的无监督偏好对齐框架PGPG，利用序贯进度对齐从自主采集的rollout中自动生成伪偏好标签，微调生成式策略并优于监督微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式策略在模仿学习中表现优异，但受限于专家示教数据稀缺；基于偏好的微调可利用次优rollout提升性能，却严重依赖昂贵的人工标注。

Method: 提出Progress-Guided Preference Generation（PGPG）：以少量专家示教为参照，通过序贯覆盖对齐（ordered coverage alignment）度量rollout相对专家数据的任务进度，从而自动提取伪偏好标签；并引入关键改进提升这些进度引导偏好的可靠性，在无需人工设计奖励函数的情况下微调预训练生成式策略。

Result: 在一系列具有挑战性的长时程操作任务中，PGPG优于标准监督微调基线；该框架概念简洁、通用性强，可同时集成于扩散策略与流匹配（flow-matching）策略等多类生成式策略。

Conclusion: PGPG去除了偏好对齐中的人在回路监督，仅凭少量专家示教即可实现无监督偏好微调，具备跨策略类别的广泛适用性。

Abstract: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations.
