Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

</details>


### [749] [Stochastic Tracking of Drifting Affine Fixed Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25699)
*Sajad Khodadadian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究时变仿射算子下的线性随机逼近，给出常数步长的累积误差上下界，并提出无需已知噪声和漂移的近乎最优自适应方法，应用于变化环境中的TD学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有线性SA的有限时间分析大多假设底层算子固定，而实际中固定点会随时间变化、噪声可能跨轮相关，缺少对时变情形下误差的量化刻画及步长选择的理论指导。

Method: 1) 对时变仿射算子的线性SA，在常数步长下建立迭代点与对应固定点之间累积期望平方距离的上界，涵盖初始误差、观测噪声与固定点漂移；2) 对高斯标量模型建立下界，证明合适选取的常数步长在最坏累积误差上达到最优（常数因子意义下），即使与可利用未来观测的估计器相比；3) 提出自适应方法，利用额外有界无偏固定点观测，在未知噪声水平和漂移幅度下实现近乎最优；4) 应用于同步表格时序差分学习中的值函数估计（生成模型、共同不变分布）。

Result: 得到显式累积误差上界；下界表明常数步长在此意义下最优，并量化了时间相关性对估计精度的影响；自适应算法无需已知噪声水平和固定点变化即可接近最优；在变化环境的TD值函数估计中给出相应保证。

Conclusion: 时变线性SA在常数步长下可获匹配的上下界，常数步长为最优选择，且时间相关性会降低精度；自适应步长机制可实用地逼近最优，并推广到非平稳强化学习中的值函数估计。

Abstract: Linear stochastic approximation (SA) is widely used to estimate fixed points from noisy observations, but most finite-time analyses assume that the underlying operator remains fixed. We study linear SA with time-varying affine operators, where the fixed points change over time and the observation noise may be correlated across rounds. For constant-stepsize updates, we establish a bound on the cumulative expected squared distance between the iterates and the corresponding fixed points. The bound accounts for the initial error, observation noise, and changes in the fixed points over time. We also establish lower bounds for scalar Gaussian models, showing that, under specified conditions, a suitably chosen constant stepsize achieves the smallest possible worst-case cumulative error up to constant factors, even compared with estimators that use future observations. These results further quantify the effect of temporal correlation on estimation accuracy. Since choosing an appropriate stepsize generally requires knowledge of the noise level and how much the fixed points change, we develop an adaptive method that uses an additional bounded, unbiased observation of the fixed point to achieve an almost optimal algorithm without needing the knowledge of the noise level and the fixed point variation over time. Finally, we apply our results to value-function estimation using synchronous tabular temporal-difference learning in changing environments, assuming generative-model access and a common invariant distribution.

</details>


### [750] [Predictive Bandit Curriculum Reinforcement Learning via Gradient-Based Sample Group Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25704)
*Liang Xu,Shufan Shen,Zhongni Hou,Chao Bi,Yufei Zhang,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PGB课程学习：用样本级梯度聚类构建"优化感知"学习单元，并用轻量时序预测器预测各单元未来效用，转化为Boltzmann采样分布实现自适应数据分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL课程学习方法用预定义数据属性（如难度）构建课程单元，并仅靠聚合近期训练历史的单一代理信号估计效用。这会将优化效果不同的样本混在一起，且无法预判效用随策略演化的情况。

Method: 1) 聚类投影后的样本级梯度，自动发现优化感知的学习单元；2) 用轻量级时序预测器预测每个单元的未来效用；3) 将预测转为Boltzmann采样分布，实现自适应数据分配。

Result: 在多模型规模与推理基准上，PGB稳定优于标准GRPO、基于难度的课程以及基于历史的调度策略，数据利用率和训练效率均提升。

Conclusion: 以梯度聚类替代预定义属性、以效用预测替代历史聚合，是构建更有效RL数据课程的关键。

Abstract: Curriculum learning, which organizes training samples according to their learning priority, has been widely adopted in reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency. However, existing methods commonly construct curriculum units using predefined data properties and estimate their utility by simply aggregating a single proxy signal from recent training history.Such designs may group samples with different optimization effects and fail to anticipate how their utility evolves in relation to the policy. We propose Predictive Gradient-based Bandit (PGB) Curriculum, which first discovers optimization-aware learning units by clustering projected sample-level gradients. PGB then employs a lightweight temporal predictor to forecast the future utility of each unit and converts the predictions into a Boltzmann sampling distribution for adaptive data allocation. Experiments across multiple model scales and reasoning benchmarks show that PGB consistently outperforms standard GRPO, difficulty-based curricula, and history-based scheduling strategies, demonstrating improved data utilization and training efficiency.

</details>


### [751] [Evidence Sufficiency and Model Comparisons in MexRegQA: An Item-Level Audit of Mexican-Spanish Regulatory QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25710)
*Fred Hu,Yeqi Wang,Xing Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文审计墨西哥西班牙语金融监管问答数据集，发现相似度检索覆盖不等于证据充分：135题中35题缺失关键事实，去除证据缺陷题会改变55组对比中14组的显著性结论，并提出带证据状态标签的MexRegQA v1.0数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 grounded QA 基准以检索相似度或覆盖率衡量证据可得性，但没有验证检索到的证据是否真正包含回答问题所需的事实，导致模型比较可能把"证据缺失"误判为"模型能力差异"。

Method: 对墨西哥西班牙语金融监管 QA 进行证据审计：(1) 标注每题证据充分性；(2) 在事后全证据子集(n=98)上让11个提示匹配模型作答并做成对显著性检验；(3) 在56道零证据题上测准确率；(4) 在可弃答提示下移除证据，测十个实验腿的性能下降；(5) 构建 MexRegQA v1.0（192题，含来源出处与证据状态标签、冻结检索证据、预测与评判输出）。

Result: 135题中35题缺失部分或全部关键事实；全证据切片上11个模型得分95–98/98且均与锚点无显著差异（但不能证明等价）；剔除缺陷题后55组成对比较中14组显著性状态改变；56道零证据题准确率跨度33.9%–89.3%；可弃答提示下移除证据使准确率下降63–81个百分点，十腿均无恢复题。

Conclusion: 证据可得性会实质性影响 grounded QA 的模型比较结论；应在发布基准时同时提供证据状态标签，使模型能力比较可与证据可得性分离。作者同时声明审计为结果感知、模型扫描复用同一批问题、且全程机器评判未经人工验证等局限。

Abstract: Similarity-gated coverage does not establish that retrieved evidence contains the facts needed to answer a question. We audit Mexican-Spanish financial-regulatory QA and find that 35 of 135 covered items lack some or all load-bearing facts. On the post-hoc full-evidence slice (n=98), eleven prompt-matched models score 95-98/98 and none differs significantly from the anchor; this does not establish equivalence. Removing evidence-defective items changes the nominal significance status of 14 of 55 pairwise comparisons. On 56 zero-evidence items, accuracy spans 33.9%-89.3%. Removing evidence from the audited items under an abstention-permitting prompt reduces accuracy by 63-81 percentage points in all ten tested legs, with no recovered items. Building on sufficient-context research, we contribute MexRegQA v1.0: 192 items with provenance and evidence-status labels, frozen retrieval evidence for 191 evaluated items, predictions, judge outputs and offline checks. The audit was outcome-aware, the later model/panel sweep reused the same questions, and all reported scores and labels rely on machine evaluation without independent human validation. We propose releasing evidence-status labels alongside grounded QA benchmarks so that model comparisons can be examined separately from evidence availability.

</details>


### [752] [Learning to Couple: Context-Adaptive Joint Denoising for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25723)
*Zilei Shao,Ian Li,Heng Zhao,Kewei Lian,Guy Van den Broeck,Zhe Zeng,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Codpula：将 Transformer 与可处理的概率推断层结合，由上下文生成的门控调节耦合参数，在保持精确条件推断的同时实现上下文相关的联合分布解码，刷新推理基准并改进精度-延迟前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型并行预测多 token 以加速生成，但因子化去噪器把同时预测视为条件独立，产生错误；解码启发式只控制提交哪些 token，未改变因子化分布本身；已有联合建模方法把单独学习的层附加到冻结去噪器上，主干未适配联合目标，耦合参数也不随上下文变化。

Method: Codpula 由 Transformer 与可处理概率推断层组成：给定部分掩码输入，Transformer 输出 token 势（塑造逐位置预测）和紧凑门控（调节该层耦合参数），从而得到上下文相关的联合分布并保留精确条件推断；以条件去噪目标联合优化两部分，采用双流乘性更新保证概率参数合法；推理时支持标准启发式，并通过条件查询适配提交决策，单步内无需额外 Transformer 评估。

Result: 在广泛推理基准上取得新的 SOTA，并在数学推理与代码生成上推进精度-延迟 Pareto 前沿。

Conclusion: 通过上下文参数化的联合去噪建模而非仅靠解码启发式，可在不牺牲精确推断与效率的前提下缓解并行预测的条件独立假设，兼顾准确率与延迟。

Abstract: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but factorized denoisers treat simultaneous predictions as conditionally independent. Decoding heuristics reduce the resulting errors by controlling which tokens are committed, but leave the underlying distribution factorized. Joint modeling addresses the source of the problem, yet existing methods attach separately learned layers to frozen denoisers, leaving the backbone unadapted to the joint objective and the coupling parameters fixed across contexts. We propose Codpula, a context-parameterized denoiser combining a Transformer with a tractable probabilistic inference layer. Given a partially masked input, the Transformer produces token potentials that shape per-position predictions and compact gates that modulate the layer's coupling parameters, yielding a context-dependent joint distribution while retaining exact conditional inference. We jointly optimize both components under a conditional denoising objective using a dual-flow multiplicative update that preserves valid probabilistic parameters. At inference, Codpula supports standard heuristics and uses conditional queries to adapt commitments to dependencies among proposed tokens without extra Transformer evaluations within a step. Codpula sets new state-of-the-art results across a broad suite of reasoning benchmarks while advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

</details>


### [753] [Anatomy of Off-Policy Policy Gradient: Importance Sampling, KL Regularization, and Baselines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25725)
*Haoqun Cao,Yurun Yuan,Tengyang Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM后训练中"离策略"使用策略梯度方法的合理性，证明一致性需要轨迹级重要性加权或"KL正则+最优软价值基线（组均值）"二者之一，指出后者即GRPG并与GRPO目标对应，给出有限样本遗憾界；并揭示基线的隐藏作用——常数偏移实现悲观性，从而获得单策略覆盖下的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练普遍用策略梯度方法做离策略更新（数据由旧策略或混合策略产生），但vanilla策略梯度假设同策略采样，这种离策略部署何时成立、重要性采样/KL正则/基线各自在分布偏移下起什么作用，缺乏理论解释。

Method: 对一类通用离策略策略梯度更新做理论分析：刻画最优策略仍为驻点（一致性）所需的结构条件；聚焦KL路线，将其识别为组相对策略梯度（GRPG），证明其等价于轨迹级Bellman残差最小化目标，在all-policy coverage下推导有限样本遗憾界；再通过非对称REINFORCE目标实例化基线的悲观性作用，并联系博弈论离线RL框架。

Result: 证明一致性要求两种结构之一：轨迹级重要性加权（受horizon诅咒困扰）或KL正则配最优软价值基线（组均值实现）；GRPG在all-policy coverage下有有限样本遗憾界，并给出GRPO某变体的理论解释；基线常数偏移等价于悲观性，可在单策略覆盖下获得遗憾界。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM后训练中的离策略策略梯度提供了统一理论视角，阐明了重要性采样、KL正则与基线的作用，并把GRPO类方法与经典离线RL（悲观性、单策略覆盖、博弈论框架）联系起来。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central tool for large language model (LLM) post-training, where policy gradient methods are routinely deployed off-policy, even though vanilla policy gradient assumes on-policy sampling. We study when such off-policy deployment is justified, and what roles its core ingredients, including importance sampling, KL regularization, and baselines, play in handling the resulting distribution shift. We show that for a general class of off-policy policy gradient updates, consistency, in the sense that the optimal policy remains a stationary point, requires one of two structures at the optimal policy: trajectory-level importance weighting, which suffers from the well-known curse of horizon, or KL regularization with a baseline equal to the optimal soft value, instantiated by the grouped mean. Focusing on the KL route, we identify it with the group-relative policy gradient (GRPG) update, establish an equivalence to a trajectory-level Bellman residual minimization objective, and obtain a finite-sample regret bound under all-policy coverage. This also gives a theoretical account of a variant of the empirically successful GRPO objective. We further uncover a hidden role of baselines in the off-policy setting: a constant shift in the baseline implements pessimism, the standard remedy in offline RL for partial data coverage. We instantiate this via the asymmetric REINFORCE objective, and connect it to the game-theoretic offline RL framework, showing a regret bound with single-policy coverage. Together, these results offer a unified theoretical view of off-policy policy gradient in LLM post-training and connect it to classical ideas in offline RL.

</details>


### [754] [Neural Video Coding under Limited Delay: Theoretical Optimality and System Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25729)
*Likun Cai,Jun Chen,Ashish Khisti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Graph-Factored Sequential Coding (GFSC)框架，将有延迟的视频编码形式化为马尔可夫网络的团因子分解问题，理论证明K阶马尔可夫源下K帧延迟即可达到联合编码的率失真最优，并通过轻量神经模块在现有因果预测编解码器上实现该框架，实验验证其率失真性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经视频压缩(NVC)固守严格因果预测范式，将零帧延迟视为固定约束而非可设计参数。从信息论角度，允许有限帧延迟可利用延迟窗口内未来帧的相关性，降低严格因果预测无法触及的不确定性，从而改善率失真权衡。作者希望将这一直觉形式化并加以利用。

Method: 基于马尔可夫网络的团(clique)因子分解进行严格的率失真分析，提出GFSC顺序编码框架。理论上给出首个证明：对正分布的一般K阶马尔可夫源，K帧延迟足以在非平凡的失真区域内达到联合编码的率失真最优。实践中用轻量神经模块实例化GFSC，无需修改现有因果预测编解码器的核心架构即可增强它们。

Result: 在多种NVC模型和数据集上的实验表明，GFSC相较对应的因果版本持续提升率失真性能；在匹配延迟预算下，与代表性双向编解码器相比也取得有竞争力的表现。

Conclusion: 将帧延迟作为显式设计参数可从信息论上突破严格因果预测的局限。GFSC提供了理论保证且实现轻量、即插即用，为现有因果NVC提供了一种有效且通用的增强方案。

Abstract: Traditional neural video compression (NVC) methods predominantly follow strictly causal predictive-coding paradigm, treating zero-frame delay as a fixed constraint rather than delay as an explicit design parameter. From an information-theoretic perspective, allowing limited frame delay enables a codec to exploit correlations with future frames within the delay window, thereby reducing uncertainty that is inaccessible to strictly causal prediction and potentially improving the rate-distortion tradeoff. In this work, we formalize this intuition through a rigorous rate-distortion analysis builds on the clique factorization of Markov networks, and propose Graph-Factored Sequential Coding (GFSC), a principled framework for sequential video coding under limited delay. To our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical result showing that, for general $K$-order Markov sources with positive distributions, a $K$-frame delay is sufficient to attain joint-coding rate-distortion optimality over a nontrivial distortion region, a guarantee unavailable to zero-delay causal coding in general. In practice, we instantiate GFSC through lightweight neural modules, allowing existing causal predictive codecs to be augmented without modifying their core architectures. Experiments across multiple NVC models and datasets show that GFSC consistently improves rate-distortion performance over the corresponding causal counterparts. Under matched delay budgets, GFSC also achieves competitive performance compared with representative bidirectional codecs.

</details>


### [755] [How Much Does One Wrong Answer Cost? Error Propagation in Constraint Pruning with Noisy LLM Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25739)
*Zhengtao Gui,Weining Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文主张用"预言机出错时的风险"来评价约束剪枝：随机顺序的蕴含规则剪枝无一阶风险，但多前提规则与实体解析中错误会按 Wiener 指数等放大，pivot 顺序近似最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有使用约束剪枝（如传递性跳过已被蕴含的 yes/no 提问）的实体解析与 LLM 排序系统，其分析通常假设 oracle 完全正确；但真实 oracle（LLM）会出错，而一个被错误接受的结果会扩散到它所蕴含的所有问题，因此应按出错风险而非查询数来评价剪枝策略。

Method: 在每条答案以概率 ε 独立出错的模型下，做一阶风险分析：风险≈ε×"一个错误答案平均污染的事实数"。分别分析（1）蕴含规则（如分类taxonomy），（2）含 s 个前提的规则，（3）单实体 m 条记录的实体解析，将风险表示为查询顺序所建生成树的 Wiener 指数（总成对距离），并比较 pivot、随机、most-similar-first 等顺序。

Result: 蕴含规则随机顺序剪枝的一阶风险为零（一个会改变 k 个事实的错误答案被接受概率为 1/k，平均代价为 1 个事实）；s 前提规则打破该平衡，共享前提处错误可造成约 r^(1-1/s) 的代价。实体解析中一阶风险 = ε×生成树 Wiener 指数；pivot 顺序误差放大不足 2 倍且最优，随机顺序放大 m^(1/3) 量级，most-similar-first 在一维下最差、m 大时在二维还不如随机；多实体情形下错误合并的代价与其他实体数量无关。模拟结果与所有预测常数在抽样误差内一致。

Conclusion: 剪枝策略应以抗错误风险为设计准则：简单蕴含下随机顺序已最优，但高元规则和实体解析的顺序选择显著影响错误传播；pivot 顺序是稳健的实用选择，而直观的 most-similar-first 反而可能最差。

Abstract: Constraint pruning saves queries to a large language model (LLM) or another noisy oracle by skipping each yes/no question implied by answers accepted earlier, for example through transitivity. Entity-resolution systems and LLM-based rankers use this idea. However, their analyses typically assume a correct oracle. We argue that pruning should be judged by its risk when the oracle errs, since an accepted wrong answer spreads to every question it implies. When each answer is wrong independently with small probability $\varepsilon$, the first-order risk is set by how many facts one wrong answer corrupts on average. We consider two kinds of constraints. For implication rules, as in taxonomies, pruning in a random order adds no first-order risk: a wrong answer that would change $k$ facts is accepted with probability $1/k$, so it costs one fact on average. Rules with $s$ premises break this balance: a wrong answer at a premise shared by $r$ rules can cost order $r^{1-1/s}$ facts. For entity resolution with $m$ records of one entity, the first-order risk equals $\varepsilon$ times the Wiener index (the total pairwise distance) of the spanning tree built by the query order. Pivot orders, which first compare one record with all others, amplify errors by less than 2 and are optimal; random orders by order $m^{1/3}$; the common most-similar-first order is the worst in one dimension and, for large $m$, worse than random in two. With several entities, the cost of wrongly merging two does not depend on how many others exist. Simulations agree with every predicted constant within sampling error.

</details>


### [756] [Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25747)
*JooKyung Yuh,Byungmin Park,Eunseo Choi,Jinheon Baek,Junmo Cho,Kyu Hyun Choi,Sung Ju Hwang,Kyong Hwan Jin,Hae Beom Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BMD 将 LLM 驱动的假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计闭环结合：LLM 提出模型族，数值引擎拟合参数、按模型证据加权并平均预测，再以联合期望信息增益选实验条件，并把更新后的信念与残差诊断回传给 LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学模型发现需要提出候选模型并设计能区分它们的实验。现有 LLM 方法仅靠上下文学习预测与选实验，缺少显式模型评估来系统指导假设搜索；贝叶斯方法能做原理化的模型比较，但局限于预定义候选集，搜索空间有限。

Method: 提出 BMD：LLM 提出模型族；数值引擎拟合各模型参数，以模型证据为权重进行加权并对预测做模型平均；通过最大化对模型族及其参数的联合期望信息增益来选择下一批实验条件；将更新后的信念与残差诊断反馈给 LLM 以指导下一轮提案。

Result: 在四个科学发现基准上，BMD 的最终预测误差低于上下文学习方法和基于 LLM 的科学智能体，且更频繁地恢复出精确的函数形式；消融实验支持数值反馈与联合设计目标的有效性。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计闭环耦合，可在开放搜索空间中实现原理化的模型比较与高效实验选择，优于纯 LLM 方法。

Abstract: Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.

</details>


### [757] [Cognitively Decoupled Meta-Induction for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25749)
*Yuqian Wang,Yuanzheng Wang,Chaojun Xiao,Ke Xu,Bingxiang He,Jinghan Tan,Zijun Chen,Lu Chen,Yi-Xin Huo,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出认知解耦元归纳方法CoDI，先归纳任务级归纳表示（TIR）再直接作答，以提升大模型在分布外任务上的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习（ICL）严重依赖查询与示例间的近邻匹配，分布外（OOD）泛化差；基于规则的归纳推理虽能提取任务级规律（TIR），但现有方法缺乏跨多样任务的通用归纳能力。

Method: 受元学习启发，提出CoDI，包含两部分：(1) 认知解耦框架，实现与查询无关（query-blind）的TIR归纳；(2) 双环元归纳学习，用于跨任务的归纳器优化。

Result: 在五个ID与OOD基准上取得显著性能提升，且推理阶段无需显式归纳即可保持OOD增益。

Conclusion: CoDI通过解耦归纳与作答、并以元学习优化归纳器，实现了通用任务上的TIR归纳推理，兼顾泛化性与推理效率。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) tackles downstream tasks conditioned on demonstrations. This paradigm relies heavily on neighbor-based matching between queries and demonstrations, limiting out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. For better generalization, rule-based inductive reasoning derives task-level regularities, which we term task-level inductive representations (TIR), before directly answering. However, existing methods lack generalizable inductive ability across diverse tasks. Inspired by meta-learning, we propose Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction (CoDI) for TIR-based inductive reasoning on general tasks. CoDI comprises a Cognitive-Decoupling Framework for query-blind TIR induction, and a Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning method for cross-task inducer optimization. Empirically, CoDI achieves substantial performance gains on five ID and OOD benchmarks, and preserves OOD gains without explicit induction at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Yuqian-Wang2277/codi-meta-induction.

</details>


### [758] [NADS: Navigator-Guided Data Selection for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25751)
*Jianhao Zhang,Ou Wu,Yi Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NADS框架，用目标微调得到的"导航模型"与预训练模型的预测分歧来给合成候选数据打分，再经高效的效用-多样性选择构建约束集，缓解LLM单阶段微调的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无法获取原始预训练数据的单阶段微调场景下，灾难性遗忘严重；现有合成数据缓解方法依赖与真实训练收益对齐有限的间接代理信号，且大规模候选池上的效用-多样性选择计算开销大。

Method: 1）按目标微调配方（无保持正则）训练出navigator模型，其相对预训练模型的偏移反映配方导致的capability drift；2）以navigator与预训练模型的预测分歧为每个合成候选打"遗忘感知效用"分；3）用高效的效用-多样性选择策略构建约束集；4）在新任务数据上微调，同时对所选约束蒸馏预训练模型行为以保持通用能力。

Result: 实验表明NADS在新任务性能与通用能力保持之间取得更优平衡，同时降低了效用-多样性选择的开销。

Conclusion: 以模型自身漂移作为直接效用信号、配合低成本的选择策略，是无需预训练数据即可有效缓解灾难性遗忘的可行方案。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting is a central obstacle in single-stage fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) on a new task, especially when the original pretraining data are unavailable. Synthetic data offers a practical mitigation path, but candidate pools are often noisy and redundant, making effective selection essential. Existing methods often rely on indirect proxy signals whose alignment with actual training benefit can be limited, while utility--diversity selection over large candidate pools remains computationally demanding. To address these challenges, we propose NAvigator-guided Data Selection (NADS), a fine-tuning framework for LLMs. NADS first follows the target fine-tuning recipe without preservation regularization to obtain a navigator model, whose deviation from the pretrained model exposes recipe-induced capability drift. It then uses the predictive divergence between the navigator and the pretrained model to score forgetting-aware utility for each synthetic candidate, and constructs a constraint set through an efficient utility--diversity selection strategy. Finally, NADS fine-tunes on the new-task data while distilling pretrained behavior on the selected constraints to preserve general capabilities. Experiments show that NADS delivers a stronger balance between new-task performance and general capability preservation, while reducing utility--diversity selection overhead. Code at: https://github.com/zjh-vinky/NADS.

</details>


### [759] [Which Answers Agree? Evaluating Self-Consistency from Incomplete Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25752)
*Zhengtao Gui,Zexi Chen,Weining Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究自一致性（self-consistency）评估在仅有部分日志信息时可达到的界限：利用随机序（majorization）推导在已知/未知弃权计数与答案类别数下的精确准确率界限，并提出Plurality-U动态规划在保留答案计数时精确计算投票准确率，实证表明记录弃权与答案选项可使区间宽度减半以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性需要正确性标签以及响应间一致性信息才能评估投票准确率及额外投票的收益，但实践中日志常只含部分信息（如仅正确性标签）。作者希望厘清不完全日志能确定什么，并给出信息缺失或部分保留时的精确评估手段。

Method: 对正确响应映射到同一规范化答案的任务，用经典随机序（majorization）推导准确率的紧界，并借助弃权计数与答案类别上限加以细化；进一步推导共享响应池下不同投票预算间准确率变化的紧界。当答案类别计数可得时，提出基于计数的动态规划Plurality-U，在所有固定大小子集上精确平均投票准确率，消除有限池蒙特卡洛误差。

Result: 在Scorio Lite与Scorio Trace的1,403,520条推理模型输出上，记录弃权计数与答案选项使SuperGPQA准确率区间宽度缩小一半以上；从9票增加到17票时，相较简单组合独立界限的基线，所提界限在SuperGPQA上区间宽度中位数缩小77.7%，在14个GPQA与Adaptive-Consistency池上缩小72.3%；精确计算在15个池-预算设置中的14个上配对中位运行时间低于2,000子集蒙特卡洛。

Conclusion: 研究明确了不完全日志能够确立的结论范围，并在保留答案计数时提供了精确的评估流程；弃权信息与答案选项数量对收紧评估界限至关重要。

Abstract: Self-consistency answers a question by generating multiple responses and selecting the most frequent answer. Its evaluation requires both correctness labels and information about which responses agree; correctness labels alone generally determine neither voting accuracy nor the benefit of additional votes. For tasks in which all correct responses map to the same normalized answer, we derive sharp accuracy bounds using classical stochastic majorization, refined by abstention counts and answer-category limits. We also derive sharp bounds on accuracy changes across voting budgets that share a response pool. When answer-category counts are available, we introduce Plurality-U, a count-based dynamic program that exactly averages voting accuracy over all fixed-size subsets, eliminating finite-pool Monte Carlo error. On 1,403,520 stored outputs from recent reasoning models in Scorio Lite and Scorio Trace, recording abstention counts and answer options cuts the width of SuperGPQA accuracy intervals by more than half. For moving from 9 to 17 votes, our bounds reduce interval width by a median of 77.7% on SuperGPQA and 72.3% on 14 GPQA and Adaptive-Consistency pools, compared with a baseline that combines separate accuracy bounds. Exact computation has lower paired median runtime than 2,000-subset Monte Carlo in 14 of 15 tested pool-budget settings. These results clarify what incomplete logs can establish and provide an exact evaluation procedure when answer counts are retained.

</details>


### [760] [Remember Less, Adapt Longer: Bounded-State In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Summary Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25758)
*Jiawen Wang,Cheng Xue,Peng Zhang,Jochen Renz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出循环摘要记忆（RSM）：Transformer策略只精确关注一个短的近期交互工作缓冲区，并用固定容量摘要承载更早的经验；缓冲区满时重写摘要并清空，使部署内存与每步决策成本对任务长度保持O(1)，长程任务中可持续超越训练视界的适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICRL智能体需依赖记忆持续适应新任务。现有方案陷入权衡：增长式记忆（全历史注意力、累积摘要）存储与每步开销随任务长度增长；固定大小记忆（滑动窗口、循环网络）则限制访问，丢弃旧经验或把近期交互压缩进隐状态。

Method: RSM由两部分组成：精确注意的近期交互工作缓冲区＋固定容量摘要。缓冲区满时，用旧摘要与缓冲区内容重写摘要，随后清空缓冲区，从而将内存与计算成本限定为常数。

Result: 在长时部分可观测任务中，冻结的RSM策略在8倍训练视界上维持适应性能，仅用约1%的全历史内存，最终优于所有对比基线，而增长式记忆出现退化；任务配置中途变化时再适应能力更优。消融显示清空或阻断摘要访问会消除收益，替换他任务摘要可将行为导向该任务。

Conclusion: 固定容量摘要足以支撑远超训练视界的上下文内适应，为持续运行的ICRL智能体提供低成本、可扩展的记忆机制。

Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables agents to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates, relying on memory to retain what they learn from experience. For agents operating continually, existing approaches using memory trade off bounded cost against access to past experience. Approaches using growing memories, such as full-history attention and accumulating summaries, incur storage and per-decision costs that increase with task length. Fixed-size memories bound storage but restrict access: sliding windows discard older steps, while recurrent networks compress even recent interactions into a hidden state. We introduce Recurrent Summary Memory (RSM), a Transformer policy that attends exactly to a short working buffer of recent interactions and carries a fixed-capacity summary of earlier experience. When the buffer fills, RSM rewrites the summary from its previous contents and the buffer, then clears the buffer, so deployment memory and per-decision cost stay $O(1)$ in task length. On long-running partially observable tasks, frozen RSM policies sustain their adapted performance for eight times the training horizon with about 1% of full-history memory, ending ahead of every evaluated baseline while growing memories deteriorate. When the task configuration changes mid-run, RSM re-adapts better than growing and recurrent memories. Clearing the summary or blocking the policy's access to it removes its benefit, while swapping in another task's summary steers behaviour towards that task. Together, these results show that our fixed-capacity summary can sustain in-context adaptation far beyond the training horizon.

</details>


### [761] [Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25760)
*Pedram Mouseli,Massieh Moayedi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在文件锁状态重建任务中，推理对规则遵循的收益主要来自"每步现场生成推理"，而保留历史推理帮助有限；可解码的内部状态对预测行动干预效果指导有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测语言模型智能体"先推理后行动"的价值取决于推理与行动的关系。本文研究当正确行动依赖于不断变化的状态时，智能体的行动如何依赖其推理，并区分推理的两种角色：每次行动前生成推理 vs. 在提示中保留先前推理。

Method: 构造小型文件系统任务：背景事件只宣告哪个文件的锁被切换、不给出新值，智能体需从历史重建当前锁状态才能安全移动文件。使用 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3.5-9B，对"生成推理"与"保留历史推理"两种干预进行对比；并测试填充文本、为其他历史编写的推理、准确的状态表格等对照；再给出与真实历史仅一个锁值不同的推理，观察智能体是否违背自身历史而遵从推理。最后用线性探针从激活中解码状态，并与文本分类器从对话记录中恢复状态作比较。

Result: 违反锁约束命令的减少主要来自行动时刻现写的推理；保留先前推理对规则遵循帮助很小，但能帮助其中一个模型完成任务。收益取决于推理的具体内容——填充文本、为其他历史写的推理、准确的状态表格都无法复现该收益。当给定仅一个锁值不同的推理时，智能体会依据该推理行动，即使与自身历史相矛盾。无推理时，线性探针从激活恢复状态的效果与文本分类器从记录恢复相当，但解码准确率并不能预测哪些干预会改变行动。

Conclusion: 在此设定下，推理对规则遵循的收益主要来自每步即时生成；无推理时可解码出的状态只是智能体行为的有限指南。

Abstract: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

</details>


### [762] [Detection Augmented Learning In Non-Stationary Bandit Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25782)
*Argyrios Gerogiannis,Yu-Han Huang,Subhonmesh Bose,Venugopal V. Veeravalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Detection Augmented Learning (DAL)，一个由bandit算法、变化检测器和强制探索计划三模块组成的黑盒范式，用于无需环境变化先验的非平稳bandit问题，在理论与实验上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳bandit问题中环境变化未知，现有方法通常依赖对变化先验知识的假设，难以适用于经典到高度结构化的多种bandit场景，缺少通用且可迁移的框架。

Method: DAL将任意bandit算法、变化检测器与强制探索计划组合为模块化黑盒范式；给出统一regret bound，把平稳输入的regret迁移到分段平稳情形，并分析漂移环境下的良好表现条件，另提出bandit驱动的强制探索策略。

Result: 单一regret bound在考虑的各场景中达到或改进最优已知界；在九种bandit设定、多样非平稳场景下，DAL一致超越所有先验无关与先验相关的最先进方法；bandit驱动的探索策略进一步提升性能并缩短检测延迟。

Conclusion: DAL提供了通用、模块化且理论与实证兼备的非平稳bandit解决范式，验证了强制探索策略设计对性能与检测延迟的重要性。

Abstract: We study the problem of non-stationary bandits without knowledge of the environmental changes. We propose Detection Augmented Learning (DAL) a black-box paradigm that comprises three modular components: a bandit algorithm, a change detector, and a forced exploration schedule. This modular design enables its applicability across a broad spectrum of bandit problems, from classical to highly structured settings. First, we provide theoretical insights into DAL's strong empirical performance: a single regret bound shows that DAL transfers the regret of its stationary input to the piecewise stationary setting, attaining or improving the best known bounds in every setting considered. We further identify conditions under which DAL performs well in drifting environments. Then, we showcase DAL's practical performance and versatility through extensive experimentation in which DAL consistently surpasses all state-of-the-art methods, both prior-free and prior-based, across diverse non-stationary scenarios in nine bandit settings. Finally, we investigate the effectiveness of the forced exploration and show that a bandit-driven strategy improves performance and shortens detection delay.

</details>


### [763] [Communication-Efficient Federated Domain Generalization in Edge Networks via Dynamic Prototype Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25810)
*Yuankun Xia,Hui Wang,Ling Yuan,Ziyu Hong,Di Yin,Yufeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DPGR-GCAM，一种面向无线边缘网络Vision-Language Model联邦域泛化的通信高效框架，结合双PEFT架构与信道感知分层传输、梯度冲突感知调制，在衰落信道下降低时延并缓解客户端漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无线物联网边缘部署VLM面临两大挑战：大模型参数导致带宽受限衰落信道上行传输时延高；Non-IID数据加剧客户端漂移。现有特征对齐方法引入的辅助计算占用传输时隙，在时延约束下更易造成掉队节点。

Method: 1）采用双参数高效微调（PEFT）架构降低传输负载；2）设计信道感知分层传输机制，自适应截断负载以最大化衰落条件下节点存活率；3）提出梯度冲突感知调制（GCAM），在低维特征流形内动态化解多目标优化冲突，以极小边缘计算时延减少计算引发的网络中断。

Result: 实验表明DPGR-GCAM提升跨域泛化能力，并在衰落场景、仅10%客户端参与率下仍保持收敛。

Conclusion: 通过PEFT降低通信开销、信道感知传输提升节点存活率、GCAM以低时延缓解客户端漂移，三者协同使VLM联邦域泛化在恶劣无线条件下可行。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing the likelihood of straggler dropouts under system delay constraints. To address these issues, we propose DPGR-GCAM, a communication-efficient federated domain generalization framework. By employing a dual-parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) architecture, we design a channel-aware tiered transmission mechanism that adaptively truncates payloads to maximize node survival rates under fading conditions. To mitigate client drift, we introduce the Gradient-Conflict Aware Modulation (GCAM) mechanism. GCAM operates within the low-dimensional feature manifold to dynamically resolve multi-objective optimization conflicts with minimal edge computation latency, thereby reducing computation-induced network outages. Experiments demonstrate that DPGR-GCAM improves cross-domain generalization and sustains convergence under network fading scenarios with a 10\% client participation rate.

</details>


### [764] [Is it RL or Data? A Controlled Comparison of GRPO and Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25812)
*Lakshya Chaudhry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在Bauer et al.(2026)的计数任务上，GRPO在每种提示集下都优于RFT：curated提示集上留出测试领先10.9分，匹配rollout预算后easy/mixed上分别领先8.4和9.2分；迭代式RFT仅缩小约30%的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bauer et al.(2026)发现混合难度提示使GRPO样本效率提升至5倍，但未检验该收益是否GRPO特有，还是任何同等数据的后训练方法都能获得。作者旨在通过控制实验区分"方法效应"与"数据效应"。

Method: 在程序化计数任务上使用Qwen3-4B-Base + LoRA，对比GRPO与拒绝采样微调(RFT)，共享提示、验证器与token上限。6个主实验组=2方法×3提示集(Easy、Mixed、Curated)；每组3个种子，预先注册假设与否证条件。为排除基线调参不足，RFT进行27次超参扫描，GRPO沿用原配方；另设迭代式RFT消融。

Result: GRPO在所有提示集均优于RFT：curated上+10.9分；匹配rollout预算下easy +8.4、mixed +9.2。测试集上优势在最不利的截断处理下仍成立，OOD下截断导致无法定论。Curated对RFT无益(-2.7)；混合难度数据使RFT提升+3.7，GRPO证据不确定。迭代RFT仅弥补10.9分差距中的3.2分(约30%)。

Conclusion: GRPO的增益不能仅由数据难度或提示筛选解释，方法本身存在独特优势，但迭代RFT可部分追平。结论限于单一合成任务族、单一基座模型、每组3个种子，外推需谨慎。

Abstract: Bauer et al. (2026) showed that in low-data reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, training GRPO on mixed-difficulty prompts gives up to 5x the sample efficiency of easy-only prompts. They did not test whether this benefit is specific to GRPO, or whether another post-training method given the same data would obtain it too. We test this on their procedural counting task with Qwen3-4B-Base and LoRA, comparing GRPO to rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) on the same prompts, verifier and token cap. Six primary arms cross the two methods with three prompt sets (Easy, Mixed, and a Curated subset of prompts the base model sometimes solves, which makes GRPO's implicit filter explicit). We use three seeds per arm. Hypotheses and falsifiers were registered before training. To rule out a poorly tuned baseline, RFT receives a 27-run hyperparameter sweep, while GRPO uses Bauer et al.'s recipe unchanged. GRPO outperforms RFT at every prompt set: by 10.9 points on held-out test problems with curated prompts, and, in post hoc comparisons with matched rollout budgets, by 8.4 and 9.2 points on the easy and mixed prompts. On test the advantage survives the least favorable treatment of truncated completions; out of distribution, truncation prevents a conclusion. Curating prompts does not help RFT (-2.7 points). Mixed-difficulty data helps RFT (+3.7 points), while for GRPO the evidence is inconclusive. A secondary iterated-RFT arm, which resamples from the current policy, recovers 3.2 of the 10.9-point gap (about 30%). These are controlled measurements on one synthetic task family and one base model with three seeds per arm.

</details>


### [765] [SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25844)
*Yanjin He,Cuifeng Shen,Wanzhou Lei,Maohua Li,Tao Lan,Kan Liu,Hanlin Tang,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Swift 提出一种自引导训练方法：用冻结的弱去噪器（如早期 checkpoint）外推回归目标，提升强模型且不增加推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型训练与引导推理计算昂贵；希望在不增加推理成本的前提下提升模型质量。

Method: 对每个噪声输入，将干净回归目标从弱去噪器预测处外推，放大欠拟合分量；弱引导为主模型早期 checkpoint，训练时无需反向传播，训练后丢弃；保持原始采样器，无需 label dropout 或无条件分支。用 RKHS 中有限时间总体梯度流的谱分析解释机理。

Result: 证明在早期停止的弱引导下，存在非空外推强度区间使后验均值误差严格低于标准训练。CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet-256 上跨模型规模与表示均有提升；某 ImageNet-256 配置下用约一半总训练算力达到基线最佳 FID；RAEv2 上无引导 FID 1.15，有引导 0.99。

Conclusion: 目标外推是有效的弱到强扩散训练途径，兼具单模型高效推理。

Abstract: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.

</details>


### [766] [ACE-Trader: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Generator-Critic Trading Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25847)
*Chang Zhou,Jiarun Zhou,Xingtong Yu,Hong Cheng,Hui Zhang,Xinming Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ACE-Trader是一个对抗式协同进化交易框架，为LLM交易者与红队审查者分别设计依赖情境的记忆选择器，并通过共享交易记录把双方记忆关联起来，实现角色间的相互学习与共同进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成器-批评者交易系统虽能通过红队反馈改进单次决策，但无法保证两个智能体从经验中共同学习：一种市场条件下有效的经验在另一种条件下可能有害；且交易结果同时反映双方行为，难以厘清各自应获得何种经验。

Method: 1) 为Trader和Red-Team分别构建依赖情境的记忆选择器，学习识别对当前决策有用的经验；2) 两个选择器共享来自"完整记忆辅助流水线"与"无记忆流水线"净收益差异的反馈，并进行侧重近期结果的在线更新；3) 设计协同进化机制，通过共享交易记录连接角色专属记忆，用实际市场结果评估红队风险评估与交易者修订效果，并将经验回写至各自记忆，使交易者依据过往批评改进提案、红队随交易者行为变化调整审查重点。

Result: 在美国股票交易实验中，ACE-Trader在累计收益上优于全部22个主动基线，并在主动方法与被动基准中均取得最高夏普比率和最低最大回撤。

Conclusion: 通过情境化记忆选择与基于共享交易记录的对抗协同进化，ACE-Trader有效解决了经验选择与角色信用分配问题，验证了生成器-批评者框架中双方共同进化的可行性与实用价值。

Abstract: Generator--critic trading systems pair an LLM-based trader that makes trading decisions with a red team agent that evaluates these decisions and provides feedback for revision. However, improving individual trading decisions does not ensure that both agents learn from experience and improve together over time. This raises an important question: how can the trader and red-Team select useful experience and learn from each other's evolving behavior? On one hand, experience that benefits decisions under one market condition may become ineffective or harmful under another. On the other hand, trading outcomes reflect both agents' actions, making it difficult to derive appropriate experience for each role. In this work, we propose ACE-Trader, an adversarial co-evolution trading framework. Specifically, we first develop separate context-dependent memory selectors that learn to identify useful experience for the current trading decision. Both selectors receive shared feedback from net-return differences between complete memory-assisted and memory-free trading pipelines, with online updates emphasizing recent outcomes. We further design a co-evolution mechanism that links role-specific memories through shared trading records. We use these records to evaluate the Red-Team's risk assessments and the effects of the Trader's revisions against realized market outcomes, then derive experience for their respective memories. By linking this experience to the corresponding records, we enable the Trader to improve its proposals based on prior critiques and the Red-Team to adjust its review focus as the Trader's behavior changes. Experiments on U.S. stock trading show that ACE-Trader outperforms all 22 active baselines in cumulative return and achieves the highest Sharpe ratio and lowest maximum drawdown across both active methods and passive benchmarks.

</details>


### [767] [Rubrics Beyond Evaluation: Exploiting Rubric Structure in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25850)
*Yuxun Huang,Yunyao Zhang,ZeLiang Chen,Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen,Junqing Yu,Zikai Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RSRL 将评分细则从单纯奖励信号转化为能力结构，贯穿强化学习训练全程，显著提升开放式问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评分细则（rubrics）把整体质量拆解为显式标准，蕴含丰富的能力结构信息。但现有方法只把评则当作直接反馈/奖励信号，未显式建模其背后的能力结构，导致这一结构在训练中基本未被利用。

Method: 提出 Rubric-Structured RL（RSRL）框架，含三项设计：(1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring，从评则条目中还原隐含的能力结构；(2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning，利用该结构把发展不足的能力转化为有效学习信号以自举；(3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing，在优化中保留各能力的专属增益。

Result: RSRL 同时提升整体性能与薄弱能力；在下游科学问答任务上，较初始策略最高提升 7.43，较非评则结构的 RL 基线最高提升 7.60。

Conclusion: 强化学习能够从评则所编码的能力结构中显著受益，评则应被当作训练的结构化指导而非仅奖励来源。

Abstract: Rubrics are widely used to evaluate open-ended question answering by breaking overall quality into explicit criteria. These explicit criteria make rubrics a rich source of learning guidance, yet their potential for guiding the training process has been largely overlooked. Existing methods use rubrics mainly as direct feedback signals, without explicitly modeling the capabilities behind their criteria. This leaves their capability structure largely unused in guiding the training process. We introduce Rubric-Structured Reinforcement Learning (RSRL), an RL framework that unlocks the full potential of rubrics by exploiting their structure throughout the training process, rather than treating them simply as direct reward signals. At its core, RSRL builds on three key designs: (1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring first recovers the capability structure hidden in rubric criteria, (2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning then uses this structure to bootstrap underdeveloped capabilities into effective learning, (3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing finally preserves capability-specific gains during optimization. Experiments show that RSRL consistently improves both overall performance and underdeveloped capabilities, boosting downstream scientific question-answering performance by up to 7.43 over the initial policy and 7.60 over non-rubric structured RL baselines, showing that reinforcement learning can substantially benefit from the capability structure encoded in rubrics.

</details>


### [768] [Statistical Learning Theory for Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25856)
*Joel Wills,Yuanfan Li,Yiming Ying,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从理论上研究DPO因Bradley-Terry建模假设失效而带来的结构性误差，用偏好对数几率的三三角旋度(triangle-curl)刻画该误差，并给出超额逻辑风险的上下界与有限样本分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO依赖Bradley-Terry模型，将偏好表示为得分差的形式。作者希望厘清DPO的失败究竟源自结构性误设，还是仅由模型容量有限或样本有限造成，从而区分可随容量增大而消除的误差与不可消除的结构障碍。

Method: 提出用偏好对数几率的三三角旋度(triangle-curl)刻画结构性近似误差，该量恰好当偏好可被Bradley-Terry表示时为零。将可达超额逻辑风险上界分解为得分类近似项与三角旋度项，并在有界性假设下给出正比于三角旋度的下界。对ReLU及裁剪得分模型推导显式近似率，并对裁剪经验风险最小化给出有限样本界。最后在替代风险框架下将结果迁移到上下文偏好准确率(CPA)。

Result: 理论上证明：增大模型容量可消除得分近似项，却无法消除三角旋度所代表的结构性障碍；下界表明超额风险正比于三角旋度。有限样本界将网络近似误差、结构性误设与估计误差分离。标准逻辑一致性与校准结果可将超额风险上界迁移至CPA。

Conclusion: DPO受Bradley-Terry结构假设的内在限制，仅提升容量或样本量不能弥补结构性误设；三角旋度是诊断该障碍的有效工具。作者同时强调CPA只是偏好判断与策略概率比变化一致性的度量，并非生成响应质量的完整衡量。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns from pairwise preferences through a logistic objective whose score-difference parameterization follows the Bradley--Terry model. We study how failure of this modeling assumption limits DPO, distinguishing structural misspecification from limited model capacity and finite-sample estimation. Our main contribution is a characterization of structural approximation error through the triangle-curl of the preference log-odds, which vanishes exactly when preferences admit a Bradley--Terry representation. We upper bound the achievable excess logistic risk by a score-class approximation term and a triangle-curl term, and establish a lower bound proportional to triangle-curl under additional boundedness assumptions. For ReLU score models, including clipped models, we derive explicit approximation rates showing that increasing capacity can eliminate the score-approximation term while leaving the structural obstruction unchanged. We further establish finite-sample bounds for clipped empirical risk minimizers that separate network approximation, structural misspecification, and estimation error. We place these results within a surrogate-risk framework by identifying contextual preference accuracy (CPA) as a natural measure of agreement between preference judgments and changes in pairwise probability ratios relative to the reference policy. Standard logistic consistency and calibration results connect DPO's objective to this policy property and transfer our excess-risk upper bounds to CPA, without treating CPA as a complete measure of generated-response quality.

</details>


### [769] [Adaptive Decoding Methods for Token-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25860)
*Zhaonan Li,Zelei Cheng,Amritansh Mishra,Chia-Hsuan Lee,Mann Patel,Sambit Sahu,Ben Zhou,William M. Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在4B代码RLVR中，rollout的候选token支持集采用从top-K=10逐步扩到K=20再到全支持的自适应调度，在150M token预算下比固定K=10平均高1.80±0.42分，与最强固定K=20基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: rollout解码同时决定RLVR中使用哪些轨迹以及消耗多少completion token，因此需研究训练过程中候选token支持集应固定还是逐步放宽，以提升rollout采样效率。

Method: 提出随尝试token预算增长的支持调度：先top-K=10，再K=20，最后全支持；在4B代码RLVR设置下与匹配的固定K=10续训、固定K=20基线对比，并以插值150M-token验证值、mixed-reward-group诊断和单次运行回放进行检验。

Result: 调度在三次运行中均优于匹配固定K=10续训，平均提升1.80±0.42分；与最强固定支持设定固定K=20表现相当。后期放宽到全支持似乎最有前景但证据有噪声；mixed-reward-group诊断未清晰解释增益；单次回放中调度与固定K=10点估计相同。

Conclusion: rollout支持集是RLVR采样效率的重要控制变量，值得进一步研究自适应支持调度；当前结论仍受噪声与回放结果限制。

Abstract: Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. Overall, our results show that rollout support is an important control for sampling efficiency in RLVR and motivate further study of adaptive support schedules.

</details>


### [770] [Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25873)
*Guanghua He,Hancan Zhu,Gaohang Yu,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出残差引导的自适应Tucker秩分配方法，在固定参数预算下为3D网络各卷积层联合选择输入/输出通道秩，用于ADNI轻度认知障碍转AD预测，AUC 0.7706且仅1.45%可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D预训练网络参数高效微调中，如何在卷积层间分配有限的可训练容量是核心难题；固定比例分配忽略了各层重要性差异。

Method: 从下游数据学习任务特定代理更新，用候选Tucker秩对近似之并保留空间核模态；通过扰动分析以逐层重建残差上界输出差异，将平方残差按代理更新能量归一化为相对近似误差；用动态规划在全局预算（含通道因子与Tucker核心）约束下最小化残差和，得到全局最优秩分配。

Result: 在ADNI队列（海马分割预训练，预测36个月内MCI转AD）上，五个随机种子平均AUC为0.7706，优于固定比例Tucker（0.7239）和全量微调（0.7430）；可训练参数约61.8万，仅占全模型1.45%。

Conclusion: 自适应Tucker秩分配是3D医学影像参数高效迁移学习的有效途径。

Abstract: Allocating limited trainable capacity across convolutional layers is a central challenge in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of pretrained three-dimensional (3D) networks. We propose Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation, which jointly selects input- and output-channel ranks under a fixed adapter-parameter budget while preserving the spatial kernel modes. To guide rank selection, we learn task-specific proxy updates from downstream training data and approximate them using candidate Tucker rank pairs. A perturbation analysis bounds the output discrepancy between the fixed proxy network and its Tucker approximation in terms of layerwise reconstruction residuals, motivating residual-based allocation. We normalize each squared residual by the corresponding proxy-update energy to compare relative approximation errors across layers. Dynamic programming minimizes their sum under a global budget constraint that accounts for both channel factors and the Tucker core. This yields a globally optimal allocation over the specified candidate rank pairs. We evaluate the method on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for predicting conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease within 36 months, using hippocampal segmentation pretraining. Across five random seeds, the proposed method achieves a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7706, compared with 0.7239 for fixed-ratio Tucker adaptation and 0.7430 for full fine-tuning. The total number of trainable parameters is limited to approximately 0.618 million, accounting for only 1.45% of the full model. Adaptive Tucker rank allocation thus provides an effective approach to parameter-efficient transfer learning in 3D medical imaging.

</details>


### [771] [DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25877)
*Chen Liang,Daoping Wu,Donghua Yang,Zhiyu Liang,Ying Zhang,Shuguang Xiong,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DeltaTrace，一种基于掩码后log概率差值的token归因框架，通过有效割线斜率反向组合实现精确归因，在注意力及线性注意力模型上取得更好的忠实性和检索/推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究上下文词语如何支持或反对语言模型的响应，需要解释输入token对固定响应的影响，并保证归因可加、可聚合且适用于多种注意力结构。

Method: DeltaTrace测量掩码被解释上下文token时响应log概率的变化，为有限变化构建算子特定的局部规则，并利用有效割线斜率沿计算图反向组合；每个token的归因为其嵌入位移与反向传播斜率的內积。

Result: 在注意力模型上，DeltaTrace在多数检索与推理任务上取得最低的删除忠实性分数（RISE、MAS），并在needle-in-a-haystack Recall上超过FlashTrace 5.67–24.33个百分点；在混合注意力与线性注意力模型上，相对FlashTrace在9个任务上降低RISE、12个任务上降低MAS。

Conclusion: DeltaTrace通过局部守恒的精确归因，兼顾可解释性与计算可行性，支持注意力及线性注意力模型，辅助内存随序列长度线性增长。

Abstract: We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by 5.67-24.33 percentage points. On the evaluated hybrid attention and linear-attention model, DeltaTrace lowers RISE on 9 tasks and MAS on 12 relative to FlashTrace.

</details>


### [772] [Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25880)
*Xidong Wu,Qi Qi,Yuqiong Ji,Shangqian Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出异步在线自蒸馏框架AsyncOPSD，将rollout生成与学习更新解耦，并引入陈旧度感知策略控制和token级熵加权，实现1.96–2.25倍吞吐提升且精度不降反升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏（OPSD）虽只需单一模型兼作学生与教师，但同步rollout生成占据主要训练时间，成为规模扩展的严重系统瓶颈。而OPD架构在异步训练时又存在多模型协调开销。

Method: 将rollout生成与学习器更新异步解耦；由于师生共享参数，避免OPD的多模型协调开销。针对老策略缓冲轨迹陈旧问题，设计基于陈旧度感知（staleness-aware）策略控制的蒸馏目标，并结合token级熵加权。

Result: 在三种模型规模和数学推理基准上，训练吞吐相比同步OPSD提升1.96–2.25倍，同时平均基准准确率有所提高。

Conclusion: 异步化可有效突破OPSD的rollout瓶颈，且合理的陈旧度与熵加权机制可抵消陈旧轨迹的负面影响，实现速度与精度的双赢。

Abstract: Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

</details>


### [773] [Learn the Interface, Not the Implementation: Output Representation Dominates Training Regime in LLM-Based RTL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25881)
*Siddharth Patel,Vikram Singh,Siddharth Savyasachi Malu,Rohit Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在SECDED ECC存储器包装器生成任务上，输出表示（interface）比训练方式更决定成败：模型只需输出8字段配置由确定性生成器展开，形式等价通过率可达0.89–1.00，而直接生成RTL最多0.17。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM生成RTL研究集中于训练范式（微调、继续预训练、基于验证器的RL），作者认为这是"二阶问题"，真正关键的是输出表示（接口）的选择。

Method: 固定任务、数据和正确性判定（约一千万设计点上的形式等价验证，而非手写testbench采样），独立变化两个轴：七种训练设置与四种输出表示层级（从完全展开的扁平Verilog到8字段配置经确定性生成器展开）。

Result: 表示占主导：接近原始RTL的表示通过率≤0.17，而配置表示零训练即达0.83；模型输出配置后所有训练范式达0.89–1.00。原始RTL存在硬性输出长度瓶颈：512位设计需44,237 tokens，配置仅69 tokens，故超过32位数据字后不可行。<50M参数从头训练+生成器达0.89形式等价，对比32B参数微调模型的1.00，但每正确设计推理能耗约为其1/1600；推理能耗还主导摊销后的训练能耗。

Conclusion: 应学习接口而非实现（learn the interface, not the implementation），通过确定性生成器将生成问题转化为配置预测可显著提升正确性与能效。

Abstract: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

</details>


### [774] [Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25932)
*Minoo Ahmadi,Seyedarmin Azizi,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出保持谱系的SMC解码（LP-SMC），用Chopthin重采样加输入权重下限，避免多项重采样丧失谱系多样性，在扩散语言模型推理上显著提升覆盖率与准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时SMC解码依赖重采样步骤，需在集中计算于有希望候选与保留探索多样性之间平衡。多项重采样会复制高权粒子、丢弃可能仍能到达正确答案的谱系，而ESS无法反映这种多样性损失。

Method: LP-SMC结合Chopthin重采样与输入权重下限：Chopthin限制返回权重的最大/最小比值而不强制等权，并将不等权重传递下去；下限约束重采样前权重相对最大值的最低值，使早期低权谱系仍有恢复机会。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准、两个基模型上，oracle覆盖率在所有设置提升1.8–25.6点；端到端准确率在12个设置中11个提升，LLaDA-1.5最高+7.9点，Dream-7B最高+18.3点。

Conclusion: 外部奖励模型下覆盖率增益依然存在，表明保多样性重采样与引导信号对推理时搜索各自独立贡献，验证了LP-SMC的有效性。

Abstract: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

</details>


### [775] [Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25901)
*Nimeshika Udayangani,Flora D. Salim,Christopher Leckie,Sarah Erfani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TA-KAN框架，用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的局部神经可塑性实现无回放的持续学习OOD检测，并设计几何引导的OOD评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中的OOD检测需同时避免灾难遗忘并在无过去ID数据条件下识别未知样本，现有方法依赖回放缓冲或封闭世界假设，扩展性与可靠性受限。

Method: 基于KAN的固有局部神经可塑性缓解遗忘；提出任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，通过任务特定的激活局部性控制缓解近因偏差、增强ID-OOD可分性；并提出不依赖过去ID数据的几何引导OOD评分，与分类器置信度互补。

Result: 显著提升OOD检测性能，同时保持较强的ID分类性能，在OOD-CL任务上取得state-of-the-art结果。

Conclusion: TA-KAN为无回放持续学习OOD检测提供了有效方案，KAN的局部性与几何评分互补可在不访问旧数据的条件下实现可靠检测。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

</details>


### [776] [An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25906)
*Tyler Bonnet,Marek Rei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一文本-图对齐框架，用轻量Transformer适配器让文本表示与图拓扑协同演化，并通过语言模型维护目标防止语义漂移，在动态文本属性图边分类上稳定优于冻结文本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态文本属性Web图（评论网络、社区论坛、新闻知识图谱）的边分类需要随网络演化自适应的高质量语义表示。现有动态图架构用预训练语言模型初始化文本特征后在训练中冻结，以保持语义结构，但放弃了文本表示与网络拓扑共同演化的潜在收益。

Method: 构建统一的文本-图对齐框架：引入轻量Transformer适配器，通过对比预训练目标产生的时空梯度更新token级文本表示；同时加入语言模型维护目标，将演化中的文本嵌入锚定到原始语义结构，以避免语义失真。

Result: 在Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark上，该锚定式文本-图协同演化在多个Web相关领域一致优于冻结文本基线。表示分析显示框架降低了各向异性、提升文本嵌入的线性可分性，并将结构与时间信息有效编码进语义空间；效率分析表明该收益不带来端到端联合训练的昂贵计算开销。

Conclusion: 文本表示与图拓扑的锚定式协同演化是动态文本属性图上可行且高效的改进方向，兼顾语义稳定性与时空信息融合。

Abstract: Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

</details>


### [777] [Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25920)
*Haoyu Li,Zeren Shui,Yuhao Zhang,Ferhat Erata,Benjamin Mikek,Murali Krishna Ramanathan,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Maestro 是一个 Lean 证明器框架，通过让证明器报告失败原因并由全局协调器统一调度，克服了传统分治式分解在错误方向上的盲目深入问题，在多个数学与软件验证基准上超越原生编码智能体和已有证明系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Lean 证明系统采用递归分治：把难题拆成子引理，遇到证不出的引理就继续拆。但引理证不出可能有多种原因（缺乏引导、命题为假、分解本身有缺陷），而现有系统只能得到"失败"这一信息，且响应局限于失败节点，无法审视整体证明或修改上层计划。结果系统会沿错误方向持续分解直到预算耗尽，导致整个证明失败。

Method: 提出 Maestro，一个 Lean 证明器 harness，用全局协调处理失败：(1) 证明器不仅报告失败，还报告失败原因；(2) 一个能看到完整证明树的协调器据此选择恰当应对——引导卡住的证明器、修正错误引理，或撤回有缺陷的子树并重新规划。该框架同样可扩展到经过验证的代码合成，用检测到的反例反馈驱动代码修复。

Result: 在四个前沿 LLM、七个数学基准和三个软件验证基准上评测。在所有尚未饱和的基准上，Maestro 证明的目标数都超过各模型的原生编码智能体（Claude Code 或 Codex），在研究级数学上提升最大。用 Claude Opus 5 时，在 2026 年 6 月 arXivLean 的 48 个定理中自主证明 34 个（原生智能体为 19 个）。同时在所有共有基准上超过所有已发表证明系统：PutnamBench 669/672、Lean-IMO-Bench 59/60、IMO 2026 6/6。

Conclusion: 失败信息与全局协调的引入显著提升了自动形式化证明的效率与成功率，Maestro 在数学与研究级证明及软件验证任务上均达到当前最优水平，说明"诊断式失败反馈+顶层重规划"是突破分治式证明系统瓶颈的关键。

Abstract: Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof obligations into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

</details>


### [778] [Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25973)
*Suwan Yoon,Seongryong Jung,Changhee Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: APSD提出非对称策略优化：按回答正确性混合学生与自教师分布，正确样本插值以保留成功行为，错误样本外推以加强纠正，在RLVR与丰富反馈任务上优于基线且平均以2.6倍更少步数达到SDPO性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏策略优化提供密集的token级监督，但直接匹配自教师分布会破坏正确轨迹上已有的成功行为，同时对错误轨迹的纠正不足。

Method: 构造依赖正确性的双目标：正确rollout上用学生分布与自教师分布的插值（保留成功行为），错误rollout上用超出自教师的外推（强化纠错）；并从散度分解、反向KL重心几何与梯度分析三方面进行理论分析，强调梯度需通过学生依赖的目标流回学生。

Result: 在带可验证奖励与丰富反馈的强化学习设置下，APSD整体性能优于RL与自蒸馏基线，并在Qwen3各规模模型上平均以2.6倍更少训练步数匹配SDPO。

Conclusion: 按正确性非对称设计自蒸馏目标能兼顾成功行为保持与错误纠正，理论与实验共同验证其高效性与有效性。

Abstract: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

</details>


### [779] [UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25924)
*Qifeng Lei,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Shilong Bao,Linchao Zhang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出以"错误代价"为核心的效用导向评测范式：构建15,000条可验证答案的UtilityBench，用Best-Worst Scaling量化错误严重度，并提出UtilityAUC指标衡量模型"作答/拒答"排序与真实效用的对齐。理论分析与20个SOTA模型实验表明UtilityAUC能区分准确率与AURC无法区分的模型，且更高准确率或更强架构并不必然带来更高UtilityAUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流评测把所有错误视为等价，只看正确率，忽略真实场景（如医疗）中错误后果的巨大差异；模型该回答还是该弃答的决策应依据各场景的真实重要性，而非仅凭置信度。

Method: 提出基于效用的评测范式：构建大规模基准UtilityBench（15,000条带可验证答案的样本），使用Best-Worst Scaling由数据驱动地引出并量化错误严重度（效用）；用这些效用决定模型何时作答或弃答；并设计UtilityAUC，通过模型响应排序计算效用曲线下面积以衡量效用偏好对齐。

Result: 理论分析证明UtilityAUC可区分标准准确率与AURC无法区分的模型；在20个SOTA模型上评测发现，更高准确率或更先进架构并不稳定带来更高UtilityAUC，暴露出"解题能力"与"负责任决策"之间的差距。

Conclusion: 评测应从"错误频次"转向"错误后果"，以效用对齐衡量语言模型的负责任决策能力；UtilityBench与UtilityAUC为此提供了可复用的基准与指标。

Abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.

</details>


### [780] [The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25933)
*Moritz Wagner,Christophe Roux,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KV-Surgeon，通过校准数据建模注意力softmax重归一化带来的条目间交互，用二次代理目标联合决定删除与补偿，显著推进KV-cache离线压缩的成本-精度Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线压缩KV-cache可降低重复查询固定上下文的成本，但核心难点在于决定删除/保留哪些条目。现有方法对每个候选独立打分（其余缓存固定），忽略了softmax重归一化的非线性耦合：删除一个条目会改变所有剩余条目的注意力权重。

Method: KV-Surgeon利用校准数据以可处理的方式建模条目间交互：推导二次代理目标，得到可闭式求解的联合最优贪心删除决策，并对剩余条目进行补偿。还提出一个更快的变体。

Result: 在QuALITY、LongHealth、Long Code Arena上，各压缩比例下，均显著推进4B–30B稠密与MoE模型的成本-精度Pareto前沿。50×压缩时，问答精度最高比SOTA注意力匹配提升4个点（成本相当）；快速变体仅用其2/5成本即超越SOTA。

Conclusion: 考虑KV条目间交互（而非独立打分）是KV-cache离线压缩的关键，二次代理+闭式贪心解在精度与成本上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

</details>


### [781] [Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25993)
*Alessandro Cagiano,Lorenzo Molfetta,Gianluca Moro,Matteo Zignani,Pasquale Minervini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 图到表系统由三部分组成：将关系证据映为特征行的编码器、选择标注样本的上下文构造器、以及表格解码器。作者通过"匹配比较"（固定其余组件与评估口径、只改一个组件）检验这些组件能否独立评估，结论是：不能——对某一组件的结论会随其他组件变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图到表流水线常把编码器、上下文构造器、解码器当成可分别优化的模块，但缺乏证据表明单组件评估能反映其在整体系统中的行为。作者希望验证：在控制其余条件不变时，单组件结论是否稳健。

Method: 在 CLUTRR、57 个 GraphLog world 和 57 个知识图谱上，使用逻辑回归、CatBoost、TABPFN-3 三种解码器做匹配对比实验：逐次只更换编码器、上下文或解码器之一，其余与评估保持不变，考察排序与结论是否稳定。

Result: CLUTRR 上绝对位置编码能保留全部查询区分且几乎完美拟合短路径，但因"受支持前缀"充当捷径，泛化反而不如关系计数特征；GraphLog 上编码器优劣依赖解码器，关系计数表示随 CatBoost 树深增加而退化；多知识图谱上把冻结的 ULTRA 分数加到局部特征上稳定有益，反向叠加效果更小且不稳；点式 TABPFN-3 读取器用完整编码器在 57 个数据集中有 48 个不如原生 ULTRA。

Conclusion: 编码器评估依赖于上下文与解码器的联合作用，面板级结论还受评估与聚合协议影响；因此单组件的独立基准不足以预测系统整体表现，需采用匹配比较与多协议验证。

Abstract: Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. We investigate whether these components can be evaluated independently through matched comparisons that change one component while holding the rest of the pipeline and the evaluation constant. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. On CLUTRR, absolute positional encodings maintain all distinctions among the evaluated queries and fit the short-path setting nearly perfectly; yet, they generalise worse than relation-count features because the supported prefix acts as a shortcut that breaks down on longer paths. On GraphLog, encoder preference depends on the decoder, while the relation-count representation degrades as CatBoost tree depth increases. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. A pointwise TABPFN-3 readout using the full encoder underperforms native ULTRA on 48 of 57 datasets. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

</details>


### [782] [Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26325)
*Abdul Rahman Iqbal,Muhammad Fawad Nasim,Amir Saleem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较三种类型化决策模型（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）与其骨干模型及两个微调分类器在分布漂移下的表现，发现决策训练并非一致有益，TDMs 在漂移下也不比微调分类器更脆弱，主要弱点是本身的无漂移误校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TDMs 宣称校准良好，但部署中类频率会变化，固定测试集上的校准未必在阈值应用处成立。现有评估存在两个空白：(1) 厂商决策训练带来的增益未在与骨干完全相同的读出方式下被剥离出来；(2) TDMs 仅在测试集类别分布下被评估过。作者因此追问：决策训练是否优于其自身骨干？TDMs 的校准与阈值能否像微调分类器一样抵御流行度（标签）漂移？

Method: 在五个公开数据集上，对三种 TDM（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）、它们各自的基座模型以及两个训练分类器，在完全相同的决策读出下进行比较，并模拟标签漂移；预先固定 35 个配对检验，任���计算前即确定。另做 2000 次漂移场景的探索性平均，并测试以模型在开发集上的平均预测为先验的 EM 先验校正（无需标签）。

Result: (1) 决策训练并非一致有益：Nimble-9B 仅比 Qwen3.5-9B 多一个 LoRA 适配器，在意图任务上校准更好，但在金融情感任务上 Macro-F1 低 12.0 点。(2) 中度漂移下，Jev 的 ECE 与阈值风险仅在金融情感任务上显著劣于微调 DeBERTa，分别差 1.7 和 2.5 个百分点；在 2000 次漂移场景平均下，各数据集差距至多 1 点。(3) 无标签的 EM 先验校正使 Jev 在 ECE 最高的两个数据集上漂移下 ECE 降低 2.7 与 1.8 点，但有标签重校准降低更多。

Conclusion: 所测三种 TDM 既非一律优于其骨干，也非在漂移下格外脆弱；就校准而言，它们的主要弱点是漂移前就已存在的误校准。作者公开全部输入、代码与输出。

Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's.
