Result: (1)学习映射优势在最窄扩维时最大，随扩维变宽衰减至零；(2)学习映射下保留≤1/10坐标的top-k表示在各扩维上均与同维度稠密ReLU不可区分，但GELU/SiLU不同；(3)强制二值化时稀疏码更优，因二值化对稀疏码无损而对稠密层有损；(4)可"免费"的稀疏度随扩维增大而升高，无固定上限。回归任务重现第一点，并对第二、三点有修正性结论。

Conclusion: 学习式EaS可做得很小且实用；稀疏表示与稠密ReLU层在宽度足够时性能相当，二值化下稀疏更优，稀疏度由扩维宽度决定而非存在固定极限。

Abstract: Expand-and-sparsify ($\texttt{EaS}$) representations lift an input to a much higher dimension through a linear map and keep only the $k$ largest coordinates. Existing theory builds that map at random and needs the expanded dimension to grow exponentially in the input dimension, which puts the construction out of practical reach. We ask what is gained by learning the map by gradient descent instead, and how that gain depends on how wide the expansion is. We sweep $73$ OpenML classification tasks and $48$ regression tasks under a protocol that holds the datasets, expanded dimensions, sparsity levels and splits fixed across every method, and we summarise each comparison by a median over datasets and a Wilcoxon signed rank test. We report four findings. First, learning the expansion helps most when the expansion is narrowest, and its advantage over a random map decays to nothing by the widest expansions we run, so a learned $\texttt{EaS}$ layer can be made small. Second, with the map learned, a top-$k$ representation that keeps at most a tenth of its coordinates is indistinguishable from a dense $\texttt{ReLU}$ layer of the same expanded dimension at every expansion factor we test, while GELU and SiLU are not. Third, when the representation is forced to be binary the sparse code is the better of the two, and the reason is that binarization costs it nothing while it costs the dense layer accuracy. Fourth, how sparse the representation can be is governed by how wide it is: the sparsity level that is free rises as the expansion grows, so there is no fixed limit on how sparse it can be. The regression tasks reproduce the first finding and qualify the second and third.

</details>


### [819] [A Simple and Unified Method for Gradient-Variation Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26473)
*Hang Yu,Peng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于"决策移动二次惩罚的替代损失"的统一方法，在非平稳在线学习与通用在线学习中同时获得梯度变化界，并可改进在线博弈的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度变化（gradient-variation）在线学习连接博弈论与优化，但以往在非平稳在线学习（最小化动态遗憾）和通用在线学习（适应未知损失曲率）两个场景中，各自使用不同技巧、分别推导梯度变化界，方法分散且不够统一。

Method: 用一个带决策移动二次惩罚的替代损失（surrogate loss with quadratic penalty on decision movement）构造简单统一的算法框架：在非平稳场景中实现"乐观到梯度变化"的归约（optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction）；在通用场景中直接导出简单算法。

Result: 非平稳在线学习中，一大类算法可达到 Zhao et al. (2024) 的速率；通用在线学习中，与 Yan et al. (2024) 的最优通用遗憾界匹配，同时放宽了扩展光滑性假设；并应用于在线博弈，改进现有保证。

Conclusion: 二次惩罚替代损失是一种简单统一的工具，可统一两套梯度变化分析并带来更弱假设与更强保证。

Abstract: Gradient-variation online learning has attracted increasing attention for its connections to game theory and optimization. It has been studied in both non-stationary online learning, which aims to minimize dynamic regret against time-varying comparator sequences, and universal online learning, which seeks to adapt to unknown loss curvature. Prior work obtained gradient-variation bounds using different techniques tailored to each setting. We propose a simple and unified method based on surrogate losses with a quadratic penalty on decision movement, yielding gradient-variation bounds in both settings. For non-stationary online learning, the method induces an optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction, enabling a broad class of algorithms to match the rate established by Zhao et al. (2024). For universal online learning, it yields a simple algorithm that matches the optimal universal regret bounds of Yan et al. (2024) while relaxing the extended smoothness assumption. Finally, we apply our method to online games and improve on existing guarantees.

</details>


### [820] [Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26486)
*Christoph Metzl,Stefan Kapsreiter,Kianusch Vahid Yousefnia,Virginia Poli,Richard Müller,Frank Krüger,Tobias Bölle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 降水临近预报的生成模型主要在偏湿数据集上训练和评估，这会同时引入训练偏差与评估偏差。作者从解析层面说明目标依赖的采样如何移动生成模型学到的条件分布，并用一个卫星到雷达的扩散模型实证：在偏湿测试集上模型显得欠预测，在代表部署分布的测试集上却显得过预测，且该结论在七年后的域外仍可复现，且会误导下游调参（如无分类器引导）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有降水临近预报的生成模型多在偏湿数据集上训练与评估，以突出稀有极端事件，但按目标观测挑测试样本会让评估偏向"匹配所选分布"的预测而非真实部署分布。作者想弄清这种目标依赖采样是否也会改变生成模型学习到的条件分布，从而让评估偏差掩盖训练偏差。

Method: 解析推导目标依赖采样对生成模型所学条件分布的影响，证明当训练与测试采样一致时，即便理想模型也会学到评估偏好的分布；随后用固定的卫星到雷达扩散模型做实验，对比偏湿测试集与代表部署分布测试集的校准评估，并在相隔七年的域外数据上复现；最后以无分类器引导为例分析矛盾校准结论对下游开发的误导。

Result: 目标依赖的测试采样可以反转校准评估结论：同一固定模型在偏湿测试集上表现为欠预测，在部署代表性测试集上表现为过预测；该现象在七年间隔后的训练域之外仍能复现；基于矛盾校准结论调节无分类器引导会误导下游模型开发方向。

Conclusion: 偏湿数据集带来的训练偏差与目标依赖测试采样带来的评估偏差相互耦合，评估偏差可掩盖训练偏差。降水生成模型的校准评估应采用代表部署分布的测试集，否则可能得出相反结论并误导模型改进。

Abstract: Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

</details>


### [821] [Concerns in Benchmarking Jailbreaks: An Empirical Study of Attack Success Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26595)
*Leon Tu Nguyen,Rohan Menon,Rafael Tappe Maestro,Eric Aubinais,Chih-Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 越狱攻击的ASR高度依赖生成与判定流程：同一攻击在关键词匹配下达96.0%，在Qwen3评测器下达2.7%；改变尝试次数与排列会反转方法排名；重复采样100次可让初始拒答的请求出现100%（关键词）／50%（Qwen3）的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱研究普遍用攻击成功率（ASR）横向比较方法，但ASR受响应生成方式与判定标准影响，缺乏统一定义，导致结论可能不可靠甚至误导安全评估。

Method: 对3个开放权重模型测试8种攻击，采用3种评估流程（含关键词匹配与遵循StrongREJECT评分的Qwen3评测器）对比ASR；改变尝试次数与排列检验排名稳定性；另做实验：对同一未修改请求在Ollama默认温度0.8下采样100条响应，比较两种判定下的ASR。

Result: 低资源语言攻击在关键词匹配下平均ASR为96.0%，Qwen3评测器下仅2.7%；尝试次数与排列变化使DeepInception与改写方法排名反转；重复采样100次时，关键词匹配ASR达100%，Qwen3评测器下为50%。

Conclusion: ASR比较脆弱、跨评估不可比；重复采样揭示初始拒答后的残余不安全行为，属概率性抑制而非稳健排除。建议明确成功定义、匹配响应预算、验证评测器，并报告重复交互下的累积失败率而非单次生成测试。

Abstract: Jailbreak methods are commonly compared using Attack Success Rate (ASR), but these comparisons depend on how responses are generated and judged. In this paper, we examine eight attacks against three open-weight language models using three evaluation procedures. Low-resource language attacks achieve a mean ASR of 96.0% under keyword matching but 2.7% under a Qwen3 evaluator following StrongREJECT scoring instructions. Changing the number and arrangement of attempts reverses the ranking of DeepInception and rewriting. In a separate experiment, sampling 100 responses for each unchanged request at Ollama's default temperature of 0.8 yields 100% ASR under keyword matching but 50% under the Qwen3 evaluator. Beyond evaluator sensitivity, these findings raise a safety concern: repeated sampling can expose residual unsafe behavior despite an initial refusal, suggesting probabilistic suppression rather than robust exclusion. We recommend explicit success definitions, matched response budgets, validated evaluators, and reporting cumulative failure under repeated interaction rather than relying on single-generation tests.

</details>


### [822] [Bombadil: A Foundation Model for Plant Electrophysiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26597)
*James Kirk,Piotr Bednarski,Filip Twardy,Justin Mast,Lee von Kraus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bombadil——首个植物电生理基础模型，在无标签条件下用 100 个物种、10 种环境、超 400 万小时的电信号预训练，可跨物种、跨环境地追踪 7 项植物胁迫生理指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 植物用胞外电信号传递生理状态信息，但已有机器学习模型均为单任务训练，无法跨任务、物种或环境迁移，难以满足农业、林业、园艺及消费级植物养护的规模化需求。

Method: 构建基础模型 Bombadil：用差分胞外电极采集电信号，在覆盖实验室、温室、商业果园与天然森林 10 类环境、100 个物种、逾 400 万小时的无标签数据上做自监督预训练，学习植物电信号的通用表征，再据此追踪 7 项胁迫生理指标。

Result: Bombadil 能从电信号中追踪 7 项植物胁迫生理指标，且对训练中完全无标签的物种与胁迫类型同样有效。

Conclusion: 无标签预训练的基础模型范式可显著提升植物电生理信号的泛化能力，为跨物种、跨环境的规模化植物健康监测提供可行路径。

Abstract: Living plants, like animals, use electrical signals to carry information about their physiological state across their body, from roots to branches. These signals can be recorded, as they are in animals, from a pair of differential extracellular electrodes inserted into signal-conducting tissue. While machine-learning models have been trained to predict specific plant stress states from these signals, each of these models has been trained for only a single task and none have been designed to transfer across tasks, species, or environments. These approaches do not allow easy scaling across the wide range of species and environments that are relevant to agriculture, forestry, and horticulture for both commercial and consumer plant care.
  Here we present Bombadil, a foundation model for plant electrophysiology, pretrained without labels on over 4 million hours of electrical signals recorded from 100 plant species in ten distinct environments, including laboratories, greenhouses, commercial orchards, and natural forests. In this way, Bombadil is able to learn the fundamental features of plant electrical signals across a wide array of species and environments. Then, from those same electrical signals, Bombadil tracks changes in seven physiological indicators of plant stress, even among species and stressors with no labels in training.

</details>


### [823] [ITU-DESC: a missingness-aware machine-learning dementia risk score in the UK Biobank cohort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26604)
*Abdullah Kavaklı,Faik Boray Tek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可解释机器学习痴呆风险评分ITU-DESC，通过约8000候选特征的广泛筛选并显式控制缺失偏倚，在UK Biobank约50万人队列中预测全因痴呆，性能优于现有评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有痴呆风险评分依赖固定预选特征与线性模型，或忽视队列数据中信息性缺失带来的偏倚，限制预测性能与可靠性。

Method: 基于UK Biobank约50万参与者（中位随访16.6年）；用无条件随机热甲插补隔绝缺失模式信息；以10个随机插补种子重复BorutaSHAP特征选择，取至少8/10次被选中的38个预测因子；训练CatBoost梯度提升决策树模型，在50,041人独立测试集评估。

Result: 全因痴呆预测平均精度0.138（95%CI 0.123-0.156），ROC AUC 0.853（0.844-0.863），显著优于包括最强对比模型UK Biobank Dementia Risk Prediction（0.118，0.841）在内的其他评分；并发现传统评分未包含的预测因子如白细胞端粒长度和肝酶。

Conclusion: ITU-DESC是首个将广泛特征筛选与显式缺失偏倚控制相结合的痴呆风险评分，性能优越且具可解释性。

Abstract: Background: Existing dementia risk scores rely on fixed, pre-selected features and linear models, or ignore bias from informative missingness in cohort data. Here we introduce the Istanbul Technical University Dementia Risk Score (ITU-DESC), an explainable machine-learning score for incident all-cause dementia that combines broad feature selection across roughly 8,000 candidate features with explicit control of missingness bias.
  Results: We studied approximately 500,000 UK Biobank participants with a median follow-up of 16.6 years. We withheld missingness patterns from the model using unconditional random hot-deck imputation. We stabilized feature selection by repeating BorutaSHAP-based feature selection with ten random-imputation seeds and selecting predictors chosen in at least eight of the ten seeds, which yielded 38 predictors. We trained a CatBoost gradient-boosted decision-tree model and evaluated it on a holdout test set of 50,041 participants. For all-cause incident dementia, ITU-DESC achieved an average precision of 0.138 (95% confidence interval 0.123-0.156) and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.853 (0.844-0.863), significantly outperforming other risk scores, including the strongest comparator, the UK Biobank Dementia Risk Prediction model (0.118 and 0.841). We identified dementia risk predictors absent from established scores, including leukocyte telomere length and liver enzymes. Conclusions: ITU-DESC is the first dementia risk score to combine broad feature selection with explicit control of missingness bias.

</details>


### [824] [Degree Bounds for Separating Polynomial and Neural Invariants for Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26612)
*Snir Hordan,Harm Derksen,Mircea Petrache,Nadav Dym*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出了区分n个点的点云（模旋转与置换）的多项式的首个二次上下界，并据此推导出Tensor Field Networks与MACE表达完备性所需的表示阶数的首个显式二次界；在局部正则假设下，区分只需依赖邻域大小的低阶不变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有等变点云网络虽已知在表示阶数足够高时具有通用性（可区分任意点云对），但此前没有关于该阶数随点数n如何增长的具体界，只有存在性结果，缺乏可操作的保证。

Method: 通过研究区分n点云在旋转与置换下所需多项式的次数，建立二次下界与上界；并证明Tensor Field Networks和MACE在表示阶数足够时可表达给定次数的全部不变量多项式，从而将阶数界与网络表达能力对接；另在局部正则假设下分析基于消息传递、使用仅依赖局部邻域大小的不变量的模型；最后构造反例分析MACE的必要表示阶数。

Result: 得到区分n点点云的不变量多项式的首个二次下界与上界；给出TFN和MACE完备性所需的表示阶数的首个显式二次上界；表明在局部正则假设下点云区分可由仅依赖邻域大小的不变量通过消息传递模型实现；并给出反例表明MACE在局部正则点云下仍需计算高阶不可约表示。

Conclusion: 论文把等变点云网络完备性从存在性结论推进为显式定量保证：表示阶数随点数呈二次增长即可保证完备性，且局部正则条件下可显著降低所需阶数；同时MACE类架构的局部情形仍受高阶不可约表示需求的限制。

Abstract: Neural networks that respect the symmetries of point clouds commonly compute high-order representations of the rotation group to improve their expressivity. Such models are known to be universal, and thus able to separate any pair of point clouds, when using representations of sufficiently high order, yet no precise bound on this order, as a function of the number of points, was previously known. We establish the first quadratic lower and upper degree bounds for polynomials that separate point clouds of n points up to rotations and permutations. By showing Tensor Field Networks and MACE can express all invariant polynomials of a given degree with sufficient representation order, we additionally derive the first explicit, quadratic bound on the representation order sufficient for these architectures to be complete, replacing previous existence results with concrete guarantees. We further show that, under local regularity assumptions, point cloud separation can be achieved with a message-passing-based model using invariants whose degree depends only on the size of a local neighborhood, rather than on the size of the full point cloud. Finally, we provide counterexamples showing MACE must compute high order irreducible representations to separate locally regular point clouds.

</details>


### [825] [Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC): A Mechanism for Time-Aware Pediatric Sleep Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26618)
*Saurav Raj Pandey,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出全局时间感知条件化机制GTC，将睡眠分期片段在全夜中的全局时间信息注入自监督学习表征，在两个儿科队列五项任务上普遍提升F1与AUPRC且跨队列迁移有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 睡眠生理随夜间进程演变（睡眠周期、呼吸稳定性、心血管动态均变化），但现有睡眠自监督学习方法多处理固定时长短窗口，未显式建模窗口在整夜睡眠中的位置，缺失全局时间上下文。

Method: GTC：在每个输入窗口的潜在表征上，以该窗口的全局睡眠时间（time-of-sleep）作为条件，补充局部位置编码；将其集成进三种代表性SSL框架，在两个独立儿科队列、五项临床相关且类别极度不平衡的任务上评估，并考察跨队列迁移。

Result: 在各架构与任务上，GTC总体提升F1与AUPRC，且增益在跨队列迁移场景下依然保持。

Conclusion: 全局时间上下文对睡眠表征学习具有明确价值；GTC是一种通用、可插拔的增强机制，适用于多种SSL框架并具跨队列泛化性。

Abstract: Sleep physiology evolves throughout the night, with changes in sleep cycles, respiratory stability, and cardiovascular dynamics. However, self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for sleep typically process short, fixed-duration windows without explicitly modeling where each window occurs within the full sleep session. We introduce Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC), a mechanism that complements local positional encodings by conditioning latent representations on the global time-of-sleep of each input window. We integrate GTC into three representative SSL frameworks and evaluate them on five clinically relevant tasks with extreme class imbalance across two independent pediatric cohorts. GTC generally improves F1 and AUPRC across architectures and tasks, with gains persisting under cross-cohort transfer, highlighting the value of global temporal context for sleep representation learning.

</details>


### [826] [SleepPairNet: Learning Multimodal Pediatric Sleep Representations with Random-Pair Cross-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26628)
*Saurav Raj Pandey,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SleepPairNet，一个通过交叉注意力学习生理信号两两交互的多模态自监督学习框架，配合随机模态对选择策略，在呼吸任务上超越现有SSL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 睡眠质量评估与睡眠障碍检测依赖生理睡眠信号分析，而跨越多种生理信号的模态间关系学习能提供更丰富的表示，但现有多模态方法难以灵活应对不同模态组合。

Method: SleepPairNet采用多模态自监督学习框架，利用交叉注意力学习生理信号对之间的交互；并提出随机模态对选择策略，在预训练阶段让模型接触多样化的信号对，从而在测试时灵活适配不同模态组合。模型在NCH数据集上预训练。

Result: 在所评估的所有呼吸相关任务上优于SSL基线，在EEG相关任务上保持竞争力；迁移到外部CHAT数据集时效果更佳。

Conclusion: 通过成对交互建模与随机模态对采样，SleepPairNet实现了灵活且泛化性强的多模态睡眠信号表示学习，并具备良好的跨数据集迁移能力。

Abstract: Analyzing physiological sleep signals is important for assessing sleep quality and detecting sleep-related disorders. Learning inter-modal relationships across physiological signals can provide richer representations for downstream sleep analysis. We introduce \textbf{SleepPairNet}, a multimodal self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that learns pairwise interactions between physiological signals through cross-attention. We propose a random modality-pair selection strategy that exposes the model to diverse signal pairs during pretraining, enabling flexibility across modality combinations at test time. Pretrained on the NCH dataset, SleepPairNet outperforms the evaluated SSL baselines on all respiratory tasks while remaining competitive on EEG-related tasks, and shows even stronger results when transferred to the external CHAT dataset.

</details>


### [827] [VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26629)
*Shashwat Saxena,Mehul Goel,Sreyas Venkataraman,Sarvesh Patil,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Value Disaggregation (VaDar)，训练单一子目标无关策略来最大化各子目标critic值的线性组合，仅训练时需要子目标信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时序任务对强化学习困难，传统方法将任务分解为子目标并学习子目标条件策略，但部署时需要进行可能昂贵或繁琐的子目标选择。

Method: VaDar训练一个不依赖子目标的单一策略，通过学习子目标分解的多个critic值并最大化其线性组合来实现；子目标信息仅用于训练阶段。

Result: VaDar与goal-conditioning等基线相比始终具有竞争力且经常更优；能在非序列目标结构和多优化目标任务上成功；是首个在RoboCasa套件中解决挑战性长时序任务的算法，即使从BC预训练（初始成功率接近零）开始也能成功。

Conclusion: 子目标信息通过增强critic学习有效性而有益于actor-critic强化学习，而策略的子目标条件化往往是不必要的。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence.
  We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.

</details>


### [828] [The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26651)
*Aaron Maiwald,Roderick McNeill,Jaeyoung Lee,Matthew A. Clarke,Lennart Justen,Alejandro Acelas,Ivo Andrews,Giles Harper-Donnelly,Adam Moore,Sophie Rose,Oliver M. Crook,Felix Jackson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用ESM-2蛋白质语言模型研究预训练数据过滤作为开源权重模型安全防护的有效性、持久性与可扩展性，发现过滤病毒蛋白能选择性削弱病毒相关任务性能，但可被低成本微调恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练数据过滤是对开源权重语言模型最常见的安全防护手段之一，但其实际有效性、能否抵御后续微调以及随模型规模的扩展行为尚不清楚，作者希望对此进行系统评估。

Method: 以ESM-2蛋白质语言模型族为对象，从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白，在8M至3B参数规模上对比掩码语言建模、突变效应预测和长程接触预测在病毒与非病毒蛋白上的表现，并测试对已移除病毒家族序列进行微调后性能的恢复情况与所需算力成本。

Result: 过滤病毒蛋白显著降低病毒蛋白上的掩码语言建模、突变效应预测与长程接触预测性能，而非病毒蛋白性能基本保持；效应集中于感染人类的病毒蛋白，并随模型规模增大而增强，规模越大严格过滤越有效。但对被移除病毒家族序列微调即可恢复丢失的性能，即便最大模型也仅需约80美元H100算力。

Conclusion: 预训练过滤可适度有效地选择性削弱病毒蛋白上的性能，但面对少量算力和相关数据下的微调并不持久，因此不能作为可靠的长期安全防护。

Abstract: Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time. This work establishes pretraining filtering as moderately effective at selectively degrading performance on viral proteins, but not durable against fine-tuning with modest computational resources and access to relevant data.

</details>


### [829] [Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26666)
*Sara Neri,Eugenio Gaeta,Andrea Ceschini,Andrea Facchinetti,Giuseppe Fico*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在ARC-AGI-1上以等参数量对比HRM/TRM/URM及其"嵌套持久中间状态"变体，低算力条件下嵌套无一致优势，假设仍待验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究递归推理模型中加入一个"持久中间状态"（通过同一算子整合快速状态的重复更新）是否能提升预测性能，这是对递归推理组织方式的一个假设检验。

Method: 操作化定义"嵌套(nesting)"组织方式，并在三种架构（HRM、TRM、URM）中实现；使用官方代码库在ARC-AGI-1上，将每个基线与等参数量的嵌套变体对比，评估训练中见过示范任务的留出查询；实验仅用单GPU，远低于原文训练协议。

Result: 在测试条件下，嵌套变体在token准确率、预测损失和精确求解率上均无一致优势，精确求解率在所有配置下接近零。

Conclusion: 结果未能否定该假设，结论保持开放；作者提出一项确证性对比实验：信息量更足的基线、多种子、隔离嵌套效应的对照、预设判据，以判断该组织方式是否值得继续发展。

Abstract: Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.

</details>


### [830] [PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26671)
*Xiao Zhou,Alex Schutz,Victor-Alexandru Darvariu,Nick Hawes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PACT通过计划增强的迹图（Trace-graph）实现多智能体在动态部分可观测组合优化问题中的前瞻协调，优于已有基线与特权集中oracle。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经组合优化的多智能体方法假设问题实例信息一次性已知，而现实中信息随动作逐步揭示（如到达某边才发现不可通行），现有方法无法协调探索与利用这些逐步揭示的信息。

Method: 在环境图上增补代表智能体计划的辅助节点，并将其与资源节点相连以表示未来依赖关系；在增强图上进行消息传递，使智能体间协调扎根于环境，从而实现主动式（而非被动反应式）的冲突解决。

Result: 在动态问题上解质量优于基线；向更大实例迁移效果最好，甚至超过具有实例不确定性特权信息的集中式oracle。

Conclusion: 将计划显式编码进图结构可有效应对动态信息揭示下的多智能体协调难题，并具备良好的规模泛化能力。

Abstract: Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.

</details>


### [831] [GeoSplit: Selective Edge--Server Map Acquisition for Cross-User Travel-Mode Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26707)
*Zepu Wang,Luyao Niu,Ruolin Li,Jeff,Ban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoSplit是一个边缘-服务器框架，用于出行方式识别，将地图证据的效用、训练期迁移和运行时选择性获取分离评估。在GeoLife 10%标签下，全图上下文将未见用户的macro-F1从0.7154提升至0.7864，地图知识蒸馏得到的纯运动学生模型达0.7225；熵门控查询仅用39.5%轨迹即达0.7729（全查询0.7738），应用负载减少60.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络化移动感知将本地轨迹推断与远程地理上下文耦合，通信决策成为预测系统的一部分，因此需要研究地图证据何时、如何获取才通信高效。

Method: 提出GeoSplit边缘-服务器框架，将地图证据分为三部分：全地图上下文效用、训练期地图知识蒸馏（教师-学生）、运行时紧凑查询接口的熵门控选择性获取；并测试学习式价值估计与概率融合。在GeoLife数据集10%标签下，采用user-day与user-disjoint两种分组评估。

Result: 用户分离设置：全图上下文使macro-F1由0.7154升至0.7864；蒸馏学生模型0.7225；熵门控0.7729 vs 全查询0.7738，仅查询39.5%轨迹，负载降60.5%。用户-日分组：查询率21.6%时选择性查询与全查询接近。学习式价值估计与概率融合无稳定增益。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了面向智能交通感知任务的通信高效边缘-服务器推理，证明选择性获取地图证据可在几乎不损失精度下大幅降低通信量。

Abstract: Networked mobility sensing couples local trajectory inference with remote geospatial context, making communication decisions part of the prediction system. We present GeoSplit, an edge--server framework for travel-mode recognition that separates the utility of map evidence, its training-time transfer, and its selective acquisition at runtime. On GeoLife with 10% labels, we evaluate these components under user-day and user-disjoint grouping. For unseen users, aligned full-map context raises macro-F1 from 0.7154 to 0.7864, while map-informed distillation yields a motion-only student at 0.7225. Through a compact query interface, entropy gating achieves 0.7729 macro-F1 versus 0.7738 for all queries, querying 39.5% of trajectories and reducing application payload by 60.5%. Under user-day grouping, selective and all-query scores are similarly close at a 21.6% query rate. Learned value estimation and probability fusion offer no consistent improvement. These results illustrate communication-efficient edge--server inference for an intelligent transportation sensing task.

</details>


### [832] [Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26710)
*Tomàs Garriga,Munib Mesinovic,Luke De Bretton-Gordon,Gerard Sanz,Axel Brando,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的双稳健学习器，用于在时变治疗和历史依赖删失下估计异质性生存治疗效应，并通过理论性质与数值实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学等领域，需从时变治疗下的生存数据中估计异质性生存治疗效应（如判断哪种治疗序列的生存概率更优）。但治疗决策、患者特征与删失概率往往共同演化，需对治疗和删失同时做序贯调整；现有生存学习器多只考虑单一基线治疗分配，而纵向治疗效应学习器通常假设结局无删失。

Method: 提出一个双稳健学习器，将干预窗口与生存时区分开：治疗只在有限期内施加，之后顺其自然。框架要求对治疗与删失进行序贯调整，允许使用灵活的机器学习模型估计nuisance参数与治疗效果回归，并建立Neyman正交性、速率双稳健性和准oracle有效性等理论性质。

Result: 理论上证明了所提学习器具有Neyman正交性、速率双稳健性与准oracle效率；数值实验表明学习器有效。

Conclusion: 该框架为时变治疗与历史依赖删失下的异质性生存治疗效应估计提供了理论上可靠且实用的双稳健学习方法，可灵活结合机器学习。

Abstract: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.

</details>


### [833] [Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26718)
*Jean-Loup Dupret,Patrick Cheridito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出深度Pontryagin学习框架，用于含跳扩散的高维连续时间随机控制，通过分离伴随学习与策略改进求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接策略优化需在整个时间离散动力学上反复反向传播目标函数，计算代价大且难以处理跳扩散。作者希望利用Pontryagin随机最大值原理中的状态敏感性信息，将伴随学习与策略改进解耦。

Method: 对固定马尔可夫控制，沿模拟状态轨迹把奖励随时间反向传播得到路径级伴随标签，再经监督回归投影到马尔可夫状态上；随后通过强制执行逐点Hamiltonian平稳条件更新控制。

Result: 证明投影后的伴随过程满足离散时间Pontryagin原理，且当时间步趋于零时收敛到对应连续时间伴随倒向随机微分方程的解；数值实验显示方法在精度、稳定性和可扩展性上表现良好。

Conclusion: 该框架为高维连续时间（含跳扩散）随机控制提供了可扩展且理论有保证的深度学习方法，兼具伴随过程收敛性保证与良好数值性能。

Abstract: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

</details>


### [834] [Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26733)
*Jeffrey Regier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE)，利用样本分割将后验均值估计与高阶矩(方差)估计分离，用 K 折交叉拟合先生成 out-of-fold 残差再拟合条件密度，缓解 NPE 的过自信与过拟合问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NPE 以对数似然为训练目标，会鼓励密度估计器在训练点上赋予任意高的密度（因归一化流、高斯编码器等足够灵活），导致极端过自信，泛化到留出数据时表现差。早停与正则化虽可缓解，但只能在由样本内残差决定的优化轨迹上选择，形成"后验均值欠拟、后验方差过拟"的不利权衡。

Method: CF-NPE 采用 K 折交叉拟合：将数据划分为 K 折，先拟合 K 个后验均值回归器，再对每个样本用其未参与训练的折所给预测计算 out-of-fold 残差，最后以这些残差为条件拟合条件密度估计器。由此将条件均值估计与后验高阶矩估计解耦。

Result: 在合成数据与一个宇宙学应用中，CF-NPE 在留出数据上的对数似然高于标准 NPE，且通常改善校准性；在高维、模拟数据受限的场景中最有价值。

Conclusion: 通过样本分割避免 NPE 的过自信-过拟合权衡，CF-NPE 是一种简单有效的改进方案，尤其适用于高维、仿真预算有限的摊销贝叶斯推断任务。

Abstract: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) fits an amortized conditional density estimator to a simulated training set of complete-data realizations. NPE's training objective, log-likelihood, favors posterior approximations that assign arbitrarily high density to the training points, and typical families of amortized conditional density estimators (e.g., normalizing flows, Gaussian encoders) are flexible enough to oblige. The resulting policy of extreme overconfidence translates poorly to held-out data. Early stopping and other regularizers can prevent this degeneracy, but they are limited to selecting posterior approximations along an unfavorable optimization trajectory set by in-sample residuals, where the posterior mean is underfit while the posterior variance is overfit. To avoid this trade-off, we propose Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE), which uses sample splitting to separate conditional-mean estimation from the estimation of the posterior's higher moments. Using $K$-fold cross-fitting, CF-NPE fits $K$ posterior-mean regressors and then fits a conditional density estimator to the resulting out-of-fold residuals. In experiments with synthetic data and in a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration. CF-NPE is most useful in high-dimensional, simulation-limited settings.

</details>


### [835] [CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26734)
*Tan-Ha Mai,Hsuan-Tien Lin,Vu Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAVA方法，通过为互补标签设计专门的OT代价和标签间隔，解决OT数据估值迁移到互补标签学习时的语义错配问题，从而在低噪声场景下可靠检测并回收对角噪声样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互补标签学习（CLL）中，众包或视觉语言模型可能把真实类别误标为互补标签，这类"对角噪声"会让模型被显式训练去抑制正确答案，危害极大。OT数据估值本可识别有害样本，但直接迁移到CLL会因训练中标签c表示"非c"、验证中标签c表示"是c"而产生语义错配。

Method: 理论分析表明直接迁移的OT分数在噪声率足够高时有信息，在交叉率1/M处失效，低于1/M时方向反转（而实际CLL标注恰在此区间）。提出CAVA：引入互补标签代价（complementary label cost）与标签间隔（label margin），隔离每个互补标签对传输势的贡献，使方向在各噪声率下保持一致；并用无参数、闭式精度的阈值检测对角噪声，检测出的样本可回收为普通标签监督。

Result: 在合成与人工标注基准上，CAVA几乎完美分离对角噪声，而直接迁移的OT估值表现劣于随机；仅用部分干净验证集即可提升所评估的全部CLL目标。

Conclusion: 一旦显式建模互补监督的语义，基于OT的数据估值在CLL中变得可靠，CAVA为低成本标签下的大规模标注提供有效的噪声检测与样本回收方案。

Abstract: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

</details>


### [836] [Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26749)
*Alessandro Palma,Charles Jones,Tristan Cinquin,Fabian J. Theis,Frederik Wenkel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"轨迹回放"（trajectory replay），用匹配冻结的历史速度场与当前任务速度场的方式替代生成式回放的完整轨迹模拟，从而在连续时间生成模型的终身学习中减少离散化误差与计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将预训练连续时间生成模型适配到顺序到来的数据时，需避免遗忘旧任务。主流生成式回放需每步完整模拟轨迹，离散化误差累积会劣化被回放的历史分布，且计算代价高。

Method: 训练更新后的速度场同时匹配两部分：(1) 沿其轨迹的冻结历史速度；(2) 新任务的速���场，两者以稳定性-可塑性系数加权。理论分析（连续时间传输视角）表明最优解按各自密度对两个任务速度加权平均，生成两概率路径的混合。再结合均值速度蒸馏，仅需少量网络评估即可访问历史轨迹。

Result: 在类增量图像生成上优于生成式回放与蒸馏基线；在两个生物学案例研究中，将生成式扰动模型扩展到新语境和实验批次（跨两种数据模态），并保持治疗效果预测性能。

Conclusion: 以速度场匹配取代样本生成的回放方式，可在连续时间生成模型中高效缓解灾难性遗忘，兼具理论保证与跨领域实证有效性。

Abstract: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

</details>


### [837] [Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26757)
*Adrian Remonda,Jiajun Xi,Nicklas Hansen,Marcus Greiff,Thomas Lew,John Talbot,John Subosits,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA)，一种离线到在线、基于模型的强化学习框架，将结构化仿真先验作为有偏先验，通过不确定性正则化规划在有限真实交互中快速适应，并在自动驾驶赛车仿真与真实赛车上验证其少样本适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习能得到高性能控制策略，但依赖大量交互，在数据采集昂贵、失败不安全的真实物理系统上难以部署。作者希望减少对海量真实交互的依赖，同时不要求仿真器完全精确。

Method: PIA先在高/低保真度的异构仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型，然后利用目标域有限的交互数据，通过不确定性正则化的规划进行在线适应。其核心思想是把仿真轨迹看作有偏先验，在在线适应阶段修正残余不匹配，而非依赖精确仿真器做策略迁移。

Result: 在高保真仿真自动驾驶赛车中，PIA在赛道与路面变化下比强基线适应更快、圈速更低、失败更少；在真实全尺寸赛车上，实现可靠的少样本适应，车端交互时间少于1小时。

Conclusion: PIA表明将仿真先验视为可修正的有偏先验并结合不确定性正则化规划，可有效实现离线到在线的快速少样本适应，具备真实物理系统部署潜力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

</details>


### [838] [Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26777)
*Steven Motta,Davide Mambelli,Alessandro Rozza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TSI（不可约性的拓扑层）框架，用层论与上同调把任务级兼容性障碍与系统能力分离，通过非零上同调定义"结构签名"、用注册干预检验能力，并在两类有限模型中验证高阶交互的可证伪检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在相同智能体与相同通信预算下，多智能体系统仍会因联合交互形式不同而表现迥异；现有方法缺乏区分"任务本身的结构性障碍"与"系统能力不足"的理论工具。

Method: 用交互复形 K 与容量层 F 表示任务，以非零 H^n(K;F) 作为结构签名；上层链实现问题可精确求解当且仅当所表示的上同调类消失。对余圈数据给出可解性判据，1 次归约导出环空间见证与观测需求；并给出2次四面体边界的算例。

Result: 1次情形15,625个输入下，全智能体加性原语在判定与修复上均精确；最优成对系统判定达88.80%（仅比88.79%多数类基线高一个输入）、修复26.63%。2次四面体边界任务531,441个输入中，同2-骨架系统保留全部四个三智能体原语，却在分离窗口内与仅成对最优持平；加入填充四智能体原语后两任务皆精确。保状态鲁棒性检验保持精确性能，但未与恢复类别的消融做成本匹配。

Conclusion: 在给定注册原语与成本模型前提下，TSI 提供任务相对、可证伪的高阶交互检验方法；签名依赖于所选层，成对系统在特定任务上会遭遇不可约的交互障碍。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex $K$ and a capacity sheaf $\mathcal{F}$; nonzero $H^n(K;\mathcal{F})$ defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.

</details>


### [839] [Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26790)
*Maria-Eleni Sfyraki,Jun-Kun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文考虑训练数据由少量真标签样本与大量机器学习预测标签样本混合的场景，提出一阶和零阶随机优化方法，并通过线性回归到LLM微调的实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工获取真实标签代价高、难以扩展；但直接用ML预测标签会引入错误标签，因此需要针对"真标签+ML标签"混合数据设计合适的优化方法。

Method: 将问题建模为混合标签数据集上的优化问题，分别提出一阶与零阶随机优化算法用于训练。

Result: 通过从线性回归训练到大语言模型微调的全面实证研究，展示了所提算法在处理ML标签数据时的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提一阶/零阶随机优化方法能够有效应对ML标签噪声，为缓解人工标注瓶颈提供可行训练方案。

Abstract: Training a machine learning (ML) model is an optimization process that typically requires a set of examples with ground-truth labels beforehand. Obtaining these ground truths usually requires laborious human effort and can be costly. The scalability of human labeling becomes a concern when there are a large number of data points that need to be labeled. To address this practical issue, we consider an optimization setting where a subset of samples has ground-truth labels, while the remaining data points were labeled by an ML predictor, which could potentially assign incorrect labels to those points. We propose both first-order and zeroth-order stochastic optimization methods for training on datasets consisting of a mix of true-labeled and ML-labeled samples. We further conduct comprehensive empirical studies from training a linear regression model to fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for training with ML-labeled data.

</details>


### [840] [On Data Scaling in Tabular ML: More Data, Better Generalization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26794)
*Ivan Rubachev,Nikita Lazarev,Artem Babenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文构建八个含多达约千万训练样本的真实表格数据集，系统研究大规模表格数据的训练数据扩展（scaling）行为，比较GBDT、MLP与表格基础模型的缩放趋势，并揭示在分布偏移下ID与OOD性能在大规模时可能背离的现象及验证集使用策略的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格机器学习中大规模（100万+）数据这一细分方向仍缺乏研究；现有评估缺少对真实分布偏移下训练数据缩放的系统性考察。作者希望填补这一空白，理解不同模型族在数据规模增长时的行为，以及缩放训练数据在分布偏移下带来的新问题。

Method: 构建八个真实表格数据集（最多约一千万训练样本），保留任务自然分布偏移，并以随机划分评估作为对照。比较GBDT与MLP的缩放趋势；考察表格基础模型在不同上下文规模下的缩放行为；通过MLP容量扫描，以及比较MLP和GBDT中用于调参和早停的验证分布，分析ID与OOD性能背离问题；对比验证数据用于MLP模型选择的实践与用于表格基础模型上下文拟合的实践。

Result: GBDT与基于MLP的模型呈现大体相似的缩放趋势，均能从更多训练数据和算法改进中获益；表格基础模型缩放行为更多样，较新版本在更大上下文下（即使存在分布偏移）获益更稳定。ID与OOD性能在小规模下大多同步提升，但在大规模时可能背离。更强偏移下，使用能代表评估条件的验证集进行模型选择的MLP随训练数据增长一般能保持或提升性能；而将此类样本纳入上下文虽能提升基础模型性能，却未能阻止其随训练规模增大而恶化。

Conclusion: 大规模表格数据的缩放并非简单“越多越好”：在分布偏移下，ID/OOD性能可能随规模背离，验证数据的代表性至关重要。MLP配合有代表性的验证选择在大规模下较为稳健，而表格基础模型的上下文拟合策略在更强偏移下仍存在随训练规模退化的问题，值得进一步研究。

Abstract: Recent work in tabular machine learning has emphasized the importance of diverse and realistic evaluation settings. The niche of large-scale (1M+) data, however, remains under-explored. To study training-data scaling, we assemble eight real-world tabular datasets with up to around ten million training examples, retaining the natural distribution shifts of the tasks and using random-split evaluation as a control. We find that GBDTs and MLP-based models show broadly similar scaling trends, with gains from both additional training data and algorithmic improvements. Tabular foundation models show more varied scaling behavior, with recent versions benefiting more consistently from larger contexts even under distribution shift. However, scaling training data under distribution shift introduces new challenges: in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance mostly improve together at smaller scales but can diverge at larger scales. We examine this through MLP capacity sweeps and comparisons of the validation distributions used for tuning and early stopping in MLPs and GBDTs. We also compare common practices of using validation data, contrasting its use for model selection in MLP pipelines with using it for in-context fitting in tabular foundation model pipelines. Under stronger shifts, MLPs selected using validation representative of the evaluation conditions generally maintain or improve performance as training data grows. In contrast, including such examples in context improves foundation-model performance, but does not prevent deterioration with increasing training size in our experiments.

</details>


### [841] [Two hidden layer suffice: the caterpillar net](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26795)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Caterpillar Net：用两层隐藏层（宽度O(N²)与2^{O(N log N)}）非递归地实现N个输入的max运算，面向ReLU网络对CPWL函数最大表示的表达力研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPWL函数是仿射函数最大值的有限带符号和，故"最大值表示"是ReLU网络表达力研究的核心问题；此前关于max需对数深度的猜想已被推翻，而Brunck等(2026)证明两层隐藏层足以表示一般CPWL函数，本文希望给出具体的非递归构造。

Method: 提出Caterpillar Net（毛毛虫网络）：一种非递归网络构造，使用两个隐藏层实现N个输入的最大值，第一层宽度O(N²)，第二层宽度2^{O(N log N)}，并给出该构造的直接几何解释。

Result: 成功构造出用两层隐藏层计算N输入最大值、且具有上述宽度上界的Caterpillar Net，并提供了清晰的几何直观解释。

Conclusion: Caterpillar Net表明max可由两层隐藏层非递归实现，为"两层足以表示一般CPWL函数"提供了具体构造与几何视角。

Abstract: Every continuous piecewise linear (CPWL) function is a finite signed sum of maxima of affine functions, making maximum representation a central problem in the study of the expressiveness of ReLU networks. A now-disproved conjecture predicted logarithmic depth for maxima. Inspired by the proof by Brunck et al. (2026) that two hidden layers suffice for general CPWL functions, we give the Caterpillar Net, a nonrecursive construction for the maximum of $N$ inputs with two hidden layers of widths $O(N^2)$ and $2^{O(N\log N)}$. The construction has a direct geometric interpretation.

</details>


### [842] [Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26800)
*Yuheng Ma,Chendi Wang,Qiong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeDRM 将去中心化联邦学习的推理期协作建模为图约束的预算化本地专家转介过程，通过密度式路由势进行相邻比较选择转介路径，无需中心路由器即可提升推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习中客户端专长互补，但查询通常只在到达的客户端上评估，无法利用网络中分布的专长，且缺乏全局协调机制。

Method: 形式化"预算化本地专家转介"：查询仅能在相邻客户端间移动，仅访问过的客户端贡献预测。EdgeDRM 为每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势，用相邻势差选择下一步转介，并沿路径聚合本地任务模型预测；训练与推理均仅用邻居本地信息。

Result: 给出所学比较量的估计保证，刻画局部改进与图结构如何决定转介带来的先验加权密度增益；在基准与真实医疗数据上多数设置优于图匹配的去中心化基线，稀疏连接下优势最明显。

Conclusion: 本地势比较+路径聚合构成一种无需全局评分的可扩展去中心化推理协作范式，在稀疏图上收益最大，为异构联邦网络的推理期专长利用提供理论与实践支持。

Abstract: In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.

</details>


### [843] [Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26802)
*Zhuofan Josh Ying,Guanglong Sun,Nolan Ho,Kieran Liu,Rui Yang,Andrew Chen,Nikolaus Kriegeskorte,Pony Ma,Hossein Adeli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 BrainLoRA：用参数高效微调（LoRA）适配大型预训练多模态骨干网络来做大脑编码预测，配合因果结构单次多时间点预测、多 LoRA 融合核与 200+ 模型集成，在 Algonauts 2025 挑战赛及其公开后挑战榜单上取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流大脑编码模型只从冻结骨干上训练轻量读出层。受限于神经数据的稀缺与昂贵，从零训练大模型或做全量微调都很困难，因此需要一种能以少量可训练参数有效适配超大预训练骨干的方法。

Method: 1) 用低秩适配器（LoRA）加轻量读出层替代全量微调，实现参数高效的大脑编码适配；2) 利用骨干的因果结构在一次前向中预测多个时间点，替代滑动窗口，大幅降低特征提取与微调开销，从而可适配最多 104B 参数的多模态骨干；3) 提出多 LoRA 核，在共享骨干上加速多个 LoRA 的联合训练，用于构建大规模模型集成；4) 通过模态归因分析检验适配后模型的可解释性。

Result: 在九种多模态骨干上均稳定提升大脑编码性能；在与先前 SoTA 相同的 Qwen3-Omni 骨干上，BrainLoRA 取得 Algonauts 2025 挑战赛已发表最佳成绩；模态归因复现了经典的感觉皮层地形分布（此前多依赖分离的单模态编码器构造得到），并显示神经适配提升了音频输入与骨干内部跨模态融合的贡献；200+ 适配模型的集成在公开的 Algonauts 后挑战榜单上排名第一。

Conclusion: 结果表明 PEFT 是大规模大脑编码的一种高效而强大的范式：既能在通用多模态骨干上以低成本获得更强预测性能，又能保持模型可解释性，并可借多 LoRA 训练扩展到大规模集成。

Abstract: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

</details>


### [844] [Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26834)
*Anamaria-Roberta Hartl,Levente Zólyomi,Michael List,Günter Klambauer,Sebastian Böck,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KronLSTM 是一种基于 Kronecker Delta Rule 的线性注意力架构，通过单方向、最小侵入的记忆修正机制提升长上下文建模的稳定性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性注意力（如 DeltaNet 家族）的 delta-rule 更新会干扰已存储信息，且常需额外归一化与稳定化机制来保持记忆状态稳定。

Method: 提出 Kronecker Delta Rule 作为关联矩阵记忆的新更新规则，扩展 xLSTM 家族；该机制仅沿矩阵空间单一方向修正目标关联，实现最小侵入的记忆修订。并对记忆动力学进行数学分析（马尔可夫链收敛到稳态、记忆矩阵期望范数一致有界）。

Result: 理论上保证稳定记忆动力学且无需额外归一化/稳定化；实验中与现有线性注意力架构（含 (Gated) DeltaNet）相比具竞争力并常优于它们，在长上下文基准上表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: Kronecker Delta Rule 是构建稳定关联记忆的有效且可解析的基础，适用于循环线性注意力架构。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

</details>


### [845] [Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26863)
*Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran,Yue Zhao,Armin W. Thomas,Ehsan Adeli,Jiajun Wu,Juan Carlos Niebles,Li Fei-Fei,Michael Poli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Halcyon 系列早期融合多模态自回归模型完全从零预训练（仅用1亿图文对），无需网络规模语言预训练，即可在更低算力下超越 LlamaGen-XL/8 与 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文生图系统普遍依赖互联网规模的语言预训练，作者质疑语言预训练是否对强T2I生成是必要的。

Method: 提出 Halcyon 早期融合多模态自回归模型族，在自建 GPIC（1亿图文对）数据集上从零预训练；并通过对照实验检验纯文本预训练的作用，以及用 I2T 监督替代 caption dropout。

Result: Halcyon-0.52B 以 18.2× 更少预训练算力达到 48.0 对 63.3 gFD（优于 LlamaGen-XL/8）；Halcyon-1.6B 以 275× 更少算力达到 35.3 对 41.0 gFD（优于 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++）。对照实验显示纯文本预训练并未提升T2I生成；替换为 I2T 监督后模型还能学会图像描述且保持T2I质量。

Conclusion: 强T2I系统可以从零训练，无需互联网规模语言预训练；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [846] [GardenBench: A lightweight, daily evaluation of LLM capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23866)
*Benedict Cummins-Mburu,Mariana Garcia Mejia,Oscar Heath,Sabrina Kreyzerman,Ellie Murray,Arusan Surendiran,Rohan Alexander*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GardenBench：一个含11个测试套件的轻量级LLM基准，通过日常轻量提问追踪模型用例表现、成本与耗时的日间变化，并以实时看板公开结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多聚焦于高成本、静态的能力测评，缺少对模型每日表现波动（包括部署后变更或新版本发布导致的进步与退化）、运行成本与耗时的持续追踪，也缺少面向普通消费者日常任务的评测视角。

Method: 构建包含11个测试套件的基准，用系统化的轻量查询对LLM进行持续性提示测试，记录准确率、运行成本与耗时，跨模型提供方与版本比较；通过每日重复测量捕捉模型表现的日常波动，并将结果发布在实时看板上。

Result: 记录了模型准确率的日间变化，既能捕捉能力进步也能发现退化（如部署后模型被替换、新模型发布时），并实现了跨提供方/版本的准确率与响应特征对比。

Conclusion: GardenBench提供了一个创新、轻量、低成本、面向消费者与日常任务的基准，补充了现有LLM测试方法的多样性，并公开结果以便持续监测。

Abstract: We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss. This allows us to compare the accuracy and features of responses across model providers and versions. We account for daily variations in model accuracy, capturing both model progress and degradation, for instance, when a model is changed post-deployment or when a new model is released. We base our evaluation on general-use tasks and make our results publicly accessible via a live dashboard, diversifying existing approaches to LLM testing. Our main contribution is an innovative, lightweight, and inexpensive benchmark, designed to be consumer-facing and for everyday tasks.

</details>


### [847] [Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24108)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文比较三种多模态范式（联合预训练编码器+融合头 JOINT、独立预训练编码器+融合头 DECOUPLED、冻结LLM作智能体 AGENT），在16个配对数据集、5个领域、144个数据集-预算组合上无单一范式占优；并提出用目标任务的表示与几何诊断在训练前做两步级联选择，优于仅用元数据的路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态信息整合方式存在分歧：究竟是联合预训练编码器、下游融合，还是交由LLM推理更好？现有工作缺乏在统一条件下跨领域、跨标签预算的系统比较，也不清楚何时哪种范式更优。

Method: 以公开检查点实例化三种范式：JOINT（冻结联合预训练编码器上训练融合头）、DECOUPLED（冻结独立预训练编码器上训练融合头）、AGENT（冻结LLM，给定任务指令、标注样例、可用样本文本与单模态监督读出）。在16个配对数据集（5领域）和多个训练标签预算下比较。进一步用几何、监督表示诊断、文本-标签匹配等目标端诊断，配合任务与预算元数据，构建两步级联选择器（先选 AGENT/融合，再选 JOINT/DECOUPLED），并做留一组交叉评估。

Result: 144个组合中 DECOUPLED 胜54、JOINT 胜44、AGENT 胜46，无范式全面占优。ScienceQA、MELD、MetMeme 随监督量增加从 AGENT 转向融合。5个QA数据集中JOINT在4个上于所有预算领先；单模态5-NN准确率越高越倾向DECOUPLED（8个分类数据集，Spearman ρ=-0.67）。两级级联选择器留一组评估下71.4%选中胜者（元数据路由为54.2%），平均相对后悔0.028 vs 0.057；融合几何、监督表示诊断与文本-标签匹配优于任何单一来源。

Conclusion: 范式偏好与监督预算、任务形式和单模态5-NN准确率相关；目标端诊断可在拟合候选系统之前预判并选择范式，从而避免盲目试训，降低相对后悔。

Abstract: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

</details>


### [848] [Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23921)
*Ritvik Garimella,Biplav Srivastava,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用1000道算术表达式基准对比7种方法（原生函数调用、REST、SOAP、MCP微服务、直接LLM、本地Ollama模型、LLM调用MCP工具的智能体），发现确定性方法100%准确且延迟极低，而直接LLM最高92.9%准确、延迟超22000倍，最优智能体达99.9%准确但延迟约100万倍，并提出按任务类型选择架构的决策框架(ADF)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI被广泛追捧，但在准确性、延迟和成本维度上，智能体相对REST、SOAP、MCP、本地计算等既有方案何时更优尚不清楚，缺乏系统性证据。

Method: 构建需保持运算符优先级语义的1000道算术表达式受控基准，横向比较七类方法：原生Function Calling、REST/SOAP/MCP微服务、Groq云API直接回答、五个本地Ollama模型直接回答，以及五个本地LLM借助MCP工具的智能体系统，测量准确率与延迟。

Result: 确定性方法准确率100%且延迟可忽略；直接LLM最高92.9%准确，延迟为原生函数调用的22000倍以上；MCP工具加持下最佳智能体达99.9%准确，但延迟约为基线100万倍。

Conclusion: LLM/智能体方法不适合精确算术求值，应依据准确率与吞吐需求选择架构；提出ADF决策框架，并建议按任务类型（推理 vs 语言类）探索多种架构，而非一刀切采用LLM。

Abstract: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. The deterministic methods achieve 100% accuracy with negligible latency. Direct LLM evaluation achieves at most 92.9% accuracy at over 22,000x the latency of a native function call. With MCP tools, the best agent reaches 99.9% accuracy, but incurs nearly 1,000,000x the baseline latency. These results demonstrate that LLMs approaches are poorly suited for exact arithmetic evaluation and motivate an informed architectural decision framework (ADF) for choosing an architecture based on accuracy and throughput requirements. We recognize that an actual interaction with an agent may span both reasoning and linguistic tasks. Hence our recommendation is to explore multiple architectural choices (based on task type) rather than one-size-fits-all solution (LLMs).
  Code is available at - https://github.com/Ritvik-G/adf/

</details>


### [849] [A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23962)
*Hanqing Dou,Zijia Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种受控LLM工作流，结合历史相似交易检索、对比式SHAP证据、基于参考的推理与确定性校验，用于解释风险评分差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险评分差异（如某笔交易为何比参照样本得分更高）难以解释，普通LLM解释缺乏证据支撑、不稳定且不可追溯。

Method: 受控工作流：①检索相似历史交易作为参考；②计算对比式SHAP证据；③基于参考进行LLM推理；④确定性验证约束输出。

Result: 测试集实验中，相较无结构化工作流引导的同一LLM，该工作流生成的诊断更一致、更有证据依据、更可追溯。

Conclusion: 将检索、对比归因证据与确定性校验嵌入LLM流程，可有效提升风险评分解释的可靠性与可追溯性。

Abstract: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation. Experiments on a test dataset show that the workflow produces more consistent, evidence-grounded and traceable diagnoses than the same LLM without structured workflow guidance.

</details>


### [850] [What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24006)
*Dawei Li,Bohan Jiang,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，提出"轨迹忽视论题"：AI安全讨论过度聚焦突发的灾难性事件，而忽视了通过日常广泛使用逐步累积的隐性危害，应转向评估累积性使用模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流AI安全讨论集中于存在性威胁和灾难事件（如AI引发核冲突、生物疫情），缺少对"广泛使用中逐步累积危害"这类风险的关注。

Method: 借鉴社交媒体研究的经验（互惠性媒介效应、社会强化、个体易感性），类比分析AI系统中类似机制如何运作，并以对话式AI为具体场景（生成、语义推断、持久记忆可能收紧反馈回路），用谄媚、操纵、隐私流失为案例研究其交互与累积。

Result: 识别出重复安抚、选择性暴露、反复出现的决策偏差和个人画像积累等机制，可能逐步收窄视野、削弱独立判断或促成剥削性影响；强调这些是待研究的机制而非已证实的危害。

Conclusion: 呼吁评估累积性使用与部署模式、个体与社会层面的结果，进行严谨的因果推断，并设计保留有用协助与用户知情选择权的适度保障措施。

Abstract: Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

</details>


### [851] [Beyond Explicit Intent: Discovering and Shaping Artistic Intent through Human-AI Co-Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24010)
*Renye Yan,Jialun Zhong,Jikang Cheng,Yi Gao,Yanzeng Li,Ling Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出超越显式意图表达的人机协同创作范式，通过扩大模型探索让艺术家在观察比较中发现潜在偏好，并用强化学习将策展判断融入模型，形成"探索-识别-塑造-再探索"循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI交互假设创作者能预先明确表达意图并通过文本提示准确传达，但艺术意图常是模糊的、潜在的，或只有在看到具体视觉可能性后才被识别。

Method: 扩展模型探索以呈现多样视觉可能性；让艺术家通过观察、比较、选择识别未言明偏好；将其策展判断整合进强化学习，依据对生成轨迹的偏好分配不同学习强度，更强地强化被认可的方向，使模型逐步适配个体审美。

Result: 通过三项用户研究分别考察：潜在偏好的发现、个性化偏好对齐、以及模糊且难以表达的创作意图的外化。

Conclusion: 构建持续的"探索-识别-塑造-再探索"循环，使艺术意图被逐步发现、外化与塑造，实现超越显式意图表达的人机共创。

Abstract: Generative AI is becoming an important medium for artistic creation, yet existing interactions often assume that creators can specify intentions in advance and accurately communicate them through text prompts. Artistic intentions, however, may be vague, latent, or recognizable only after seeing concrete visual possibilities. We propose a human-AI co-creation paradigm beyond explicit intent expression. By expanding model exploration, we expose artists to diverse visual possibilities, allowing them to identify previously unarticulated preferences through observation, comparison, and selection. We then integrate artists' curatorial judgments into reinforcement learning, assigning different learning strengths based on preferences over generation trajectories, so recognized directions are more strongly reinforced and the model gradually adapts to individual aesthetics. This creates a continuous "explore-identify-shape-re-explore" loop in which artistic intent is progressively discovered, externalized, and shaped. Through three user studies, we examine latent-preference discovery, personalized preference alignment, and the externalization of vague, difficult-to-express creative intentions.

</details>


### [852] [Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24024)
*Jian Yang,Peiling Liu,Songda Li,Yu Cao,Yuqing Feng,Lan Yu,Jiarong Pan,Jing Ye,Xinwen Huang,Chaochun Zou,Xudong Lu,Huilong Duan,Haomin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FusionRare提出一个多范式融合框架，整合符号推理、深度学习、病例检索与LLM推理，在2528例严格隔离病例上实现SOTA罕见病优先级排序（表型仅Recall@1达51%，表型+基因型达79%），并经临床随机交叉验证证实可提升诊断排名与医生信心、缩短诊断时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见病影响全球约3亿人，诊断过程漫长且受临床稀缺性和知识碎片化限制。现有AI范式各有结构性缺陷：符号方法受知识完备性限制，神经网络牺牲可解释性，LLM系统易受数据泄漏等评估偏差影响。因此需要一种能够调和这些正交范式的统一框架。

Method: 提出FusionRare统一多范式融合框架，集成四类能力：知识驱动的符号推理、深度学习模式识别、基于病例的患者检索、LLM启发式推理；并通过统计元聚合与知识增强的智能体反思机制进行整合。评估采用2528例严格隔离临床病例及严格防泄漏协议，并开展随机交叉的医生-AI验证。

Result: 表型仅诊断下宏平均Recall@1为51%，表型-基因型联合分析为79%，显著优于DeepRare、GPT 5.5、PhenoBrain、LIRICAL等系统。临床验证显示FusionRare在45%决策中提升真实诊断排名，62%情况下提高医生信心，诊断时间缩短21%。

Conclusion: 调和正交AI范式可显著增强诊断能力，弥合计算基准与临床可用可靠性之间的差距；该工作为在高风险、复杂且资源匮乏的医疗领域部署可信诊断AI提供了可复现框架。

Abstract: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. These results represent decisive advantages over the advanced agentic system DeepRare, frontier LLMs including GPT 5.5, and specialized tools like PhenoBrain and LIRICAL under stringent anti-leakage protocols. A randomized, crossover clinician-AI validation demonstrated that FusionRare elevates the true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improves physician confidence in 62%, and reduces time to diagnosis by 21%. These findings indicate that reconciling these orthogonal AI paradigms significantly enhances diagnostic capabilities, bridging the gap between computational benchmarks and actionable clinical reliability. More broadly, this work provides a replicable framework for deploying trustworthy diagnostic AI across complex, high-stakes, and underserved medical domains.

</details>


### [853] [LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24051)
*Savitha Sam Abraham,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将T2I评估视为约束满足问题，提出逻辑框架与LogicVal评估方法，揭示模型在复杂组合约束上存在巨大能力缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I基准虽覆盖属性绑定、计数、空间与常识推理，但缺乏统一、形式化的评估视角，难以刻画模型在多重逻辑约束下的真实能力。

Method: 提出形式化逻辑框架，明确基准领域的对象、属性、关系及生成图像需满足的约束；在9类约束（从单对象属性到含∀、∃、count、→的多对象关系）上评测4个SOTA T2I模型；并提出LogicVal——结合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理判定约束满足。

Result: 单对象约束最高98%准确率，复杂条件多对象关系约束仅53%；组合泛化上，单约束84%降至多约束同时满足20%；不可满足提示识别最高仅23%；LogicVal在CLEVR上ROC-AUC为0.88–0.98，与人类判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 基于逻辑的评估能有效刻画T2I模型的能力与局限，LogicVal为细粒度、可解释的约束满足评估提供了可靠方法。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

</details>


### [854] [World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24061)
*Shannon Zejiang Shen,Yapei Chang,Qiyao Liang,Benjamin Newman,Jenny Liang,Rulin Shao,Ziqiao Ma,Junjie Oscar Yin,Yung-Sung Chuang,Weijia Shi,Yejin Choi,Luke Zettlemoyer,Pang Wei Koh,Mohit Iyyer,Tongshuang Wu,David Sontag*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Software World框架，用于在真实软件生态中模拟多智能体协作，发现协作收益随推理时计算扩展，最佳模型可将下游效率提升达31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体团队承担更大项目和长期开放问题时，智能体协作成为扩展推理时计算的新维度，但缺乏理解协作何以致效与可扩展的系统性研究环境。

Method: 构建Software World框架，自动生成由真实、相互依赖的Python包组成的"软件世界"（不同主题、规模与依赖结构）。模拟中智能体以提升软件效率为高层目标自主发现任务并协作，通过改变通信、所有权和资源分配研究协作要素；以隐藏依赖包的加速比集体评估；在3个世界、8个模型上运行超1万小时模拟。

Result: 整体性能提升随推理时计算扩展，最佳模型将下游效率提升最高31%；多数智能体能通过协作找到有意义任务，但部分前沿模型会过早停止寻找改进而进展甚微。

Conclusion: 多智能体协作是可扩展的推理时计算维度，但智能体存在过早收敛问题；框架与轨迹已开源以支持后续研究。

Abstract: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

</details>


### [855] [Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24090)
*Peilin Wu,Yi-Zhuang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究累积记忆能否帮助LLM智能体解决新问题、记忆设计是否影响收益。用668个汉字绘制任务、五种智能体条件对比：自由笔记提升首次成功率4.6个百分点，笔记加可复用代码库提升2.8个百分点，两者总体无显著差异，但代码库在后期更难任务上有提示性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究从先前尝试中累积的持久记忆是否真正帮助LLM智能体解决新问题，以及记忆的设计方式是否会影响这种收益的大小与分布。

Method: 以程序化汉字绘制为任务，五种智能体条件尝试同一组668个条目。对比两种记忆设计：纯自由形式笔记、笔记加可复用代码库。另做事后比较，考察代码库智能体在获得目标特定结构监督（特权信息）时的表现。

Result: 尽管记忆库规模大幅增长，记忆带来的总体聚合收益有限：自由笔记使首次尝试成功率提升4.6个百分点，笔记+代码库设计提升2.8个百分点。两种设计总体无显著差异，但代码库在后期更难条目上呈现提示性优势；获得目标特定结构监督时改进显著更大。

Conclusion: 智能体能利用高信息量的结构指导，但特权逐项信息无法说明仅靠经验学习可达到何种效果。记忆设计可能决定累积经验在何处变得有用，即使平均收益有限。

Abstract: Does persistent memory accumulated from previous attempts help an LLM agent solve new problems, and does memory design affect that benefit? We study programmatic Chinese-character drawing across five agent conditions attempting the same 668 items. Accumulated memory produces modest aggregate gains despite substantial growth in the memory stores: free-form notes improve first-attempt success by 4.6 percentage points, while a design combining free-form memory with reusable code improves it by 2.8 points. The two designs do not differ significantly overall, but the code bank shows a suggestive advantage on later, harder items. A separate post-hoc comparison finds a much larger improvement when the code-bank agent receives privileged, target-specific structural supervision. The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.

</details>


### [856] [Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24107)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Zhenyu Bi,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI
