Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.

</details>


### [926] [The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24873)
*Jinwei Hu,Youcheng Sun,Yi Dong,Xiaowei Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"单关系攻击(ORA)"——通过定位智能体推理中连接证据与结论的关键"隐含担保(warrant)",用一句有来源支撑的句子对该关系进行干预,即可操纵智能体信念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体的推理依赖证据到结论的隐含推理关系,但这一环节是否可被单句攻击操纵、其脆弱性尚不明确。作者希望验证隐藏的隐含担保是否构成一个可被利用的认知攻击面。

Method: 提出ORA:定位关键隐含担保,并用单句、有来源依据的"限定/修饰"句介入该关系,将智能体从正确答案引向错误信念。在18个模型上覆盖生物医学推理与漏洞检测任务,并设置配对对照实验、迁移实验与防御检验(来源支持检查、身份识别、多智能体辩论)。

Result: best-of-10攻击使初始正确回答被翻转:专有模型平均54.9%,开源模型80.0%;攻击可在无受害者反馈下迁移;对照实验支持"定位目标"与"限定修饰"的作用;成功句子能通过来源支持检查、逃避识别;多智能体辩论在平衡压力测试中反而使团队错误率从50.0%升至59.5%。

Conclusion: 隐含担保是操纵智能体信念的认知攻击面,单句即可显著翻转判断,且现有防御与多智能体协作难以有效抵御。

Abstract: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.

</details>


### [927] [HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24899)
*Soyoung Yoon,Peiran Xu,Han Wang,Ruofan Wu,Xiaodong Yu,Feng Yan,Mohit Bansal,Debiao Li,Seung-Won Hwang,Yuxiong He,Zhewei Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HybridResearcher：通过合成跨源桥接轨迹+SFT/RL，让4B小模型学会结构化与非结构化证据的交叉推理，在HybridDeepResearch上超基线30分并超越397B大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM agent擅长单一同质来源（结构化表或非结构化文本）的证据收集与综合，但真实分析问题常跨异构来源（如内部数据库+网页）。HybridDeepResearch等基准暴露了前沿模型在此边界的短板，但缺乏显式教授跨源推理的方法。

Method: 从已验证的单源任务（text-to-SQL、网页搜索）出发，利用种子自身输出中的桥接实体伪造缺失的另一源，合成跨源桥接轨迹；通过严格构造门控（确认单侧不足以回答）筛选样本以保证真正的跨源依赖；再用该数据集做SFT+强化学习训练4B模型。

Result: 在HybridDeepResearch基准上，较基座Qwen3.5-4B提升30.0点pass@8，超过Qwen3.5-397B-A17B达8.3点；在单源held-out基准BrowseComp与BrowseComp-Plus上也优于基座，未出现灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 复杂的跨源推理能力可直接教给小模型，且不会牺牲单源性能，为异构来源证据融合提供了可复现的数据合成与训练范式。

Abstract: While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [928] [A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24913)
*Kevin Krazius,Tim Schlippe,Paul Libbrecht*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对Zero-Shot、Few-Shot、RAG与PE2式自动提示优化进行受控跨域对比，使用同一LLM和六个基准数据集，发现没有任何提示策略在所有任务上占优，检索样本达300时RAG平均准确率最高（78.33%），提示方法应按任务特性自适应选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示工程研究常使用不同的LLM、数据集或任务设置，导致方法之间与领域之间难以直接比较，缺乏公平的跨域对比证据。

Method: 在统一的LLM下开展受控实验，对比Zero-Shot、Few-Shot、RAG和基于PE2的自动提示优化四种策略，在覆盖算术推理、逻辑推理、常识推理与事实核验的六个基准数据集上评测，并对最优配置做成对统计比较。

Result: 无单一策略在所有领域稳定占优，最优配置间成对统计比较无显著差异；RAG在可检索300个样例时取得最高平均准确率78.33%；Few-Shot在多项结构化推理任务上表现较好；Zero-Shot在自包含输入任务上仍有竞争力；PE2式优化结果稳定但未系统性地更优；增加任务示例数量并不持续提升性能。

Conclusion: 提示技术的效果高度依赖领域与任务，应依据任务特征自适应选择提示策略，而非将其视为普适的优化方案。

Abstract: Prompt engineering has become a central mechanism for guiding the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a wide range of reasoning and language understanding tasks [1], [2]. However, existing studies frequently evaluate prompting techniques using different LLMs, datasets, or task settings, making direct comparisons across methods and domains difficult [3]. Consequently, in this paper we present a controlled cross-domain evaluation of Zero-Shot prompting, Few-Shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automatic prompt optimization based on a PE2-inspired optimization pipeline [4]-[6]. All experiments were conducted with the same LLM and evaluated on six benchmark datasets covering arithmetic reasoning, logical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and factual verification. The results show that no prompting strategy consistently outperforms the others across all domains, and pairwise statistical comparisons of the highest-performing configurations revealed no significant differences. RAG achieves the highest overall average accuracy of 78.33% when 300 examples are available for retrieval, while Few-Shot Prompting achieves comparatively high accuracies across several structured reasoning tasks. Zero-Shot Prompting remains competitive on tasks with self-contained inputs, whereas the PE2-inspired optimization approach produces stable but not systematically superior results compared to the other evaluated prompting techniques. Furthermore, increasing the number of task-specific examples does not consistently improve performance across prompting techniques, indicating strong domain and task dependency. These findings suggest that prompting techniques should be selected adaptively based on task characteristics rather than treated as universally applicable optimization strategies.

</details>


### [929] [Means-Ends Analysis Helps LLMs Plan in Continuous-State Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24928)
*Jiayi Li,Carl Kingsford*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Medaka，一个受Means-Ends Analysis启发的结构化提示框架，用于让LLM在连续状态域中进行规划，并在液体混合测试平台Liquidworld上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM规划研究多聚焦于离散状态域，假设动作可枚举并把规划当作候选动作搜索；但在动作构成连续统、无法枚举的连续状态域中，该假设失效，因此需要新方法以评估和提升LLM的原生连续状态规划能力。

Method: 借鉴Newell与Simon的Means-Ends Analysis（MEA）启发式，设计Medaka结构化提示框架，鼓励递归目标分解、代数推导与逐步状态跟踪；同时构建Liquidworld液体混合测试平台以系统评估连续状态域下的LLM规划。

Result: 在Liquidworld上，Medaka在多个模型家族中均能提升性能，表明经典MEA能够激发对连续状态规划有益的LLM原生推理能力。

Conclusion: 经典手段-目的分析可迁移到LLM提示设计中，有效缓解连续状态域下动作不可枚举的规划难题，为LLM原生连续规划研究提供了方法与基准。

Abstract: LLM planning research has traditionally focused on discrete-state domains, where actions form a finite, enumerable set. Existing LLM planning frameworks largely assume actions are enumerable, modeling planning as a search process over candidate actions. However, in continuous-state domains, where actions form a continuum and cannot be enumerated, this assumption breaks down. We find a remedy in Newell and Simon's Means-Ends Analysis (MEA), a general problem-solving technique rooted in heuristics from human psychology. We develop Medaka, an MEA-inspired structured prompting framework that encourages recursive goal decomposition, algebraic derivation, and per-step state tracking. To evaluate native LLM planning abilities in continuous-state domains, we develop Liquidworld, a systematic testbed on liquid mixing. On Liquidworld, Medaka can improve performance across model families, suggesting that classical means-ends analysis elicits LLM-native reasoning abilities that are helpful for continuous-state planning.

</details>


### [930] [LowNet: Looped Wavelet Neural Networks with 24 Learnable Parameters for Solving Poisson Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24941)
*Yuanhao Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种受小波启发的极简Poisson方程求解器，仅含24个可训练标量，通过循环复用小波块在紧凑性、精度和效率上取得优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法虽确定性强但非数据特定，受CFL稳定性限制需大量迭代；深度学习方法数据驱动且高效，但依赖精确训练数据、计算量大。需兼顾紧凑、精确与高效的求解方案。

Method: 构建仅24个可训练标量的小波启发Poisson求解网络：四个独立5×5卷积核，每核由6个参数表示；采用残差循环结构复用同一小波块而不增加参数。

Result: 在10000张图像上，小波块循环1、2、3次分别达到PSNR 47.27、74.14、100.74 dB，验证循环有效提升精度；得益于小波变换，计算复杂度为线性，速度更快。

Conclusion: 所提循环小波神经网络在紧凑性、精度与效率方面均具优势，可应用于计算流体力学、图像重建、生物医学工程、电磁场仿真等领域。

Abstract: Poisson equations frequently appear in various fields, such as mathematics, physics and informatics. Solving Poisson equation, however, is challenging. Traditional methods are not data-specific, although have high certainty. They require a large number of iterations due to the CFL numerical stability. In contrast, deep learning methods are data-driven and more efficient, but require accurate training data and suffer from heavy computation. To tackle these issues, we propose a wavelet-inspired Poisson solver with 24 trainable scalars. The proposed network has several advantages. First, it is compact. It has four independent $5\times5$ kernels, each represented by six parameters, leading to 24 scalars in total. Such compact format can be deployed on most devices. Second, thanks to the loop design, it achieves higher accuracy than previous methods. A residual loop reuses the wavelet block without increasing its parameters. Numerical experiments confirm that such loop indeed improves the solving accuracy. On 10000 images, one, two, and three loops of the wavelet block lead to PSNRs of $47.27$, $74.14$, and $100.74$ dB, respectively. Third, the proposed method is computationally fast. Thanks to the wavelet transform, the proposed method has linear computation complexity, leading to high computation performance. In short, we propose a novel looped wavelet neural network with compactness, accuracy and efficiency for solving Poisson equations. Our method can be applied in various fields, such as computational fluid dynamics, image reconstruction, biomedical engineering, electromagnetic field simulation.

</details>


### [931] [MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24955)
*Yiming Zong,Shiyuan Piao,Jiashuo Jiang,Fugee Tsung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemPrice 将 LLM 智能体的活跃上下文视为共享资源，用自适应价格机制在记忆条目与表示粒度之间动态分配上下文预算，兼顾硬约束与长期占用控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程 LLM 智能体的交互历史不断增长，面临“保留什么、分配多少上下文、以何种粒度表示”的分配问题；现有记忆机制只关注相关性、检索或压缩，把这一分配权衡隐式化、未显式建模。

Method: 把活跃上下文当作共享资源，将累积的记忆压力转化为对上下文的自适应“价格”，只有当细节的预估保留价值足以抵偿其额外占用时才分配细节；该压力跨记忆刷新持续存在，使记忆内容可变而长期上下文占用受控。理论上构造了“同状态基准”（same-state benchmark）以在其真实记忆状态上评估分配，并证明不可逆压缩会导致相对事后最优的线性最坏情形遗憾；在价格前沿正则性下给出平均分配遗憾界。

Result: 证明了不可逆压缩会产生线性最坏情形遗憾；在价格前沿正则性条件下，当累积估计误差为次线性时，相对同状态基准的平均分配遗憾趋于零；并在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、AppWorld、WebShop 四个基准、三种基础模型、匹配记忆预算的设置下完成评测，覆盖查询无关的记忆构建与目标导向的智能体上下文管理。

Conclusion: MemPrice 在每轮强制满足硬上下文预算，并通过自适应定价调节长期占用，且无需预先知道交互时长；为长时程智能体的上下文分配提供了显式建模、可证明遗憾保证与实证验证的框架。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents face a fundamental allocation problem as interaction histories grow: which information to retain, how much context to devote to it, and at what granularity. Existing memory mechanisms largely focus on relevance, retrieval, or compression, leaving this allocation trade-off implicit. We introduce MemPrice, which treats active context as a shared resource and dynamically allocates it across memories and representation levels. MemPrice turns accumulated memory pressure into an adaptive price on context, encouraging detail only when its estimated retention value justifies the additional footprint. This pressure persists across memory refreshes, allowing the contents of memory to evolve while preserving long-run control over context usage. We show that irreversible compression can force linear worst-case regret against hindsight following its own memory trajectory, and introduce a same-state benchmark to evaluate allocation on MemPrice's realized memory states. MemPrice enforces the hard context budget at every round and regulates long-run occupancy through adaptive pricing, without prior knowledge of the interaction horizon. Under priced-frontier regularity, its average allocation-regret bound against this benchmark vanishes when accumulated estimation error is sublinear. We evaluate the framework under matched memory budgets on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, AppWorld, and WebShop across three foundation models, spanning both query-blind memory construction and goal-directed agent context management.

</details>


### [932] [Revealing what benchmark scores hide: Jointly measuring the breadth and reliability of LLM capabilities using accessibility profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24957)
*Kazem Faghih,Yize Cheng,Shoumik Saha,Mobina Pournemat,Armin Gerami,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"可访问性"(accessibility)指标——模型在语义等价重述下成功的概率,揭示准确率与现有提示鲁棒性指标所掩盖的能力"广度"与"可靠性"的权衡,并提出 Access@5 与 Reliable@5 两个度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型基准对每个问题只用一个固定措辞给出单一正确与否的结果,但同一请求有多种等价表达方式;因此真正关心的量不应是单一措辞上的正确性,而是模型在保持语义的多种表述下成功的概率。准确率以及现有的最好/最差/平均提示得分无法区分能力覆盖广但不稳定、与覆盖窄但稳定这两类模型。

Method: 定义可访问性为模型在保持语义的多种表述下成功的概率,刻画其在各问题上的分布,区分"能力广度"(能成功的不同查询数量)与"可靠性"(在同一查询上重复成功的稳定性)。基于此提出 Access@5(五次表述中至少一次成功)与 Reliable@5(五次全部成功)两个度量,并在六个基准、二十多个模型上进行实证分析,考察规模扩展、推理与提示优化对能力分布的影响。

Result: 在约一半平均可访问性接近的模型对中,谁更优取决于采用 Access@5 还是 Reliable@5;部分模型对两者差距显著,可达十个百分点的相反方向。结果还显示规模扩展、推理与提示优化会以聚合准确率无法呈现的方式在问题间重新分配能力,有时扩大了可成功的查询集合却降低了其可重复性。

Conclusion: 可访问性将"措辞敏感性"从干扰因素转变为可度量的能力属性,区分模型"偶尔能成功"与"用户可真正依赖"的部分;评估应关注语义等价表述下的成功分布,而非单一措辞的准确率。

Abstract: Language model benchmarks assign each question a single outcome from one fixed wording, even though the same underlying request can be expressed in many equivalent ways. We argue that the quantity of interest should therefore not be correctness on one wording, but the accessibility of an inquiry, which we define as the probability that a model succeeds across meaning-preserving formulations. The distribution of accessibility across inquiries reveals a structure that accuracy and existing best-, worst-, or average-case prompt scores collapse: how broadly a model's capabilities extend across inquiries and how dependably those capabilities can be elicited. Two models can have the same average performance while one succeeds across more inquiries unreliably and the other succeeds across fewer inquiries but more consistently, leading to opposite preferences depending on whether the task allows multiple retries until one success or when repeated consistent success is required. Across six benchmarks and more than twenty models, this tradeoff is common: for about half of the model pairs with nearly equal mean accessibility, which model looks better depends on whether one success across five formulations is enough or all five must succeed, quantities we call Access@5 and Reliable@5, respectively. For some pairs the two measures diverge significantly, by up to 10 points in opposite directions. Accessibility also reveals that scaling, reasoning, and prompt optimization can redistribute capability across inquiries in ways aggregate accuracy obscures, sometimes broadening the set of inquiries a model can succeed on while making success on them less repeatable. Accessibility turns formulation sensitivity from a nuisance into a measurable property of capability, distinguishing what a model can sometimes succeed on from what users can actually depend on.

</details>


### [933] [CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24960)
*Zhongwei Xie,Yiming Du,Jiaxin Bai,Baixuan Xu,Chunyang Li,Xiyu Ren,Wei Fan,Tianshi Zheng,Weizhi Du,Jingqiao Yu,Xingsu Li,Zhaowei Wang,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CoworkEnv 框架，从工作流需求出发自动合成可执行的 AI 同事训练环境，并结合 SFT 与 RL 训练紧凑型 PocketWorker 模型，在 Claw-Eval 等基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 同事需协调工具、跨轮沟通并应对变化的 workspace 状态，同时遵守工作流约束；而构建此类训练经验需要一致的请求、服务记录、工具接口与评分检查，数据集构造成本高。

Method: 能力导向的环境合成：以工作流需求引导任务构建，用程序化验证加反馈修复机制生成规格与评分逻辑；教师模型执行产生 SFT 演示，学生交互产生 rollout 与奖励用于 RL；并比较不同奖励处理与信用分配配置下的 RL 训练动态。

Result: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 Claw-Eval 上经 SFT 平均分由 46.6 升至 64.1，Multi-turn 任务提升 31.9 分；SFT-only 扩展至 ClawMark 表明跨基准适用；RL 中训练奖励提升提供环境支持策略优化的初步证据。

Conclusion: 能力引导的可执行环境合成是训练 AI 同事的有效路径，合成环境可同时支撑 SFT 与 RL；但 RL 部分仅为初步证据，跨基准泛化有待进一步验证。

Abstract: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

</details>


### [934] [Towards Human-AI Complementarity for AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24969)
*Sander Lanbo Shi,Miranda Anna Christ,Eric Modesitt,Andrew Louis,Konrad Cheng,Brandon Thai Tran,Sewoong Lee,Ratnakar Pawar,Gaia Molinaro,Juliana Bain,Nandika Donthi,Maja Pavlovic,Annya Dahmani,Francesca Bianco,Abhishek Shah,Tyler Crosse,Arth Singh,Karissa Huang,Sukanya Krishna,Konstantinos Voudouris,David Demitri Africa,Joshua Jacob,Rishub Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文构建了已知最大的真实安全相关人-AI协作监督任务套件（8个数据集、6个领域、3957个实例），并搭建平台测量人类、AI及人机混合的判断表现，发现互补性潜力虽大但现有方法难以实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着模型能力提升，AI输出越来越长越复杂，人类监督者的审查难度不断增加；若人类与模型在不同地方犯错，则结合二者判断可能产生比任一方单独更强的监督信号，作者希望在实际安全场景中检验这一"互补性"机会。

Method: 构建了覆盖8个数据集、6个领域、3957个实例的任务套件，以及配套平台和数据流程，用于在匹配条目上测量人类、AI和人机混合的表现；共收集416名人类评分者的35,613条判断，并测试了多种辅助与混合方法。

Result: 发现存在相当大的互补性空间；但在所测试的辅助方法下，即便人类整体准确率上升，人类纠正AI错误的频率反而降低；所测试的混合方法平均来看相对更优的单一来源提升有限。

Conclusion: 互补性是安全监督中一个重要且可行的工程目标，但真正实现它仍是未来工作的开放挑战。

Abstract: Safely overseeing AI is increasingly challenging for the humans doing it, as they must evaluate longer and more complex outputs with every new model generation. To mitigate this challenge, we could leverage complementarity: where humans and models make different mistakes, combining their judgements could yield an oversight signal stronger than either produces alone. We study this opportunity in realistic, safety-relevant settings, contributing the largest known suite of such tasks (3,957 instances across 8 datasets and 6 domains) as well as a platform and data pipeline for measuring human, AI, and human-AI performance on matched items. We collected 35,613 judgements from 416 human raters, finding a considerable opportunity for a complementarity effect. We also found that with the assistance methods we tested, human raters corrected the AI's errors less often, even when overall human accuracy rose, and the hybridisation methods we tested added little over the better single source on average. While complementarity is an important and feasible engineering target for safe oversight, achieving it remains an open challenge for future work.

</details>


### [935] [CorrectRTL: Boost RTL Generation Quality Through Automated Self-Correction with Instruction Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24977)
*Jing Wang,Shang Liu,Hangan Zhou,Wenji Fang,Yuchao Wu,Yugao Zhu,Zhiyao Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ScaleBench基准与CorrectRTL智能体框架，用"先分解后纠错"范式提升LLM从规范到RTL的生成质量，Pass@1从20.5%升至49.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自纠正范式在规格到RTL生成中受两方面限制：基准测试被先进LLM饱和，难以评估智能体自纠正框架；单体式自纠正一次性重写整个设计，易导致错误混淆并破坏原本正确的代码。

Method: 提出ScaleBench（200个复杂RTL设计的高难度基准）与CorrectRTL智能体框架。CorrectRTL实现"先分解后纠错"范式，将骨架构建与细节实现显式解耦，含三项核心技术：面向结构的分解、基于片段的RAG、基于SVA的自纠正。

Result: 在ScaleBench上Pass@1由20.5%提升至49.0%（+28.5%）；在VerilogEval上Pass@1最高达96.1%，在简单与复杂设计上均有一致提升。

Conclusion: 通过更难的基准与分解式智能体框架，CorrectRTL有效缓解错误混淆与正确代码破坏问题，验证了分解-纠错范式在RTL生成中的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong promise in specification-to-RTL generation. Among the explorations, the self-correction paradigm has significantly advanced LLM-based RTL generation. However, two challenges limit further progress. Existing benchmarks are saturated by advanced LLMs, leaving little room to evaluate the agentic self-correction framework. The monolithic self-correction paradigm rewrites the entire design at once, where LLMs are susceptible to error confusion and corruption of originally correct code. To address the benchmark challenge, we contribute ScaleBench, a more challenging benchmark of 200 complex RTL designs. To address the challenge in methodology, we propose CorrectRTL, an agentic framework that realizes a new decompose-then-correct paradigm, in which the LLM agent explicitly decouples scaffold construction from detailed implementation. CorrectRTL contributes three core techniques: (1)~\emph{Structure-oriented decomposition}, (2)~\emph{Snippet-based RAG}, and (3)~\emph{SVA-based self-correction}. On ScaleBench, CorrectRTL improves Pass@1 from 20.5% to 49.0% (+28.5%). On VerilogEval, CorrectRTL achieves up to 96.1% Pass@1, demonstrating consistent improvements across both simple and complex designs.

</details>


### [936] [VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25043)
*Sicheng He,Yi Pan,Qiuting Yu,Jiaming Huang,Qi Lu,Shuyan Wu,Hongyan Feng,Xuanyu Liu,Jun Zhang,Jie Zhang,Wenqi Zhang,Xuhong Zhang,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VLA-Rolling 提出将 flow-matching VLA 重规划时被丢弃的 action tail 作为可复用的去噪中间状态，通过"尾部继承—逐动作置信度估计—置信度引导的重加噪与去噪预算分配"三阶段实现冻结 VLA 的高效推理，在 16 组模型-基准对上全部降低推理成本（最高 1.48×加速），14 组成功率提升（最高 15.08 个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 采用 receding-horizon 执行：每个 action chunk 只执行短前缀就重新规划，剩余 action tail 被丢弃，下一 chunk 又从高斯噪声重新去噪。作者发现被丢弃的尾部仍保留了可迁移的去噪进度，用更少步数即可匹配甚至超过原生 10 步高斯初始化；但最优去噪预算随样本差异很大，因此尾部复用必须根据更新后的观测自适应。

Method: VLA-Rolling 是轻量推理框架，底层 VLA 完全冻结，包含三阶段：(1) action-tail inheritance，继承上次未执行的尾部作为初始化；(2) per-action confidence estimation，逐动作估计置信度；(3) confidence-guided refinement，通过 renoising 和去噪预算分配进行自适应精化。

Result: 在 π0.5、SmolVLA、X-VLA、MolmoAct2 四个模型与 LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 四个基准的组合共 16 对中，action-chunk 推理成本全部下降，最高 1.48× 加速；其中 14 对成功率提升，最高 +15.08 个百分点。

Conclusion: action tail 并非无用预测，而是可复用的中间状态，能在更少去噪步数下生成更好的动作，实现更高效、更准确的 VLA 推理。该方法为无需训练/微调的 VLA 推理加速与性能提升提供了新视角。项目见 https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/。

Abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

</details>


### [937] [SteadyThought: Mitigating LLM Under-Thinking via Thought-Level Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25045)
*Zhenyue Peng,Lin Yang,Jie Wang,Xiaoqi Ni,Hanzhu Chen,Xize Liang,Yanjun Wu,Rujing Wang,Kaiwen Zhou,Jianye Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Steady Thought（ST）思维级偏好优化框架，将 LRM 的 "under-thinking"（过度切换且无法维持有效思路）形式化为切换点的偏好问题，减少冗余切换同时保持推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型推理模型（LRM）虽能灵活切换推理轨迹，但常过度切换且无法坚持有前景的思路，即 "under-thinking"。近期抑制切换的做法属于过度纠正，会丢弃有价值轨迹。

Method: ST 将 under-thinking 建模为切换点的偏好问题：强制从识别出的切换点进行单路径续写以产出高质量推理；随后进行思维级偏好优化，将新生成的响应作为 preferred、原始响应作为 dis-preferred。

Result: 在多个模型和数据集上，ST 将 token 消耗最高降低 63.8%，同时保持较强推理准确率；分析表明模型获得了跨领域、跨语言减少冗余切换的泛化能力。

Conclusion: ST 提供了一种优于简单抑制切换的方案，在压缩冗余推理开销与维持准确率之间取得平衡，并具备跨域跨语言泛化性。

Abstract: Flexible switching between reasoning trajectories (i.e., thought switching) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, existing models often switch excessively yet fail to sustain promising reasoning thoughts, a phenomenon termed "under-thinking". While recent efforts suppress switching to mitigate this, such over-correction may discard valuable trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Steady Thought (ST), a novel thought-level preference optimization framework. ST formalizes under-thinking as a preference issue at switching points, forcing single-path continuations from identified points to yield high-quality reasoning. Then, ST performs thought-level preference optimization by treating the newly generated response as preferred and the original one as dis-preferred. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that ST effectively reduces token consumption, achieving reductions of up to 63.8%, while maintaining strong reasoning accuracy. Further analysis suggests that ST helps models acquire a generalizable ability to reduce redundant switching across domains and languages. Code is available at https://github.com/MIRALab-USTC/SteadyThought.

</details>


### [938] [One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25064)
*Parsa Razmara,Seyedarmin Azizi,Ardalan Aryashad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 SkillClash 基准，研究同一任务的多个 skill 文件同时进入上下文时模型的行为。发现模型普遍出现"接管"现象：只遵循一个 skill 的规则而丢弃另一个，且主要由 skill 内的工作示例驱动；在 skill 末尾加入一个同时遵循两个 skill 的示例可将接管率降至 1–15%，而由强模型合并成单一 skill 文件可使规则遵循率达到 96–99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户从不同作者处安装 agent skills，同一任务可能存在多个同时激活的 skill 文件。论文关注：当两个同任务 skill 文件都在上下文时，模型是整合兼容规则，还是只遵循其中一个而忽略另一个。此前缺乏对该冲突场景的系统量化。

Method: 构建 SkillClash：16 对"同任务"skill，每对通过代码逐条检查规则，并提供参考输出作为可达最优结果。在 5 个家族共 7 个模型（4B 开源模型到 Qwen3-235B、GPT-4.1）上测试单 skill 加载与双 skill 同时加载的规则遵循率。随后做干预实验：在每个 skill 文件末尾加入同时符合两个 skill 的示例、显式告知优先级、显式要求同时应用两个 skill，以及由 Claude Opus 5.5 撰写的单一合并 skill 文件（并消融其中的示例）。

Result: 单 skill 加载时规则遵循率 93–99%，同时加载同任务 skill 时降至 61–62%，多数输出呈"接管"：一方独有规则全遵循，另一方独有规则全丢弃。skill 内的工作示例是主因。结尾加入同时符合两者的唯一示例后，6 个受测模型接管率降至 1–15%。告知优先级无效；要求同时应用两 skill 仅两个强模型能恢复被丢弃 skill，且相互作用的规则仍被破坏。Opus 5.5 合并的单一 skill 文件使 7 个模型规则遵循率达 96–99%，其增益主要来自那一个工作示例，且示例正确时才有效。

Conclusion: 同一任务的多个 skill 共存会导致模型"接管"式遵循，这是由 skill 中的示例驱动的失败模式，简单的优先级提示无法修复。有效的缓解方式是在 skill 结尾提供一个同时满足所有 skill 的正确示例，或将多个 skill 合并为单一 skill 文件。合并 skill 的收益依赖于示例质量，错误示例反而有害。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Agent Skills are instruction files that tell a coding agent how to do one job. Users install skills from many authors, so two skills for the same job can be active at the same time. We ask what a model does when both skill files are in its context: does it combine their compatible rules, or follow one skill and drop the other? We build SkillClash, 16 pairs of same-job skills in which code checks every rule and a reference output shows the best result that can be reached. On seven models from five families, from 4B open models to Qwen3-235B and GPT-4.1, a skill's rules are followed 93 to 99% of the time when it is loaded alone and 61 to 62% when a same-job skill is loaded next to it. Most outputs show takeover: every rule that only one skill asks for is followed, and every rule that only the other skill asks for is dropped. The worked examples inside the skills drive this. When each skill file instead ends with one example that follows both skills, takeover falls to 1 to 15% on the six models we tested. Telling the model which skill has priority does not bring the dropped skill back, and telling it to apply both skills brings the dropped skill back only on the two strong models and leaves the interacting rules broken. One merged skill file written by the strongest model we used, Claude Opus 5.5, lets all seven models follow 96 to 99% of the achievable rules. Most of its gain over a plain list of both skills' rules comes from its one worked example, and such an example helps only when it is correct. Code and data: https://github.com/prazmara/skillclash

</details>


### [939] [DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25089)
*Dengyuxing Wang,Yonggang Zhang,Qianshu Cai,Huajiang Zheng,Jun Song,Yangqiu Song,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DAGLoop，用消融实验思想逐项检验AI研究代理方法候选的多重设计决策，将决策-实验映射为DAG规划消融，并构建结构化研究记忆引导后续修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI研究代理仅依赖候选方法的整体评估结果决定下一步修改，但候选往往包含多个设计决策，整体表现无法揭示各决策是否产生预期效果、条件是否满足、应保留还是修改哪些决策。

Method: 借鉴机器学习消融研究，针对每个设计决策，在保留其依赖的其他决策的前提下，对比"有/无该决策"的实现来检验其预期效果。将每个决策的理由转译为可检验的预期，并配以针对性实验，形成实验规范；把消融规划建模为从候选设计构建DAG：节点关联决策与测试，边编码依赖关系，支持多决策联合测试；结果连同决策、预期与条件记录为结构化研究记忆。

Result: 在数十个研究任务上的实验表明，DAGLoop在多样化的可执行研究场景中取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 基于决策级消融与结构化研究记忆的代理能更可靠地判断各设计决策的贡献，保留有实验支持的决策、修正无支持的决策，并在证据不足时规划进一步实验，从而显著提升自动化AI研究效果。

Abstract: Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

</details>


### [940] [Explore or Confirm? LLM Agents Misallocate Measurements Under Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25111)
*Abdul Karim,Matt Keon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Wellocate基准环境，测量LLM智能体在噪声实验中发现候选时如何在"探索新候选"与"重测确认"间分配预算，发现模型双向误配，并验证简单干预（未试候选清单）可改善部分行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随模型推理变便宜，物理实验成为发现流程中的慢且贵环节；每次实验只返回带噪声的读数，高值可能是好候选也可能只是运气。固定预算下智能体必须权衡探索新候选与重测确认，此权衡此前缺乏可量化的测量手段。

Method: 构建Wellocate：带已知真值的模拟assay流程，基于生成景观及GB1、PhoQ两个真实蛋白数据集（打乱以防记忆）。以五个语言模型作为无工具、无长期记忆（仅依赖prompt内历史）的最小智能体进行测试，并与脚本化基线对比；再施加多种干预（未试候选清单、读数摘要、景观描述、末轮重测）分析失败原因。

Result: 模型双向误配：三个模型过度确认，将大部分预算用于重测；生成景观上一个模型确认不足、轻信单次读数，且所有模型最终选择都劣于简单脚本策略。过度确认者可因"未试候选清单"减少重测，在真实蛋白数据上两个模型选择显著改善；而读数摘要或景观描述影响不超过5个百分点。对确认不足者，末轮重测仅能挽回约四分之一损失。

Conclusion: 确认行为需贯穿整个campaign而非末尾补救；不同失败各有成因，需针对性干预。Wellocate作为带冻结划分与脚本基线的基准及强化学习环境开源，可用于在真实实验前测量并训练智能体的预算分配能力。

Abstract: As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate.

</details>


### [941] [Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25140)
*Amirhossein Ghaffari,Susanna Pirttikangas,Ekaterina Gilman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出谱自适应图Transformer（SAGT）：空间算子可学习、有向、随交通状态条件化且复杂度对传感器数线性；辅以稀疏路网扩散分支与零初始化门控，以及单位增益频带注意力重加权短时周期性。六个基准（170–1843传感器，3随机种子）上误差最低或与最强注意力模型相当，显存约为其1/4，训练约快2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱图卷积交通预测依赖拉普拉斯特征分解：立方复杂度、由路网固定、对称算子无法刻画拥堵的有向传播；注意力Transformer虽无这些限制，但每层每步产生稠密传感器间注意力图，内存成为大规模路网的瓶颈。

Method: 空间算子由数据学习而非拉普拉斯导出，具有向性，并以当前交通状态为条件，代价随传感器数线性增长；加入稀疏路网图扩散分支以表达低秩算子无法表示的严格局部传播，用零初始化门控学习二者权重；空间混合前设单位平均增益的频带注意力模块，按传感器身份与当前上下文重加权其短时周期性。

Result: 在六个公开基准（170–1843个传感器）、三个随机种子下评估：在一个基准上取得所有单端到端模型中的最低误差，其余基准上与最强注意力模型相当；显存约为最强注意力模型的四分之一，训练速度约快两倍。

Conclusion: 以可学习、有向、状态条件化的线性复杂度空间算子替代特征分解与稠密注意力，配合局部扩散分支与频带注意力，可在保持精度的同时显著降低内存与训练成本，适合大规模路网。

Abstract: Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

</details>


### [942] [Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25179)
*Chen-Fang Hu,Hong-Han Shuai,Woan-Shiuan Chien*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PLACE：为持久记忆增加"写侧状态认证+读侧授权"的双重治理层，因子实验表明写侧治理提升生命周期状态正确性，读侧治理消除不合规记忆的因果泄漏，二者结合效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持久记忆系统把历史交互变为可持久agent状态，但缺乏控制：(1)该状态是否仍然有效；(2)它是否应影响后续查询。作者认为可靠记忆必须同时治理"状态如何形成"和"查询时是否施加影响"。

Method: 提出PLACE——可分解（factorized）的治理层，附加在记忆后端之上：写侧引入状态认证（state certification），读侧引入查询时授权（authorization）。在Mem0后端上，用Qwen2.5-3B与Qwen2.5-7B做因子式（factorial）评估，隔离各机制的独立贡献。

Result: 写侧治理显著提升生命周期状态正确性；在状态正确的设定下，读侧治理消除了测得的不合规记忆因果泄漏；两者组合取得最强联合表现，同时保留与查询相关的有效支撑信息。

Conclusion: 可靠持久记忆需要对"所维护状态"与"查询时信息影响"都进行显式控制，二者缺一不可。

Abstract: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.

</details>


### [943] [Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25182)
*Minsung Hwang,Donggyu Yoon,Gowoon Hwang,Kwanghee Jang,Joyce Jiyoung Whang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SearCl，利用用户搜索与点击行为自动生成对话式推荐对话，无需人工构建或标注，并通过 LLM-as-a-judge 验证质量优于现有基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模对话式推荐数据集通常依赖人工构建对话或人工标注，成本高、难以扩展。作者希望利用已有的真实用户搜索与点击行为，低成本自动生成可控、有知识依据的对话式推荐数据。

Method: SearCl 将用户交互切分为查询会话，每个推荐目标来源于搜索后用户所选内容；使用可配置的概率状态机控制对话流程；两个 LLM 智能体分别扮演 seeker 与 recommender，按轮级约束生成话语；并利用对话中内容条目的元数据构建知识图谱提供给推荐方，实现知识支撑的推荐。

Result: 基于内容搜索与点击交互数据生成 3,538 条对话，覆盖 1,731 个唯一目标物品；在 LLM-as-a-judge 评测下，生成对话的质量得分高于现有基准对话。

Conclusion: SearCl 证明了无需人工标注即可构建可控、知识支撑的对话式推荐数据集，为规模化数据构造提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

</details>


### [944] [BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25208)
*Haotian Gan,Weidong Tang,Hanbin Sun,Yi Luo,Xintian Li,Jiayong Wang,WanYue Li,Yudong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BrandEval双轨基准（静态BrandEval-Static与多智能体动态沙盒BrandPolis），并构建中文危机应对数据集BrandSRD，用Strategic Rationale实例化参考策略智能体，评估LLM在品牌产品危机沟通中的长程风险敏感能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM危机沟通评测基准多为静态、单轮，仅判断孤立回复，无法反映公众反馈与竞争对手行动对信任的长期重塑，缺少长程、风险敏感的沟通能力证据。

Method: BrandEval-Static评估面向利益相关者的策略分析；BrandEval-Dynamic在受控多智能体沙盒BrandPolis中压力测试应对策略，含消费者反馈、竞争者响应与信任风险轨迹；构建中文数据集BrandSRD，并以Strategic Rationale（SR）实例化参考策略智能体，在闭源与开源模型上评测。

Result: 静态策略质量具信息量但不完整：与部分终态结果对齐，却无法可靠预测波动性与延迟恢复；动态压力测试进一步暴露在操纵性或不扎实依据策略下的尾部风险失败。

Conclusion: 单一静态评测不足以刻画危机沟通的长程风险；需结合多智能体动态压力测试才能揭示尾部风险与恢复能力差距，代码与数据集将公开。

Abstract: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

</details>


### [945] [Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25298)
*Silvia Fernández-Sabido,Jorge Reyes-Magaña,Jesús Adrián Chay Tun,Jean Carlos Buenfil,Victor González Nahuat,Francisco Morales*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将语言模型与拉丁美洲原住民社群伦理原则对齐的系统：基于五位原住民领袖访谈构建含12条原则的"文化宪法"，用SFT+DPO两阶段Constitutional AI流程微调Qwen2.5-7B/1.5B，并部署带RAG的对话界面使社群可参与知识库构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM主要基于反映西方、英语世界观的语料训练，在领土、社群权威、人与自然关系等问题上隐含与使用社群相异的预设，构成认识论不公；作者希望为全球南方的价值对齐提供一个"认识论正义机制"的首次尝试。

Method: 通过访谈5位原住民领袖与维权者，提炼基于原住民宇宙观的12条原则形成可操作的"文化宪法"；据此实施两阶段Constitutional AI流程——监督微调(SFT)与直接偏好优化(DPO)，基座模型为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct；并部署带RAG的对话界面供社群反哺知识库。

Result: 仅用24对偏好数据，改进幅度有限但可检测，主要体现在代际传承、语言谨慎性、协商与同意三方面；定性分析显示SFT阶段贡献了主要的对齐转变，DPO则细化特定类别。

Conclusion: 该架构在功能上可行，待语料扩充与算力限制解决后可定性扩展；作为全球南方价值对齐的首次迭代，具有一定示范意义，但数据规模小、效果有限，需进一步验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosmovision, with 12 principles. On this basis, we implemented a Constitutional AI (CAI) pipeline in two phases: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO). The base models were Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. With only 24 preference pairs, improvements were modest but detectable in intergenerational transmission, linguistic caution, and consultation and consent. Qualitative analysis reveals that the SFT phase was responsible for the primary shift in alignment, while DPO refined specific categories. The system was deployed in a conversational interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that allows communities to feed the knowledge base, turning alignment into a participatory cycle. We argue the architecture is functional and will scale qualitatively once the corpus is expanded and computing constraints are resolved. The work constitutes a first iteration of an epistemic justice mechanism for value alignment in the Global South.

</details>


### [946] [Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25384)
*Mingyuan Li,Yucheng Li,Xiaxia Wang,Gong Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OACR 用仅训练时可用的 KG 状态结果模型估计相邻搜索状态间的结果奖励变化，将其转化为操作信用并导出 token 级权重，在不改变结果优势符号的前提下重新分配 token 更新幅度，从而缓解轨迹级优势与操作效果不匹配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic KGQA 中，结果监督强化学习只依据最终答案给出可验证奖励，却把整条 rollout 的结果级优势统一分配给所有策略生成的 token。但同一条轨迹内不同 KG 操作对搜索过程和最终答案的影响差异很大，导致"轨迹到操作"的信用错配。

Method: 提出 Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation（OACR）：引入仅在训练阶段使用的 KG 状态结果模型，估计相邻 KG 搜索状态之间的结果奖励变化，并转换为操作级信用，再由其推导 token 级权重；这些乘性权重用于调节 token 更新的幅度，同时保持每个 token 上结果级优势的符号不变，即只重新分配更新强度而不改变优化方向。

Result: 在三个基准上，OACR 的整体性能优于现有 KGQA 方法，同时推理阶段的 LLM 调用次数与 token 消耗更少。

Conclusion: 细粒度的操作级信用分配可有效改进 agentic KGQA 的结果监督强化学习，兼顾性能提升与推理效率，且训练用的结果模型不增加推理开销。

Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

</details>


### [947] [When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25402)
*Xuyuan Liu,Xinshuai Dong,Elynn Chen,Yujun Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文检验LLM是否具备逻辑等价不变性，发现强模型仍不满足，并提出LoGIST框架用决策图结构引导推理以提升一致性与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在推理任务上表现强，但不清楚其是否真正理解底层逻辑结构，还是依赖浅层语义线索。逻辑等价输入下预测一致性是衡量这种理解的关键指标。

Method: 通过精心构建数据的系统评估，测试LLM在逻辑等价输入上的预测一致性及对未见逻辑形式的泛化；提出LoGIST，将每个输入映射为捕获逻辑结构的决策图（DAG），编码为逻辑嵌入来条件化LLM的推理过程。

Result: 即使强LLM也常无法在逻辑等价输入间保持一致预测，对未见逻辑形式泛化差；LoGIST在多种训练设置下降低逻辑等价下的不一致性，并提升对未见逻辑形式的泛化。

Conclusion: 逻辑不变性可作为构建更鲁棒、更可泛化的LLM逻辑推理的有用目标。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

</details>


### [948] [Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25441)
*Yifei Shi,Michalis Korakakis,Rami Aly,Eric Chamoun,Lukasz Szpruch,Andreas Vlachos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文把逐步推理验证重构为自然语言推理（NLI）任务，问题与部分解答前缀作为前提、下一步推理作为假设，判断其是否被蕴含。发现 0.15B 编码器分类器优于多数最多 4B 参数的生成式验证器，同骨干下分类优于生成，表明强验证不需大生成解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有验证工作集中于大规模解码器模型，生成式与判别式验证器结果混杂，尚不清楚哪种范式更有效、大模型是否必需。

Method: 将逐步验证建模为 NLI：问题+部分解前缀为前提，下一推理步为假设，分类为蕴含/非蕴含；实现单步错误定位，并在不同模型规模与标注预算下比较编码器分类、解码器分类、解码器判词生成三种方案。在五个推理数据集上实验。

Result: 0.15B 编码器分类器优于多数 4B 以内生成式验证器；相同解码器骨干下，0.5B–4B 分类优于生成，7B 最强骨干上持平，且只需约十分之一的标注问题量。

Conclusion: 分类是参数与数据高效的逐步验证方法，强验证能力不依赖大型生成解码器。

Abstract: Verifying the reasoning of large language models is increasingly important as they are applied to complex mathematical and scientific problems. Existing work focuses on large decoder models and reports mixed results for generative and discriminative verifiers, leaving unclear which paradigm is more effective and whether large models are necessary. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters. On identical decoder backbones, classification outperforms generation from 0.5B to 4B parameters and matches it on the strongest 7B backbone---reaching comparable performance with roughly one tenth as many annotated problems. Our findings establish classification as a parameter- and data-efficient approach to stepwise verification and show that strong verification does not require large generative decoders.

</details>


### [949] [System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25456)
*Syed Usama Khalid Bukhari,Syed Safwan Khalid,Muhammad Aamir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: System X 在 LLM-as-Jev 决策读出中增加"文字回复"选项，低置信度时复用 KV cache 续写，兼顾校准与延迟，v4 版本在 JevBench 上从 55.0% 提升到 61.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型只输出候选选项的概率，但实际部署的智能体往往需要用自然语言回复。作者希望在保留概率式决策读出的同时，为模型增加文本回复出口，并避免为此付出重复 prefill 的延迟代价。

Method: 基于 Qwen3-0.6B，用 LoRA 在 Reason-9k 与 Bitext 回复数据上微调，在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中加入 text-reply 选项；当该选项胜出或置信度低时，从决策的 KV cache 继续生成。后续 System X+ 加入对话、行业与投诉数据；v4 改用 Qwen3-1.7B、重平衡数据和教师改写回复目标。

Result: 0.6B：JevBench 准确率 55.4%→54.5%（p=0.87，无显著变化），ECE 0.292→0.169，Bitext 路由准确率 98.3%，M4 Pro 上延迟降低 15–37%；缓存拷贝打分与全序列打分误差在 1.4e-6 内。System X+ 提升支持任务但 IFEval 从 55.5% 降至 45.0%。v4（1.7B）：JevBench 55.0%→61.0%（p=0.04），IFEval 无显著变化（p=0.71），延迟降低 17–39%；一名 LLM 评审偏好 v4 回复（31:11，p=0.003），另一名不显著。

Conclusion: 在单一读出框架内融合概率决策与文本回复是可行且能保持校准、降低延迟的方案，但状态冲突与无依据的回复细节仍是失败模式；作者建议用多种子、人类评审和真实客服数据做进一步验证。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

</details>


### [950] [On Reasoning Correctness Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25464)
*Munachiso Samuel Nwadike,Zayd M. K. Zuhri,Rifo Genadi,Abzal Nurgazy,Ali Mekky,Alham Fikri Aji,Zangir Iklassov,Kentaro Inui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ChainSearch任务与小型模型，检验推理正确性信息是否可线性解码及能否找到因果有效的方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究模型内部是否存在可用于因果干预（steering）的推理正确性方向，检验线性表征假设在推理情境下是否充分。

Method: 构建ChainSearch受控算术推理任务（在Countdown基础上加入显式搜索与回溯），训练3百万参数的小模型；用线性探针、均值激活差和直接优化三种方法搜索内部推理正确性方向，并进行因果干预实验。

Result: 模型中存在统计显著的推理正确性内部方向，但所得方向在因果干预下均无法一致地提升推理表现。

Conclusion: 推理正确性信息可线性解码，但并不保证存在因果有效的方向；线性表征假设在识别推理相关的因果有效方向方面可能并不充分。代码已公开。

Abstract: We present experimental evidence suggesting that information about whether a model's reasoning is on the right track can be linearly decodable without defining a causally useful direction for steering. To study this, we introduce ChainSearch, a controlled arithmetic reasoning task that extends Countdown with explicit search and backtracking. We train a 3-million-parameter model to solve this task. Its compact size allows us to study internal model correctness directions in detail using linear probes, mean activation differences, and direct optimisation, as part of a rigorous search for internal reasoning-correctness directions. We find that while the model contains statistically significant internal directions of reasoning correctness, none of the resulting directions consistently improves reasoning under causal intervention. This calls into question whether the linear representation hypothesis is sufficient for identifying causally useful directions in the context of reasoning. Our code is made available together with this work.

</details>


### [951] [A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25470)
*Shashwat Singh,He He,Tal Linzen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"强多模态"概念，检验VQA式对齐是否让语言模型的文本表示本身具备视觉结构，发现现有VL模型并未实现这种跨模态迁移，并提出蒸馏目标加以改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型通过VQA目标微调实现"弱多模态"（能回答图像问题），但作者关心这种对齐是否改变了语言模型对文本的表示，尤其是在几何等需要"可视化"的纯文本任务上，即是否具备"强多模态"。

Method: 构造形状计数任务：文本版用线段坐标描述图形、图像版给出等价图形，二者等价但对文本版需隐式可视化。对比Qwen-2.5和Mistral的指令微调版与其视觉对齐版在文本版上的表现；用探针实验检验视觉对齐解码器嵌入是否携带更多视觉结构；并提出将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏到文本嵌入的优化目标。

Result: 多模态模型在文本版任务上并不比纯文本模型更好，尽管在图像版上表现很强；探针显示视觉对齐嵌入并未携带更多视觉结构。所提蒸馏对齐方法在无显式任务监督下提升了文本版表现，甚至在比对齐时更复杂的样本上也有效。

Conclusion: VQA式对齐留下了未被利用的跨模态迁移潜力，当前VL模型仅实现弱多模态；通过显式蒸馏视觉嵌入到文本嵌入可激发强多模态能力。

Abstract: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

</details>


### [952] [P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25474)
*Lev Stambler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在冻结决策模型上加入无训练测试时搜索：让模型对完整候选答案的"正确性"给出Yes概率，并用单答案编辑或联合优化搜索更高分答案，普遍提升准确率，逻辑谜题上精确全对题数提升最多（Qwen3.8-27B从2到30，15倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型通常只对每个选项输出概率，缺乏在整个答案空间上的一致性优化；希望在不训练、不改动模型的前提下，利用模型自身的Yes/No判断提升答案质量，尤其是需要所有空都对的严格正确性任务。

Method: 把候选完整答案喂给模型，读取其回答"该答案正确吗"时Yes的概率作为打分函数；在答案空间做测试时搜索，两种方式：一次只改一个答案（局部编辑）或同时改动多个答案的联合优化；无需任何训练或参数更新，也可仅通过公开API对闭源模型使用。

Result: 所有模型与测试集上准确率均提升。128个逻辑谜题上Qwen3.8-27B精确全对从2增至30（15倍），每空准确率27.8%→48.5%。47个谜题共享集上，用各模型自身Yes/No分数搜索，StartLux Instant、Perplexity Decider、Clef、JEV每空准确率提升4.0–13.0个百分点；三随机种子平均的全对题数分别从10→35、9→26、2→11、9→31.7。

Conclusion: 模型对"答案是否正确"的自评概率可作为有效搜索目标，测试时搜索是一种简单、无需训练、可跨模型甚至黑盒API使用的通用性能提升手段，对严格全对指标收益最大。

Abstract: Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

</details>


### [953] [From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25496)
*Shashank Shekhar,Laurent Jeanpierre,Abdel-Illah Mouaddib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"语义感知决策框架"，将候选动作的评估与执行显式分离：动作先在交互语境下被评估，再解析为实际执行结果，从而为交互语义提供显式表示层，且保持与标准MDP规划兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多人-AI系统中，候选动作并非直接执行，而是先由另一决策实体在可能不同的目标或决策模型下评估。标准决策理论直接在状态-动作对上定义转移动力学，把评估吸收进转移模型，无法显式表示这种交互，缺乏对交互语义的结构化刻画。

Method: 引入语义感知决策框架：候选动作被提出→在交互语境下评估→解析为执行结果。用联合动作语言与解释函数形式化，将每个联合动作和语境映射到语义结果；转移与奖励动力学由这些语义结果诱导，形成交互语义的显式表示层。语义结果作为可复用的组织单元，通过应用相关的评估机制实例化，并与人-AI共享自主场景（如建议、授权模式）结合实例化。

Result: 框架能捕捉建议（advisory）与授权（authorization）等交互模式，并说明交互语境如何影响决策；同时该形式化与标准MDP规划保持兼容，无需修改底层规划算法即可分离指定语境相关评估与执行动力学。

Conclusion: 该工作为交互语义提供了结构化的规范接口，使语境相关评估与执行动力学解耦，可跨不同交互实例复用，并在共享人-AI自主场景中保持与MDP规划的兼容性。

Abstract: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

</details>


### [954] [Assessing the AI Readiness of Construction Datasets: A Multidimensional Operational Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25499)
*Xiaoyu Hou,Bo Xiao,Abdolmajid Erfani,Ronghua Xu,Yu Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个建筑业数据集AI就绪度评估框架，涵盖元数据完整性、数据质量与代表性、数据治理与可访问性、AI实用性四个维度共30项属性，用属性打分、适用性筛查及自动+人工校验，评估了21个公开数据集，平均就绪度0.879。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑领域AI应用快速增长，对可用于可靠建模、评估和复用的数据集需求上升；但建筑业数据集在文档、质量、治理和评估支持方面差异很大，缺乏一致的AI就绪度评价标准。

Method: 构建"Construction Dataset AI Readiness Framework"，包含四维度30项属性；采用属性特定评分、适用性筛查以及自动化与人工相结合的验证方式；在7类数据类型共21个公开数据集上进行评估。

Result: 总体就绪度得分在0.720至0.964之间，均值0.879；混合验证中自动建议与人工核实得分的一致率为90.5%。

Conclusion: 该框架可对异构建筑业数据集进行一致性评估并识别就绪度差距，有助于数据集的可靠开发、评估与复用。

Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in construction has increased the demand for datasets suitable for reliable model development, evaluation, and reuse. However, construction datasets vary widely in documentation, quality, governance, and evaluation support, and consistent criteria for assessing AI readiness remain limited. This study develops a Construction Dataset AI Readiness Framework with 30 attributes across four dimensions: Metadata Completeness, Data Quality and Representativeness, Data Governance and Accessibility, and AI Utility. The framework uses attribute-specific scoring, applicability screening, and automated and manual verification. It was evaluated using 21 publicly available datasets across seven data-type groups. Overall readiness scores ranged from 0.720 to 0.964, with a mean of 0.879. Hybrid verification achieved 90.5% agreement between automated suggestions and manually verified scores. The framework supports consistent assessment of heterogeneous construction datasets and identification of readiness gaps.

</details>


### [955] [Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25501)
*Rolf Drechsler,Christina Plump*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"形式化养育"(Formal Raising, FR)，将选定道德价值表示为可机器检查的显式属性，使其参与LLM从能力获取到评估与行动选择的整个发育过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图灵"儿童机器"构想与近期"模型养育"工作主张道德价值应与能力获取同步发展而非事后对齐；但价值需要可形式化、可检查的表达方式才能参与发育过程。

Method: 构建基于C语言的推理框架：候选行动按优先排序的伦理属性进行评估，冲突依给定顺序解决，严格规则不可推翻，欠定情形显式报告；例外通过备选方案比较自然涌现而非硬编码；并提出受PSL启发的属性层以刻画状态与时序要求。

Result: 给出覆盖生命、诚实、伤害、隐私、自主性及严格规则等冲突的示例，并说明属性层如何整合进养育流程。

Conclusion: 形式化、可检查的道德属性可作为养育式LLM发展的可行基础，为价值与能力协同发展提供框架性方案。

Abstract: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

</details>


### [956] [Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25516)
*Jithin VG,Ditto PS*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍并评估 Bud agent runtime 内置的上下文压缩机制 Bud ContextCompact 2.0：通过把旧对话轮次替换为摘要来缓解上下文窗口溢出，在召回评测和 SWE-bench Verified 端到端任务上均带来可测量的收益，但收益依赖触发时机与会话时间预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮 agent 会话会超出（尤其是小模型与受限推理系统的）上下文窗口。压缩虽可让会话继续，但有损、需额外一次模型调用，且效果取决于何时执行，因此需要实证评估其收益与边界。

Method: 在两种设置下评估 Bud ContextCompact 2.0：(1) 在录制的 agent 会话上做召回问答，比较压缩至 16K、截断与完整 32K 历史，模型为 1.2B 与 9B；(2) 用 27B 推理模型在 49K token 窗口上端到端跑 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务（556 个评分会话），并做阈值触发时机研究与 45 分钟会话预算实验。

Result: 召回任务：1.2B 模型准确率 0.335（截断 0.247，完整历史 0.176，p<0.001）；9B 从 0.515 升至 0.577（p=0.04）。SWE-bench：长会话解决率 41%→53%（+12.3 点，95% CI +1.6~+23.0，McNemar p=0.043），短会话无变化，每个已解决任务 token 减少 13%，总成本持平。无压缩时主要失败并非历史溢出，而是推理轮耗尽了历史剩余空间。局限：45 分钟预算下收益消失（摘要中位耗时 161 s）；仅在触发足够早、留有余量时有效；8B 模型约十轮后提交（5–8K token）从未需要压缩。

Conclusion: 压缩对小模型与长会话有实质收益，但需早触发并为其时间成本做预算；作者认为在同等模型与窗口下准确率结论可跨硬件（含 CPU 推理）迁移，而时间成本随硬件变化必须单独核算。

Abstract: Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

</details>


### [957] [When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25522)
*Dean Ariel,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"目标位移"（goal displacement）概念并构建GDB基准，衡量对话LLM用维护人格/情感内容替代目标实质帮助的失败，含230场景、9领域、18模型、4134条人工评分回复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话LLM常以温暖安抚回应，却不推进用户既定目标；既有评估缺乏对这一失败模式的可复现诊断工具。

Method: 构建2×2分类法（硬约束×情绪困扰），区分"未能直面不可行目标/未能结合共情与实用指导"与"反向位移"（未被请求的解题替代情感支持）；采用删除检验评分法，剔除纯支持性句子后评估是否仍有实质帮助；用因子探针区分目标位移与社会阿谀；分析OLMo-2匹配检查点的SFT与DPO效果。

Result: 独立评分者与作者分数加权κ=0.82；陷阱位移0.0%–37.7%，与Arena Elo强负相关（ρ=-0.706, n=15）；反向位移达41.9%；高复杂低压力条件下阿谀35.0%但位移仅7.5%，两者关联弱；OLMo-2位移在SFT后仍52.3%，DPO后降至13.8%。

Conclusion: GDB提供可复现的用户目标推进诊断，支持模型比较、后训练评估与回归测试；数据集与评分标准以CC-BY-4.0、评估代码以MIT开放。

Abstract: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

</details>


### [958] [StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25525)
*Jiarong Liang,Xueguang Ma,Dongfu Jiang,Yuxuan Zhang,Ping Nie,Wenhu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 StopLoss：一个小型外部监控器，从已完成的轨迹及其验证结果中学习识别失败，在运行可能失败时提前终止以节省成本，且不改变执行器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常会在注定通不过验证的运行上持续消耗资源，而请前沿大模型做监督本身也很昂贵。

Method: 用最终结果给较早的局部窗口打标签，微调一个语言模型对最近若干工具调用步骤做单次前向打分；再在成功运行上校准阈值，将分数转为中止决策。基于 GPT 系列 SWE-rebench 轨迹训练，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Pro 子集上，以 GPT 和 Claude 为执行器，与六个通用判别器对比。

Result: 结果监督使首次检查时的失败预测从接近随机提升到有效信号，单次检查成本比所有被测判别器低 1–2 个数量级；相对把所有任务跑完，Verified 上每个保留解的成本降低 4.5%（保留 99% 成功运行），Pro 子集最高降 31%，Qwen3-8B 骨干可达 48%，四种设置下成本均低于所有判别器策略。

Conclusion: 经结果训练的小型监控器可把失败识别做得足够廉价，使提前停止本身即可收回成本。

Abstract: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

</details>


### [959] [From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25530)
*Jiayan Yang,Ad Feelders,Arno Siebes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出一个不确定性感知的前瞻性排班框架，将患者风险预测的不确定性显式建模，并用CVaR度量极端短缺风险，再嵌入小时级滚动时域排班策略，在MIMIC-IV上实现成本-短缺的更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EHR/重症数据库机器学习模型多只以判别性指标评估，缺少将概率风险估计系统转化为真实运营决策（班次刚性、招聘延迟）的方法，存在预测到决策的转化鸿沟。

Method: 不改动上游预测模型，构建“转化层”：显式建模动态预测不确定性，用CVaR评估极端短缺暴露，避免朴素确定性聚合与固定安全缓冲；将风险校准后的需求信号嵌入小时级滚动时域排班策略，生成延迟约束下的排班决策。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV真实轨迹上，相比确定性与纯反应式基线，获得更优的成本-短缺权衡；Pareto前沿分析显示不确定性感知需求构造会随安全偏好改变资源配置；压力测试表明在校准漂移等系统性预测偏差下仍具运营鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过形式化这一“转化层”，为将概率性AI输出安全整合进高风险医疗运营系统提供了有原则、透明的路径。

Abstract: Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays.
  This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions.
  Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.

</details>


### [960] [Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25540)
*Junhao Liu,Tianxiao Li,Yongxian Wu,Ziheng Duan,Ren Li,Jing Zhang,Martin Renqiang Min*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出两阶段审计方法（PT2D + Token-Class Redaction），揭示agentic LLM在TCR-pMHC结合预测中的"科学推理"实为工具结果中隐藏的标签捷径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic LLM通过外部证据进行科学预测时，串行化的工具结果可能包含数据集标识符、模板痕迹等隐藏标签捷径，造成"表面成功"而缺乏真实生物学推理，现有评估难以识别此类风险。

Method: 两阶段审计：阶段一PT2D（Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition）将标签预测性模式定位到单个工具结果，避免拼接轨迹中的信号稀释；阶段二Token-Class Redaction对定位出的捷径做反事实测试，检验冻结的LLM是否依赖该捷径。以TCR-pMHC结合预测为案例。

Result: 工具增强显著优于无证据基线，表面看似LLM学会了利用科学证据；但PT2D将最强信号定位到某工具结果中的标识符，遮蔽这些标识符后性能降至随机水平。

Conclusion: 隐藏标签捷径可伪装成科学推理或发现，在信任基准提升前应进行源级（source-level）审计。

Abstract: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace.
